tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 1 mu tig gling gi dga' ston

tei:publicationStmt.tei:distributor: This OCR'd text was generated using UCB's Namsel-OCR application on Jul 23, 2014 at the request of the Tibetan Buddhist Resource Center. Please note this document has not been finalized and is subject to additional changes and corrections.

tei:div.tei:p: ma tig gling gi dga' son/she tamacho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyurakhang gis bsgrigs/mi rigs dpe skrun khang /
mu tig gling gi dga' ston/mcho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyur khang gis bsgrigs/mi rigs dpe skrun khang /

〈nye bcar rtsom mdzod 〉rtsom sgrig chogs mi/gtso sgrig pa/ dge gnyen/gtso sgrig pa gzhon pa/ tshe mgon/ bla ma lha/lag bstar rtsom sgrig pa/ hūṃ chen/ gcod pa klu rgyal/tshe ring bkra shis/ phag mo tshe brtan/

dkar chagadage gnyen/rig gnas ljon dbang la smon pa/ ( 1 )rig 'jin/le lo rnying zhen gyi bsam blor bsnun pa'i mda' mo/ ( 1 )chos mcho sgrol ma/ bod kyi deng rabs sgrung gtam thad kyi bsam gzhig (6)ban de mkhar/bod rang mtshan pa'i mdzes rtog lta ba dang deng rabs rtsom rig(12)bod mi'i las dbang dang deng rabs rtsom rig (18)dge gnyen/ngag rgyun rtsom rig dang rtsom rig mkhan gyi brtsams chos bar phan tshun shan zhugs tshul gleng ba/ (24)spel stangs kyi rtseg rim che khag gsum gyi thad nas ngag rgyun rtsom rig la dpyad pa/ (38)— 1 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/yul skad dang ngag rgyun rtsom rig (61)bdud lha rgyal/snyan ngagad khyod nam zhig ngu shub las thar thub/ (77)nga da dung yid mi tshim/ (80)ljang bu/ma bklags tshad med kyi sgrung gtam/ (88)go bder btang ba'i rin chen rgyal po/ (91)lha lung mcho/〈rkang lam phra mo〉bklags pa'i tshor ba 'ga'/ (97)yon tan/srol rgyun dang deng rabs/ (100)'o bzhugs/bod kyi byis pa'i rtsom rig gi rtsom lus skor gleng ba/ (107)zhi bde nyi ma/mi yi rin thang / (115)'phrin khyung /skyo 'os la ngu bro ba'i rdog phres lci mo zhig (120)khyung thar rgyal/nga tsho'i rtsom rig gi mi 'dang sa gang na yod/ (123)che grub/snyan ngag thad kyi bsam gzhig (129)— 2 —

dkar chagamyong tshor rigs shig gi gsed 'grol/ (134)bya gzhung dbyangs bha/khong 'dar/ (146)skyabs chen bde grol/slar yang bod kyi snyan ngag gsar par 'khyug tsam lta ba/ (153)me lce/blo 'byed bsam blod bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig gis nam yang g.yol mi rung ba'i brjod gzhi zhig (159)skar tshogs rnam par bkra ba'i mtshan mo/ (166)bya mdo don grub che ring /snyan ngag gsar ma'i dus skabs/ (176)bkra shis rgyal/〈byu ru'i las dbang〉gis byin pa'i dmigs bsal tshor ba/ (180)byang skar/'u tshor blo 'byed byed dgos don ci red/ (184)kun dga' ye shes/ thun min gyi myong rtog thun min gyi blos bslangs/ (188)gdugs dkar che ring /‘‘ra lo'i’’snang brnyan dang 'brel ba'i gtam/ (1smo)che ring rdo rje/‘‘sems chung sde ba'i’’bsam gzhig than thun/ (207)— 3 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/mgon po skyabs/kha h+phi kha dang kho'i sgrung gtam gyi khyad chos rags tsam gleng ba/ (218)sha bo skyid/pad ma tshe brtan gyi sgrung thung〈gza' nyi ma〉bklags pa/ (lnga )a bu/don grub rgyal bsam blo pa yin min skor gleng ba/ (237)ltung bshags dang gsal bshad/ da dung sems khral re gnyis/ (244)rgya mcho 'bum/rtog btags kyi yid brnyan/ (258)mjug byang / (73)

rig gnas ljon dbang la smon pa/da 〈nye bcar rtsom mdzod〉spel 'go tshugs par zhus pa/nye ba'i lo 'ga'i nang / tang krung dbyang gis rang re'i rgyal khab kyi gsar 'gyur dril bsgrags las rigs la yang dang yang du‘‘nye bcar gsum’’gyi re 'dun te/ ‘‘dngos gnas dang nye bar bcar ba/ 'tsho ba dang nye bar bcar ba/ mang tshogs dang nye bar bcar ba’’bcas bton zhing / sngon bas bzang bar rgyal khab kyi‘‘dpal yon rnam gsum’’gong du spel bar zhabs phyi dgos tshul nan ston gnang phyin/ gsar 'gyur dril bsgrags las don tsam gyis ma zad par/ rig gnas las don spyi nas kyang thad kar spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi dgos mkho tshim par bya dgos pa'i re 'dun bton/da lan nged tshags par khang gis〈mtsho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyur〉spel 'go tshugs nas lo ngo55'khor bar rten 'brel zhu ba'i tshul gyis〈nye bcar rtsom mdzod〉ces pa'i ma ldan deb phreng 'di spel ba'i 'go bzang /ri ri ra ri deb phreng 'di'i khag dang po la deb bzhi 'dus shing / rang re'i tshags par du lo mang po'i ring bkod zin pa'i gsar 'gyur brtsams chos dang rdom shaṃg

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/brtsams chos dang rtsom rig dpyad mol dang rtsom rig mi sna ngo sprod bcas phyogs kyi rtsom yag shos las tshod 'dzin nges can zhig yod par phyogs sgrig byas yod pa yin/ de yang / 'di ni lo mang po'i yun du rim pa so so'i tang srid dbu khrid dang zhing chen phyi nang gi rgya che'i rig gnas las gnyer pa dang mi dmangs mang tshogs kyis nga tshor rgyab skyor thugs khur gnang bar drin lan ma brjed pa'i sems tsam mtshon pa'i legs skyes su‘‘me tog chung yang lha rdzas’’tshul du phul ba yin/ 〈dri bzang thul ba'i sman ljongs〉ni sgrung gtam dang lhug rtsom dang snyan ngag sogs kyis grub pa'i rtsom rig brtsams chos kyi deb cig yin/ spyir bod yig tu rtsom rig spel ba'i srol rgyun ring yang / srol gsar 'byed pa'i phyogs nas da dung 'bad dgos par gzhigs nas khyad chos nges can ldan pa'i brtsams chos btus nas bsgrigs pa yin la/ nang sgos ring thung gi tshad tshags par du 'god 'tsham la sngon gyi srol lam yangs bskyed la phan par dmigs nas lhug rtsom gyis gtso ba bzos yod cing / 'di ni srol rgyun ldan pa'i rig khag de phun sum je tshogs su gtong ba'i 'dun pa mtshon tsam lags/ 〈nags klong khu byug 'du gnas〉ni deng rabs bod yig gi rtsom rig gsar rtsom thad grub 'bras mngon gsal blangs dang len bzhin pa'i rtsom pa po ngo sprod dang khong rnam pa'i 'thus tshab tu rung ba'i rtsom re gnyis ngo sprod tshul du bsgrigs pa yin/ 〈mu tig gling gi dga' ston〉nang du rtsom rig dpyad mol gyi rigs bsgrigs yod/ snga ma bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig lo rgyus 'bri bar mthun rkyen bzos pa yin pas rig khag gsar ba bskrun par gzhigs pa dang / phyi ma bod yig brgyud pa'i rtsom rig dpyad mol da rung zhan pa la skul spel dang / bod du da rung rtsom rig mtha' dpyad(sprar+hamikā༈ sprar+ha7ro/))kyi rig khag chags med pa de 'thus tshang yong ched bsgrigs —༄2 —

rig gnas ljon dbang la smon pa/pa yin/ dzñogom stabs dang zhabs rjes〉ni gsar 'gyurno gyi rtsom btus te/bod yig steng nas da rung gsar 'gyur rig pa'i rig khag dar med par gzhigs nas 'di'i lam srol 'byed par mthun rkyen tsam bzos pa yin/rtsom rig ni dmangs spyi la dbang ba'i khyad chos 'dzin zhing / mi dmangs kyi rlabs po che ba'i spyi tshogs lag len dang phun sum tshogs pa'i 'tsho ba rol stangs dang yid du 'ong ba'i chags sdang rnam 'gyur bcas ni rtsom rig gi brjod don thams cad kyi 'byung khungs yin la/ 'di dag gsal lhang brnyan 'dra dang bcas par mtshon pa'i 'gan babs khur 'dug pa ni rtsom rig ljon dbang nyid kyi tshe dpal nyams med ring du 'dzin pa'i rgyu mtshan du'ang gyur yod/ rtsom rig gi ngo bo nyid ci yin pa la kha tshon gcod sla ba zhig min na yang / rim byon mkhas mchog rnams kyis yang yang dpyad nas bye ma las gser btsags yong ba'i gnad rnyed pa lta na/ rtsom rig ni ngag gi sgyu rtsal la brten nas dngos gnas las lta ba mtho ba dang / dngos gnas las go ba zab pa dang / dngos gnas las 'bur du thon pa dang / dngos gnas las 'tsho ba'i don dam rtogs pa'i tshul du mtshon 'god byung ba na/ yong khungs dmangs yin la 'phrod yul yang dmangs yin pa'i nang rkyen gnas phyir/ de ni spyi tshogs 'phel 'gyur gyi 'phar rtsa brtag gnas shig dang dmangs kyi 'tsho bar blang dor bslab pa'i gnas shig yin la/ 'gro ba mir ltung shan gyi gshis kyang zhor du ldan pa'i‘‘rnam shes’’de ya rabs dpal yon can gyi phyogs su ngang gis 'dren pa'i yon tan bskyang yong ba yin/ srid zhi gnyis las mngon srid spyi tshogs kyi don skyong bar spras brjod dang 'khyog brjod kyi sgyu rtsal thabs lam nas gnas tshul du gnas lugs ston 'gyur ba ni nyid kyi khyad chos lhang nge ba zhig red/ gsar 'gyur la'ang dmangs spyi la — 3 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/dbang ba'i khyad chos yod cing / brjod bya 'dzin stangs kyi cha nas brnyan 'dra dang bcas par mtshon dgos pa'i nges pa med pa dang / spras brjod dang 'khyog brjod dang sgyu 'phrul lta bu'i nyams snang mi bzo ba dang / dngos gnas las lta ba mtho ba dang go ba zab pa dang 'bur du thon pa dang 'tsho ba'i don dam rtogs pa bcas thad nas rtsom rig las dma' ba tsam las shin tu nye mtshungs yin srid/ deng gi dus 'dir ga 'dra'i yag par snang zhing yid du 'ong ba'i don dag la bsngags skul gtong rgyu yod pa/ ga 'dra'i rin thang ldan zhing gzengs su 'don 'tshal ba'i don dag dar spel gtong rgyu yod pa/ ga 'dra'i ma rabs tha shal gyi don dag la mtshang 'byin lcag gzhus gtong rgyu yod pa/ 'di dag ni gsar 'gyur gyi dmigs bya yin la rtsom rig gi dmigs bya yang yin pas/ 'di gar 'dus pa'i rtsom rig brtsams chos dang gsar 'gyur brtsams chos kyang 'di nang bzhin lag bstar byas pa'i grub 'bras 95gabasdo/‘‘nye bcar gsum’’zer ba'i dmigs gnad de dngos gnas su snang ba'i skabs bab dgos mkho dang 'tsho ba las thon pa'i skabs bab dgos mkho dang mang tshogs la phrad pa'i skabs bab dgos mkho tshim par byed pa la kha gtad yod pa red/ nye bcar gyi ldog zla rgyang bkyed pa yin nges/ nye bar bcar ba'i dmigs gnad kyi ldog zla'i don ni skabs bab dang thad kar gyi dgos mkhor brtsi 'jog dang len mi byed pa la go / gal te khyed kyis bris pa'i rtsom mam gnyer bzhin pa'i rig gnas gang de dngos gnas dang 'tsho ba dang mang tshogs dang rgyang bkyed cing / skabs su bab pa'i thad kar dgos gtug la brtsi 'jog dang len ma byas tshe/ phan mi thogs pa min pa'i dbang du btang na yang / gos lham phyi nas za 'phrug langs sar 'brad pa dang — 4 —

rig gnas ljon dbang la smon pa/gnyis su med pas/ gang dang su yis dmigs btsags nas khyed kyi grub 'ji rmo tsho ring 'ji tsho ni pa 'ag rdzo'abras la ma nga chung byas pa man na yang / dngas gnas dang 'cha ba dang mang tshogs kyis kyang khyed kyi las ka der brtsi 'jog dang len thad nas rgyang bkyed srid pa red/ yang na/ ya rabs su snyeg pa ni mi'i rang gshis dang spyi tshogs kyi ngo bo dang sbrags mar gnas pa'i khyad chos shig yin srid mod/ 'on te de dang 'gal zla gcig gyur gyi tshul du mi'i rigs la da dung ma rabs ltung shan gyi rang gshis dang spyi tshogs 'phel phyogs dang phyin ci log pa zhig kyang lus dang grib ma ji bzhin yod pas/ rig gnas kyi las ka thams cad po yar 'phel sngon thon gyi phyogs dang mthun pa'i nges pa med/ 'di bzhin du nye bcar gyi rig gnas las ka la'ang lhad skyon mi 'dres pa dang rdzun 'khrul mi 'byung ba zhig ga la yin/ yin na yang bcar nye ba'i dbang du dang len 'thob sla ba dang 'thob pa khyab che ba'i rkyen gyis lhad skyon sel mgyogs pa dang de'i phyir bden rdzun brdar myur ba'i khyad chos 'dzin pas/ yar 'phel sngon thon gyi chos can dang yang bcar nye ba yin srid/ ‘‘lag len ni bden lugs bsher ba'i gzhan bkag tshad gzhi 'ba' zhig yin’’zhes pa'i legs bshad 'di nas kyang / bden pa rnyed dgos na bcar nye min dang lag len dang 'brel dam min bcas la rag las yod pa mngon shugs gnyis nas shes/ de yang / rnam pa gang yang rung ba'i rig gnas shig chags zin pa na/ de la 'chun skul gnyis kyi byed nus yod pa yin/ srog gcod mi rung zhes pa'i rig gnas lta ba 'di chags phyin/ mi gsod rta 'ded dam mi shi rta 'gyel lta bu'i nyes dmigs 'gog pa dang / skye khams kyi dngos po kun dang mdza' mthun ngang 'tsho ba rol nas phyi ma'i phyi mar 'tsho rten skyong ba'i thad nas 'chun rkyen du 'gyur srid/ yin na yang / rig gnas de 'dra'i khor yugado nadī nya rjos

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/skyong ba dang bshas tshong rgyag pa lta bu'i lag len la tshod 'dzin byed pa myong grub yod pa de bzhin/ 'chun rkyen des phyin log la tshod 'dzin byed pa tsam gyis ma zad par yar 'phel la'ang tshod 'dzin byed srid/ 'on te gtso bo phyin log la tshod 'dzin pa red/ skul rkyen des ya rabs la skul 'ded tsam gyis ma zad par ma rabs la'ang skul 'ded byed srid/ 'on te gtso bo ya rabs la skul 'ded byed pa red/ de'i phyir mi dmangs kyi dngos gnas lag len dang 'tsho bar bcar nye ba'i rig gnas spel na/ skul rkyen gyi drang phyogs yon tan ches cher gtong ba dang 'chun rkyen gyi ldog phyogs byed nus las sgrol bar 'gro ba'i phan yon de rgyang bkyed pa'i rig gnas las ldab 'gyur gyis bzang ba shin tu gsal/ rgyu mtshan 'di'i dbang du nye bar bcar ba'i rig gnas spel na ni yar 'phel sngon thon gyi ngo bo dang yang thag nye ba red/ nye bcar rig gnas spel ba'i mi la rgyang bkyed rig gnas spel ba'i mi las rig gnas dang lag len byang tshad thad kyi blang bya de bas mtho ba red/ kho tsho rig gnas la mkhas shing rig gnas lag len la 'jon thang ldan dgos pa ma zad/ yig thog gam rigs gzhung tsam gyis mi chog par/ spyi tshogs la brtag mkhas shing spyi tshogs lag len nang thad kar zhugs nas skabs bab don bya yag 'khyongs la'ang 'jon thang ldan dgos/ rgyang bkyed rig gnas gnyer stangs las mang shos de mi sger gyis yun ring las bya'i rnam pa can zhig yin la/ nye bcar rig gnas gnyer stangs las mang shos ni sde khag gam de bas khyab che ba'i khongs kyi mnyam las la brten 'dug de la khab gsog nas snyung bu dang snyung bu gsog nas gri lta bu'i brgyud rim zhig kyang rtag tu snang / de lta na tsag tsig gsog nas ma lag can zhig skyong ba dang / skabs phrad gnyer nas yun ring la ༵na spra zhig skrun pa/ rags rob gsog nas zhib rgyas can zhig bzo

rig gnas ljon dbang la smon pa/ba'i gnyer rim zhig brgyud kyi yod pa'ang nyid kyi rang bzhin dbang du gyur yod/ da lan nged tshags par khang gis〈nye bcar rtsom mdzod〉bsgrigs pa'ang 'di lugs su lad mo byas pa yin/nye bcar rig gnas spel rgyu de rig gnas ma lag gsar pa zhig skrun pa'i 'jug sgo gal chen zhig yin srid/ rang don 'khyongs pa'i khyim tshang zhig la mtshon na/ dus srol yul srol dang 'tsham pa'i nang nom phug nor dang ca ga ca lag 'dzoms dgos pa nang bzhin/ rgyal khab bam mi rigs shig gi cha nas bshad kyang / dus rabs dang mthun zhing 'dzam gling mi rigs gzhan dag las rang tshugs lcogs pa'i dpal 'byor dang rig gnas dang tshan rtsal gyi stobs 'byor zhig cis kyang dgos pa red/ de ltar yin na da gzod dza drag che ba'i spyi tshogs 'gran rtsod nang nas yun brtan pham min gyi go gnas shig 'dzin nges/ rang re'i rgyal khab kyis gral rim 'thab rtsod gnad du bzung ba'i jus chen bsgyur nas dpal 'byor thad kyi 'dzugs skrun lte ba byas te bcos bsgyur sgo 'byed kyi jus chen lag bstar byas tshun/ dpal 'byor dang rig gnas dang tshan rtsal bcas kyi phyogs gang mang nas 'dzam gling yongs kyi mig ldan ha las pa'i byas rjes bzhag yod/ da lta'i krung go ni 'dzam gling dpal 'byor gong spel dang zhi bde rgyun skyong thad kyi sgul stobs 'byung gnas shig tu gyur yod/ 'on kyang 'phel rgyas su phyin che ba'i rgyal khab dang bsdur na da rung te bag mi chung ba yod pa dang / nang sgos dpal 'byor 'phar snon 'byung stangs dang rang bdag shes bya'i thon dbang gis dpal 'byor dang tshan rtsal la bzo ba'i shugs rkyen thad nas mngon gsal du zhan pa yin phyir/ tshan rig dang mthun pa'i 'phel rgyas lta ba lag tu bstar bar do snang byed pa dang / gron chung can gyi spyi tshogs skrun par do shaṃng 7bye1 pa/

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/gsar 'byed can gyi spyi tshogs skrun par do snang byed pa bcas kyi byed phyogs srid jus rab dang rim par bton zhing lag len byed bzhin pa'i sgang yin/rang re'i bod khul dag la mtshon na/ gzhung po ti ga tshod ldan pa dang bcu phrag rig gnas kyi gzi brjid gang 'dra yin par 'ud sgrog bskyar zlos tshul gyis yid tshims par 'dug pa'i skabs shig min tshod red/ de dag ni bran g.yog spyi tshogs nas bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin spyi tshogs su zhugs pa dang / snga thog gi 'thog sgrug dpal 'byor dang gshor rngon dpal 'byor nas rang byung cha rkyen la brten pa'i zhing phyugs dpal 'byor(rang byung dpal 'byor zhes kyang bya)la zhugs skabs/ mes da—bon rnam gsum gtsos pa'i sngon byon dam pa rnams kyis snga bzang rgyun skyong dang gzhan bzang dpe g.yar dang gzhi de nas gsar 'byed byas par brgyud nas rang rigs la bzhag pa'i nang nom phug nor red/ des na bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin spyi tshogs nas ma rtsa ring lugs spyi tshogs su zhugs pa dang / rang byung dpal 'byor nas rlangs sgul glog sgul 'phrul chas sogs kyis mtshon pa'i bzo las spyi tshogs su zhugs skabs/ 'u cag gis rig gnas nang nom phug nor dang ca ga ca lag ci zhig bsrel yod ces pa na/ yid mug mug dang zhe skyo skyo tshal du 'dug pa'am a tshags can kha spyor lar theg ra mizi mo rtsar no༅ ༷jushas kyas ngad cag la da 'dra ma ldan kyang chag lta bu' lkug rdzu 'dabs pa las brjod kyi mi 'dug ma rtsa ring lugs nas spyi tshogs ring lugs spyi tshogs su zhugs 'go brtsams shing / bzo las dpal 'byor nas 'phrin sprod lag rtsal dang yi/nga rtags lag rtsal dang skye dngos lag rtsal sogs lag rtsal mtho gsar gyis mtshon pa'i shes rig dpal 'byor ram phyi'i bzo las spyi tshogs kyang zer bar 'jug bzhin pa'i deng rabs/ rang re'i rig gnas nang nom phug nor dang ca spya ca 'a ga gang ci ba'/ga cing bsrel yod ces pa na/ phal cher ha las

rig gnas ljon dbang la smon pa/pa'i tshul du 'dug pa las smra sgo 'gag 'gro/ de'i phyir/ bod khul la mtshon na nges mkho rig gnas dang thun mong rig gnas thad nas spyi tshogs la bu lon steng du skyed ka brtsegs pa'i chad stong mang drags song / rig gnas rgyun skyong thad nas thabs zhan pa dang / dpe g.yar thad nas lam dog pa/ gsar 'byed thad nas stobs gnyom pa bcas kyi gnas tshul mngon 'dug yin na'ang khag 'di gzhan la 'gel ba dang 'khang ra byas nas ci yang mi 'ong /thabs lam 'dems mkhas la gtsigs 'dzin byas nas gzhan las 'bad brtson snying rus che bar mchong skyod lta bu'i 'phel rgyas bsnyeg dgos na/ thog mar rig khag gsar ba dang gzhogs gtogs yan lag rig tshan gsar pa 'thus tshang du gtong rgyu 'di ni rig gnas spyi'i rgyun skyong dang dpe g.yar dang gsar 'byed bcas kyi rmang gzhi'i gnad dam pa red/skabs bab dgos mkho dang dngos gnas lag len las bton pa'i blang bya ltar na/ spyi tshogs ring lugs tshong khrom dpal 'byor gyi spyi tshogs khor yug 'di nas nges par khrims lugs la gtsigs chen byed pa dang / dpal 'byor phan yon la gtsigs chen byed pa/ mi'i bar gyi rton srung la gtsigs chen byed pa/ mi'i spus spyi dang rig gnas tshan rtsal 'jon thang la gtsigs chen byed pa bcas kyi blang bya sngon bas mtho bar gyur yod pas/ rig khag gsar pa'i 'dzugs spel de'ang sngon bas kha tsha dgos gtug tu gyur yod/ des na nga tshos ji ltar gzhal yod rgyu stobs dang mi stobs legs par spyad nas go skabs ma shor bar rig gnas gsar pa'i 'dzugs spel la mchong skyod lta bu'i 'phel rgyas 'byung 'jug pa ni mi rigs spyi'i lo rgyus las 'gan du gyur yod/ de 'dra'i dbang du rig khag gsar pa'i 'dzugs spel las don 'di dmangs spyis stobs sgril nas lag rub bya 'tshal ba zhig yin gyi/ rig gnas can nyung — 9 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/shas kyis a gsar rang mtho mtshon pa'i gnas ma yin/ 'on kyang rig gnas can gyis thad kar tshul gyi zhabs phyi brgyud pa na/ da gzod gdong mchong sna khrid kyi nus pa 'don 'gyur ba dang / gdong mchong sna khrid kyi nus pa gang legs shig 'don dgos na/ nges par thad kar gyi zhabs phyi'i nang nas 'khyongs dgos pa myong grub byung yod/ las rigs so sos rang babs lo rgyus las 'gan 'khur phod pa dang 'khur mkhas pa'i gzhi nas/ spyi yongs dang yun ring la bsam blo btang nas phan tshun mthun rkyen bzo ba dang phan tshun ram 'degs byed pa'i phyogs nas las rigs tha dad bar du mnyam las mi 'khyongs pa'i gnad 'gag bsal 'tshal/ dmangs spyi'i smyan byad de gsar 'gyur dril bsgrags las khungs kyis smyan byad kyi yon tan de sgo kun nas legs par skyong dgos la skabs don zin 'god kyi sbrags su gzhi rtsa'i rgyal khab skyong jus che shos te/ dpal 'byor spel ba lte bar bzung nas bcos bsgyur sgo 'byed rgyun 'khyongs byed pa dang / khrims la brten nas rgyal khab legs skyong yong ba/ tshan rtsal slob gso la brten nas rgyal khab dar rgyas yong ba/ pho mo 'dra mnyam yong ba/ rig gnas la brtsi 'jog dang 'jon ldan la brtsi 'jog yong ba/ 'char gzhi'i btsa' skye rgyun 'khyongs yong ba bcas phyogs nas babs 'gan gang lcogs kyis 'khur ba dang / ched las zhib 'jug las khungs dang ched las mkhas pa bar phan tshun sdongs grogs tshul du nye bar bcar ba'i rig gnas gnyer ba'i brgyud rim nang nas rig khag gsar pa'i 'dzugs spel la thun mong ma yin pa'i nus pa 'don par blo dang jus kyi bkod pa yod 'tshal snyam/ dzñonye bcar rtsom mdzod〉ni gong gleng ji bzhin lag len byas pa'i grub 'bras las sde dang po tsam yin/‘‘nye bcar gsum’’ni rig gnas gsar pa spel ba'am gzhi de nas sngon — 10 —

rig gnas ljon dbang la smon pa/thon rig gnas spel ba'i bgrod lam gtso shos shig lags/ nga tshos phyogs 'di'i gnas lugs snga char ma rtogs pa nas da lta gtsigs 'dzin byed pa dang /sngon du gzhan skul tshul nas da lta rang 'gul tshul du 'gyur bar da rung lag len dang gleng phyogs gnyis kyi cha nas 'bad 'tshal ba red/rig gnas gsar pa de sngon thon gyi thon skyed nus shugs dang thon skyed 'brel ba rmang gzhir bzung ba'i spyi tshogs lam lugs gsar pa'i rgyu rkyen sna tshogs nas 'byung ba yin srid/ des spyi tshogs kyi deng byung dgos mkho dang dmangasaspyi'i da lta'i khe phan la brtsi 'jog byed pa'i thad nas sngon thon rig gnas kyi rang bzhin dang mthun pa red/ nye bcar rig gnas yin na sngon thon rig gnas kyang yin pa'i nges pa med na yang / sngon thon rig gnas yin na des nye bcar gyi rang mtshan 'dzin pa ni bsnyon du med/ sngon thon rig gnas la deng gi mkho ba tshim la go chod pa/ 'byung 'gyur la'ang phan thogs shing gzhi btsun pa'i khyad chos yod kyang / 'on te des srol rgyun rig gnas dang mi rigs rig gnas kyi khyad chos 'gog pa zhig gtan nas min/dgos mkho che ba dang phan pa che ba la gzhigs nas gna' bzang deng spyod dang gzhan bzang rang spyod dang rnying bsal gsar 'don tshul du rang gi mtshan nyid 'dzin/ rgyu mtshan 'di'i dbang du sngon thon rig gnas kyis 'das zin lo rgyus las nyar tshags byung ba'i dge mtshan ldan pa'i rig gnas kun dang /'gro ba mi'i thun mong du dge mtshan ldan pa'i rig gnas kun la brtsi 'jog byed pas/ spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas su 'gro bar go chod min dang mi dmangs kyi rtsa ba'i phan khe dang mthun min 'di rtsa gnad du thug 'dug 'di dang 'gal ba'i rig gnas gang de ma smad ma dgag kyang nyid kyi tshe dpal 'tsho stobs rang shugs su nyams 'gro ba smra ci/ de 'dra'i dbang du spyi khog tsam nas bltas na/— 11 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/sngon thon rig gnas ni deng gi spyi tshogs kyi dmangs spyi(nyung shas la min)la mkho che ba dang go chod pa dang phan 'dogs thub pa bcas gcig sgril gyi rnam pa can zhig yin pa dang / gna' bzang deng spyod kyi rgyun skyong dang gzhan bzang rang spyod kyi dpe g.yar dang gzhi de nas dus kyi dgos dbang du gsar 'byed bcas gcig sgril gyi rnam pa can zhig yin pa dang / mi rigs kyi nges pa dang thun mong gi nges pa dang rtser son gyi nges pa gcig sgril gyi rnam pa can zhig yin pa bcas ni nyams myong las sgrub nus/dus rabs gsar pa la rig gnas gsar pa 'byung ba'i cha rkyen ldan 'dug rig gnas gsar pa'i sa bon ga sa kun tu 'debs bzhin pa la ni bsnyon du med/ bod khul dag tu slob grwa'i slob gso dang rgyang bsten slob gso dang spyi tshogs slob gso bcas kyi sa zhing da rung mu mthud du rgya skyed 'dugacha 'phrin lag rtsal dang gsar 'gyur smyan byad dang rig gnas theg byad gzhan dag la brten nas rig gnas gsar pa'i smyu gu ga sa kun nas 'khrungs bzhin pa'ang bsnyon du med/ bskal bzang 'di'i go skabs ma shor bar 'bad brtson sngon bas che bar btang na/ bzo las spyi tshogs nas phyi'i bzo las spyi tshogs su zhugs 'go brtsams pa'i dus 'dir/ rang re'i bod la'ang gzhan gyis yid smon 'chor ba'i rig gnas ljon dbang rgyas 'gyur zhing /de'i smin grol 'bras bzang gis rang rigs la phan pa 'byung ba tsam gyis ma zad par/ yul gru'i khyad chos dang mi rigs kyi khyad chos de sngon thon gyi ngo bo dang gcig sgril yong yod pa'i cha nas mi rigs gzhan dang rgyal khams gzhan la'ang sman par 'gyur nges/ dus rabs gsar pas mngal la rig gnas gsar pa 'dzin bzhin pa 'di la rdzun med pa yin na/ 'byung 'gyur gyi rig gnas gsar pas kyang dus rabs 'di la gzi brjid kyi mngon rtags legs — 12 —

rig gnas ljon dbang la smon pa/par brgyan yong /rig gnas skor gyi gnad don la da dung 'dzam gling khyon nas yang brtag yang dpyad kyi 'du 'dzi mtha' rdzogs dka' ba'i skabs 'dir/ gong du gleng ba dag ni bar skabs 'di'i slob sbyong las thob pa'i ngos zin tsam yin pas/ mkhyen ldan rnam pas dgongs 'char bdud rtsi mngar mo la skom pas re sgug ji bzhin lags/sgrig pa po dge gnyen gyis2006lo'i zla4ba'i ches15nyin zi ling nas/

le lo rnying zhen gyi bsam blor bsnun pa'i mda' mo/rig 'dzin/sgrung thung〈rkang lam phra mo〉zhes pa ni bod kyi na gzhon rtsom pa po don grub rgyal ma 'das sngon la brtsams pa ste/ de'i drang don la pha yul gyi rgan rgon tshos rang rang gi 'dod pa phyogs su 'khyer te yang na gna' mi tsho la skur ba 'khang ra byed pa dang / yang na ngo mtshar ba'i sgro mang po btags te bsngags brjod byas nas phan tshun rtsod pa'i rgyun ma chad mod kyi/ 'on kyang su rīyin yang rtag tu ja ro skam po la chu rgyag pa ltar rtsod gzhi de bskyar zlos byed pa las rkang lam de khod je snyom dang rgya je cher gtong rgyu ni bsam yul la'ang shar ma myong ba'i snang tshul rgod bro ba de bstan cing / nges pa'i don la ni rang cag pha mes kyis shul du bzhag pa'i dngos po dang bsam pa'i longs spyod de 'dzin skyong spel ba'i thabs la mi 'bad par rtsis med rtswa bzhin 'dod pa'am/yang na rnying zhen gyi dbang du gyur te shes rig gsar pa sdud pa'i sgo rang gis gcod pa'i snang tshul skyo rung ba ste mi phal mo che'i thun mong gi gcong nad du gyur pa'i mtshang de gsal rjen du bstan pa red/sgrung gtam 'di'i nang du rtsom pa pos 'bod pa'i tha snyad dang po'i tshul du pha yul gyi rgan rgon sos dal can te/ rus ldong can gyi rgan po dang gling tshang gi sgrung pa/ spyan ras gzigs kyi byin rlabs su sems pa'i rgan mo/ lha — 1 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/lung dpal rdor gyi rjes 'brangs pa/ ri dwags la mos pa'i rngon pa la sogs pas sde 'dabs kyi rkang lam phra mo de'i skor la lab gleng byas te/ la las rkang lam phra mo 'di 'dra zhig bton nas sa rtsub mo 'di 'dra ba zhig la gzhi bcas pa'i gna' mi tsho la mi rangs pa'i 'khang ra byed pa dang / la las de la ngo mtshar zhing 'dzin rgyu med pa'i sgro sna tshogs btags te bsngags brjod byed pa/yang la las de ni ri dwags kyi rgyu lam tsam mo zhes btang snyoms su bzhag pa'i tshul zhib tu bris pa la brten nas/ nga tsho la gzugs brnyan de dag gi nang nas de snga sku zhabs lu'u zhun gyi smyug rtse las thon pa'i rgan mo kyig cin lo the dang a0gzugs brnyan dang cha 'dra ba'i grib ma re zung yang mig lam du 'char yod/ de yang rgan mo kyig cin lo the zhes pa ni deng rabs kyi yod tshad gna' snga mo la mi do bar mthong ba'i rnying zhen can yin pas/ gsar byung bya dngos gang zhig mthong ma thag tu‘‘e/ da lta gna' la mi do’’zhes shugs ring nar nar 'byin pa zhig yin/ a'azhes pa ni gzugs po chung zhing sha rid pa/khro sla zhing lag 'gul bar dga' ba/ nam yin yang gdong la nga'o snyam pa'i mdangs shig shar 'dug kyang don du‘‘bsam pa'i rgyal kha sgom thabs’’la brten nas rang mthong rang che'am rang brnyas rang smad byed pa'i mi zhig yin pas/ de dang de 'dra ba ni rang rigs kyi khrod na ji 'dra'i mang po zhig yod pa red ang /rang mi rigs kyi shes rig 'phel ba'i lo rgyus la bltas tsa na rig stobs kyi shed mong gnam la zug pa'i sngon byon dran dbang tshogs kyis/ la las mthu stobs dpung gis mnga' khongs bskyed pa dang la las yang dag khrims kyis rgyal srid bskyangs/ 'ga' zhig rig pa'i 'phrul gyis phan bde bskrun/'ga' zhig gis gsang rab bod kyi skad du bsgyur ba la sogs thams cad son la nga ༷//rdo la tsho sa bye /rwaspro/

le lo rnying zhen gyi bsam blor bsnun pa'i mda' mo/med gsar gtod du 'khums pas dngos gnas brtson 'grus che zhing dpa' ngar ldan pa/ mig rgya yangs shing blo khog zab pa/ sngar srol rgyun 'dzin byed cing yon tan gsar pa sdud mkhas pa zhig yin la/ mi rabs nas mi rabs bar phyi rol yul gyi cha rkyen sdug pos blo ma pham/ dpa' ma zhum/ mgo ma smad par rang byung khams kyi kha gtad du langs nas 'tsho thub pa'i cha rkyen tog tsam ldan pa zhig yin tshe sa ji ltar tsub cing lam ji ltar dog kyang gnas bcas te gzhis chags pa red/ sgrung gtam nang gi sa cha'ang phal cher de 'dra zhig yin par snang ste rtsom mkhan gyis kyang rang gi sgrung gtam nang du bsngags brjod byas yod pa 'di ltar/ ‘‘rkang lam phra mo 'di gshags mkhan ni lha mi dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba gang zhig yin na yang ngo ma rlabs che ba red/ g.yang gzar ba'i brag ri 'di lta bu'i ngos nas lam btod rgyu'i blo skyes pa de ni blo gros kyi dwangs ma yin la blo de lag len tu btab pa ni gsar skrun gyi snying bcud red/ gya gyu'i rkang lam 'di khyon dog cing la gzar la shug pa mang na yang thengs dang por lam phran 'di'i thog tu rkang rjes bkod pa'i gna' mi de'i spobs pa ci 'dra mtho zhing snying stobs ci 'dra che ba dang / thengs dang por lam phran 'di ded nas ri rtse la slebs pa'i dpa' bo de'i blo rgya ci 'dra che zhing mig rgyang ci 'dra'i ring ba zhig red ang / rgyu mtshan ni gna' mi des mi'i lo rgyus thog gi lam dang po btod pa dang / dpa' bo des mi'i rigs la 'tsho ba'i lam dang ma 'ongs par bgrod pa'i lam dang po gsar gtod mdzad pa red’’ces pa ste/ bsngags brjod 'di 'dra ni 'ur bstod dang sgro 'dogs ma yin par don la gnas pa zhig red/ 'on kyang 'di tsam gyis yid tshim 'dod pa khengs te 'di las lhag pa deng phyin kyang 'byung mi srid par snyam nas rang lta mchog 'dzin dang ring zhen bag 'khums byas pa'i dbang gis rim 4/// la — (3) la ——

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/bzhin klad pa ni mkhregs po/ bsam blo ni rengs pa/ 'du shes ni rnying par gyur te pha mes kyis bzhag pa phag bzhin du za zhing khyi bzhin du srung ba'i brtul zhugs 'dzin pa las sngar med gsar gtod byed pa'i spobs pa nyams dmas su gyur/ ltos dang da lta rkang lam phra mo'i sked nas thon byung ba'i bla ma dang de'i rjes 'brangs btsun pa gnyis kyis kha nang nas‘‘skyabs 'gro’’'don bzhin sos dal bag phebs kyis phebs pa'i ngang tshul la bltas na rkang lam gya gyog des kho gnyis la ji 'dra'i bde snang zhig bskyed 'dug nga'i dran snang la gal te rkang lam de na 'gro bzhin pa ni spyan ras gzigs kyi byin rlabs su sems pa'i rgan mo de yin na ni lag pa'i snyim pa snying gar sbyar zhing mig mthar dad pa'i mchi ma 'khrugs bzhin mgrin pa brnangs brnangs kyis skyod nges red la/ rus ldong can gyi rgan po dang sgrung ba rgad po gnyis ka yin na ni nga'o snyam pa'i dregs nyams dang bcas skyod nges yin zhing / gna' mi la 'khang ra byed pa'i rgad po de yin na ni rkang lam de skyod dus gdong gnag smin ma bsdus nas g.yas g.yon la kha chu sna chu 'dor bzhin skyod nges yin pa gdon mi za/ da lta spyi tshogs ni 'pho 'gyur gyis 'gros dang bstun nas glog rdul dang 'phrin gsar gyi dus rabs la slebs pas/ nga tshos da dung rang lta mchog 'dzin gyis sos dal bag phebs dang rkang lam phra mo de 'dra brgyud nas skyod khom gang na yod de med mod/ 'on kyang da rung don med kyi tshig rtsod chag med du rgyag bzhin dus 'da' bar byed pa ni ji 'dra'i blo phangs pa zhig red ang / sgrung gtam gyi rtsom mkhan gyis kyang tshul der snying nas ma bzod pas/ sgrung gtam nang gi lam 'gro ba zhig gi ngag g.yar nas rang nyid kyi lta ba gsal bar mtshon pa yin te/ lam 'gro bas rgan rgon tsho la‘‘khyod tsho'i rkang lam 'di gu dog drags pas rgya che ru btang na ci ma rung’’zhes bskul ma byas pa — 4 —

le lo rnying zhen gyi bsam blor bsnun pa'i mda' mo/dang / don la rtsom pa pos nga tsho la don med kyi bsngags brjod dang 'khang ra'i col gtam dag phar g.yug ste da lta'i shes rig gsar pa sdud len gyis rang rigs kyi shes rig bang mdzod de sngar las gya nom par gtong bar rigs so zhes gsal 'debs dang skul lcag btang ba de ni rtsom mkhan gyi dgongs pa'i mthil nyid yin snyam/da lta rang rigs kyi shes rig nyams pa sor chud dang ma nyams pa rnams gong spel/ sngar med shes rig 'tshang ga shig shig gis rang gi 'jo sgeg ngom pa'i skabs 'dir da rung rnying zhen bag 'khums/ rang sgo rang gcod byed pa ni rmongs pa'i rang mtshang kho na mngon pa las gzhan ci yod/ gal srid shes rig gsar pa'i mdzes sdug gi bslu brid mdun du 'jigs snang skyes nas phyi bshol byas na ni mthar thug shes rig gis stongs pa'i mu to bar mi 'gyur grang / a me ri kha'i mkhas dbang lu'o dbyi si yis〈snyan ngag gi bskyar zlos dang gsar brje〉zhes pa'i dpe cha'i nang du/ ‘‘ngag dbang lha mo'i pho brang gi bang rim ngos su snyan ngag smra mkhan mang po 'tshang ga shig shig byed bzhin yod na'ang / phal mo che ni sngon gyi snyan ngag smra mkhan skyes thob kyi shes rab ldan pa dag gis bor ba'i lwa ba de slar blangs nas gyon dang gyon bzhin mchis so’’zhes gsungs pa ni bod kyi gnas tshul la dmigs nas gsungs pa yin pa'i 'char snang zhig ngang gis bskyed thub pa red/

bod kyi deng rabs sgrung gtam thad kyi bsam gzhigachos mtsho sgrol ma/〈gzhon nu zla med〉la sogs sgrung gtam du brtsis nas bshad na/ bod la sgrung gtam gyi rtsom srol dar nas dus yun mi thung na yang sgrung gtam gyi dgongs don la chos lugs kyi lhad zhugs te bod mi'i lta ba gsar brje la mngon gsal gyi phan ma thogs/bod yul du dus deb rim bzhin gsar spel dang tshags par du rtsom rig par ngos bkod sgrig byas phyin/ bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig 'phel bar dgos nges kyi cha rkyen bskrun pa nas bzung / na gzhon gtso byas pa'i rtsom pa po dang rtsom sgrig pa rnams kyis rtsom rig gi 'phel rgyas dang / rtsom pa po'i dpung sde 'dzugs skrun/ mi rnams kyi dmangs gtso'i rtsom rig gi go rtogs je mthor gtong ba bcas la dmigs nas/ bod pa'i sgrung gtam gyi dngos yod nus pa 'don spel byed pa'i thad gom pa sngar med spos byung /deng rabs sgrung gtam ni nges pa don gyis mi'i rtsom rig yin stabs/de bod la dar ba nas bzung / bod mi'i lta ba gsar brje dang / go sla ba'i yig skad phun sum je tshogs su gtong zhor du khyab gdal byed pa sogs la nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bton/ skabs bab mi rnams kyi spyi tshogs yar rgyas kyi 'gros dang mi mthun pa'i lta ba gsar brje byas te/ spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi ༈la sdogs su bsgyur thub pa de ni rtsom rig gi dngos yod dam dgos

bod kyi deng rabs sgrung gtam thad kyi bsam gzhiganges kyi nus mthu'o/ /da lta'i dus rabs kyi snga char/ sku zhabs lu'u zhun gyis dmangs kyi nad gdung sel ched/ 'jar pan du phebs nas phyi gling gso rig la sbyang nas bzhugs dus/ 'jar dmag gis krung go pa zhig gi mgo blangs te khrom ston byas rung / lta ba 'thom sbrid du song ba'i krung go pa tsho gam du langs nas ltad mor lta ba'i glog brnyan mthong bas/ phugs 'dun la 'gyur ldog byung zhing rtsom rig gis rgyal dmangs skyob pa'i bgrod lam la zhugs/ khong gis gsungs don/ ‘‘ngas bltas na gso rig slob rgyu kha tsha dgos gtugs kyi don zhig ma red/ glen zhing nyam chung ba'i rgyal dmangs thams cad la mtshon na/dbang bo rnam lnga tshang zhing lus po bde thang ngang 'tshar longs byung rung / de gzhan gyis bltas na mig shom che ba dang ltad mo pa tsam las don snying ci yang med pas/ na 'chi ji 'dra byung rung de chag sgo zhig la gtan nas brtsi mi dgos/ der brten/ nga tsho'i 'gan khur thog ma ni kho tsho'i lta ba dang snying stobs legs bsgyur byed rgyu de yin la/ skabs der kho bos lta ba legs sgyur la phan nus che ba rig rtsal yin par sems te/ rig rtsal las 'gul slong 'dod pa yin/’’ sku zhabs lu'u zhun gyis rtsom rig gi spyi tshogs yar rgyas thad kyi nus pa rtogs te/ blo brtan 'gyur med dang lhag bsam zol med kyis rtsom rig gsar rtsom la 'bad pas/ krung go'i gsar brje las don la byas rjes rlabs chen bzhag pa kun gyis shes pa bzhin yin/ ribacings 'grol byas rjes/ rang re'i rgyal khab kyi mi rigs che chung kun la rtsa khrims dang srid jus thad nas 'dra mnyam thob mod/ 'on te rig gnas dang dpal 'byor sogs thad gang mang du da dung rjes lus kyi zhwa mo gon 'dug pa'i gras su bod kyang gnas/ mi rigs shig 'phel rgyas su 'gro dgos na nges — 7 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/par du rang gi ma dag pa'i lta ba gsar brje byas te/ bsam blo'i 'khyer so spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi 'gros dang bstun dgos/ gnad 'di nas bshad na/bod la deng rabs sgrung gtam dar ba nas bzung / de'i go sla ba dang yid 'phrog pa'i khyad chos kyis klog pa po gang mang zhig gi 'thom sbrid kyi lta ba gnyid las dkrog ste/ mi rigs kyi zhan cha gang yin dang / sha tsha stangs gang 'grig gi go rtogs rnyed pa'i skye bo 'bor chen byung dang 'byung bzhin mchis/mkhas pa la las‘‘bod la'ang cis kyang spyi skad cig dgos 'dug’’ces pa nas bzung / bod khul la‘'ur langs nas/ la las‘‘am skad du brda rnying mang bas spyi skad bya chog’’zer/ la las‘‘bod ljongs ni chos lugs dang rig gnas kyi lte ba yin pas/ yul skad de spyi skad byas na legs’’zer/ yang 'ga' zhig gis‘‘khams skad dbus gtsang pas go ba dang / a mdo pa la'ang cung lob sla bas/ de spyi skad byas na bzang’’zer/ don chen 'di thag chod dgos na zhib 'jug gting zab par spel ba dang yul so so'i bar gyi 'brel gtug rgyun ldan rgya cher gtong ba sogs kyi thabs lam gal che yang / nga'i bsam tshul du mig sngar nga tshos sgrung gtam la brten nas go sla ba dang mang tshogs kyis khas len 'dod pa/ mi rigs kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i yig skad 'thus tshang bar btang nas mdo dbus khams gsum du khyab gdal byas rjes da gzod phyogs bsdus kyi bsam gzhig byas na 'os pa red sems/deng rabs sgrung gtam du 'os min gyi mngon brjod dang brda rnying sogs dor zhing / go sla ba'i yig skad bkol zhor du skabs bab kyi dgos nges dang yig skad kyi 'phel rgyas la phan par dmigs nas rgyug che ba'i kha skad kyi ming brda'am tshig srol dang / yul skad las nyams ldan pa dang dper 'jal mtshar ba dang don mtshon nus pa khyad par can gyi rjod byed bcas dag — 8 —

bod kyi deng rabs sgrung gtam thad kyi bsam gzhigachar mthun pa'i ngang bdams nas sgrung gtam du drangs pa na/ go sla ba'i yig skad sngar bas cha tshang du yong ba dang spyi skad gtan 'bebs byed par sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen skrun bzhin mchis/bod kyi deng rabs sgrung gtam gyi srol phyes nas yun ring bo ma 'gyangs kyang / 'di la rmang rdo bzhengs pa lta bu'i rtsom pa po dang brtsams chos skor zhig byung ba ni/ bod kyi rtsom 'byung lo rgyus kyis brjed mi srid la brjed kyang mi rung lags/ dper na/ sku zhabs don grub rgyal gyi〈'bol rtsom zhogs pa'i skya rengs〉su 'khod pa'i〈pad mtsho〉zhes pa de da skabs bltas na zhan cha mang tsam 'dug rung / nyid kyi srol 'byed thad du thon pa'i yon tan ni khas len dgos kyi red/ de yang / chos lugs srid jus slar gso byas ma thag mi ngan la las chos dad mang tshogs kyi chos zhen lhag sems rab tu khol ba'i gnas bab de spyad nas/ chos lugs pa'i ming g.yar te mgo skor gtong bzhin mchis pas/ snying phod che ba'i sku zhabs don grub rgyal gyis mang tshogs la dgos med kyi chag sgo mi 'byung bar dmigs pa'i sgo nas〈sprul sku〉zhes pa gsar rtsom byas shing / bod kyi deng rtsom du thog mar brjod bya 'dzem dgos pa can gleng ba dang dngos yod gnad don la phog thug btang ba'i srog don ldan pa'i brtsams chos spel bas mi rnams la shan shugs mi chung ba thebs su bcug 〈sad kyis bcom pa'i me tog〉lta na/ nang gi mi sna gtso bo rnams dmigs su bzung nas rgyas zhib tu bris shing / bod yig sgrung gtam du 'bod pa'i tha snyad dang po bkol ba'i 'bri stangs de mngon par spel bas/ sgyu rtsal gyi rin thang gdeng 'jog 'os pa zhig bskrun byung / lhun 'grub kyi〈rta nag sgrog 'gros〉zhes pa ni bod kyi bud med kyi las dbang dmigs su bzung nas bod yig tu bris pa'i deng rabs sgrung gtam 'go ma yin pa ma zad/ byung ba — 9 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/phra mo mtshon pa dang mi sna'i snang brnyan de 'tsho nyams can du bzhengs pa'i thad nas grub 'bras bsngags 'os pa zhig blangs byung / ljang bu'i〈sog rus las mched pa'i rnam shes〉zhes pa ni bod kyi dngos yod sgyu 'phrul ring lugs kyi sgrung gtam thog ma dang klog pa pos bstod bsngags yang yang byed pa'i brtsams chos su bgrang / tshe ring don grub kyi〈rtse chus khrel dgod byed bzhin〉dus deb tu bkod rjes/ klog pa po'i khrod du bstod smad kyi 'ur chen thengs shig langs shing / de ni chos pa tshul min lugs min pa'i spyod ngan rjen par bton pas spyi tshogs gnad don la thad kar the gtogs gtong ba'i brjod bya'am srog don 'dzin tshul thad nas deng rabs sgrung gtam gyi spyi tshogs las 'gan nan bzhes kyi rang chos 'bur du thon pa byas/ 〈rtswa thang gi nyin tho〉ni thog dang por bud med rtsom pa pos bod rigs bud med kyi las dbang bris pa'i brtsams chos bzang po zhig yin pas/ klog pa pos bsngags pa mang du gtor mur rtsom rig dpyad bsdur khrod bya dga' yang thob pa red/ ljang bu'i〈lha sa'i zla ba〉ni dus dang gnas kyi nges pa med pa'i sgrung gtam khyad mtshar zhig yin la/ sgyu rtsal thad 'tshol snyeg byas pa'i grub 'bras thun mong ma yin pa zhig blangs byung ba red/ stag 'bum rgyal ni mdun lam yangs pa'i na gzhon rtsom pa po zhig yin la/ kho'i〈gangs rgyan me tog〉steng bkod pa'i〈nyin gcig gi cho 'phrul〉ni 'di sngon rang gi 'thus tshab brtsams chos byas chog sgrung gtam du bod kyi 'brog mi kun gyi tshab byas chog pa'i g.yang 'bum gyi yang yang skyar zlos byas pa'i mi tshe ring mo'i 'tsho ba de nyin gcig tu sgril nas byung rim gyi rten gnas dang dus tshod sil thor du btang zhing / 'tsho ba'i rang nyams nyid gsal lhang nger mtshon byung ba la thabs rtsal dpe med pa spyad yod pa red/ — 10 —

bod kyi deng rabs sgrung gtam thad kyi bsam gzhigagong du ngos bzung ba ltar so sor rang gi rin thang dang go gnas nges can zhig yod pas spyi sdom gyi dbang du btang na deng rabs bod kyi sgrung gtam gsar pa'i shing rta'i srol phyes pa'i gzi brjid ldan pa'i par la btab pa'i snga gzhug ltar bsgrigs pa yin la/ da skabs skyar klog byas na brtsams chos la lar byis blo'i ngang tshul 'dug kyang / lo rgyus kyi 'phel rim nang bzhin rdo ring zhig la bsam nas gdeng 'jog dgos tshul ston pa lags/deng rabs sgrung gtam gyi dar yun mi ring bas na zhan cha yang mang ste/rags tsam gleng na/ sgrung gtam du mtshon pa'i 'tsho ba sna mang sna tshogs min par brjod bya 'ga' skyar 'bri byed bzhin pa dang lad mo byas pas nye du'i 'brel ba 'dug pa'i brtsams chos kyang mang tsam snang / bsam blo dang sgyu rtsal thad rin thang phal cher med cing yig tshogs kyis lci ba'i sgrung gtam khog stong yang mang / khyab yul chung ba'i yul skad kyis gsar rtsom byas pas go mi bde ba dang gcig gyur gyi yig skad la ngan shan bzos pa ni rtsom pa po rnams kyis nges par du gzab dgos pa'i skyon du 'dod/

bod rang mtshan pa'i mdzes rtog lta ba dang deng rabs rtsom rigaban de mkhar/'dir brjod pa'i mdzis rtog lta ba ni lta ba'i phyogs su gtogs pa'i mi rigs kyi rtsa ba'i khyad chos thun mong ma yin pa zhig yin/ mdzes rtog lta ba de sems pa'i dbang gis tshad mar 'dzin pa dang phyi yul dngos po'i dbang gis tshad mar 'dzin pa/ de min nang sems pa dang phyi dngos po gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i lta ba bcas bzhed pa mi mthun pa du mar snang yang / nga tshos 'dir nang sems pa dang phyi dngos po gnyis zung du sbrel ba las byung ba'i bod kyi rang mtshan pa'i mdzes rtog lta ba rang la dmigs pa yin la/ thun mong du dge ba'i las la bzang bstod dang mi dge ba'i spyod pa la 'phya ba ni 'jig rten gyi spyi lugs su snang yang / de las gzhan bya ba dang dngos po bye brag pa la mi rigs spyi dang sger gyi 'dzin tshul bye brag pa re yod pa'ang gor ma chag go/rtsom rig gi brtsams chos tshad ldan zhig yin phyin de las mi rigs kyi dad mos dang brtse dung / mi dang mi'i bar gyi 'brel ba/ mdzes rtog lta ba sogs khyad chos thun mong ma yin pa zhig mthong thub pas/ mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel tshang gis‘‘de yang yul so so'i gtam rgyud dang sgrung rgyud shin rītu yang mi 'dra zhing / de la bltas nas yul de ga'i mi rnams kyis bzang po gang la byed/ ngan pa gang la byed/ 'dod chags gtso bo byed dam/ zhe sdang gardo 2bo dze+ed sogs khams dang sems pa mi 'dra ba rnams shin tu yang

bod rang mtshan pa'i mdzes rtog lta ba dang deng rabs rtsom rigagasal bor mtshon nus pas’’mezhes gsungs pa ni ches bden yang / bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig gi brtsams chos mi nyung ba zhig tu bod rang mtshan pa'i mdzes rtog lta ba ring du dor te gzhan gyi 'du shes 'dzin stangs mi nyung ba btsan sbyor byed pa'ang du ma snang /de yang mdzes rtog gi lta ba de 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi bya ba dang dngos po sogs sna mang la 'du shes 'dzin stangs su nges pas/ rtsa ba'i kha dog bzhi dang yan lag gi kha dog brgyad la sogs par mi rigs so sor 'dzin pa mi 'dra ba re yod pas/ de rtsom rig tu bkol ba 'os na mi rigs so sor 'dzin pa mi 'dra ba re yod pas/ rtsom rig tu bkol ba 'os na mi rigs de'i mdzes rtog gi lta ba dang rtsom pa po'i bsum blo/ brjod bya'i srog sogs la dngos rgyud gang dung gis ram 'degs byed thub ste/ kho lom pi ya'i deng rabs rtsom mkhan grags can mar khu'e zi(paṃpoṭ+wāṃspo)yi〈lo brgya'i kher hreng〉du bye ma leb ser po dang me 'khor gyi mgo ser po/ sil tog ser po sogs mtshon don rang bzhin gyi kha dog mang du bkol te/ na tis an mi rigs kyi kha dog la 'dzin pa'i srol rgyun gyi lta tshul te ser po ni than ltas ngan pa'i mtshon bya byas te ma rgon to grong rdal la byung ba'i nad yams dang rang byung gi 'jigs pa sogs brjod bya 'bur du thon par ram 'degs byas/ bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig khrod kyi brtsams chos kha shas la mjal dus kha dog gi sgyu rtsal mtshon thabs rang re'i bod pa'i mdzes rtog lta ba dang 'gal zlar gyur pa mang du gda'/ bod rang gi srol la ljang mdog ni yan lag gi kha dog brgyad las ches phal ba zhig tu brtsi ba las dkar po dang ser po ltar dri ma bral 'ing bde du 〈gangs can rig mdzod〉deb bcu gcig pa/ 2 19 2 78— 13 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/legs 'byung ba'i ltas shig tu ci la brtsi/ 'on kyang / snyan ngag cig 'bri skabs ser po'i zhing khams zhes na khrel med zhig tu rlom ste/ ljang mdog gi zhing khams zhes na bod mi dmangs kyi sems kyis re ba'i zhing mchog sham bha la dang gnyis su med pa ltar ngos 'dzin byed pa 'di/ bod mi dmangs kyi mdzes rtog lta ba dang 'gal zlar gyur pas rtsom rig gi mi rigs rang bzhin nyams pa'i rgyur 'gro ba gdon mi za'o/ /gzhan yang / phyi lus kyi mdzes rtog gi thad la kha rgyun du pho yag gdong gi sna dang mo yag ba'in gyi mig ces brjod cing / sna'i gzengs mtho ba dang mig mdzo mig lta bu mdzes par brtsi ba ni bod rang mtshan pa'i lta ba lhad med cig yin la/ mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel tshang gis kyang / ‘‘sha rtsi smug po mdzes par brtsi/ bud med gzugs ring la phra ba dang / skyes pa rgyag cing gzugs rag pa la mchog tu 'dod’’du ces gsungs don yang bod kyi mdzes rtog lta ba rnal ma zhig gis bzhin mdangs dkar por shi mdog mngon 'dug zer ba las mdzes bar bgrang mi rigs/ bod kyi deng rabs sgrung gtam du mi sna zhig zhib 'bri byed skabs nag cing snum pa'i skra lo sogs ches spyir btang ba zhig bris pa las/ u ko yi〈pa lis 'phags ma lha khang〉zhes pa'i sgrung gtam ring mo'i nang gi rja zhis mo'u to'i snang brnyan dang se 'ar rdi zi yi〈thang ci khe ta〉las thang ci khe ta lta bu'i snang brnyan bye brag pa nas dpe mtshon rang bzhin can mngon pa ches dkon/ der ma zad/ bod mi rigs kyis rgyun par 'dogs pa'i bzho bzung / ske rgyan/ wa zhwa/ sram dang gzig pags sogs mdzes chos su bgrang ste rgyan char brtsi ba ni bod kyi dmangs srol dhi 〈gangs can rig mdzod〉deb bcu gcig pa/ 2 19 2 78— 14 —

bod rang mtshan pa'i mdzes rtog lta ba dang deng rabs rtsom rigagyi grub cha gal chen zhig yin la/ rtsom rig dang dmangs srol zung yang rten cing 'brel dgos kyang / nga tshos gzhan pa'i rig gnas kyi shan ma zhugs pa'i bod mi'i bsam blo thun mong ma yin pa zhig gi phyogs su 'grengs te deng rabs rtsom rig la gdeng 'jog byas na/ rtsom pa po'i lta ba re 'ga' ni bod kyi 'tsho ba'i klong las bsrubs pa'i nying bcud cig yin zhes mtha' dpyod byed mkhan med la byed thabs kyang bral/ bod kyi 'tsho ba'i nang mngon pa'i skya ser dang ban bon/ yig rmongag pa dang yon tan pa sogs 'gal zlar gyur pa'i mi'i mdzes rtog lta ba mi 'dra bas spyi tshogs kyi snang tshul mngon pa nyung bar gda'/ te kel(ṭhacha.oṃ)gyis‘‘snyan ngag la thog mtha' bar gsum du mi rigs rang mtshan pa'i khyad chos kyis bkag rgya thebs la/ snyan ngag gi 'byung khungs mi rigs yin pas/ mi rigs kyi nang snying dang rnam pa ni snyan ngag gi brjod bya dang mtshon thabs kyang yin’’duzhes pa'i gsung las kyang / ‘‘deng sang dus deb steng du 'khod pa'i sgrung gtam mang che bar phyi yi skad yig gi sgyu rtsal gyi nyams zhan par ma zad/ nang nyams steng gi mi rigs kyi khyad chos kyang shin tu zhan/ sgro btags kyi gzugs su bkod pa'i mi phal cher zhig la bkra shis dang lha mtsho sogs bod ming re btags pa ma gtogs bsam pa dang kun spyod/ yul srol goms 'dris/ bza' zla dang bzang sa dang yul mi phan tshun bar gyi 'brel ba/ drang g.yo dpa' zhum dang sdug rus sogs kyis mtshon pa'i mi gshis sogs bris yod pa phal cher 'o mar chu nag bsres pa ba'in/ rang mdangs zhan pa dang / mi rigs gzhan par dpe 'gebs byas pa mang zhing rjo 〈nub gling sgyu rtsom gyi gzhung lugs grags can bdams bsgrigs〉 pe cin slob grwa chen mo'i1985lo'i par/ 2 544— 15 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/rtsom mkhan rang nyid 'tsho ba'i nyams myong dang 'tsho stangs la cha rgyus med pas 'ol tshod byas pa'am/ gnas tshul cha rgyus med pa'am lta tshul mi mthun pa'i mi rigs gzhan pa'i mthong snang bkod pa mang la’’buzhes gsungs pa ltar bod kyi mi rigs rang mtshan pa'i mdzes rtog lta ba mngon ci thub mi byed par zhwa dpe lham 'gebs byas pa 'di skyon du rtogs thub/ bod kyi na gzhon rtsom pa po grags chen bkra shis zla ba'i〈bod ljongs/ rgyun bu'i mdud pa la rgyus pa'i rnam shes〉dang〈sbas skung gi lo zla〉 de min〈gtsang bo'i pha rol na〉sogs sgrung gtam mang shos kyi sgyu rtsal mtshon thabs bla na 'phags kyang mtshon bya bod mi rigs yin rung / mi sna'i lta ba dang bsam pa/ kun spyod kyi khyad chos/ yul srol goms 'dris sogs ci lta ba bzhin mtshon med par mi rigs gzhan gyi shan zhugs pa ches mang bas/ mtha' dpyod pa dag gis mi rigs rang bzhin dang deng rabs rang bzhin gnyis bar gyi 'gal 'brel la thag gcod 'os 'tsham byas te mi rigs rang mtshan pa'i khyad chos mngon par brtson dgos zhes mdzub ston byas/u ru su'i rtsom rig gzhung lugs mkhan pe lin si khe(shā//lo7zlo)yis‘‘mi rigs so so'i rang mtshan pa'i gsang ba ni/ kho tsho'i gon pa las mtshon pa ma yin par kho tshos phyi yul la ngos 'dzin byed thabs la rag las zhes brjod chog’’duces gsungs pas kyang mi rigs kyi rtsom rig la mi rigs rang mtshan pa'i khyad chos ldan dgos na mi rigs de'i rang mtshan pa'i mdzes dpyod lta ba du dge rgan chen mo dor zhi'i gsung / 〈zla zer〉1988 1dhi 〈phyi rgyal gyi rtsom rig mkhas pas mkhas pa gleng ba〉 hwa shar dge thon slob grwa chen mo'i1985lo'i par/ 2 130— 16 ge

bod rang mtshan pa'i mdzes rtog lta ba dang deng rabs rtsom rigamatshon ci thub byed rgyu ches gtso bas/ kha dog ser po gleng na ngo tsha zhing ljang khu gleng na yid spro ba'i dgos pa ci yang ma mchis so /bod kyi sngon byung mkhas dbang dag gis yul dus dang 'gal ba ni snyan ngag gi skyon sel bcu'i ya gyal du bgrang zhing / rtsom pa po zhig gis nges par du spang dgos pa'i gnad cig yin par mang du gsungs/rtsom la thog mar 'jug skabs rang yid la 'dzin dgos pa ni bod mi rigs 'di gzhan dang mi 'dra bar gangs ri ra bas bskor ba'i mtho ljongs su gnas pa dang / de yang sku zhabs don grub rgyal gtso byas pa'i rtsom pa po mi nyung ba zhig la tshad ldan du gyur pa'i brtsams chos mang du 'dug pa las/yul dus kyi rang bzhin gzhan las gsal bas bltas ma thag tu bod yul du byung ba'i gnas tshul zhig yin pa'i nges shes rnyed thub/ yang phyogs gzhan nas gleng na/ deng skabs bris pa'i rtsom mi nyung ba zhig tu rang rgyal nang khul gyi yul dus kyi khyad chos btsan sbyor byas te/ dbyar tsha bas mi nus shing dpyid kyi dus la me tog gi 'dab ma grol ba sogs bod kyi 'tsho ba mtshon pa'i rtsom du drangs kyang / bod kyi yul dus kyi khyad chos dngos la mtshon na de lta ma yin te/ yul gyi cha nas gleng na spang ri dang nags ri/ rtswa chu shing gsum 'dzoms shing bya bye'u gre 'gyur snyan pa'i ljongs ris bzhengs pa las khang brtsegs dang 'phrul chas kyi sgra sogs kyis bod kyi deng dus kyi 'tsho ba mtshon ga la thub/

bod mi'i las dbang dang deng rabs rtsom rigaban de mkhar/bod mi rigs la mtshon na gnam grus mkha' lam gcod dus g.yag rgyab nas ki ring 'debs pa'i las dbang 'di 'dra dbyangs su gyer te mi rnams la rtogs sad sbyin mkhan ni deng rabs rtsom rig yin la/ yongs grags su rtsom pa po la‘‘lo rgyus kyi drung yig’’ces 'bod pas deng gi skabs bab 'di phyi rabs par sgrog mkhan yang deng rabs rtsom rig yin zhes mgrin pa gzengs su btegs te brjod los chogabod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig la phyir bltas byas na/ grwa rdzun bla rdzun gyis mi dmangs la mgo skor byas pa〈sprul sku〉rdzun ma'i spyod pa dang / gnyen sgrig la rang dbang bral zhing mi rabs gnyis kyi 'gal ba'i bsam blo mtshon pa〈sha dang rus pa'i brtse dung〉phrag dog dang zhe sdang gi dbang gis nang dme'i khrag dmar 'tshub pa〈'brong stag thang〉gi rtsod gleng bcas gsum gyis bod kyi deng rabs spyi tshogs khrod kyi snang tshul mi 'dra ba gsum mtshang 'byin byas te/ phyi rabs pa dag gis rang nyid 'phel rgyas su 'gro bar gegs su gyur pa'i bsam blo rjes lus dang / lta ba gu dog bcas spang dgos par gdams pas bod kyi 'tsho ba'i bro ba ldan la lo rgyus kyi rin thang yang chen po ldan/ 'di dag ni sku zhabs rdospya grub rgyal gyis bod kyi 'tsho ba dngos las sngog 'don dang btso sbyang

bod mi'i las dbang dang deng rabs rtsom rigabyas pa'i 'bras bu red/ bod kyi sgrung gtam pa tshe ring don grub lags kyis〈ra lo〉lta bu'i snang brnyan zhig nga tsho'i mig mdun du gnang ba ni bka' drin zhu 'os pa zhig kyang red/ 'di las ldog pa ni bod yig dus deb re 'ga'i steng sgrung gtam gyi brjod bya slob grwa'i 'tsho ba spyir btang ba zhig gam/ grong khyer du gnas pa'i mi sna'i gnas tshul rang ga ba cha tsam re klog pa po'i mig lam du spungs kyang / 'di dag ni 'gro ba mi spyi'i 'tsho stangs tsam las bod mi'i 'tsho ba mtshon zhing las dbang la sems khur byed pa'i tshul tsam yang rtogs mi thub/nga tshos 'dzam gling spyi'i rtsom rig gi lo rgyus la bltas na/ dbyin ji'i rtsom mkhan grags chen shig se pher(ṣ+ṭharwakhrikhuyo)gyi mi tshe gcig gi snyeg sa ni dbyin ji'i 'tsho ba yin pas/ ‘‘kho'i zlos gar gyi don rkyen gang du byung na'ang /khyod kyis rtogs sla ba ni byung rim 'di dag dbyin ji'i gnam 'og kho na las 'byung thub par nges’’duzhes en ke si yis gdeng 'jog tshad mtho byas/gzhan yang / h+pha ran si'i skad grags che ba'i rtsom mkhan pal za khi(༅lo༈'iṭ+wāṃ)yi brtsams chos kyi brjod bya ni h+pha ran si'i rgyal sa pha ri si'i don dngos te/ ham pa dang 'gran sems/ rgyu nor gyi dmyal 'phrang sogs nas byung ba'i mi rnams kyi brtse dung dang tshe srog gi skyo gar yin la/ kho'i〈mi yul gyi spro gar〉ni dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i stod kyi h+pha ran si'i lo rgyus kyi gzigs ris shig yin zhes kun gyis bsngags par byed/ der brten/ rtsom rig gi brtsams chos shig la 'dzam gling rtsom rig gi gar stegs steng gzhan las 'phags pa'i du 〈mar khe si dang en ke si yis sgyu rtsal la dpyad pa〉 mi dmangs rtsom rig dpe skrun khang / 1966lo'i par/ 2 99— 19 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/go gnas shig dgos na/ thog mar rkang 'dzin byed sa ni rang rigs kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i las dbang dang lo rgyus kyi rgyab ljongs yin dgos la/ bod kyi snyan ngag la mtshon na'ang lha rgyal tshe ring gi tshigs bcad snyan ngag〈phangs pa'i mchi ma dbang med shor〉zhes pa dang / rgod phrug dpal 'byor gyi rang mos snyan ngag〈ri grong〉dang 'brug lha rgyal gyi〈mtho sgang 'brog mi〉sogs kyis bod kyi 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi snang brnyan gson po re mngon yod pa ni rjes su yi rang 'tshal bar sems/ 'on te rang mos snyan ngag skor zhig gi brjod bya'i srog gang yin rtogs mi thub pa dang / snyan ngag pa re 'gas rtsom pa po rang gi tshor 'du kho na mtshon pas gzhan gyis rtogs mi thub skad/ der brten bod mi dmangs spyi la slob gso'i nus pa thon rgyu lta zhog tha na slob grwa chen mo pa'i nang khul du'ang bsam blo brje res byed pa'i rgyur yang mi 'gro/ mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel tshang gis‘‘sla mo zhig dka' ru btang nas bshad na 'jigs shing mkhas nyams su byed pa 'di rgud pa'i sgo ru snang yang byed thabs zad’’duces pa dang / h+pha ran si'i rtsom mkhan mu'o pha sang gis〈sgrung gtam gleng ba〉zhes par‘‘nga tshos rtog dka' ba'i dngos po'i ming dang bya ba'i ming / khyad chos kyi ming nyung du bkol ba dang / sgrig gzhi sna mang dang mtshon thabs khyad mtshar can/ sgra gdangs snyan zhing sdeb legs pa'i yig skad sna mang bkol ci thub byos’’du zhes gsungs pa dag rang gis 'grel dka' la gzhan gyis tshod dpag tsam yang byed dka' ba'i snyan ngag 'bri mkhan tshor mtshon na med du mi rung ba'i man ngag cig yin los che/du 〈gangs can rig mdzod〉(deb bcu pa)2 285du 〈phyi gling rtsom rig gzhung lugs phyogs bsdus〉las drangs/— 20 —

bod mi'i las dbang dang deng rabs rtsom rig rtsom rig gi 'dzam gling rang bzhin steng nas gleng bslangs na'ang gal bo che la nan tan byed sa'i gnad 'khrul med ni mi rigs rang mtshan pa'i khyad chos yin la/ h+pha ran si'i rtsom pa po cis yad mo a po lis mkhar gyi〈bsam blo gsar pa dang snyan ngag pa tsho〉zhes pa'i ched rtsom nang du/ ‘‘dus 'di 'dra zhig gi skabs kho nar sgyu rtsal gyi mi rigs rang bzhin nyams srid de/ dus der 'gro ba mi rnams rang byung khor yug 'dra mtshungs shig gi steng nas 'tsho ba rol zhing / rnam pa gcig tu bkod pa'i khang ba'i nang du gnas pa ma zad skad rigs gcig bkol zhing skad gdangs kyang gcig gi sgo nas kha brda byed dgos mod/ 'on kyang / 'di 'dra'i dus shig srid mtha'i bar du'ang yod mi srid/ mi rgyud dang mi rigs kyi dbye bas rtsom rig gi mtshon stangs la sna mang gi rang bzhin ldan par byed cing / sna mang rang bzhin de kho na ha cang brin par brtsi’’rjozhes pa'i gsung 'di las kyang rtsom pa po zhig yin phyin thog mar rang mi rigs kyi re 'dod dang dgos mkho/ de min las dbang sogs dbyangs su gyer te mi rnams la 'bod skul dang rtogs sad sbyin dgos pa rtogs thub/ deng gi dus 'dir rtsom rig mtha' dpyad sna mang spel ba'i khrod ches gtso bo ni rtsom rig gi khungs 'tshol ba'i skor yin la/ rtsom rig gi mgo khungs ni mi rigs rang mtshan pa'i sgyu rtsal mtshon thabs dang bsam pa'i 'khor phyogs/ lo rgyus kyi 'phel rim khrod myong ba'i thun mong ma yin pa'i las dbang bcas yin la/ de thog mar1976lor a me ri kha'i mi nag rtsom pa po a lis kha si ta lis kyi〈khungs〉zhes pa'i sgrung gtam nang du a me ri kha'i bran g.yog lam lugs kyi gnya' gnon 'og sdug gis mnar ba'i mi nag mang bo'i dhi 〈h+pha ran si'i rtsom pa pos rtsom rig la dpyad pa〉2 48— 21 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/ 'tsho ba mtshon zhing de'i nang du ches rin thang ldan pa'i dri ba zhig bton pa ni‘‘nga tsho'i mi rigs kyi khungs gang du yod’’ces pa de yin la/ des phyi gling gi rtsom pa po mi nyung ba zhig la rang gi mi rigs kyi mgo khungs snyeg par gsal 'debs byas/ rang rgyal nang khul du'ang nye ba'i lo 'ga'i ring du han hra'o gon(tho8/〉gro)gyi〈rtsom rig gi mgo khungs〉sogs mang du spel te mi rigs kyi lkog gyur gyi 'du shes dang rig gnas kyi khyad chos las rang nyid kyi‘‘khungs 'tshol’’ba'i 'bod tshig bsgrags tshun/ mi rigs rang nyid kyi mgo khungs 'tshol mkhan tshos 'di'i phyogs la bsam gzhig mang du byas par ches legs pa'i sdom tshig cig rnyed pa ni/ rtsom rig ni mi rigs rang mtshan pa'i srol rgyun gyi gshin sa kho nar 'bras bu smin thub pa'i 'dod tshul de ma gros rang mthun du song /der brten/ bod mi rigs 'di 'dzam gling thog mi rigs gzhan dang 'dra bar lo rgyus kyi rlabs rtser 'tsho 'dod na/ rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gnas dang rang gshis 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed rgyu gal chen nang gi don chen yin/ mi rigs rang gi srol rgyun rig gnas dang deng rabs kyi bsam blo gsar pa zung du sbrel rgyu ches gtso ba las/ ‘‘ba tshwa'i dri dang 'grogs pa'i kha sang gis de ring gi skom pa sel mi thub la/ mtshar sdug 'od stong 'bar ba'i sngon chad kyis da lta'i tshab byed ga la rung’’du snyan ngag pa sgre 'ad zed kyi〈gtan gnas kyi shig se pher〉zhes pa'i nang du‘‘shig se pher gyi gzhan las 'phags pa'i byas rjes ni khos ha cang 'os 'tsham sgos rnying pa dang gsar du don grub rgyal gyi〈lang tsho'i rbab chu〉las drangs/— 22 —

bod mi'i las dbang dang deng rabs rtsom rigapa gnyis thab khung gcig tu sgron mkhas pa de yin’’duzhes gsungs pa'ang dri mas ma gos par snang la/ si phen rgyal khab kyi a led zhan ta lis kyi‘‘brtsams chos nang du si phen gyi srol rgyun gyi brtse mtshon snyan ngag gi rgyun bskyangs shing deng rabs ring lugs kyi rtsom gshis spyad de/ mi rnams kyi 'jig rten dang 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi gnas tshul lhug tu brjod pas’’1977 lor nol per rtsom rig bya dga' thob cing / ku'e thi ma la rgyal khab kyi a si thor ris zi yis kyang rtsom rig gi mgo khungs la tin me gling gi yen tes an mi rigs kyi snying stobs dang srol rgyun rig gnas la snyeg ste sgrun du med pa'i brtsams chos mang du spel bas1967 lor nol per rtsom rig gi bya dga' thob/ dpe 'di dag las nga tshos mthong thub pa ni/ bod kyi rtsom rig gis mi rigs rang mtshan pa'i mgo khungs snyeg cing 'dzam gling du dar ba'i sngon thon gyi bsam blo dang gsar gtod rang bzhin gyi mtshon thabs zung du sbrel ci thub bya ba ni 'bad phyogs lags/rjo 〈phyi rgyal gyi rtsom rig mkhas pas mkhas pa gleng ba〉2 8— 23 —

ngag rgyun rtsom rig dang rtsom rig mkhan gyi brtsams chos bar phan chun shan zhugs chul gleng ba/dge gnyen/ngag rgyun rtsom rig gis rtsom rig mkhan gyi brtsams chos la shan bzos tshul skor gyi brjod don shin tu mang yang / gtso bo rags tsam gleng na/bzhugs don gyi thad nas brjod bya dang snang brnyan dang zhen phyogs bcas gtsigs pa dang / rten don gyi thad nas rtsom lus dang spel stangs dang rjod byed bcas gtsigs pa red/dang po/ phun sum tshogs pa'i brjod bya bton tshul/grogs rnams la go thos yod pa ltar/ gna' rabs kyi ke ri se'i(zhi la'ang zer)skyo gar mkhan grags can rnam gsum zer ba'i zlos gar 'khrab gzhung gi brjod bya mang tsam lha sgrung nas blangs pa yin la/ dper na e si kha'u li sis brtsams pa'i〈rgod po bdun gyis ti pe phab pa〉dang / gsum mthud 'khrab gzhung ste〈me blangs pa'i phu lo mi zhig si〉 〈dam la btags pa'i phu lo mi zhug si〉〈dam las grol ba'i phu lo mi zhug si〉bcas dang / so pha'u khe li sis brtsams pa'i〈'od sde phu si rgyal po〉dang / u li pi te sis brtsams pa'iṭ+wāṃmis te ya〉lta bu rnams ni ngag rgyun brtsams chos kyi brjod bya spyad pa — 24 —

ngag rgyun rtsom rig dang rtsom rig mkhan gyi bar phan tshun shan zhugs tshul gleng ba/yin zhes pa ni mkhas mang sgros mtshungs red/ gna' rabs kyi hin rdu(rgya gar)rgyal khab kyi zlos gar 'khrab gzhung bcu gsum las/ lo rgyus snyan mgur ring mo〈ma hā bha ra ta〉(‘‘mo khu sbo ro to’’zhes kyang bklags)nas brjod bya blangs pa can drug yod pa dang /〈rā ma ṇi'i rtog brjod〉nas blangs pa gnyis/gzhan rnams kyang〈rig byed〉dang〈bam po lnga〉la sogs ngan rgyun gyis grub pa'i gna' dpe nas blangs pa yin zhes nye rabs hun rdu rang btsan byas phyin gyi dpyad rtsom grags chen dag tu gsal/ gna' rabs rgya nag gi snyan ngag mkhan grags can chi'u yon gyis brtsams pa'i〈mgur dgu〉dang / 〈'bral smen〉 〈lha la zhus pa〉bcas kyi brjod bya'ang ngag rgyun nas blangs shing /nang sgos de rnams su bzhugs pa'i〈srog bdag gcen po〉dang〈srog bdag gcung po〉〈shar phyogs rje〉〈zhang chu'i rje〉〈zhang chu'i lcam〉bcas ni ngag rgyun gyi bsang mchod brngan gsol la brten nas legs par brtsams kyang / ngag thog nas brgyud byung ba'i tshul dang phal cher gcig mtshungs red ces mkhas pa rnams kyi dgongs pa gcig tu nges/ bod ltar na srol rgyun gyi zlos gar chen mo brgyad dang〈sa skya legs bshad〉〈chu shing bstan bcos〉la sogs su'ang rgya bod ngag rgyun gyi gtam rgyud mang tsam brjod byar blangs yod pa kun tu gsal ba lags/gnyis pa/ grags che ba'i snang brnyan bton tshul/u ru su'i rtsom rig mkhan nam rtsom gzhung smra ba'i dbang bo kor khi'i〈rang mtshan pa'i nyams 'jig〉ces pa las/ ‘‘rgyal khab so so'i rlabs chen snyan ngag mkhan gyi rmad byung brtsams chos kun gyis dmangs khrod kyi brtsams thon nor mdzod nas rgyu cha blangs te/ gna' nas da bar du snyan rtsom gyi — 25 bhe

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/brjod don la go ba zab la bsdus gsal ba'i brjod gzhi mang po dang grags che ba'i snang brnyan nam dper 'os ci rigs bton byung ba red’’ces gsungs pa nang bzhin/ deng rabs bod kyi zlos gar〈btsan po'i pho nya〉nang gi blon po mgar stong btsan gyi snang brnyan ni lo rgyus dang ngag rgyun/ nang sgos mgar mi rgas long ba'i sgrung rgyud kyi shan pa shes sla ba red/ rgya rigs kyi〈nub phyogs 'grim pa'i zin bris〉nang gi thang sin(thang rgyal khab kyi dge 'dun)dang sung 'u 'ong(stong rtogs sprel)gi gzhi'ang ngag rgyun nas yong ba bston du med/ yo rob gling du grags rgyug che ba'i pha'u hri te zhes pa snang brnyan 'di'i phugs ded na/kho ni 'jig rten 'dir 'tsho myong la rus ming yongs la yo han ke'u ar ke pha'u hri te zer zhing / 'jar man gyi nub lho'i phu thin po sa char 'khrungs pa dang / skar rtsis sam ril bu sbyang ba'am lung ston pa sogs su spro mos che ba zhig yin la/ kho dang dus mnyam pa'i mkhas pa 'gas kho la‘‘'ud shod khram pa’’zhes ngan smras myong ba dang / chos sdes kho la rdzun 'chal gyi spyod pa mi rung tshul gdams kyang nyid kyis bdud dang rang gi bar du 'chams bzhag zin pas bshol thabs bral bar kha g.yar tshul/ yang na1528lor grong khyer yin kar gyi srid gzhung gis kho'i lung bstan la rgyu mtshan mi gsal ba'i nyes btsugs nas yul de nas spyugs shing / 1540lo ste kho'i rang lo drug cu'i thog rdzas 'gyur nyams sad skabs su gas me shor nas rang srog bcad pa sogs yig tshags rdzob po bsdus nas gsal cha things yod/ 1570lo nas bzung ste ngag rgyun gyi mi sna zhig tu thos kyi yod pa dang / 1587lor rtsom pa po su yin ma nges pa'i deb chung mthong rgyu yod pa las khos rang gi bla ni bdud la btsong nas mi lo nyi shu 'das pa'am bdud dang kha 'chams nas phan tshun 'gro 'ong byung tshul sogs bkod pa ngang gis 'jar man dang dbyin ji sogs su khyab/— 26 bhe

ngag rgyun rtsom rig dang rtsom rig mkhan gyi bar phan tshun shan zhugs tshul gleng ba/gzhi de nas dbyin ji'i khi li si tho ma los1588lor〈mkhyen yangs pha'u hri te'i skyo gar〉zhes pa'i zlos gar 'khrab gzhung grags can de brtsams la/mtshan snyan phyogs bcur khyab pa'i ti tes kyang gzhi 'dir brten nas〈pha'u hri te〉zhes pa'i zlos gar rgyal spyir khyab pa de brtsams pa red/gsum pa/ phyogs zhen gyi cha nas shan bzos tshul/u ru su'i rtsom rig mkhan po phu'u zhi kin ni sku drag khyim rgyud cig tu 'khrungs la/ rgyang phud byas sar dka' ba myong skabs rang gi nu bor 'phrin sbyar ba las‘‘ngas dmangs khrod gtam rgyud nyan don ni/ 'di la brten nas rang gis myangs pa'i ngan mthar smod 'os pa'i slob gso'i zhan cha de yo bsrang byed pa'i slad du yin’’zhes pa nang bzhin/ khos mi dmangs kyi bsam tshul dang ngag rgyun gyi phyogs zhen nas 'tsho bcud blangs pas/ rang dang dus mnyam pa'i rtsom rig mkhan rnams las khyad 'phags brtsams 'bras bton pa red/ kor khis khong la bstod bsngags byas te/ ‘‘phu'u zhi kin ni dmangs khrod kyi brtsams par do snang mdzad cing de rtsom rig khongs su ngo sprod bgyis pa'i u ru su'i rtsom rig mkhan 'go ma ste/ khong gis yo bsrang mdzad gnang la brten nas dpon phyogs kyi mi dmangs can gyi go ba dang pho brang gi snyan ngag pa rnams kyi dge bar rdzus pa'i phyogs lhung ltar ma byas par/ rang gi shes rab kyi 'od zer gyis dmangs khrod glu gzhas dang gtam rgyud la legs spras mdzad cing / de rnams kyi blo stobs la gnod pa'ang ma thebs’’zhes gsungs pa red/ rgya rigs kyi〈chu ngogs gtam rgyud〉du bsdus pa'i de'i sngon du byung ba'i sgrung rgyud thor bu/ sgra snyan rdung len/ rnga sbrags gyer sgrung sogs snyigs dor bcud len dang bden 'tshol rdzun spong la brgyud nas sngon gyi byung — 27 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/don dam dum las zhing pa tshos mos 'dun te‘‘dpon gyis gtses na dmangs gyen ldog’’ ‘‘dge ba med sar dme bas bsgyurari’ ‘‘dpa' spobs la brten nas rgyu 'bras rtsod’’ces pa'i snying don 'bur thon du bkod phyir/ brtsams chos 'di la yun ring khyab spel gyi sgyu rtsal tshe srog thob pa red/bzhi pa/ rtsom lus sna tshogs kyi rmang gzhi bton tshul/rtsom rig mkhan gyi brtsams chos khrod kyi sgrung gtam dang zlos gar 'khrab gzhung ni mi dmangs kyi ngag rgyun rtsom rig las lha sgrung dang sgrung rgyud/mgur sgrung chen mo/ gtam rgyud/ glu sgrung bcas kyi rmang gzhi nas byung ba yin pa dang / rtsom rig mkhan gyi rtsom rig gi lugs nges snyan ngag gam gna' srol snyan ngag yang zer ba 'di ni mi rigs so so'i gna' rabs kyi glu gzhas dang mgur ma'am gab tshig bcas kyi rmang gzhi nas byung ba yin pa dang /rtsom rig mkhan gyi snyan ngag ring mo ni gna' rabs kyi ngag rgyun bsang mchod brngan gsol dang bag ston khang ston la sogs pa'i cho ga'i gtam mam glu gzhas nas byung ba yin pa bcas ni rig gnas dar snga ba'i mi rigs rnams kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus las shin tu gsal/ de yang / dmangs khrod zhabs bro'i gshib zla la bro gar yod pa'i phugs ni gna' rabs kyi zhabs bro dang gar rtsed la thug yod pa dang / dmangs khrod kyi sgrung rgyud dam gtam rgyud dam rtsed mo'i gshib zla la glu gar yod pa'i phugs ni gna' rabs kyi glu gzhas dang zlos gzhas dang gzhas 'cham sogs la thug yod pa dang / dmangs khrod kyi sgrung rgyud dam gtam rgyud dam rtsed mo'i gshib zla la gtam gar yod pa'i phugs ni gna' rabs kyi sgrung rgyud gtam rgyud dang a rtse rol rtsed sogs la thug yod pa dang / yang na rtsom rig mkhan gyi sgrung brjod snyan ngag gi gzhi'ang gna' — 28 —

ngag rgyun rtsom rig dang rtsom rig mkhan gyi bar phan tshun shan zhugs tshul gleng ba/rabs kyi mgur sgrung chen mo'am glu sgrung la thug yod pa lta bu yin/lnga pa/ spel stangs sna tshogs kyi rmang gzhi bton tshul/gzhi rtsa'i spel stangs kyi thad nas brtag na/ gna' rabs kyi lha sgrung dang / sgrung rgyud/ mgur sgrung chen mo/ 'phrul sgrung bcas kyi nyams myong med na phyis su rtsom rig mkhan gyi rtsom dang 'di'i gzhung lugs su ngos bzung ba'i 'char yan ring lugs kyi spel jus la rten gzhi dben/ gan(kru rabs kyi sgrung rgyud dang / mgur sgrung chen mo/ glu sgrung / 'tsho ba'i gtam rgyud kyi nyams myong med na phyis su ngos bzung ba'i mngon srid ring lugs kyi spel jus la rten gzhi med pa red/ srol nges spel stangs kyi thad nas brtag na/ sngon du ngag rgyun gyi sgrung brjod brtsams chos la lag len med na phyi rabs su ngos bzung ba'i‘‘nga khyod kho’’gsum ste bos tshul dang bstun pa'i spel thabs 'di mgo khungs med pa'i chu bo lta bu yin pa dang / sngon du ngag rgyun brtsams chos kyi lag len med na phyi rabs su rab bsdus dang 'dra bsdus kyi spel stangs sogs khungs med du song ba red/ rgyun spyod spel stangs kyi thad nas brtag na/sngon du ngag rgyun nas rtsom rgyag pa'i brgyud rim med na/ ched las rtsom rig mkhan gyi rtsom rig ches cher dar phyin rjes dpag tu gyur pa'i spel stangs te brjod pa dang mtshon pa dang dngags pa dang bgros pa la sogs pa'i spel tshul ma phyi 'tshol rgyu med pa red/ 'di'i thad kyi zhib don skor zhig sngon du gleng zin pa dang / skor zhig rjes su gleng bar 'tsham pas 'dir mang dogs nas mi spro/

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/drug pa/ rjod byed kyi thad nas rmang gzhi bton tshul/spyir snyan grags shin tu che ba'i rtsom rig mkhan gyis dmangs khrod kyi 'tsho nyams ldan pa dang / khog gnad 'bugs pa/ don rtsa 'dus pa bcas kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i thun mong gi snang tshul zhig yin la/ 'dir dod tsam gleng na/ shes bzhin tu mi shes khul byed pa'i tshul la dbus skad du‘‘lkug rdzu 'debs’’zer ba dang / don zhig yang yang phrad nas sun pa la am skad du‘‘sna blangs song’’zer ba 'di 'dra'i rigs su gyur pa'i dmangs khrod tshig srol gyi lugs ma dar na/ ‘‘'phyang mo nyug’’ ‘‘gdon mi za’’‘‘mdzub mo ri’’lta bu'i yig skad kyi tshig srol yang 'byung khungs med/ ‘‘g.yag sna khu tshur’’‘‘'dre shar sgo dang glud nub sgo’’‘‘rgyu ma chad nas gson re’’lta bu'i rigs su gyur pa'i dmangs khrod dpe chos med na/ ‘‘zhwa dpe lham 'gebs’’‘‘rgan mo gser khur’’‘‘bden rdzun thang mar brdal’’‘‘bya ma 'phur sgo nga lon pa’’zhes pa'i snga tsam nas yig thog tu rgyug pa'i dpe chos kyang rtsad pa med pa'i ljon pa ji bzhin lags/ kha skad kyi dper 'os tshig grub cig yig skad du 'gyur tshul phal cher 'di ltar te/ langs snga zhing nyal 'phyi ba dang las tshags lci ba'i tshul du 'tsho bar 'bad pa la‘‘nangs snga mo gangs bal mos lham byas/ mgo skar chen zhwa byas’’zhes par gyur kyang / de bas bsdus nas‘‘sad bal lham dang skar chen zhwa’’zhes par gyur nas kha skad la 'dres pa'i yul skad kyi dri ma yongs su bsal zhing yig skad kho nar grub pa nang bzhin red/rtsom rig mkhan gyis ngag rgyun rtsom rig la shan bzos pa ni phan shan thebs tshul dang gnod shan thebs tshul te phyogs gnyis nas dpyad rigs shing / phan gnod gnyis kyi nang gses su so sor gnad 'os don tshan du ma — 30 —

ngag rgyun rtsom rig dang rtsom rig mkhan gyi bar phan tshun shan zhugs tshul gleng ba/yod pa la tshul dod re brjod/dang po/ phan pa'i shan shugs thebs tshul la/nyar tshags thad dang / legs bcos thad/ khyab gdal thad/ dpyad rtogs thad bcas nas go ba len chogaka nyar tshags thad nas phan shan thebs tshul/ngag rgyun gyi brtsams chos ni ngag sgros nas thon pa'i sgyu rtsal yin pas/kha rnar brgyud kyang yid 'dzin la brten nas nyar tshags byung ba'i dbang gis dus srol gyi tshod 'dzin ni mi 'dzin thabs med yin/ mi rnams 'tsho ba'i dus rabs rim brjes sam spyi tshogs cha rkyen rim 'gyur ram sgyu rtsal mos 'dun rim 'phel bcas kyi dbang du/ ngag rgyun brtsams chos la grub cha gsar pa kha snon byung bas na/ ma gzhi'i tshul nas 'gyur ba'am tha na ngo bo yongs su 'gyur ba dang / la la bor thor du 'gro srid pa red/ rtsom rig mkhan gyis zin bris su phab pa dang par du btabs pa na/ gzhen 'gyur chung la bor yal nyung ba dang / ma gzhi'i rang tshul lam skabs shig gi rnam pa ji bzhin 'dzin par phan pa ma zad/ yun ring 'gyangs kyang mi 'gyur bar bzod/dper na/ 〈legs bshad rin po che'i mdzod〉dang〈snang sa 'od 'bum〉dang nang sgos sangs rgyas stong khung(tun hong zhes pa a mdo'i rong skad kyi stong khung gi sgra de rgyu mtshan ma shes par rgya yig tu bris skad)gi yig tshags nas byung ba'i lha sgrung dang sgrung rgyud/ mgur dang gtam dpe sogs kyis rgya bod ngag rgyun rtsom rig las ltos bcas kyi snga shos skor zhig gi gnas tshul deng sang yang rtogs thub pa de bzhin lags/— 31 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/ kha khyab gdal thad nas phan shan thebs chul/ngag rgyun rtsom rig nyid yid 'dzin la bcol zhing kha rna la brten nas khyab gdal byung ba'i dbang gis de'i tshod 'dzin yang mi thebs thabs med yin/ mi rnams yul gru kha kha dang mi rigs so so dang rgyal khams tha dad du 'dug cing / de bzhin da bar du ri klung chen po dang skad rigs mi mtshungs pa/ lugs srol mi gcig pa/ mnga' ris bkag 'dzin byung ba bcas kyi mi mthun khag rkyen sna tshogs yod pas/ ngag rgyun brtsams chos kyi khyab gdal ni bdag po med la sa chod kyang chung ba'i ngang shin tu dal ba yin/ rtsom rig mkhan gyis bris dpar byas pa la brten phyir/ khyab spel gyi lam sna je mang dang sa chod je che dang brgyud pa cha tshang ba bcas kyi mthun rkyen du 'gyur bas/yul gru'am mi rigs sam rgyal khams tha dad bar gyi brje spel yams khyab la phan pa byung/ dper na/ gna' rabs hin rdu'i‘‘rig byed sde bzhi’’la bzhugs pa'i lha sgrung dang sgrung rgyud dang 'phrul sgrung / bstod pa dang brngan 'bul zhu tshig gtam rgyud dang gtam dpe sogs rtsom rig mkhan nam mkhas pa'i snyug bkod la brten nas phal cher 'dzam gling yongs su khyab gdal du phyin yod/ga legs bcos thad nas phan shan thebs chul/ngag rgyun rtsom rig la bab chags shing bsam 'dun g.yo zol med pa mtshon yod pa'i khyad chos ldan pa dang / spyir btang du phun sum tshogs shing gya nom pa yin la 'tsho ba'i nyams dang ldan pa'i dge mtshan yod kyang /brtsams chos las mang phyed ni thabs chags tsam mam rags rtsub tsam yin — 32 —

ngag rgyun rtsom rig dang rtsom rig mkhan gyi bar phan tshun shan zhugs tshul gleng ba/pa'i zhan cha'ang yod la/ rin chen g.yu dang rdo lhan skyes kyi tshul du gnas pa shin tu mang / gal srid yang dag thabs dang rtsal la brten nas lag phras sbyong 'dum ma byas na nyid kyi rgyu rtsa mngon mi nus la yams khyab tu 'gro bar yang gnod pa yin/ de 'dra'i dbang du/ rtsom rig mkhan nam mkhas dbang skor zhig gis dgos nges 'di la rtogs pa byung nas/ rang rang 'tsho ba'i spyi tshogs kyi skabs bab chab srid dam rig gnas kyi 'os 'gan gang rung la dmigs nas ngag rgyun brtsams chos legs bcos mdzad cing phyi ma rnams la sku drin ma chung bar snang / dper na/ yar bcad mi lo nyis stong drug brgya tsam du grub pa'i rgya nag gi〈snyan ngag bstan bcos〉la sde tshan chen po gsum 'dus la/ 〈rlung〉〈snyan〉〈bstod〉gsum zhes mtshan pa red/ ‘‘rlung’’zhes pa‘‘gzhas’’la go zhing / dmangs gzhas ni skabs bab ltos 'phral du brtsams thon 'byung la nges med tshul du gyer ldang 'byung ba dang / skabs don la zur za lta bu'ang grang ngar gyis dbal thebs par mtshungs shing / rgya khyab yams spel phyin nas goms srol du grub par gzhigs phyir/ dpe la 'jal ba'i tshul du de ltar ming btags/ tshig 'bru'i tshul ni bod kyi gzhas sam nang sgos a mdo'i la gzhas dang shin tu nye/ 〈snyan〉zhes pa‘‘mgur’’la go zhing / snyan cha ldan la ya rabs kyi bsam 'dun kho nar phyogs pas de ltar btags par skad la/ bod kyi mgur dang glu'am nang sgos a mdo'i glu dang shin tu nye/‘‘bstod’’ces pa‘‘bstod bsngags’’la go zhing / rje blon chab srid dam dpon 'bangs byas rjes sam ya rabs spyod stangs sam bkur 'os lha srung bcas la bstod tshig zhus pa yin pas de ltar btags par skad cing / bod kyi bstod glu'am bstod smon bsang brngan gyi zhu tshig dang 'dra ba red/ de ltar 'tshol sdud legs bcos byas pa'i dmigs yul ni dmangs sems rtogs shing — 33 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/ dmangs la gus lugs bslab nas chab srid legs par skyong ba'i thabs su dgos pa yin zer la/ phyis su mi rigs rang mtshan pa'i snyan ngag gi lugs srol spyi sdom byung ba'i gzhi dang 'dra dpe lta bur gyur nas phan yon rgya chen po byung zhing / skabs de'i rgya rigs kyi srid dbang 'dzin pa'i mdun na 'don gyi rigs te nang sgos su mtshan la khong chug gsol ba'am bod kyi yig rnying du gong rtse 'phrul gyi rgyal po zhes pa'i mkhas dbang khong yang 'tshol sgrig legs bcos su zhugs myong tshul grags/ nga dpyad rtogs thad nas phan shan thebs chul/ngag rgyun brtsams chos su bzhugs pa'i snang brnyan nam zab don can gyi gzugs bsdus brnyan 'dra 'ga' ni byung ha cang snga ba dang gna' bo'i yig tshags su thar thor du gnas kyang / phyi rabs rnams kyis skor de'i khungs phugs sam go don la cha rgyus mi ldan pa'i gnas tshul mang / de'i nang du mi rigs gang de'i rig gnas bang mdzod kyi phugs su bsrel ba'i nor bu lta bu'ang mi nyung / rtsom rig mkhan nam mkhas pa rnams kyis rang gi gsar rtsom gyi dgos mkho'am rtsom rig lag len gyi nyams myong spyi sdom byed pa'i dgos ched du btsal bsnyegs mtha' dpyod sgos bed spyod mdzad pa na/ rtsom rig dang rig gnas gong du spel bar bka' drin gsar du smin pa red/ dper na/gna' bo'i rang rgya nag gi zhang(deng gi sgra dod hrang yin)rgyal rabs kyi gong ma'i btsun mos lha bya nag po'i sgo nga mid pa'i rmi lam rmis nas sbrum chags shing /phyis su mdzad rjes can gyi rgyal po rgya ches zer ba de 'khrungs pa'i sgrung rgyud yod pa dang / de'i sngon zhig nas rgya ni nag por dad cing bya khyung nag po lha byar bkur ba dang / bya de 'tsho stobs ldan zhing tshe srog brtan pa dang / 'od — 34 —

ngag rgyun rtsom rig dang rtsom rig mkhan gyi bar phan tshun shan zhugs tshul gleng ba/gsal lha ste nyi ma'i bcud kyis btsas la nyi ma'i 'gros kyi byon ldog dang lhan gcig yin pa'i lha sgrung yang yod/ gzhan yang rgya yig gi gna' dpe 'ga' na‘‘then h+phang’’zhes pa'i rgyal khams(deng gi a rab khongs kyi gna' rabs rgyal khab cig yin)shig yod pa dang / de gar lha bya‘‘h+phas nyi khe si’’zhes bya ba shing dri zhim btus nas rang nyid sbyin sreg byas te 'chi med 'ja' lus sgrub pa'i lha sgrung yod pa 'di rnams bed spyad nas/ nye rabs kyi mkhas chen ko mo ra'o yis〈khyung chen myang 'das〉zhes pa'i grol ba'i snyan ngag spel/ brtsams chos de dus rabs 'di'i sne zin pa'i skabs su krung go'i nang logs sa khul du‘‘lnga bzhi las 'gul’’te rig gnas sam brda sprod khongs nas bslangs shing ma 'gyangs par chab srid kyi gsar brje ru gyur pa de'i khrod du brtsams pa yin la/krung hwa mi rigs nyid 'tsho stobs rnam par rgyas te 'byor ldan dpal la rol ba'i dus rabs gsar pa zhig bskrun bsu bya bar dung mo che'i sgra dbyangs bsgrags pas gsar brje'i las 'gul la skul ma che zab thebs pa red/gnyis pa/ gnod shan thebs tshul la/g.yo bzos thad/ khram 'grel thad/ hreng gyur thad bcas nas go ba len chogaka g.yo bzo byas tshul ni/dper na/ gna' bo'i ro ma rgyal khab 'go tshugs pa'i skabs su/ ti o nis se zhes pa'i lo rgyus smra ba'i mkhas pa des〈gna' rabs kyi ro ma〉zhes bya ba'i deb ther zhig brtsams shing / la che u yul dmangs kyi gdung rgyud ni ro ma'i 'byung khungs yin tshul du brjod 'dod kyang brtag dpyad byas mthar de ni ke ri se yi mi rgyud kyi mes po yin par shes la/ de 'dra'i dbang du btang na — 35 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/ke ri se mi dmangs kyis ro ma'i dbang sgyur 'khur bzod dgos pa la gnas lugs med par 'byung bas/ khos ke ri se'i lha sgrung khrod kyi su la khi li si zhes pa de 'das zin lo rgyus su 'tsho myong ba'i mi sna zhig tu g.yo bzo byas nas lo rgyus smra bar sgrung rgyud tshul du spyad cing / ro ma btsan rgyal gyi skabs bab chab srid dam dbang sgyur la zhabs 'degs byas pa'i spyod ngan de phyis su rig gzhung pa rnams kyis mdzub chung gtad yul du gyur tshul lta bu red/kha khram 'grel brgyab tshul ni/dper na/ deng sang bod yul gyi dmangs khrod na‘‘gnyan spre phugs bla’’zhes bya ba'i dad yul gnyan po zhig yod cing the'u rang gi kha gnon yin tshul du brjod pa dang / 〈lha 'dre'i bka' thang〉du 'byung ba'i‘‘gnyan sprel brdal ba chen po’’zer ba dang / bod ljongs nas sprel 'bag gam sprel gzugs can gyi rdza gog sogs rdo chas gsar ma'i phyi char nges shing dad yul gnyan po zhig tu go rung bar 'dod pa'i gna' rdzas sa khar thon pa'i dngos po'i dpang thob la/ yang na hi ma la ya rdza rgyud kyi srib ngos su gdan rabs snga ba'i dgon rnying gnyis nas srin po'i mgo lpags re bstan ma'am chos skyong gi rdzas su bkod pa rgyal khab phyi'i mkhas pa dag gis 'dra par dang bcas par ngo sprod byas byung ba de rnams la dpyad na/ bod mi ni spra srin gnyis bsdebs pa nas rgyud mched pa'i lha sgrung zhig snga thog rig gnas dpal yon dar ma thag tsam nas yod pa rlom thub la/ phyis su shākya'i bstan pa bod yul du spel 'go brtsams phyin/bod yul 'di sangs rgyas kyi gdul zhing yin pa dang nyid kyi bstan pa 'phel ba'i las 'phro yod pa lta bu'i rgyu mtshan dgos pa'i dpang du‘‘spre'u byang chub sems dpa'i sprul ba’’dang‘‘brag srin mo sgrol ma'i sprul ba’’gnyis kyi rgyud du — 36 —
