ngag rgyun rtsom rig dang rtsom rig mkhan gyi bar phan tshun shan zhugs tshul gleng ba/bod mi'u rigs drug byung tshul dang / tha na sprel phrug drug ni 'gro ba rigs drug gam ma ṇi yig drug gi skal bar las dbang yod tshul bcas ni chos lugs spel ba'i ched du de ltar 'grel brgyab pa yin par 'dod tshul mkhyen ldan du ma'i bzhed dgongs mtshungs/ga hreng gyur tu btang chul ni/dper na/ rgya rigs kyi snyan ngag nang gi tshig rkang rer 'bru lnga can dang / 'bru bdun can/ 'bru grangs la mang nyung yod cing rkang ba gang la ci tsam thob pa sogs nges par byas pa'i snyan tshig de rigs dang thog dmangs khrod kyi glu gzhas kyi lugs la 'jal nas bton pa yin mod/ 'on kyang /phyis su la la bya dka' ba'am lugs dam pa'i srol du 'khums/ la la lugs nges pa'i srol du bcun/ lugs srol du nges pa dam drags pas/ go ba len dka' ba dang btsan gyis tshig sdeb cing grub phyir gyong por gyur/ bod ltar na/gna' bo'i ngag rgyun gyi mgur de dmangs khrod du gnas skabs 'tsho nyams ldan 'ing go bde ba zhig yin la/ phyis su snyug thogs dag gis bstan pa skyong spel phyogs su spyad nas zab don rnam ston du gyur phyin/ sngon gyi 'tsho nyams ldan pa'i srol nas dmangs don 'tsho don dang kha thag je ring je ring du btang ba mdzub mo ri lags/ 〈la'u zhon gyi spyings yig bsdus pa〉las/ snyan ngag dang snyan tshig skor zhig gi lugs srol glu gzhas mgur sogs nas blangs pa'i rgyu mtshan bstan phyin/ ‘‘rig gnyer pas blangs te bdag gir bzung / de ltar yang yang brtsams pas lhag par go ni dka' la 'khyag hreng rdo ba'i tshul du bzos gyur phyin/ slar yang sna gcig blangs yong nas ngang gis bcings pas 'khums te 'chi’’zhes pa 'di gong gleng tshul gyi gnad du khel 'dug— 37 —

spel stangs kyi rtseg rim che khag gsum gyi thad nas ngag rgyun rtsom rig la dpyad pa/dge gnyen/rtsom rig gzhung lugs su sgyu rtsal gyi rang chos gsal ba'i spel stangs la rtseg rim du mas grub yod tshul bshad pa'i dgongs pa ltar brjod na mang drags pas/ 'dir brtsams chos kyi grub tshul bar du gnas pa'i gal chen gsum las kyang so so'i khongs gtogs kyi gtsigs shos tsam ma gtogs mi spro/skad rigs tha dad pa'i gzhung rnams su spyod bde'am rtseg rim mi nog pa'i ched du so so'i ming gi 'dogs tshul la'ang khyad par 'byed pa bzhin du/'dir gzhi rtsa'i spel stangs la spel jus dang / srol nges spel stangs la spel thabs dang / rgyun spyod spel stangs la spel tshul dang / zhib phye'i spel stangs te ches rting rim du chags shing rnyog rdzob kyi gnas shig tu'ang snang ba'i rgyan du ma 'dus nas grub pa'i rigs la rab spel zhes bya ba yin/spel jus kyi thad nas ngag rgyun rtsom rig la dpyad pa/ gzhi rtsa'i spol stangs las/ shin tu rgyug che ba la‘‘mngon srid ring lugs’’dang‘‘'char yan ring lugs’’‘‘mngon 'char rnam spel’’bcas spel jurji rikā~X che ba gsum du gril ba red/

spel stangs kyi rtseg rim che khag gsum gyi thad nas ngag rgyun rtsom rig la dpyad pa/mngon srid ring lugs kyi spel jus 'di rtsom rgyag lag len du byung ba shin tu snga yang / ming thogs pa ni spyi lugs kyi1895lor 'jar man gyi rtsom rig mkhan po shis le zhes pas khong gi〈bab chags kyi snyan ngag dang skyo dngan gyi snyan ngag smra ba〉ste grags pa khyab pa'i dpyad rtsom du thog mar rig pa smra bar spyad la ma 'gyangs par go ba len tshul kha mi mtshungs pa tsam du gnas/ dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i lo rabs lnga bcu par son pa na/ h+pha ran si'i mdzes ris mkhan po khor pe dang rtsom rtsal gzhung lugs mkhan po sha h+phu le lis kyis rig pa'i dung mo che'i sgra dbyangs bsgrags shugs kyis yo rob gling chen du khyab par gdal ba dang / dus rabs nyi shu pa'i 'go tsam du rang re'i e she ya gling du khyab 'go zin pa red/ 'di la nges shes 'drongs dgos na gnad bzhi gtsigs che/ (ka)'dis 'tsho ba'i bzhin nyams dang spyi tshogs 'das don gyi bzhin nyams rnal ma rang ji bzhin slar snang byed cing / spyi tshogs khor yug gang de'i ngo bo nyid zin yod byung ba phra mo dang mi'i chags sdang 'gyur ba sogs zol med dmar rjen du slar snang byed par dam bca' 'jog (kha)'dis 'tsho ba'i gnas su yang yang myangs pa'i byung ba dang yang yang mthong ba'i mi gshis kyi spyi'i rnam pa la do snang byas nas/ spyi sdom dang btso sbyong lta bur 'bad nas yul khongs de'i dper 'os khor yug dang dper 'os mi sna bzhengs 'god byed par dam bca' ba red/ (ga) 'dis spyi mtshan pa'i 'tsho nyams gang zhig rang mtshan pa'i dper 'os can du bzhengs ched/ mang po nas 'tsham pa btog nas yang sgrig dang / rtsom pa po'i mthong thos su ma brgyud kyang 'tsho ba'i chos nyid ltar na 'byung rung la yod 'os pa'i snang tshul rtog btags sgos spel bar khas len pa red/ (nga) 'dis rtog 'char ram zol sbyor ram sgro skur sogs 'char yan pa'i spel jus su rgyug che ba'i spel tshul — 39 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/sogs spyod mi chog pa min mod/ 'on te/ 'tsho ba'i gnas kyi de nyid dang mthun pa'am gzung yul gyi rang bzhin las mi 'da' ba zhig tu tshod gzung dgos pa'i khas len yod pa red/ngag rgyun rtsom rig khrod du mngon srid ring lugs kyi spel jus ngang ngam du thon nas grub pa'i brtsams chos mi nyung yang / rtsom rig mkhan gyi brtsams chos tshad ldan dang bsdur na tshags zhib mo thon yod pa dkon par snang /'char yan ring lugs kyi spel jus 'di'i lag len phal cher gdod ma'i spyi tshogs kyi phyi cha nas byung zin mod/ 'on te ming du nges pa ni dus rabs bco brgyad pa dang bcu dgu pa'i mthud mtshams su yo rob gling du 'char yan ring lugs kyi rtsom stangs rab tu rgyas pa'i skabs der byung bar grags/ dang 'gor rtsom 'god kyi bsam blo'i 'khyer phyogs nges pa can zhig la go yang / ngang gis go don rgya bskyed de mngon srid ring lugs kyi lhos zla dang gzhi rtsi'i spel stangs shig tu grub pa red/ 'dir go ba len na gnad gsum yod pa la bsgrim dgos/ (ka)rtsom pa po'i phugs 'dun ji bzhin yid 'ong snang khams shig bzhengs 'god ched du/ mngon srid 'tsho ba'i gnas tsam du mi 'khums par mthong rgya che zhing blo khog yangs por brten nas snang srid 'jig rten de rang gi phyag mthil du blangs yod pa'i nyams mtshon pa la shin tu phyogs/ (kha)rtsom pa po'i phugs 'dun ji bzhin phugs 'dun can gyi mi sna'i snang brnyan bzhengs 'god ched du/ 'tsho ba'i bden pas tshod 'dzin ma thebs pa dang / tha na dus tshod dang gnas tshod kyis tshod bzung yang ma thebs na chog pa'i tshul du/ snang brnyan der bla na med pa'i dmigs yul dang / khyad du 'phags pa'i blo rig 'gran zla bral ba'i stobs shugs/mtshar 'os pa'i rdzu 'phrul/ ha las rung ba'i mthu rtsal/ kun las rgyal ba'i — 40 —

spel stangs kyi rtseg rim che khag gsum gyi thad nas ngag rgyun rtsom rig la dpyad pa/bzod bsran/ yid du shong dka' ba'i myong rgyud bcas yod pa can zhig tu bzhengs 'god byed pa lags/ (ga)sgyu rtsal spel stangs kyi thad du/ 'char yan pa'i rtog btags dang zol sbyor/ sgro 'dogs/ skur 'debs/ yang na 'ud chen pos brjod pa'i thabs spyad nas byung ba mtshar zhing rdzu 'phrul lta bu'i nyams ldan pa/ chags sdang 'gyur ba ni rgya mtsho rgyas pa'i rngam rlabs 'phyo ba ltar skyom shugs drags pa/ de yang lha'am lha ma yin gyi sgrung 'bum gyi gshis lci ba 'di 'dra zhig tu snang ba yin/ngag rgyun rtsom rig nang du 'char yan ring lugs kyi spol jus thon yod pa'i brtsams chos mang ste/ nang sgos su lha sgrung dang sgrung rgyud/ glu sgrung chen mo dang 'phrul snang gtam rgyud bcas su mngon gsal yin mod/ 'on kyang rtsom rig mkhan gyi rtsom rig dang bsdur na ngag rgyun du 'char yan ring lugs kyi spel jus spyad pa la dmangs kyi shes rig yon tshad kyis tshod bzung thebs phyir/ gna' gshis can nam 'das don skor brjod par spro ba'i phyogs zhen mngon che ba yin la/ rtsom rig mkhan gyi rtsom rig ji bzhin mi rnams blo rig 'phel bar bsam ba'in du dmigs shing tshan rig shes byar brten nas 'ongs pa'i phyogs su bsnyegs pa'i brtsams chos shin tu nyung /mngon srid ring lugs dang 'char yan ring lugs rnam par spel ba'i spel jus 'di'i lag len yang byung shin tu snga/ 'on te rig gzhung du ngos bzung ba ni mngon srid pa dang 'char yan pa ngos bzung ba'i phyis su byung ba red/ mi rnams kyi phugs 'dun ni rang rang so so'i 'tsho ba'i myong rgyud dang rig gnas yon tan spyi tshogs go gnas/ chab srid phyogs zhen la sogs pa'i tshod bzung dbang du gyur pa zhig yin pas tshul dang rnam pa shin tu mang /rigs che rags tsam du bkar na/ phal cher spyi tshogs 'phel phyogs dang — 41 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/mthun la gdong gral du gnas pa'i mdun brtson can gyi rigs shig dang / spyi tshogs 'phel phyogs dang mi mthun pa'am 'phel phyogs kyi rjes mi chod pa'i rjes lus can gyi rigs shig ste gnyis su phye rung ba red/ des na rang gi phugs 'dun ltar brjod bya'i mi sna'am byung ba'am dngos po sogs btso sbyong byas te mngon srid pa dang 'char yan pa zung du sbrel nas rtsom brgyab pa na/mngon srid pas 'tsho ba'i gnas tshul la brtsi 'jog byed pa dang 'char yan pas phugs 'dun la do snang byed pa gcig tu bsgril 'gyur zhing sgyu rtsal gyi 'brid 'gug stobs shugs de bas che bar 'gyur ba dang / rtsom rig gi phyogs res kyang mngon 'char so so tsam las de bas mngon gsal bar snang /ngag rgyun brtsams chos su mngon 'char rnam spel gyi rnam pa can shin tu mang / gtam rgyud dang sgrung rgyud dang glu sgrung dang snyan mgur bcas su de bas mngon che ba red/ mngon 'char rnam spel gyi tshul du byung ba'i sgyu rtsal snang khams sam snang brnyan bzhengs mtshon byung ba rnams kyi phyogs zhen ni rtsom rig mkhan gyi brtsams chos ltar bsam bzhin du dang rang rtogs mtho tsam gyi mdzad pa zhig phal cher ma yin te/ bsam bzhin du byas kyang dmigs gtad de 'dra mi gsal ba red/ rang rtogs yod kyang tshad de 'dra mngon par mtho ba zhig min par snang / 'di ni‘‘dbang sgyur can gyi dgongs pa ni dbang sgyur go gnas zin pa'i dgongs pa yin’’zhes pa'i shan thebs pa dang / yun ring bo dang mi mang bor brgyud nas gter rdo rang chu rgyun du 'gril 'gyangs pa nang bzhin rtse zur dbal so mngon dod min par gyur pa lta bu yin srid/spel thabs kyi thad nas ngag rgyun rtsom nig la dpyad pa/srol nges spel stangs zhes pa rtsom rig gi sgrig gzhi la dmigs nas — 42 —

spel stangs kyi rtseg rim che khag gsum gyi thad nas ngag rgyun rtsom rig la dpyad pa/bshad pa ste/ spel stangs spyi'i rtseg rim rnams mi 'khrug pa'i ched du spel thabs zhes kyang bya rigs pa red/ rtsom rig lag len gyi rgya mtsho lta bu nas 'di'i rigs spyi sdom byung ba'i nor bu'ang shin tu mang / skabs 'dir ngag rgyun rtsom rig gi ngo bo rtogs par mkho ba'i gnad don gnyis la cung zad spro/dang po/ rjod pa po dang brjod 'gyun thabs/rtsom rig gzhung 'grel rnams su rjod pa po rang nyid rtsom du the tshul mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis rnams pa gsum du bkar/ gcig ni‘‘bos tshul dang po’’dang‘‘ngos bzung rang’’zhes don gcig ming gi rnam grangs su brjod/ gzhan zhig ni‘‘bos tshul gnyis pa’’dang‘‘ngos bzung khyed’’ces bstan don gcig la ming thogs tshul gnyis su bshad/ yang gcig ni‘‘bos tshul gsum pa’’dang‘‘ngos bzung kho’’zhes go don gcig la tshig zin sna gnyis bsnyad/ bos tshul rnam gsum zer ba 'di sgrig gzhir ltos pa bcas pa'i spel thabs rigs gsum yin/ bos tshul dang po ltar brjod pa'i brtsams chos su rjod pa po rang nyid brjod byar zhugs yod pa'i tshul du 'byung la/ nga rang gis ci mthong ji myong lta bu sogs brjod pa dang / ‘‘nga rang’’gi dbang bos rtsom du bzhugs pa'i khor yug mi sna dang byung don sogs thad kar myong ba'i tshul du brjod par 'gyur bas na/ klog nyan pa rnams la brjod pa'i gnas tshul bden par snang ba'i yon tan bskyed/ngos bzung rang la zhib phye'i rnam pa gnyis yod cing / gcig ni‘‘rjod po'i rang’’ste nga rang zhes pa brtsams chos su the'ang don dam du brjod thabs tsam du zad/ gzhan de ni‘‘brjod pa'i rang’’ste/ rang de rjod pa po tsam du ma — 43 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/tshad par brtsams chos nang nas mtshon bzhengs byung ba'i mi sna nges can gyi snang brnyan zhig kyang yin pa'i tshul du 'byung ba red/bos tshul gnyis pa ltar brjod pa'i brtsams chos su rjod pa po rang nyid rtsom gyi tshig zin du mi the na'ang shugs bstan du khor yug de la the zhing / khyod kyi ci dang khyed kyis ji zhes brjod par 'gyur la/ ngos bzung khyod ces par gtad nas lab gleng byed bzhin pa'i tshul gyis rtsom pa po rang gi chags sdang 'char snang dang 'das don dran pa'i tshul du brjod pa red/ 'di la'ang zhib phye'i rnam pa gnyis yod cing / gcig ni‘‘rjod po'i khyod’’de don dam du brjod thabs tsam du zad/ gzhan de ni‘‘brjod pa'i khyod’’de shugs su'ang rjod pa po nyid brjod bya'i khor yug tu yod cing / brjod thabs tsam du ma tshad par shugs bstan gyis khyod kyi zla phyogs te rtsom pa po'ang byung don gyi rkyen dang bsdongs ba'i tshul du 'byung ba red/bos tshul gsum pa ltar brjod pa'i brtsams chos su rjod pa po bzhugs don du mi the zhing/ kho dang kho tsho'i ci dang ji zhes pa'i tshul du byung don rdzob 'dzengs dag brjod pa yin/ brjod thabs 'di la 'tsho ba'i gnas kyi skye rgu bde sdug zlos gar ji bzhin rang gi pang du blangs nas ltad mo de kun la bsgrags pa'i tshul zhig yin pas/ brjod bya rgya chen bkod sgrig byed bde ba'i khyad chos yod pas na/ shin tu rgyug che ba'i spel thabs shig red/ngos bzung‘‘kho’’yi spel thabs 'di ngag rgyun dang yig rgyun gyi rtsom rig tu 'dra mtshungs yin te zhib tu gleng ba'i dgos pa med/ ngos bzung‘‘khyod’’kyi spel thabs 'di rtsom rig mkhan gyi rtsom rig tu snyan mgur dang 'das don slar dran nam dam pa rnams dran gso'am mya ngan zhu ba lta bu'i rtsom nyung shos su ma gtogs mi rgyug pa red/ 'on te ngag rgyun rtsom rig tu glu gzhas sam — 44 —

spel stangs kyi rtseg rim che khag gsum gyi thad nas ngag rgyun rtsom rig la dpyad pa/gnyan po la brngan mchod dang mgon po la skyabs bcol ba sogs su shin tu rgyug pa red/ rgyu mtshan gyi gtso gnad ni glu gzhas la gtad yul shags zla yod pa dang brngan mchod gsol 'bul la zol sbyor gyi dbang du gtad yul yod par rlom pa yin pas spel thabs 'di byung shin tu snga ba'ang grub 'dugangos bzung‘‘rang’’gi spel thabs 'di yig rtsom du mi nyung yang / ngag rgyun du phal cher mi snang / mi snang na'ang ma srid pa min te gang zhig gis rang gis myong ba'i byung don zhig brjod pa lta bu red/ 'on kyang gtam mi khar brgyud na 'gyur nges zhes pa nang bzhin/ ngag rgyun rtsom rig gi rtsom 'god dang bed spyod dang khyab spel bcas yongs su kha rna bar du gcig nas gcig la brgyud pa'i ngang du gnas shing bsrel pa yin phyir ngos bzung‘‘rang’’gi tshul du rgyug cing khyab mi thub pa red/gnyis pa/ 'dra bsdus dang nab bsdus/'dra bsdus la nges shes 'drongs dgos na thog mar rab bsdus la go ba nges dgos/ rtsom rgyag pa'i skabs su bsdus brjod kyi rgyan dang / sbyar ba'i rgyan/ mtshungs sbyor gyi rgyan/ gab tshig gi rgyan spyi dang nang sgos rab btags kyi gab tshig lta bu mang du spyad nas/ phal cher brtsams chos de'i ma lag yongs su brjod 'dod kyi don gang yang rung ba zhig tshig zin du 'byung yang don gzhan dag brjod pa'i shugs su bstan yod pa can gyi spel thabs shig grub yod pa la rab bsdus zhes bya rigs pa yin la/ mi rigs khag gi ngag rgyun dang yig rgyun du rgyug gin 'dugade yang gong gleng bsdus brjod dang rab btags la sogs pa'i brgyan thabs dang / tha na gzugs rgyan dang dpe rgyan sogs yun ring spyad nas — 45 ge

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/mtshon byed brnyan 'dra la brten nas mtshon bya'i don rnams mtshungs chos kyi zam par brgyud nas go ba len tshul mi rnams la goms shing / mtshon byed bya dngos tsam bstan tshe phugs don yang thogs med du blos zin pas na/ mtshon byed rang ni dod rtags shig tu chags te rang gi rig gnas ma lag gi srol du grub pa red/ dper na/ go ba med pa dang u tshugs che ba dang rgyud gyong po yin pa dag gi don ni glang rgan zhes bya'i brnyan 'dra 'dis bsdus yod pa dang / blo rig ldan zhing brtson 'grus yod pa'i don ni ri bong gi brnyan 'dra 'dis bsdus yod pa/ nyi ma dmar po ni than pa dang sdug bsngal lam dus ngan nam ltas mi legs pa'i mtshon rtags su spyod srid pa/ 'di dag bod du'ang rgyug pas rgyus dgos med/ rgya nag gi rig gnas ma lag tu mya ngan nam 'jigs rung ngam bkra mi shis pa'am dgra phyogs bcas kyi don ni kha dog dkar pos 'khu bar bsdus yod pa dang / 'jar pan gyi rig gnas su kho tsho rgya mtsho'i gling phran du gnas la nyi ma rgya mtsho nas shar yong bar rtog ste nyi ma 'byung ba'i rgyal khams zhes rang bstod byed cing nyi ma'i brnyan 'dra ni rgyal khab kyi thob rtags su bkod la/ nyi ma'i nag tig ces pa rgyal srid kyi skyon dang rang mi rigs kyi zhan cha bcas kyi dod rtags su goms pa red/ 'di dang 'di lta bu la‘‘srol chags 'dra bsdus’’zhes brjod pa yin zhing / srol chags 'dra bsdus kyis snang rtog dang rab bsdus kyi spel thabs gnyis zung 'brel gyi tshul du bkol na da gzod ngag gi sgyu rtsal gyi 'dra bsdus byung ba red/rgyal khams mi nyung ba na 'di 'dra ba ni spel thabs shig tu ngos 'dzin pa ma zad/ thabs 'di gtso bor bzung ba'i rtsom rgyun grub mtha' yang rigs du ma byung yod pa red/spel thabs 'di'i khyad chos gtso bo nyid ni 'khu bar sdud byed kyi bya — 46 —

spel stangs kyi rtseg rim che khag gsum gyi thad nas ngag rgyun rtsom rig la dpyad pa/dngos kyis brtsams chos nas shugs bstan nam gsang tsam du rung ba'i zab don zhig ston par snyeg cing / me tog bshad kyang go dgos pa ni de'i dri ngad yin la/ ji skad du ‘‘gzugs yod can du gzugs med 'jug pa dang /gzhal yod can du gzhal med 'jug pa/ ltos 'phral can du rtag don 'jug pa/ sdud byed chu shel rdog pos bsdus don nor bu 'dra zhig bstan yong’’zhes pa gnad yin/ h+pha ran si'i 'dra bsdus ring lugs pa'i snyan ngag mkhan po po ti ler(1821—1867)gyi gosung las‘‘yag spros su brten nas ngas ni dmyal khams bsngogs srid’’‘‘kho bor rdul snyigs gtad kyang de nyid gser nag tu bsgyur nges’’zhes pa las kyang gsal ba red/'dra bsdus zer ba 'di ngag rgyun dang yig rgyun gnyis kar rgyug cing /snga ma'i nang du phal cher lha sgrung ngam sgrung rgyud dam mgur sgrung ring mo'am rdzu 'phrul gtam rgyud sogs su rgyug pa yin la/ 'di 'dra'i spel thabs la cha rgyus mi ldan na brtsams chos 'di'i rigs la go ba'ang len dka' ba red/ bod du gragasache ba'i〈ro sgrung〉zer ba de gtam rgyud mang po phreng bar brgyus pa'i thabs tsam du zad pa ma yin te/ slob dpon klu sgrub snying pos rnam 'dren sangs rgyas bsdus pa dang / ro dngos grub can gyis 'khor ba'i gnas kyi ltung shan mi rnams bsdus/ rgyal bu bde spyod bzang pos dge spyong bsdus/ slob dpon gyis gdams pa bzhin ro dngos grub can 'dren zhing gser lus 'thob par brtson pa des mi rnams kyi lus rten ro khog la rnam shes yang yang brten cing / 'tsho gnas su skyid sdug gi zlos gar yang yang bsgyur ba'i tshul de dang / ltung shan mi rnams dag zhing du 'dren pa ni ro dngos grub can bzhin du yang log yang skor ha cang dka' las che ba yin pa bsdus/ gtam rgyud re re'i nang du phal cher rgyu 'bras snying rje sogs lam rim chen mo'i zab — 47 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/don re bsdus yod pas/ ston pa'am bstan pa dang gdul bya dang dge 'dun rnams kyi sgrub sbyong bcas brnyan 'dra'i tshul du thon gyur cing / go sla la phal ba rnams kyi mos pa skyed pa'i gtam rgyud kyi phreng ba'i nang du 'di 'dra'i zab don gnas pa 'dra bsdus kyi spel thabs 'ba' zhig lags/spel tshul gyi thad nas ngag rgyun rtsom rig la dpyadapa/rgyun spyod spel stangs zhes pa 'di gtso bo rjod byed tshig gi cha nas bshad pa ste/ yin ring bo'i gsar rtsom lag len la brgyud nas thun mong tsam gyi lugs srol zhig tu gyur phyir 'di ltar ngos bzung ba yin la/ spel stangs kyi rtseg rim so so mi 'khrug pa'i ched du spel tshul zhes bya rigs pa red/'di la nang gses gtso bo che ba bzhi yod cing / brjod pa dang mtshon pa dang / dngags pa dang bgros pa zhes bya chog pa red/brjod pa ste rtsom rig tu ha cang rgyug che bas na gzhi rtsa'i spel tshul gyi ya gyal du 'jog cing / brtsoms chos khrod kyi mi sna la gtso phal lam the ba'am shugs bstan bcas kyi khyad par yod pa na/ skabs bab gnad min dag la rags rim tsam gleng bas chog pa dang / brtsams chos khrod kyi yul khul gang gi chags tshul yul bkod dam nges pa can gyi dus rabs gang 'dra'i spyi tshogs kyi spyir btang gnas tshul sogs rgyab ljongs su gyur pa'i khor yug chen po'am/bya ba gang 'byung bzhin pa'i rten gnas sam skabs de'i mi rnams kyi bar du chags pa'i 'brel ba bcas nges gtan khor yug la'ang dngos zhar shugs gsum gyi khyad par yod pa las rnal mi bya ba rnams rags rim tsam gsal bshad byas na chog pa dang / brtsams chos khrod kyi byung don la gzhang gzhogs zur gsum gyi khyad par yod phyir rnal mi bya ba rnams rags rim tsam ngo sprod — 48 —

spel stangs kyi rtseg rim che khag gsum gyi thad nas ngag rgyun rtsom rig la dpyad pa/byas na chog pa dang / yang na brtsams chos khrod kyi mi sna'am khor yug gam byung don sogs kyi phyogs so so lhan gcig tu sgril bar byed pa dang / mdor na klog nyan pa por brjod don gyi spyir khog tsam go bar 'jug pa'i spyir btang gi mtshams sbyor gyis 'tshams pa'i rigs la yongs su brjod pa'i spel tshul 'di spyod pa red/ srol rgyun gyi snyan ngag gzhung 'grel du‘‘rigs rang bzhin brjod pa’’ zer ba 'di brjod pa'i khongs gtogs su 'dus yod snyam la/gzhan yang spyir brtsams chos kyi don rnams phra zhib kyis mngon par byed pa la mtshon pa zer ba 'jug rung la/ rags bsdus 'os pa'i skor ni brjod pa'i tshul 'dis ston par byed pa yin/brjod pa dang mtshon pa gnyis rtag tu spel ma'i tshul du 'byung bas mtshon brjod go rim gyi dbang du btang na rigs chen po gsum du phye/ (ka)sri bzhin mtshon brjod(bsdus na‘‘srid brjod’’zer chog)'di ni mi sna'i myong brgyud dam byung don rang gi 'phel rim ji bzhin mtshon zhing brjod pa ste/byung ba snga phyi dus kyi snga phyi dang 'grig pa'i tshul du snga mas phyi ma 'dren pa dang mgo 'jug skod gsum byung don rang gi dngar ba mi 'khrug par mtshon brjod byung na go rim gsar la cha tshang ba'i yon tan du smin/ (kha)ldog par mtshon brjod(bsdus na‘‘ldog brjod’’zer chog)'di ni mi sna'i myong brgyud dam byung don gyi mjug 'bras sam yang na don snying khyad du gtso bos go rim zhig sngon du bkod sgrig byas nas gnad gang 'bur thon byed pa'am rol myong byed pa po la spro ba 'phel 'jug pa'am‘‘yid 'phyang’’(yid kyi 'phyang mo)zhig tu 'chag 'jug pa bcas kyi dgos mkho grub zin pas na da gzod byang don rang gi go rim la zhugs nas brjod par 'gyur ba can la bshad pa red/ (ga)gsab par mtshon brjod(bsdus na‘‘gsab brjod’’zer chog)'di ni byung don gtso bo zhig da 49 da

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/brjod bzhin pa'i skabs su de'i 'das zin 'byung rkyen dang / mi snar 'brel yod kyi snga don zhig byung don der 'brel zhing mkho ba'i skor gang rung zhig kha skong ngam 'grel bshad dam rgyu mtshan ston pa bcas kyi dgos pa'i dbang du skabs bab brjod don du dum tshan re gsab cing 'jug pa'i don la zer ba red/brjod pa'i spel tshul 'di ngag rgyun rtsom rig tu ha cang rgyug che/ de yang / sgrung tshul gyi brtsams chos mang che bar srid brjod kyi spel tshul snang la/ldog brjod dang gsab brjod ni srid pa tsam las mi 'byung / rgyu mtshan rags tsam gleng na/ srid brjod kyi spel tshul 'di la nyan pa pos go bde zhing yid du nges sla ba'i khyad chos yod cing / ldog brjod dang gsab brjod lta bu spyad na go log go 'khrul 'byung bar mdzes pa los yin snyam/mtshon pa ste byung ba can gyi brtsams chos su med mi rung ba yin pas rigs 'di'i khongs kyi gzhi rtsa'i spel tshul zhig la 'jog cing / rtsom mkhan gyis snyan 'dra tsam ston nus pa'i gtam la brten nas mi sna dang las bya'i khyad chos kyi snang tshul zhib rgyas 'tsho nyams can du yong bar gzab nan gyis 'god pa'am bkod pa la bshad/ bya ba'i yul gyi khyad par dbang du/ mi sna mtshon pa dang khor yug mtshon pa gnyis su bkar yod/ mi sna mtshon pa la nang gses su gzugs brnyan mtshon pa dang / sems 'gyur mtshon pa/ bya spyod mtshon pa/ lab gleng mtshon pa bcas su phye ba red/ khor yug mtshon pa la nang gses su rang byung mthong snang mtshon pa dang 'tsho gnas mthong snang mtshon pa gnyis su phye ba red/ sngon gyi snyan ngag gzhung don du bya ba rang bzhin brjod pa dang / yon tan rang bzhin brjod pa bcas kyang 'dir gtogs 'dug snyam la/ mtshon pa zhes bya ba'i skabs su rgyan gzhan dang spel — 50 —

spel stangs kyi rtseg rim che khag gsum gyi thad nas ngag rgyun rtsom rig la dpyad pa/ma 'gog pa'i khyad par yod pa red/gzhan du'ang khyad par can gyis mtshon tshul gnyis bshad cing /gcig ni‘‘phra nyams mtshon pa’’(‘‘phra mtshon’’zhes bsdu chog)dang gzhan de ni‘‘skya nyams mtshon pa’’(‘‘skya mtshon’’zhes bsdu chog)zhes bya ba red/ phra nyams mtshon pa ni snang brnyan bzhengs pa'i ched du bya dngos phran bu'am dngos pa'i snang tshul phra zhib pa'i thad de'i khyad chos sam rang gshis sam gnas tshul rnal ma gang nung zhig shin tu zhib par mtshon pa la bshad pa yin/ sngon gyi snyan ngag gzhung don du rdzas rang bzhin brjod pa dang phra mo ba'i rgyan zhes pa ni bya ba phran bu mtshon pa dang mtshungs kyang phra mtshon gyi skabs 'dir rgyan gzhan pa dang spel ma mi 'gog pa'i khyad par yod/ skya nyams mtshon pa ni sems can nam dngos po'i snang brnyan der tshon mdangs ma gos pa'am rgyas spros ma byas par tshig shin tu gron chung ba'i tshul du nyid kyi 'bur thon khyad chos dag bsdus gsal nyams dang ldan pa zhig tu mtshon pa'i tshul la bshad cing / bris ris sgyu rtsal gyi tha snyad rtsom rig tu sbyar ba yin la/ bod kyi skya thang bri tshul dang da lta'i 'khyug bris ri mo bri tshul dag dang 'dra ba'i dbang du spyad pa red/ngag rgyun rtsom rig khrod du/ mi sna mtshon pa'i thad nas bya spyod mtshon pa 'di shin tu rgyug che/ gzugs brnyan dang sems 'gyur dang lab gleng mtshon pa'i thad nas rang byung mthong snang mtshon pa sogs yod cing / snyan sgrung ring mo'am gtam rgyud ring shos nas ma gtogs rgyug che ba min/ khor yug mtshon pa'i thad nas rang byung mthong snang mtshon pa dang 'tsho gnas mthong snang mtshon pa bcas ni rags tsam pa las mi 'byung / yang na brjod pa'i tshul gyis tshab byas 'gro ba red/ phra nyams mtshon pa ni srid kyang rgyug mi che/ skya nyams mtshon pa'i thabs 'di phra shin tu rgyug che ba dang / yig bkod rtsom — 51 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/rig mkhan gyi brtsams chos dang bsdur na yang snyan 'jebs yid dbang 'gug pa'i mtshan gzhi mang po snang ba red/bgros pa ste rtsom rig khrod rtag tu spyod cing brjod mtshon dngags gsum gyi ram 'degs su mkho ba'i spel tshul med mi rung ba zhig yin la/'byung tshul ni brjod mtshon dngags gsum gyi sbrags su spyod pa dang / yang na rtsom pa po rang gi phyogs ris dang lta ba dang rnam 'gyur sogs thad kar bgros pa'i thabs la brten nas skabs bab bya ba'am dngos po'i rang bzhin nges pa'i cha re 'ga' mngon par bton pas na/ phyi nyams tsam rtogs pa nas khog rnal 'bugs par 'gyur ba dang / mngon sum tsam rtogs pa nas rjes dpag gi rtogs pa nges par 'gyur ba'i yon tan 'byung zhing / sku ris la spyan dod pa nang bzhin spur thebs chung yang 'tsho nyams zhugs su bcug pa lta bu'i nus pa ldan srid/ngag rgyun rtsom rig khrod du thad kar bgros pa nyin tu nyung / brjod pa dang mtshon pa'i sbrags su 'byung ba yin la/ rtsom rig mkhan gyi rtsom rig dang bsdur na de yang zhar byung tshig zin nyung ngu dang shugs bstan lta bu rgyug che ba red/ dngags pa dang sbrags byung can ha cang mang yang / rgyun chags kyi tshul ni dpe dang sbyar nas bgros pa dang / cha 'jog gi sgo nas bgros pa/ mi sna'i chags sdang dang sbyar nas bgros pa/ yul khod mtshon par legs min gleng ba/ bden dge yag gsum dang rdzun nyes dme gsum sogs bsdur ba'i sgo nas bgros pa/ chags sdang ngam bstod smad dam mkhas blun sogs gshib pa'i sgo nas bgros pa bcas ni rgyug che bar snang /dngags pa ste ngag tu bcangs pa la go zhing / snyan ngag ces pa‘‘snyan pa'i ngag’’dang snyan dngags zhes pa‘‘snyan par bcangs pa’’lta bu'i khyad par — 52 —

spel stangs kyi rtseg rim che khag gsum gyi thad nas ngag rgyun rtsom rig la dpyad pa/phran tsam yod/ dngags pa'i spel tshul 'di rtsom rig yongs su rgyug cing nang sgos chags sdang shugs drags par thon pa'i brtsams chos su de bas gtso che bar 'jog sngags 'chang dag gis bya yul zhig la mos sun rnam 'gyur zhig sngags bon par sbyar te sngags zor lta bu'i dngos po'i steng du sgrub zug par byas nas rol pa gang du shan bzo nus pa la rlom pa'i tshul dang cha mtshungs pa tsam yod de/ dngags pa ni mi sna'am bya ba'am khor yug gam de dag la mos sun sogs mtshon par rang rtogs yod med gang rung dang / mngon shugs gnyis nas brtsams chos su skyo spro pham spobs kyi nyams dang bcas pa'am‘‘khams 'gyur gyis zin pa'i snang rtog byung yul’’(bsdus na‘‘khams zin snang yul’’bya rung)zhes pa de la bshad/ khams zhes pa ni khams sangs sam khams dwangs dub zer ba'i don dang / 'gyur zhes pa yid kyi 'gyur ba'am rnam 'gyur la go ba dang / snang ni mig lam du mthong ba'am yid ngor shar ba'am gsal ba bcas su 'jug ngag gi sgyu rtsal gyi thon 'bras te khams zin snang yul gyis klog nyan pa po'i sems sgul nus pa zhig yin srid/dngags pa'i 'byung tshul dang thon 'bras la nges shes 'drongs dgos na‘‘phugs gnyis’’dang ‘‘rgyu gnyis’’ ‘‘rkyen gnyis’’yang na khams 'gyur gyis 'dzin tshul bcas la go ba yod dgos pas cung zad spro/dang po/ phugs kyi skon dod tsam gleng ba/snang srid 'jig rten 'khor skyod kyi dbang du lo zla tshes tshigs gza' zhag dus skar sogs bstan rtsis nas gsal ba nang bzhin dang / 'di'i 'gros su char rlung dro grang ngam snang mun sad 'khyag gam skam gsher sngo skya bcas srid pa snod kyi lugs chags phyir/ 'greng mi bu'i zas gos skom chas te — 53 —

—— mutigaglingagi dga' ston/'tsho rten gyi dbang du gnyer ba'i thon skyed dang chags spyod gnyen sbrel bcas rang gi rigs rgyud spel ba'i thon skyed 'di gnyis kyi dgos pa spyi ste/ dper na mi rnams kyi gom 'gros 'degs 'chag dang / lag stabs lus stangs sogs phyi'i 'gul skyod mtha' dag gi sbrags su/ nang gi 'gul skyod de khrag rtsa'i ldang ba/ chu rtsa'i ldang ba/ glo ba'i 'byin rngub/ snying gi 'phar lding /zas skom 'ju 'dor/ sha lpags rgyus rka'i grim lhod la sogs gso rig tu bsta na pa 'di rnams rten chen rang byung snod kyi srid pa dang rten chung bcud ma chog nyid mi'i lus khams kyi srid pa 'di gnyis 'brel bcas su grub pa'i chos nyid mi'i rang rgyud du bag la nyal byung ba phugs shig la grub pa red/gzung yul dngos po'am dngos po bar gyi byed las 'gul skyod sogs phyi yi snang ba rnams dus tshod dbang du thog mtha' bar gsum dang / rten tshod dbang du phyos/sa logs mtshams khyon/ grangs tshod dbang du gcig bcu brgya stong / shong tshad dbang du 'phel 'grib tshud mer/ bongs dbyibarige dbang du grig zlum spor leb/ 'gul skyod dbang du gtad rgol sdud 'bud bcas gzhal yul du gyur pa'i chos can rnams 'jal byed kyi dod du gyur cing /li tho'am chu tshod dam lam la tshigs ma dang zas la thun tshigs lta bur chags te/ phyi rol lam lus khams su yod pa'i chos nyid sbrel bar blo chos su gyur pa dang blo chos 'a/ rten nas bzos chas sna tshogs byung bas na/ spyi tshogs re ga gnas te‘‘dngos blo'i dpal yon rigs gnyis’’sam‘‘lam lugs kyi dpal yon’’rtsis na rigs gsum yang zer ba 'di phugs shig la grub pa red/gnyis pa/ rgyu rkyen gyi skor dod tsam gleng ba/dngags pa'i skabs kyi rgyu gnyis zhes patshoni/ skabs bab gzung yul te da 54 da

spel stangs kyi rtseg rim che khag gsum gyi thad nas ngag rgyun rtsom rig la dpyad pa/ dngos po'am dngos po'i 'gul skyod dam bya ba byung ba'i nyams dang rnam pa bcas rgyu gcig tu ngos 'dzin/ skabs bab yul gang yang rung bar mnyam 'jog gam blo sgrim par nus pa'i sems kyi 'dzin pa'am sems 'dzin zhes pa rgyu gcig tu ngos 'dzin/skyes bu gang ci'i bdag nyid can zhig gi dbang du btang na/ gzung yul de sems 'dzin la snang ngor byung phyir shan thebs pa dang / 'dzin pas gzung ba la tshor 'du skyes pa/ 'di ltar gang zag gang de'i rang ngos nas yang yang byung zhing gzung 'dzin 'brel ba myong goms grub rtogs byung nas 'dzin stangs su gyur pa na/ gal te gzung 'dzin 'brel ba gsar pa zhig la 'phrad dus khams 'gyur 'byung rkyen zhig tu smin pa yin/ rkyen 'di nyid skyes bu sger gyi dbang du btang ba'i cha shas zhes brjod cing / spyi tshogs kyi rang bzhin ldan pa ni mi'i mtshan nyid 'dzin pa'i gnas gal chen zhig yin phyir/gong gleng phugs gnyis de skabs bab gzung 'dzin 'brel ba gsar par 'phrad dus khams zin snang yul 'byung ba'i rkyen gzhan du smin pa yin la/rkyen 'di mi'i khyu tshogs gang gi spyi'i dbang du btang ba'i cha shas zhes brjod pa red/rkyen gnyis kyi 'brel ba ni spyi rkyen gyis sger rkyen la tshod 'dzin dang thun mong can du kha lo sgyur bar byed/ sger rkyen gyis spyi rkyen la grub cha gsar pa kha skong dang phun sum je tshogs su gtong ba red/gsum pa/ 'gyun 'dzin gyi skor dod tsam gleng ba/gzung 'dzin 'brel ba gsar pa zhig la 'phrad tshe/ 'dzin pa'i tshor rtog de gzung bar bstun pa'i sbrags su rgyu rkyen rnams 'dus nas 'char snang — 55 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/sprin phung brdal ba na/ dog mo'i klung nas rlabs 'phyo ba dang a yangs dgong nas glog 'khyug pa nang bzhin gzung ba'i cha nas 'phyos pa de 'dzin par 'gyur ba dang / 'dzin pa'i cha nas 'phros pa de gzung bar phar bgos shing /bag chags spyi sger rkyen gnyis sad byung la/ sgyu rtsal gyi nam yang gsar pa snyeg par phyogs pa'i dbang du 'dzin par 'khrugs pa langs pa'i gnas 'di thun mong min pa'i tshul zhig tu bsgyur zhing kha lo byas pas na/ 'dzin rtog snang yul de rnam pa gsar pa zhig tu 'gyur zhing / slar yang phyi rol du 'don tshe/ sngon nas phugs su chags pa'i spyi rkyen gyi cha shas mi'i skyes lugs su nges yod pa dang / cha shas sems lugs su nges yod pa 'di gnyis brtsams chos su mnyam thabs ni lugs srol tsam du nges 'gyur ba red/ skyes bu'i rang rgyud du chags pa'i sger rkyen gyi cha shas phyi nang chos can la rten pa gtso bo dang cha shas sems kyi 'dzin stabs la rten pa gtso bo'i khyad yod pa/ 'di gnyi ga'i shugs kyis brtsams 'bras la rang gshis nges can zhig ster srid pa red/skabs bab gzung 'dzin rgyu gnyis so so yin pa dang / phan tshun shan thebs phyir snang ba dwangs dub bam khams sangs 'thib/ yang na mos sun skyo spro lta bu'i rnam 'gyur zhig smin pa red/ rgyu rkyen gleng rnams rnam par bsres shing spel bas na/ phyir 'don pa'i tshul la'ang mngon shugs lhang yib kyi khyad par 'byung srid/ ngag gi sgyu rtsal gyi gzhung du‘‘brnyan 'dra can’’dang‘‘chags sdang can’’dang‘‘ldang tshigs can’’zhes so sor bkar 'dug cing / brnyan 'dra can ni mngon pa lhang du 'byung ba dang / chags sdang can ni mngon ma yib tu snang la/ ldang tshigs can ni yib ma shugs su thon pa lags/brnyan 'dra can gyi spyi khog tsam brjod na/ skabs de'i rgyu rkyen dbang khongs kyi bya dngos las gzugs brnyan gtso ba'i sgo nas khyad chos mngon che — 56 —

spel stangs kyi rtseg rim che khag gsum gyi thad nas ngag rgyun rtsom rig la dpyad pa/zhing ngo bo 'dzin pa can/ 'bur du thon zhing dper 'os can/ mtshar zhing spro 'os pa can gyi rigs bdams nas rtogs 'char gang 'tsham du brgyud cing /phan tshun nye mtshungs sam zla bo'am rten 'byung 'brel ba can rnams sgril bar 'tsho ba'i 'dod phyogs dang mthun par snyeg pa'i snang brnyan gsar pa zhig tu bsgyur/ brtsams chos su 'byung tshul ni rim pa gsum du go ba len tshul yod de/ rjod byed kyi cha nas dpe la 'jal ba dang gzugs su bkod pa lta bu'i tshul gyi gnas tshul dang gnas lugs nges can bstan par khams 'gyur gyis zin yod pa la go ba red/ brjod bya'i cha nas ni dngos po'i nyams/ yul gyi bkod pa/ 'tsho ba'i khor yug bya ba byung tshul/ mi sna'i gshis rgyud sogs khams 'gyur gyis zin pa la go ba dang / sgrung brjod brtsams chos su mi sna 'tsho nyams can la khams 'gyur gyis zin pa 'di gtso bor 'dzin/ don dam pa la ni rtsom pa pos rang gi tshor myong la brten nas gsar mtshon nga la klog nyan pa pos kyang tshor myong rtogs gsum lcogs pa'i snang yul gang rung la go ba red/chags sdang can gyi spyi khog tsam brjod na/ 'gyod pa'am skyo ba'am/ skrag pa'am mi mos pa sogs la 'jug pa de phyogs gcig yin/ chags pa'am zhen pa'am mos pa la 'jug pas khams 'gyur gyi khongs su gtogs pa de phyogs gcig yin/ gzung 'dzin gnyis ka phrad cing bag chags 'o ma ltar ltems pa la skabs thob rul rta thebs pa ji bzhin/ gzung ba'i 'dzin pa skul bas 'dzin pa'i char byung ba'i snang rtog phar gzung yul du yod pa'i chos kyi skabs mkho ba la khyad du dmigs nas lta stangs tsam byung ste/ yang myong yang mno'i sbrags su snang rtogs 'dzin stangs 'khrugs shing / tshor snang la sems 'gyur zhugs pa dang sems 'gyur la tshor snang the ba/ yang na 'di gnyis spyi sger — 57 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/rkyen rnams dang rnam par spel ma'i tshul du gyur phyir/ bya yul la 'os min legs nyes bsher ba lta bu'i chags sdang byung ba red/ brtsams chos su 'byung tshul ni brnyan 'dra las chags sdang shugs bstan du byung ba dang / chags sdang gis brnyan 'dra 'dren pa/ brnyan 'dras chags sdang 'dren pa/ thad kar chags sdang gi tshul 'don pa bcas rtsa che bzhi bgrang ba red/ldang tshigs can gyi spyi khog tsam brjod na/ ldang zhes pa yar langs pa dang tshad longs pa'am yengs par rgyu ba bcas la 'jug skabs 'dir smra rjod kyi grim sha btang lhod de ltos sa ltos 'jog gi tshad dang mthun pa 'di gtso bor dmigs pa yin/ de na gzung 'dzin 'brel ba chags nas snang rtog 'byung bzhin pa'i skabs der sngon phyi nang srid pa'i 'gul skyod la goms shing bag la nyal ba'i rkyen las skyes lugs kyi dbang du nges pa dang sems lugs kyi dbang du nges pa dag zhe khams kyi 'gyur ba dang rang shugs su mthun par 'ong la/ de 'dra'i 'gul 'gyur gyi shugs kyis ngag gi sgyu rtsal 'byung rim la dal brel lam gzengs 'jags sam grim lhod lta bu'i chos tshul thun tshigs can sna mang thon srid pa red/ brtsams chos su 'byung tshul ni go rim dang go rim/don tshan dang don tshan/ brjod tshan dang brjod tshan/ tshig rkang dang tshig rkang / tha snyad dang tha snyad bcas bar du byung ba'i 'gal zla gcig gyur gyi 'brel ba ste/ phan tshun mnyam pa las mi mnyam pa snang yang / mi mnyam pa las mnyam pa zhig yong nges shing / der ltos bcas kyi lugs tsam du 'grig byung nas mnyam par brgyus pa nyid lags/ ngag gi sgyu rtsal gyi gzhung du 'di la‘‘sdeb pa'i mnyam brgyus’’dang‘‘rtsol ba'i mnyam brgyus’’zhes nas dmigs yul la khyad par yod cing don dam du rang bzhin mtshungs pa'i dbang gis dog don gyi mnyam nyid la ngos 'dzin/ dog don gyi mnyam nyid ces pa 'di — 58 —

spel stangs kyi rtseg rim che khag gsum gyi thad nas ngag rgyun rtsom rig la dpyad pa/dang brnyan 'dra can nam chags sdang can la'ang phan tshun mnyam brgyus pa'i 'brel ba yod phyir/ yangs don gyi mnyam nyid ces brjod pa yin/ sngon gyi〈snyan ngag me long〉gi gzhung 'grel nang du brjod pa'i sgra rgyan spyi dang mthun pa'i sgra'i gab tshig thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyan las sbyar ba dang / mnyam pa/snyan pa/ brjid pa sogs kyang sgra gshis sdeb pa'i mnyam brgyus kyi khongs su gtogs par snyam zhing / ‘‘sdod mtshams’’sam‘‘skad cig ngal gso’’zhes pa dag ngag gi rtsol ba'i mnyam brgyus kyi khongs su gtogs 'dug snyam la/ dus rabs bcu pa yas mas su rgya gar gyi snyan gzhung la mthong rtogs kyi tshod bzung thebs phyir rags rim tsam las spyi sdom ma thon pas na/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyan gyi rgyu mtshan dang mnyam brgyus kyi yongs khyab kyi nges pa la ngos zin gzu bo ma thob pa'i rkyen gyis de'i rjes 'brangs rnams kyang ljon pa mthong yang nags klong ma mthong ba'i tshul du 'khums par byas pa los yin snyam/ de yang / tshigs bcad snyan mgur lta dhur mnyam nyid kyi yon tan 'bur du thon pa dang / tshig lhug snyan rtsom du de 'dra mngon che ba min/ 'on te bcad lhug khyad par la bltas pa med par rnam par dngags pa'i snyan rtsom gyis mi rnams la sems 'gul drags po thebs srid pa ni khams zin snang yul khyad mtshar brtsams grub thon pa'i rgyu mtshan la thug yod/dngags pa'i thad nas ngag rgyun rtsom rig tu snang ba'i khyad chos brjod na/ ngag rgyun rtsom rig tu dngags par 'byung ba'i khams zin snang yul ni rtsom spyod bsrel gsum byed po'i rig gnas chu tshad dang / 'tsho ba'i nyams myong / spyi tshogs phyogs res/ rtsom spyod rgyud rim gyi khyad chos bcas dbang gis mi nyung shos sam spyi tshogs kyi khongs chung ngu nas go ba lon zhing mos pa zhig min par/ dmangs kyi mang che bas khas len ji zhig yin srid/ bye brag — 59 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/tu brjod na/ (ka)khams 'gyur gyis zin pa'i dper 'os khor yug gi dngos po dmigs bsal can gyi brnyan 'dra dang dper 'os mi sna'i snang brnyan khyad du gsar pa zhig rtsom pa'i dus yun ring la/ grub zin phyin spyi tshogs su rgyug yun yang ha cang ring bas/ rang rang mi rigs kyi rig gnas ma lag la shan kyang zab mo bzos dang bzo bzhin pa zhig yin/ (kha) khams 'gyur du gtogs pa'i chags sdang thon tshul la dmangs phal ba'am spyi tshogs gzhi rim du 'tsho ba'i mang tshogs kyi phyogs res mngon gsal ba zhig zhugs shing nges yod pa yin/ (ga)khams 'gyur gyi zin pa'i ldang tshigs byung ba la ngal rtsol 'tsho ba'i shan thebs nas lus po'i stangs stabs sam der bstun skyes lugs kyi 'gul skyod la sbrags dam pa dang 'bur du mngon pa zhig kyang yin srid pas/mi rigs khag gi rang mtshan pa'i ngag gi sgyu rtsal gyi nyams myong spyi sdom byed par med du mi rung ba'i gzhi gal chen zhig yin/ de'i phyir/ ngag rgyun rtsom rig gis rnam par dngags shing khams 'gyur gyis zin pa'i snang yul gal chen rnams ni mi rigs so so ba'i sgyu rtsal brtsams chos kyi rang gshis 'dzin gnas yin pa dang tshad mar yang 'od la phugs bla lta bur bkur 'tshal ba red/— 60 —

yul skad dang ngag rgyun rtsom rigadage gnyen/'u cag la myong grub byung yod pa ltar/ mi rigs mang shos su kha skad dang yig skad kyi khyad par yod pa yin/ gal te 'di gnyis la bar thag mngon gsal zhig yod tshe/ ngag thog nas rtsom spyod rgyud nyar byed pa'i ngag rgyun rtsom rig la kha skad kyi rang gshis mngon par thon pa ni rang bzhin pa zhig lags/ des na/ mi rnams 'tsho ba'i yul gru so so nas/ rang rang yul khongs su goms shing yul khongs gzhan dang brje spel 'tsham pa zhig ma byung bar yun ring 'gyangs pa na/ yul gru gzhan dang mi mtshungs pa'am yang na spyi skad yig skad dang yang khyad che ba'i sgra gdangs sam ming brda'am tshig sbyor lugs srol sogs ngang ngam du chags pa dang / tha na brjod nyams la'ang khyad par nges can 'byung srid/ 'di 'dra'i dbang du ngag rgyun rtsom rig dang yul skad kyi bar du 'o chu 'dres ma lta bu'i 'brel ba grub cing / bye brag brtsams chos 'ga'i don gyi go ba dang sgra yi snyan cha dang tshig gi sbyor stangs bcas la shan zab mo thebs yod pa yin pas/ thad 'di'i gtso che ba'i gnas lugs la rags rim tsam shes par bya ba'i dgos pa yod 'dugadang po/ ngag rgyun brtsams chos go ba len par khag pa'i ming brda/yul gang du rgyug pa'i ngag rgyun brtsams chos su rang sdar ༵da kaung

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/gzhan du ma grags pa'am rgyug mi che ba'i bya ba'am dngos po'i ming don sogs go ba len dka' ba dang / phyi rabs pas zin bris sam legs sgrig brgyud nas rgya cher ngo sprod byed pa la'ang khag po yin phyir gzab dgos pa byung /ka yul thon dngos rdzas khrad par can gyi ming go dka' ba/gzhas las ‘‘rdza yung skyes sa rdza nag srin yung skyes sa srib naga'adzoms sa sman pa'i lag yin/ 'phrod sa'i nad pa gang yin’’zhes pa ltar na/rdza yung dang srin yung zer ba'i sman rtswa 'di dag khams stod dmangs khrod du 'di ltar brjod mod/ yul gzhan 'ga' nas rtswa sman du spyod 'phyis pa'am rtsad pa thog mi che bas na rtsa chen du'ang brtsi ba min/ de'i phyir phal ba rnams kyis go ba mi lon pa'am skabs 'gar rgya skad ji bzhin rdza yung la‘‘kri mo’’(〉ba81)dang srin yung la‘‘pe mo’’(yostso/)zhes g.yar ming spyod 'dug yul skad kyi dngos po'i ming dang 'di rigs khyab gdal du gtang ba'i dgos pa shin tu che bas/ brtsams chos zin bri'am legs sgrig skabs su mchan 'grel 'jug rgyu gal che/ yang na/ ‘‘sur phan bzas na kha tsha/ tsha ba zhi ba'i rdzas yin/dga' grogs bsgrigs na snying tsha/ sur phan bu mos los shes’’zhes pa las/snga ma'i‘‘sur phan’’zer ba de mdog dmar ljang gnyis yod cing mdzub mo'i sne tsam pa dang mi chen mdzub mo lta bu'i che chung la'ang rigs gnyis/ bro rdzas zas spags su spyod/ sngon du‘‘su ru phan tsha’’zhes pa'i ming 'jug la bsdus ming du sur phan zer/ zur chag pa la‘‘su phan’’dang‘‘sur pan’’dang‘‘su pan’’lta bu 'byung / yang na rigs mtshungs la bzas na kha de 'dra mi tsha zhing tog che ba/ mdog ni sngo ljang yin zhing tshal tshod rigs su spyod pa la‘‘sho lo sngon po’’zer srol yod/ sur phan nyid phal cher khams smad nas bod dbus — 62 —

yul skad dang ngag rgyun rtsom rigasu khyab pa los yin snyam/ bod mi 'tsho yul gyi sa mang shos su tshal tshod 'di mi skye ba dang thad kar rgya yul nas khyer yong ba yin phyir/ ming du'ang rgya skad ji bzhin‘‘la co’’(7a)dang‘‘sho sngon’’la‘‘r+sā.a’’zer/ ‘‘sur phan bu mos los shes’’zer ba'i tshig 'di'i nang gi sur phan zhes pa ni sur phan dang 'dra bar kha drag cing gzhung rgyud tsha ba'i dpe la 'jal ba yin la/ ‘‘su la phan pa’’bu mo khyod kyis los shes zer ba'i tshig stod bsdus pa'ang yin pas/ sgra yi mnyam nyid kyi rgyan du grub/ 'di lta bu'i yul thon dngos rdzas kyi ming 'byung ba'i brtsams chos la sgyu rtsal lam shes bya gnyis su rin thang che yang / go ba len pa'am go brda sprod par khag pas khyab gdal du ma song ba'i phugs su rang rigs kyi rig gnas lta ba la skyon yod pa'i rtags shig kyang mngon 'dugakha yul mi'i 'du shes 'dzin tshul khyad par can go dka' ba/a mdo'i gnyen gyi cho ga nang / gnyen gyi dar srol de thog mar gong ma lha yul nas dar zhing lha klu gnyis kyi bar du byung ste/ lha sras dung khyung dkar po dang klu mo dung lu sgon(kho mo'i ming la 'jug tshul mang)gnyis kyis gnyen srol phyes tshul brjod pa'i zhar du/ ‘‘smin drug khra mos bag rogs byas/ sme ba spun bdun bsu bar yong’’zhes pa sogs 'byung ba yin/ de bzhin du yul sde la lar bag skyel mi drug ste smin drug gi dod du 'grig na bkra shis par 'dod la/yang na drug grangs kyi log 'phar te bcu gnyis sam bco brgyad lta bu yin dgos pa dang / mag khyim gyi bsu mi la bdun grangs te sme bdun gyi grangs ka longs pa dang / yang na 'di'i log 'phar grangs su 'grig par bdun gyi grangs ka longs pa dang / yang na 'di'i log 'phar grangs su 'grig par byed/mag/ pa dang bag ma dang bar ba(bar ba 'di bag rogs la dmigs nas brtsi tshul — 63 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/yangayod) gsum ni dgung dbus skar chen gsum gyi skal bar 'grig na legs pa'i 'du shes 'dzin/ gzhan du bod yul na byang skar sme ba spun bdun gyi lha sgrung dang smin drug gis kha ba tshub po phab pa'i lha sgrung yod pa'ang gnyen chog thad kyi gzhig stangs dang phugs 'brel yod/ gna' rabs kyi rgya nag tu‘‘lho bre smin pa spun drug’’gis 'dzin pa dang‘‘byang bre sme ba lcam bdun’’(lha mo spun bdun yang zer)gyis 'dzin zer zhing / gtsug tu skar chen gsum pos rgyu 'bras brtag cing / de dag ni dbang skar te dbang thang rgyas pa'i sdongs sam dbang lha la'ang bkur ba dang / tshe skabs te tshe ring yong ba'i sdongs grogs sam tshe lha la'ang dad pa/ g.yang skar te nor g.yang 'khor ba'i sdongs sam g.yang lha la'ang rlom pa bcas yin/ smin drug dang sme bdun dang skar chen gsum brtsis na gong ma lha yi bden pa bcu drug de 'jig rten mi yi drang ba bcu drug srang zhes nas rgya ma'i skar phra phab pa yin tshul dang / mi yi rgyu 'bras lha'i lung ji bzhin yin pa'i 'du shes 'dzin/ gna' bo'i hor gyis mkha' dbyings chen po de la lha yul‘‘'then dgur’’zhes dad pa dang / lha rabs la dgu dgu'i grangs 'dren rgyas pa zhig yod cing / jing gir rgyal pos(mtshan gyi rnal ma ni the mu drin zer/ bod kyis‘‘jing gir’’zhes skyes chen der ngos 'dzin pa don dam du nor 'khrul zhig ste/ jing gir zer sa'i skyes bu de sog skad kyi mgur sgrung ring mo'i mi sna zhig yin la/ bod kyi ge sar rgyal po lta bu zhig la go ba red)btsun mo chen ma bsu dus skyel mi skya drug dang bsu mi skya bdun te bcu gsum grangs kyis rten 'brel 'grig po byung la smon dang ltas su legs pa'i 'du shes 'dzin tshul lo rgyus yig tshags su 'khod yod/ mdor na/ 'di dag gna' bo'i e she ya gling du dar ba'i gdod ma'i dad rlom ste/ so lo ya si te'i lugs dang sha ma'i lugs dang gshen bon lugs bcas kyi dad dmangs su gyur pa'i mi rigs — 64 ge

yul skad dang ngag rgyun rtsom rigakhag gis 'od gsal lha la dad pa'i lo rgyus kyi lhag 'phro tsam yin par snyam la/ngag rgyun rtsom rig gi thad nas ma zad par spyir rig gnas zhib 'jug thad du'ang 'di lta bu'i gna' bo'i gzhig stangs dang rig gnas snang tshul la rtsad gcod dang gsal bkral gyi rin thang che ba red/ ga yul srol thun mong min pa go dka' ba/dbus khul gyi gzhas su gtogs pa'i tshig rgyag gam khams khul gyi khram glu dang tshul nye zhing / dbyangs su mi 'gug la skad gzengs mthon pos gyer ba'i a mdo'i‘‘kha ya 'jal ba’’zhes pa las/ ‘‘ske tshe'i me tog kha ser ma/ log skor zhing kha'i gnas log ma/ rting ba sa nag kha nag ma/ lo la longs dus kha tsha ma’’zhes pa'i lan du‘‘mtha' mgo'i ra ma mgo shor bo/ mtha' rtsa'i ra rdzi slog thed po/ bu chung kha ngan lang shor bo/ lo la longs dus bza' gtor bo’’ zhes par rgol tshul du brnyas pa ltar na/ ske tshe(ke tse yang zer)ste bod kyi yig skad du yungs pa(nyungs pa'ang zer)zhes pa'i zas snum 'tshir byed yungs nag gi rigs su gtogs pa zhig yin la/ rgya skad kyis‘‘mo'ilko1’’zerab 'di'i sgra 'gyur ba ste zos na kha tsha ba'i rigs der ngos 'dzin zhing bro rdzas su'ang spyod chog log skor te zhing la log brgyab nas de lo sa bon ma btabs pa la log ma zer/ de ltar res skor ba'i zhing la log skor ma zhes bya zhing /sa bcud gshin po min la mtho sar gnas phyir yur chu'ang 'dren mi nus/'di 'dra'i dbang gis rtag tu yungs nag lta bu rtsis chung ba'i 'bru rigs 'debs pa red/ de nang bzhin yun ring phyin nas srol du chags pa na/yungs nag dang 'di btabs pa'i zhing la thad kar log skor ram log kor zhes pa'i ming yang thogs/ gnas log ma ste bag gnas nas bza' mi dang ma — 65 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/mthun pa lta bu'i rkyen gyis bza' 'thor brgyab ste phyir pha khyim du log pa'i bud med la go ba dang / pho mchog mo dman gyi 'du shes zab pa'i yul sde nas 'di'i rigs ni bad med ngan par 'jog rting ba sa nag ste ske tshe'am log ༄skor la sbyar ba yin la/ kha nag ma'am sna nag ma'ang brer ba ni bza' khyim la bkra mi shis pa'am ltas ngan pa'i bud med la smad pa'i btags ming yin/skabs 'dir phan tshun dpe yi rgyan du grub/ mgo shor te bdag tu mi chud dam khrims med lugs med rang yan du shor ba'i don la go ba dang / slog thed ni slog pa hrul bo'i don du 'jug 'di bzhin du yul srol goms 'dris la nang byan mi chud na yul skad kyi ming brda 'di rigs kyang go ba mi lon pa red/nga 'dabs 'dres pa'i mi rigs sam rgyal khams kyi gshār ming go dka' gsi khron rnga khul du rgyug pa'i gtam dpe zhig ste/ ‘‘si rung khug ma mig la yag nang gi rtsam rnying bro la ngan’’zhes pa ltar na/ ‘‘si rung’’ste rgya skad kyitsho7 zhes pa'i sgra 'gyur ba yin la/ spyir rgya skad kyis 'di la phin rung(༈7)dang ngu nung(7 7)sogs ming 'jug srol du ma yod kyang / si khron nub byang bod yul dang 'dabs 'dres sa nas rgyug pa ltar rnga khul gyi bod skad du 'gyur ba dmigs bsal tshul du snang la/ yul gzhan gyi bod mi rnams kyis spu lang dang khas lang spu ma sogs zer bas/ sgra ltar 'gyur ba'i ming 'di 'dra la yul gyi nges pa ldan 'dug bod kyi gna' dpe〈bshad mdzod yid bzhin nor bu〉dang ngag rgyun gyi glu sgrung ste〈srid pa'i rus sbal〉dag tu‘‘ma hā gser gyi rus sbal’ridang‘‘ma hā tsi na'i yul’’gyi rtsis lung dar ba'i skor gyi sgrung rgyud rgyas tsam bzhugs la/ bod kyi rig gnyer pa la las spyi lugs lo rtsis kyi sngon tsam — 66 —

yul skad dang ngag rgyun rtsom rigagyi chin rgyal rabs kyi(zloji)la tshin zhes brda rnying gi sgra 'byung la/ rgya gar pa'i‘‘tshi na’’zhes dang rjes su‘‘tsi na’’la 'gyur zer mod/ hin rdu skad rang du‘‘ma hāri’zhes pa chen po la 'jug cing‘‘tsi na’’ni khyon yangs shing 'byor phyug ldan pa'i don du go ba skad/ de yang / gna' bo'i rgya nag rang gi 'chad rgyun ltar na/ sa gzhi chen po gru ga bzhi ldan tshul/ dgung sngon gnam ni sbub pa gdugs ltar 'khor/ sa la sme dgu gling khams dgu grangs brten/ zla la bcu gnyis lhag dang bcu gsum bgrang / rus sbal lto rus gling dgu ji bzhin byon/rgyab kyi a 'dra bcu gsum ma 'dzol gsal/ srid pa'i rang chos ji bzhin mi rmongs ched/ lha klu'i lung ston chu rtsis 'di bzhin phab/ ces bya ba'i srid pa'i chags tshul dang rtsis lung dar tshul brjod cing / 'dir gzhigs na gna' snga mo 'ig nas rgya gar nag dang rang re'i bod kyi bar du rig gnas brje spel zab tsam yod pa mtshon 'dug ca yul skad kyi gces ming ngam btags ming go dka' ba/mtsho sngon khri ka rdzong gi rong yul gyi gtam dpe las/ ‘‘ngu lu'i ngu skad che no 'di/ ngu lu'i las tshegs che ni red’’ces brjod pa yin te/ ‘‘ngu lu’’ste bong bu'i ming gzhan du 'jug cing / mngon brjod du mgrin bzang zer ba ji bzhin du ngu skad chen po rgyag pa dang / ‘‘lu’’sgra ni bong bu'i bu dang mtshungs par chung ngu ston pa yin la/ 'di ltar na gces ming zhig tu'ang grub/ yun nan bde chen khul gyi gtam dpe las/ ‘‘kor lo mgyogs drags ma red/sgal lpags tsha drags de red’’ces brjod cing / zog chas btag byed rdo skor de 'then pa la bong bu spyod cing yun ngang gis srol du gyur phyir/ bong bu la'ang‘‘kor lo’’zer ba'i srol byung / 'di bzhin du bong bu'i ming gzhan du — 67 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/ —da dung bong lu dang bong the lta bu'ang yul sde gzhan dag na 'jug srol yod/khams stod yul shul khul gyi gtam dpe las/ ‘‘gces che na o yos 'gram rtsa ldag bkyag che na chung ma klad la shor’’zhes bya zhing / ‘‘o yo’’ste khye'u la go ba dang gces ming du snang / yul sde khag tu byis pa la bya byis dang lo lo dang sems bu/ byis pa pho la byis lu'am bu lo dang mo la byis mo'am gces ma lta bu ming gzhan dang gces ming shin tu mang / yang na/ dga' rogs la dga' ma dang byams pa dang yid 'phrog ma/ 'das po la bla sangs bo'am bla bde bo dang 'das mo la bla sangs ma'am mtho ris ma ji bzhin gces 'bod ming gzhan mang ba red/cha yul skad kyi bsdus ming ngam tshab ming khyad par can go dka' ba/mdo stod rnga ba khul dang mgo log khul gyi sa mtshams su a nga tsi bsad tshul gyi gab tshig ltar na/‘‘khor gi ched du ngar ga'e brgyab/ ngar gi ched du khor ga'e brgyab/ khor ga'e bsad pa bden mod/ phud pa ngar gi khrag red’’ces pa las/ ‘‘kho rang gi’’'am‘‘nga rang gi’’zhes pa‘‘khor gi’’dang‘‘ngar gi’’la bsdus/ ‘‘kho rang ga la’’ 'am‘‘nga rang ga la’’zhes pa‘‘khor ga'e’’dang‘‘ngar ga'e’’lta bur bsdus/ gzhi 'di nas‘‘kho rang gis’’ni‘‘khor gis’’dang / ‘‘nga rang gis’’ni‘‘ngar gis’’ji bzhin 'jug srol byung / bod kyi tshab ming 'jug tshul lta na/ bya bar dmigs pa'i dngos po'i tshab ming ste zas su‘‘bza' rgyu’’'am gos su‘‘gon rgyu’’lta bu dang / bya yul la gtad pa'i tshab ming ste bsam pa'i‘‘'khyer so’’'am‘‘kha gtad so’’byed po la dmigs pa'i tshab ming ste‘‘klog pa po’’'am‘‘nyan pa po’’ji bzhin yin/ gzhi 'dir brten nas a mdo'i yul skad du de bas stabs bde zhing grim pa'i bsdu tshul gsar pa byung 'dug bya ba da 68 da

yul skad dang ngag rgyun rtsom rigal gtad pa na‘‘rgyu’’sgra gzhi byas nas blta rgyu bo ni‘‘blta rgyu'o’’dang lta rgyu bo ni‘‘lta rgyu'o’’bltas rgyu bo ni‘‘bltas rgyu'o’’zhes tshab ming la dus gsum gyi dbye ba 'byed/ bya yul la gtad pa na‘‘sa’’dang ming mtha'i‘‘bo’’sgra bsdus 'gro ste/blta sa bo ni‘‘blta so’’dang / lta sa bo ni‘‘lta so’’ bltas sa bo ni‘‘bltas so’’'jug bo zhes pa'i ming mtha' sbyor tshul de sngon ma'i ming gzhir nges dod dbyangs te i u e o med tshe/ thad kar‘‘sa’’yi steng la o dbyangs sbyar zhing /bya yul gyi tshab ming la'ang dus gsum 'byed/ byed po la gtad pa na‘‘ni’’sgrar brten nas blta ni bo 'di‘‘blta ni'o’’dang / lta ni bo 'di‘‘lta ni'o’’bltas ni bo 'di‘‘bltas ni'o’’zhes byed po'i tshab ming la dus gsum sbyor/'di 'dra'i dbang du rjod byed kyi nus pa je zhib je bde la btang zhing / deng gi spyi spyod skad brda rig pa'i nang‘‘bsdus kyang sgra gnas kyi dod mi nyams’’zer ba'i lugs dang yang mthun/ 'di rigs ngag rgyun nang rtag tu 'byung bas/gzhung lugs dang zhib 'jug gi rgyab rten med na rang gis mi go ba ma zad/legs sgrig ngo sprod kyang yag po mi yong ba red/ gzhan du'ang dran slong dgos pa zhig ni/ sngon du bkod zin pa'i rtsom gshis tshig gshis skor du brjod pa'i 'dzem tshig gam tshig srol lam mngon brjod dam dpe chos sogs su'ang go ba len dka' ba 'byung srid pas gzab dgos pa'i gnas yin/gnyis pa/ ngag rgyun rtsom nig gi sgru rtsal snyan cha dang 'brel 'dug pa'i yul skad kyi snang tshul/ngag rgyun rtsom rig nyid ngag gi sgyu rtsal khongs su gtogs phyir/brtsams chos ring ma thung gsum dang rtsom lus so so ba gang yin yang / tshad rim gcig tu ma nges kyang de rnams kyi sgyu rtsal snyan cha'i thon tshul 'ga' ni — 69 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/rjod byed kyi steng nas mngon pa sha stag yin la/ 'di la yang yul skad kyi shan thebs pas khyad chos thun mong min pa 'dzin te 'dir gtso gnad tsam gleng bar bya/ka dbyangs dang gsal byed kyi cha la dmigs nas brtag na/deng gi skad brda rig pa'i(dar cha'i brda dang / dbyug pa'i brda/ tshon ris brda/ 'phros 'od brda/ stangs stabs brda sogs dang lhos bcas dbang du 'di ltar ming btags) gzhung la brten nas dpyad tshe/ bod yig gi dbyangs dang 'di'i rjes 'gro sgra la ngos 'dzin tshul gsham gsal ltar te/ ‘‘a’’dang‘‘i u e o’’dang dbyangs phyed ma la‘‘ba’’btags dang‘‘ya’’btags/ dbyangs tsam par the rung ba la‘‘ha’’ zhar byung dbyangs gsham ‘‘ra’’btags dang ‘‘la’’btags bcas bsdoms pas bcu(a dang 'a gnyis ngo bo gcig)yod/ bod kyi srol rgyun brda sprod rig pa'i khrod du 'dogs rnams 'dogs su 'os pa'i rgyu mtshan mi gsal la/ 'di'i khar srog zhugs kyang the ba rnams gsal byed du'ang spyod chog par gzhigs pa los yin/ dbyangs su ngos bzung med pa red/ yul skad so so'i nang i sgra bklags na/khuka tukhu1 kalta bu sgra thang tshul gnyis 'dug u sgra bklags na(51('u51lta bu sgra thang tshul gnyis yan 'duga.e sgra laskyi1 ka skyi'i1 kalta bu thang tshul gnyis 'dug srog zhugs sam zhar byung sgra'ang yin pa'i‘‘ha’’sgra 'di gsal byed tshul du dang dbyangs tsam tshul du bklags pa'i thang tshul kha kha yin/ 'dogs rnams ni gsal ler sgra thang min gyi khyad par yod pa ma zad/ gal te thang tshe yul skad so sor khyad par de bas mang ba red/ dper na/ ‘‘pya’’ni shwa dang ca dang tsa sogs su nye ba'am mtshungs pa'i sgra la 'gyur/ ‘‘bya’’ni zhwa dang cha dang tsa dang tsha sogs su nye — 70 —

yul skad dang ngag rgyun rtsom rigaba'am mtshungs pa'i sgra la 'gyur/ ‘‘phya’’ni shwa dang cha dang tsha sogs su nye ba'am mtshungs pa'i sgra la 'gyur/ gong gleng dbyangs dang rjes 'gro rnams rjes 'jug gi shan thebs pa gtso ba ma zad/ sngon 'jug gis kyang shan byed phyir/ sgra yi thang tshul de bas rdzob por snang / gsal byed kyi nang nas mtshan pho dang mo can gyi khyad par gtso bo ni sgra la grim lhod yod par gzhigs pa dang /kha cha tha pha tsha(sha sa gnyis kyang 'dir gtogs 'os)sogs ma ning dang mtshan pho mo can gyi khyad par gtso bo ni grim lhod yodabu pa las gzhan du sgra 'byin par dbugs thad kar sgros phyir thon min la ltos pa yin pas/ sngon gyi brda gzhung du‘‘dro ba'i yi ge’’zhes bya ba'i ma ning rnams klog skabs lag mthil kha la gtad na rlung dron po yong ba mngon par tshor phyir te/ deng gi skad brda rig pa nang du‘‘rlung 'byin pa'i sgra’’zhes pa dang mtshungs/ shin tu mo dang pho mo ma ning gi khyad par ni grim lhod dam rlung thad kar 'byin min las gzhan/'byin pa'i byed las sna nang du drangs min la gzhigs pa yin/ gna' skad gzhir bzung nas gtan la phab pa'i yig skad kyi dbyangs gsal rnam gzhag de da lta'i yul skad so sor 'gyur sdog mang tsam mchis te/ dper na/ ka ca ta pa tsa sogs dang ga ja da ba dza bcas am skad nang nas gsal byed ji bzhin bklags na sgra'i thang tshul phal cher mtshungs la khyad 'byed dka' bas/ka la ka kha dbye dang / ga la ga kha zum/ ca la ca ril/ ja la ja zur/ ta la ta sgur/ da la da skya zhes pa sogs kyi dbye ba 'byed lugs shig chags 'dugade yang dbus gtsang kha skad du mtshan ma mo can skor zhig ma ning dang nye mtshungs su gyur yod/ yul sde so so nas sngon 'jug gam rjes 'jug dang rtseg 'dogs dang dbyangs sogs bar phan tshun shan thebs tshe 'gyur ldog de bas je mang du song yod/ dbus gtsang khams dang mdo stod bcas su dngul dang /— 71 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/shul/ yul/ tshul sogs dngus shus yus tshus lta bur 'gyur/ mdo smad du dngu'u shu'u yu'u tshu'u lta bur 'gyur/ gal te‘‘pha shul bu yis bzung tshul yagapha jus bu yis bskyangs tshul yag’’ces pa dang / ‘‘pha sa ze(zer)nas rtsis ches/ pha yul ze nas gces shes’’zhes pa'i gtam dpe 'di dag dbus sgra khams skad ltar bklags tshe‘‘pha bu’’dang‘‘shul tshul yul’’dang‘‘yis yag’’‘‘ze’’dang‘‘rtsis ches gces shes’’dang‘‘nas’’sgra sogs kyang phan tshun sgra nye bar gyur pa yig skad las mngon gsal sdosaje snyan la 'gro/ mdor bsdoms na/ yul skad kyi khyad par dbang du ngag rgyun rtsom rig spyi dang / nang sgos snyan mgur gyi rigs su gyur pa'i klu gzhas dang snyan sgrung dang / gsol bstod bcas rol myong skabs su/ brtsams chos de yul gang du rgyug na yul de'i yul skad ltar rol tshe nyid kyi snyan cha mi nyams par phan pa red/kha ming dang bsdus ming gi cha la dmigs nas brtag na/yul gru la la nas‘‘brgya yas mas’’zer bar goms che/ la la nas‘‘brgya yan mnari’zer bar goms/ la la nas‘‘brgya yar mar’’zer bar goms/gal te yang skor 'byung tshe 'dra mtshungs su ma bcug na snyan cha la gnod pa red/ am skad du nyung ngu'i ldog zla la‘‘mang nga’’dang thung ngu'i ldog zla la‘‘ring nga’’zhes nas kyang 'jug pa srol du gyur yod/ phan tshun ltos pa ltar 'byung na cha 'grig tu bskyur dgos/ ‘‘rang re’’dang‘‘a re’’zhes pa gang zag bdag gzhan 'bod pa'i ming la 'jug pa yin la/ ‘‘a re’’zhes pa a mdo nas glu gzhas nang ma gtogs mi 'byung / kha skad du‘‘a ro’’zhes te brda rnying dang mtshungs/ ‘‘rogs kyi yeri’dang‘‘a la ye’’zhes pa‘‘rogs ki'e’’dang‘‘a la'e’’la 'gyur tshul yang yod cing rgyug mi che/ mdo stod du‘‘a la'e’’dang‘‘nga ro'i’’— 72 —

yul skad dang ngag rgyun rtsom rig dang‘‘kho ro'i’’dang‘‘khyod ro'i’’zhes phal cher cha tshang ba'i tshul du 'jug srid/dbus khul du‘‘a la'e’’dang‘‘nga re'i’’dang‘‘kho re'i’’dang‘‘khyod re'i’’zhes spyod srol yod/khams khul du‘‘a re’’dang‘‘nga re’’dang‘‘kho re’’dang / pho mo'i dbye ba yod tshe‘‘mo re’’dang‘‘pho re’’zhes brjod pa yin/ re sgra'am 'di dang 'brel bcas 'ga' da dung so so ba ngos 'dzin par 'jug srol yod cing / ‘‘mi re la rta re’’zhes pa dang / ‘‘pho re re'i lag na mda' re dang mo re re'i lag na phang re’’zhes pa bzhin te/ deng gi yig skad dang kha skad yongs su mthun/stong khung(tun hong)nas thon pa'i gna' yig tu‘‘ro ro’’ltar khod pa'ang snang /gzhan du da dung phyogs tha dad ngos 'dzin par 'jug srol yod/ lta tshul lam mthong tshul la‘‘phyogs re ba’’dang / bsam blo'am 'dod tshul la‘‘phyogs ris pa’’'am‘‘phyogs ris’’ gnas su chu bo'i‘‘pha ris’’dang‘‘tshur ris’’sam lung ba'i‘‘pha ris’’dang‘‘tshur ris’’('di la‘‘ri'i’’dang‘‘ra'i’’dang‘‘re'i’’bris pa'ang snang yang dag pa min sems) o ldan gyi rigs ni gzhan las byung snga bar snyam la/pha rol phyi rol nang rol lta bu yin/ 'di rnams ma lag dang ldan pa'i sgo nas dag tshul yong rgyu gal che ba ma zad/ gal te brtsams chos su phan tshun ltos bcas kyi tshul du 'byung na/ snyan cha dang thad kar 'brel ba yin pas gang 'dod du bca' ba'am ma lag dang mi mthun pa'i yig dod du bsgyur na 'tsham pa min/ dper na/ ‘‘nga re'i sems kyi bya de/ bang ba'i mtha' la 'khor shogakhyod res mos pa'i rgum bu/ nga res lag tu bsgrugs yod’’ces tshe/ ‘‘nga re'i’’dang byed pos sgra bsdus pa'i‘‘khyod res’’dang‘‘nga res’’rnams phan tshun ltos bcas tshul du skor ba rjes khrid kyi brgyan thabs spyad cing / gzhas tshig 'di'i snyan cha 'byung ba'i gnas gal chen zhig tu 'dug pas gzhan du bcos na gnod par 'gyur/ bsdus ming skor zhig kyang snyan cha la 'brel ba yin te/— 73 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/dper na a mdo'i gtam dpe las/ ‘‘kha nas mar le ring lugs chu bzhur bzhur/ khog nas ma rtsa ring lugs rdo bsgrigs bsgrigs’’zhes pa ni/ chu bzhur ba ltar bzhur yong ba dang rdo bsgrigs pa ltar bsgrigs yod zer ba bsdus nas dmigs bsal can gyi zung ldan dang shugs bstan dpe rgyan spel bar grub pa red/ mgo log khul gyi gtam dpe zhig lta na/ ‘‘ska la(skal ba)med sar ske le bsrings/ khur dang med sar phyi rting bkyag’’ces te/ 'gan khur dang du len pa'i go gnas su bab med bzhin du zhes pa bsdus pas na/‘‘ska la’’dang‘‘ske le’’bar mnyam pa dang / ‘‘khur dang’’ni‘‘phyi rting’’dang mnyam po byas nas 'jug tshul 'di 'dra'i dmigs bsal 'jug tshul byung ba red/ga phrad dang chig spyor gyi cha la dmigs nas brtag na/yul shul khul gyi gtam dpe ste/ ‘‘rgyu la che chung yod na myi(mi)la drag zhan yod/ rgyu la che chung med na myi(mi)la drag zhan med’’ces pa dang / ‘‘chos khrims dar gyi mdud pa la btang lhod/ rgyal khrims gser gyi gnya' shing la yang lci’’zhes pa ltar na/ tshig phrad rnams ming rnal ma las grangs ka nyung bas na/ tshig sbyor rang thog nas skor ba'am rjes khrid dang zung ldan lta bu'i rgyan du smin sla ba ma zad/ tha snyad dang tha snyad bar/ tshig rkang dang tshig rkang bar mnyam po yo nga ba'i ldang tshigs 'grub byed la'ang shin tu gal che bas legs sgrig skabs su gzab dgos pa red/nga chig dang chig rgyan gyi cha la dmigs nas brtag na/〈sum cu pa〉yi rtsa ba las/ yi ge'i yon tan ni‘‘ming tshig brjod pa kun gyi gzhiri’zhes pa dang / 〈smra sgo'i mtshon cha〉las/ yi ge tshogs nas ming grub/— 74 —

yul skad dang ngag rgyun rtsom rigaming tshogs nas tshig grub/ tshig tshogs nas brjod pa'o zhes pa ji bzhin/mi'i skad brda ni rtseg rim mang pos grub pa zhig ste/ ming tshig brjod gsum ni dma' rim tsam nas ngos bzung ba yin/ tshig rgyan gyi rnam gzhag zer ba'i ngos 'dzin tshul ni mang che shos‘‘brjod pa'i rim pa’’'di nas mngon pa yin pas/ rim pa 'di nas gtan la 'beb 'tshal mod/ 〈snyan ngag me long〉dang 'di'i rjes 'brangs gzhung 'grel rnams su rtseg rim gyi nges pa ma gsal ba dang gcig brjod pa'i yan gyi ngag gi rtseg rim nas ngos bzung ba gtso bas rgyan rnams phan tshun 'dres pa'i skyon ha cang mang la/ rab spel dang yang khyad par 'byed dka'/ cha rkyen ji 'dra'i dbang du 'dres rung ba dang gang 'dra'i dbang du mi nung ba'ang gsal bshad byung med pa'i snang tshul mi nyung ba dang gnyis/ tshig rgyan gyi rnam gzhag nang gi skor zhig tshig snga phyi'am brjod pa'i khor yug cha rkyen tha dad pa'i dbang du 'jags tshul la 'gyur ldog 'byung srid pa'i thad la ngos zin med pa dang gsum/ gna' bo'i hin rdu'i snyan gzhung la rig pa gzu bo'i mtha' dpyad ma thon par btsan gyis bstun pas bod kyi brgyan lugs dang mi mthun mod/ mthun thabs kyi rtsa gnad yang ma rnyed par tsha la ma tshos pa'i tshul du bskyur ba dang bzhi/ bod rang mtshan pa'i tshig rgyan 'jug lugs skor zhig gtan khel byung med pa dang lnga ste/ 'di rnams ni ngag rgyun brtsams chos kyi snyan cha smin pa'i gnas gal chen yin yang /skabs 'dir zhib rgyas smra ba'i go skabs ma yin pas dran slong tshul du gleng tsam bya/ ‘‘rten lha dkor gnyer gyis phungs/ bstan pa rgyus yod kyis bshig’’ces pa 'di‘‘cha 'grig rgyan’’zhes bya rigs/ rigs 'di'i nang gses su cha 'grig‘‘rnal ma’’dang‘‘pher ma’’dang‘‘mthud ma’’la sogs du ma yod/ rnal ma'i mtshan nyid ni tshig rkang gnyis ka'i tsheg bar cha 'grig pa dang / ldang tshigs — 75 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/cha 'grig pa/ tshig rkyang gong 'og nang gi gang la gang 'grig ltar ming gi gshis 'dra ba/ phrad kyi thob gnas cha 'grig pa/ tshig gi rnam pa tha dad kyang go don nyid ni zlos pa tsam zhes go chog mtshan gzhi ni‘‘pha a khu'i snying khrag 'don sa/ bu tsha bo'i lte khrag 'pho sa’rizer ba ltar tshig gi mdo ni pha yul ngos 'dzin pa 'ba' zhig lags/ pher ma'i mtshan nyid ni rnal ma dang phal cher mtshungs shing / tsheg khyim re gnyis cha 'grig ma yin na'ang chog pa/ mtshan gzhi ni‘‘gang la song na yul red/ chu khar thon dus ja red’’ces pa nang bzhin/ ‘‘gang la’’dang‘‘chu khar’’zhes pa phrad thob pa'i gnas 'dra yang ming mtha' yod med mi 'dra/ na sgra dang dus sgra'i snga ma phrad dang phyi ma ming ste tha snyad kyi gshis cha mi 'grig mthud ma'i mtshan nyid rnal ma dang phal cher 'dra yang / tshig rkyang snga phyi gnyis go don gyi thad nas zlos pa min gyi/ phyi mas snga mar mthud nas je gsal du gtong ba yin/ mtshan gzhi ni gong gleng‘‘rten lha dkor gnyer gyis྾ ྾ spo ’’zhes pa des chog 'di nang bzhin sngon gyi gzhung dang gzhung 'grel nang ma bkod kyang bod kyi rtsom rig lag len du dar che ba'i tshig rgyan 'jug lugs ni ngag rgyun brtsams chos kyi snyan cha dang 'brel dam pas/ gzhung lugs su spyi sdom byas nas gtan la phab pa'i dgos gal che ste/bod kyi rtsom rtsal lam tshig rgyan rig pa'i ma lag cha tshang yong bar yang mkho che ba red/

snyan ngagad wakhyod nam zhig ngu shub las thar thub/da wadeng gi snyan ngag 'ga' bklags pa'i 'char snang /bdud lha rgyal/da lta'i dus 'dir/ bod kyi yul gru kun tu snyan ngag gi sa bon thor med sa nyung la/ snyan ngag gi myu gu 'bus med sa'ang nyung / dus mtshungs su/snyan ngag gi yul khongs kun tu mya ngan dang smre ngag 'o dod dang ngu shub kyis bkang med sa dang khyab med sa zhig kyang dkon/ da lta snyan ngag pa yongs rdzogs ngu bzhin yod la/ snyan ngag yongs rdzogs bshum bzhin du yod/spyir ngu ba ni gdung bas phyir dang / gdung ba ni sems kyi 'gyur pa ches lci mo'i tshul yin pas/ ngu ba ni snyan ngag gi grub cha gson po yin nges/de yang sngar yod kyi lta ba'i tshad thig cig nas/ gar bsam 'gog rdo yin pa'i bar brgal gyi dus 'dir/ nga tshor yod pa mya ngan dang yi mug gi dngan pa ste/ 'di ni spyir nyen tshab kyi 'du shes sad pa yin pas bzang rtags shig kyang yin sems/ sems kyi myong ba drag po 'di bzhag nas/ 'dzum dkar 'o mtsho'i rlabs phreng gis/ bzhin gyis dkyil 'khor 'khru dgos zhes bshad na lugs dang 'gal la don dang yang mi mthun/nga de'i phyir/ bstod glu mtha' gcig tu blangs rjes kyi thog ma'i dus dang /ngu skad dang por thos skabs/ nga tshor gsar pa dang so sngi'i stang rdas/

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/mdzes rtog gi nyams tshor drag po byung nas snyan ngag la tshe srog gsar pa sbyin byung / yin na yang lo ngo mang po'i ring la 'di ltar smre ngag mtha' gcig tu bton pa yun ring thal bas da lta snyan ngag la brlan gsher gyi mchi ma med la/snyan ngag pa la gdung yus brjod pa'i tshig 'bru lhag ma gsar pa'ang cang med pa 'dra/mi zhig la cha mtshon nas bshad na/ lar skyo ba'i mchi ma 'don pa dang /zhor du da dung ngu bshad byed pa la phan khe ma yin pa'i mdzes rtog gi ngos nas bltas na/ mdzes sdug yin la rgyun ldan gyi mi yin pa'i rtags mtshan kyang yin/'on kyang dus rgyun nam yin yang mchi ma dku zhing smre ngag 'don na de ni rgyun ldan ma yin pa'i rtags dang sun snang skye ba'i rgyu yin/ ngas bsam na snyan ngag kyang de 'dra rang red/ da lta'i dus rabs 'di spyir bsam gzhig gi dus rabs shig dang / rigs rtog gi dus rabs shig the tshom gyi dus rabs shigadri rtags kyi dus rabs shig kyang yin/ nga tshos sngar srol yod tshad la tshad 'jal slar yang bya dgos la/ 'byung 'gyur yod tshad la skya thig gsar du 'debs dgos/ rang las kyi srab skyogs rang lag tu 'chang nas rlabs chen gyi las don la dpung 'jug byed pa'i dus 'dir/ nga tsho ni g.yu ral mkha' la gsig pa'i seng ge lta bu zhig yin dgos pa las/ smug sprin gyi klong na 'thom pa'i 'ba' lu gu lta bu zhig yin ga la rung / des na rtsom rig gi bla na 'khod pa'i snyan ngag gis kyang dus rabs kyi 'gan 'khri phrag tu blangs te dpung 'jug la ram 'degs kyis/ dus rabs nyer gcig pa bsu ba'i mi rabs gsar pa la stobs kyi ngar ldud cing sems kyi dpa' bskyed pa/ brjid chags kyi dbyangs 'gros ngar shed ldan pa bskrun rigs pa yin/ des na nga tsho ngu shub dang 'khun bu'i bdag nyid du gyur pa'i mo gshis kyi 'dam rdzab las — 78 —

snyan ngag—khyod nam zhig ngu shub las thar thub/'bud mi thub don ci yod/nga tsho ni pho gshis kyi bdag nyid can zhig yin dgos pas/ las dbang gis skabs rer nga tshos mchi ma 'don dgos byung yang / gad rgyangs sgrog pa la nga tsho lhag par du dga'/ nga tsho gdung yus brjod pa la dga' yang / ngar skad sgrog pa la lhag par du mos/ de bas da lta bdag ni pa'o tis e yi〈rgyal spyi'i glu〉la dga' la/ pe ta'o yi〈dris lan〉la dga'/ zhis cin ya'i〈nga'i smin mar bkyon ma 'bebs〉la dgadza la/ don grub rgyal gyi〈lang tsho'i rbab chu〉la dga'/ yi dam tshe ring gi〈rnga chen rol dbyangs〉la lhag par dga' ste/‘‘khrang pe ri bo'i rgya stag khra bo'i bar sgra dran tshe byang khog stod kyi la rgya'i mtsho mo dgung du 'phyo/ / bdud rtsi'i sman ljongs zhi hrong pan na'i glang chen mthong dus zhabs 'og sa 'dzin sngangs shing 'dar bzhin 'gro bar rtsom/ / glo bur nang sog rtswa thang steng nas rta rgod khros pa'i bang dang bcas te lhang lhang 'tsher skad thos pa na/ / bdag gi snying dbus ti se lhun por bag la nyal ba'i gangs seng dkar mos gnam sa g.yo ba'i g.yu ral gsig / ’’

nga da dung yid mi chim/da wabod kyi rtsom rig dang bod kyi spyi tshogs kyi 'brel ba/bdud lha rgyal/rtsom rig dang spyi tshogs bar gyi 'brel ba ni/ spyir bshad na thag gis gsal bor bcad zin yod/ de ni rtsom rig gis thad kar spyi tshogs la zhabs 'degs zhu ba'i rtsom rig gi phan nus rang bzhin des rang gi dam bca' shor nas/ rtsom rig la rang rkya 'pher ba'i khe dbang thob yod pa de yin/ rtsom rig rang gi kha gtod sa de spyi tshogs la dgag sgrub bya ba las kyang / mi dang mi'i bar dang / mi dang rang byung khor yug gi 'brel ba dang / yang na mthar thug gi gnas la dpyod pa lhur len pa sogs mdor na spyi tshogs las mi rang mtshan pa rang la kha gtod par 'gyur pa rtsom nig spyi'i 'phel phyogs su gyur yod pa ches gsal bar mthong thub/'di'i phyogs nas nga tshor ches gsal ba'i dpe gzhir rung ba zhig yod pa krung go'i dus skabs gsar pa'i rtsom rig go/ de yang lo rabs brgyad cu pa'i dus skabs gsar pa'i rtsom rig gi mdzad rjes gtso bo gcig ni/ gsar rtsom gyi steng nas krung go'i deng rabs rtsom rig dang lhag par‘‘rig gsar’’gyi rtsom rig gis chab srid la zhabs 'degs zhu ba'i gsar rtsom gyi rnam pa de la 'da' 'gongs byung ba dang / gzhung lugs kyi steng nas sngon ma'i su'u len gyi — 80 —

nga da dung yid mi tshim/rtsom rig gi phan nus rang bzhin la brtsi mthong cher mdzad pa'i gaṅger rje'i rtsom rig la 'da' 'gongs bzos pa red/ 'di'i go rim ni dus skabs gsar pa'i rtsom rig la mtshon na dngos gnas dka' tshegs can zhig yin la/de bzhin du 'phel rgyas 'dis krung go'i rtsom rig de lam gol zhig nas lam yang dag cig tu drangs par gyur pa dang / mtshams 'di nas krung go'i rtsom rig de rtsom rig dngos su gyur pa dang 'dzam gling rtsom rig gi rjes su zhugs pa'o zhes kun gyi mgrin gcig tu gleng / rtsom rig dang spyi tshogs kyi 'brel ba'i steng nas kho gnyis kyi bar thag sngar bas je ring du btang ba 'phel rgyas 'di'i phyogs gcig yin/ des na nga tsho la'ang bod rtsom de spyi tshogs dang ring du gnas dgos pa'i sdom tshig cig 'bab par 'gyur pa gdon mi za/'on kyang deng gi bod kyi gnas bab la mtshon na/ 'di lta bu gtan nas mi 'os par/ de las ldog ste rtsom rig dang spyi tshogs kyi 'brel ba da rung sngar bas je zab tu gtong dgos pa'i dgos nges rang bzhin yod/ 'di ni deng gi bod kyi gnas bab bye brag pa yin pa 'dis thag gis bcad pa yin/ de yang /nga tsho bod la mtshon na dus yun ches ring bo zhig gi nang / rang gi dngos yod spyi tshogs yal bar bor ba'i rnam pa byung myong yod/ spyi tshogs 'di srid 'dzin do dam dang dpal 'byor do dam sogs steng gi bkod pas dmigs yul yod pa dang byed thabs ldan pa gnyis kyi sgo nas rgyu mtshan dang bcas par do dam bya ba'i srol rgyun legs po de bod la med/ de bas bod spyi tshogs 'di lung ma bstan pa zhig gi ngos nas 'khor skyod byas pa yin/ bsam blo'i gter du gyur pa'i bod kyi mkhas pa thams cad kyi rig pa'i kha gtod sa de deng gi nga tshos bshad pa'i dngos yod spyi tshogs 'di ma red/ de bas bod ces pa'i mi rigs 'di rig gnas 'dzoms por yod la/ 'tsho ba'i chu tshad ches dma' ba/— 81 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/dmangs kyi rtsol ba'i tshad ches mtho ba'i mi rigs 'di lta bu zhig tu gyur pa red/ des na dngos yod spyi tshogs kyi mjug ma dam du bzung nas rkang dri bro reg bar du mi gtong ba 'di bod kyi lo rgyus kyi bslab bya yin/skya zad sngo sdug gi deng gi gnas bab 'dis nga tsho ste/ 'dzam gling mi rigs so so'i bde sdug gi tshad la go thos yod pa'i nga tsho la/ rtag tu mnar gcod byed bzhin yod la/ dus mtshungs su rang gi gnas bab ngan pa 'di bsgyur dgos snyam pa'i lhag bsam zla ba dkar po yid kyi shar ri'i phrag la 'byon bzhin du'ang yod/ deng gi gnas bab ngan pa 'di bsgyur dgos na/nga tsho la sgyur byed kyi lag cha ste rnam pa der dpyod pa'i rig pa'i lag cha zhig dgos pa smos ma dgos/ 'di la rig gnas yin tshad kyi mi chog la/ yon tan pa yin tshad kyis kyang mi 'ong / gtso bo deng gi spyi tshogs dang nye ba'i spyi tshogs rig pa'am/ dpal 'byor rig pa/ slob gso rig pa sogs dgos pa yin/ ches yid phangs pa la 'di'i skor gyi shes bya rgyud na yod mkhan bod na gtan nas med/ 'o na gal te de lta'i yon tan pa yod pa'i dbang du btang na/ de'i skor nas dpyad pa zhig 'bri ba'am kha brda zhig byed dus bod mi rnams kyis e go 'am/ spyi tshogs spyi'i khongs mi la brda chad dang brda rtags la thun mong gi go ba med dus/ bar gyi kha brda dang 'dren bsres(sna.ā+oṃṣā ༈spyik+ṣu)de 'byung thabs med/ de bas deng gi bod la mtshon na thabs 'di yang cha rkyen ma smin pas de 'dra'i go chod cig ma red/(ma 'ongs par 'dir ma bgrod thabs med yin) bshad mkhan dang bshad yul gnyis 'dren bsres bya dgos pa dang / lhag par bshad mkhan gyis bshad yul der brda sprod par 'dod na de'i sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen ni bshad mkhan gyis bshad yul gyi‘‘skad’’de bed spyod rgyu de yin/ des na deng gi bod la mtshon na/ bod mi phal cher bas nyan thub — 82 —

nga da dung yid mi tshim/la nyan par spro ba'i mtshams sbyor gyi brda go chod cig bod la chags yod pa rtsom rig go/ ngas bsam na deng gi bod mi lta bu'i rtsom rig la 'jug mi mang po yod pa gzhan du mi srid/ 'di ni dmangs kyi blo 'byed(khrim+mu)par 'dod mkhan la mtshon na 'di ni 'khor sgyur gyi phyag tu 'khor lo rin po che thob pa dang gnyis su med/ de bas na deng gi bod spyi tshogs la sha tsha 'dod pa dang sha tsha shes mkhan zhig yin na/ thog mar bod kyi dngos yod spyi tshogs yal bar 'dor mi rung / de nas dmangs kyi blo sgo 'byed ched rtsom rig gi thabs 'di bed spyod pa thabs kyi mchog yin snyam/rgya'i dus skabs gsar pa'i rtsom rig gis rtsom rig la rang dbang brtson len byed skabs kho tsho'i sgrub byed gal chen po gcig ni/ rtsom rig gis spyi tshogs bdag tu gnyer mi dgos te/ spyi tshogs bdag tu gnyer ba la spyi tshogs rig pa sogs yod pas phyir ces zer/ des na nga tsho la dngos yod spyi tshogs bdag tu gnyer bya'i shes bya'i rnam grangs med pas phyir na las 'di rtsom rig gis phrag tu mi len 'os med yin/ deng 'dir dngos yod spyi tshogs kyi cha nas sam yang na bsam blo gsar pa'am lta ba gsar pa'i kha brda zhig dmangs ches mang po'i khrod du 'byung dgos na/ rtsom rig las 'phros te 'byung bar 'gyur pa zhig yin pa 'di las kyang shes thub/de ltar ji lta bu zhig yin 'os pa'i cha nas bshad na bod rtsom gyi dngos yod spyi tshogs 'di bdag tu gnyer dgos pa deng gi gnas bab dang 'tsham pa'i bya ba go chod cig yin snyam/ 'di ni rtsom rig spyi'i 'phel phyogs dang mi mthun yang / mar khe si'i gzhung lugs kyis gnas tshul bye brag pa la bye brag pa'i sgo nas thag gcod bya dgos zhes zer la/ tshad ma'i gzhung du/ ‘‘spyi dang dmigs kyis bsal ba kun/ / bstan bcos kun la rab tu gces’’zhes pa — 83 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/de red/ des na bod kyi rtsom rig gis 'gan 'di 'grub par bya ba'i thad nas te/ ji ltar du yin pa'i ngos nas yid tshim po byung yod dam zhe na/ yid tshim po byung med/ de yang rtsom rig gis spyi tshogs la phan nus 'byin tshul gyi steng nas bshad na/ des mi re gnyis shig gi dga' snang brtas par byed pa'am/ yang na ni‘‘legs por 'dug’’ces dpe cha'i kha zum rjes brtsams chos rang la'ang rdzogs tshig rta 'dra ba babs pa zhig yin na/ spyi tshogs phan nus bya ba bshad dka'/ rtsom rig rang thon skyed nus shugs ma yin pas/ rtsom rig rang gis thad kar spyi tshogs sgul bar byed pa'am dpal 'byor gyi khe 'don par byed pa mi srid/ kho'i phan nus 'byin tshul ni mi'i bla srog gsar pa bskrun pa'i ngos nas spyi tshogs kyi sgul shugs chen po la rting gnon chen po bzo ba de yin/ de bas la las rtsom rig ni mi'i rnam shes bzo skrun byed pa'i bzo 'god pa'o zhes zer/ des na gtso bo spyi tshogs steng du bsam pa'i mtho rlabs shig 'phyur bar bya ba gal shin tu che/ deng gi nga tsho la mtshon na/ dpal 'byor gong du spel ba 'gan 'khri'i gtso bo'i nang gi rgyal po yin yang deng gi bod kyi gnas bab la bltas te bshad na/ thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro ba'i chos de bsam blo bcings 'grol dang lta ba gsar pa bskyed rgyu de red/ 'di thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro ba ma lta bur gyur yod/ 'di'i phyogs nas mtho rlabs shigo 'phyur ba shin tu gal/ lo rgyus la phyir bltas byas na/ rtsom rig gis spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas la rmad byung lag rjes bzhag pa'i dus ni yo rob gling gi rig rtsal bskyar dar dus dang / rgya nag gi‘‘lnga bzhi'i’’las 'gul dang yang na nga tsho dang thag nye ba'i lo rabs brgyad cu pa'i dus skabs gsar pa'i skabs red/ 'di dag la thun mong gi khyad chos shig yod pa ni/ skabs de dag tu bsam blo'i bcings 'grol — 84 —

nga da dung yid mi tshim/gyi mtho rlabs shig 'phyur yod la/ skabs de dag tu rtsom rig ni lo rgyus kyi kha dkyu ba'i dpung sde gtso bo yin pa de red/ deng gi bod kyi rtsom rig gis kyang 'di lta bu zhig 'byung bar byed na da gzod spyi tshogs la dngos su phan btags pa red/ 'on kyang da snga yan chad de lta'i re ba'i myu gu shin tu phra/ rtsom pa po tshang mas ra brag 'dod brag dang / lug spang 'dod spang byas nas yod pa las thams cad kyis ches gsal ba'i dar cha gcig tu sgreng rgyu byung med/de las gzhan ku re yin pa'i bden gtam zhig bshad na/ bsam blo'i mtho rlabs yin na'ang 'dra/ rtsom pa po'i cod pan yin na'ang 'dra/ tshad nges can zhig gi steng nas de rtsom rig dpyad brjod la shin tu rag las/rtsom rig dpyad brjod ni klog pa po dang brtsams chos bar gyi mtshams sbyor dang / spyi tshogs dang rtsom rig bar gyi mtshams sbyor/ rtsom pa po dang brtsams chos bar gyi mtshams sbyor bcas yin/ deng gi bod kyi rtsom rig gi gnas bab la bltas na lhag par de ltar yin/ 'on kyang bod kyi dpyad brjod ni mtho rlabs 'phyur ba'i ram 'degs su lta zhog‘‘sa bcad ma stong’’tsam red/'di dper na sta re rno yang sta ltag ma mthug pas shing gi gcod nus rang bzhin la dma' phab par 'gyur pa ltar red/de nas bod rtsom gyi gsar rtsom phyogs la bltas na'ang / yid tshim po 'byung dka'/ thog mar rtsom rig gi bsam blo'i nang don phyogs nas dngos yod spyi tshogs dang nye bar btud de yod kyang / spyi tshogs kyi snang tshul rigs rtsom du drangs pa las bsam blo la gting zab pa rgya che ba can nyung la/ lhag par rang gi thun min myong rtog gis phyug pa shin tu nyung snyam/ spyir bshad na bya ba'i brgyud rim ngo sprod pa tsam dang / rang gi sdom tshig gi 'grel ba tsam las ma 'das/ ches sla sa nas bshad na/ rtsom rig gis dmangs la phan — 85 —
