mu tig gling gi dga' ston/nus 'byin tshul de/ rig gzhung gi skor ltar du gtan tshigs kyi rigs pa bed spyod rgyu ma yin par/ yid 'gyur ram brtse dung gi cha nas sam yang na gsal phyug gnyis ldan gyi snang brnyan bzhengs skrun gyis klog pa po'i yid sems dbang med du drangs nas/ klog pa por phyir 'dang rgyag rgyu'am bsam blo'i skul ma gtong ba'i tshad la bslebs dus da gzod phan nus byung ba yin/ rtsom rig gi phan nus 'byin tshul yang 'di yin/ 'on kyang bod rtsom gyi steng nas dngos yod don snying can gyi snang brnyan ga tshod cig nga tshos bgrang thub bam/de ltar du bsam blo rkyang ba'i cha nas kyang dngos yod spyi tshogs la kha gtad kyi rang bzhin che zhing / der ma zad phyi'i snang tshul las 'das nas nang gi rtsa ba la reg thub pa'i rtsom mang po bgrang rgyu yod dam/ gzhan pa'i rtsom rig gi grub 'bras ni tag tag 'di 'dra'i steng nas bshad pa yin/ de bzhin du rtsom rig gi sgyu rtsal cha nas kyang de 'dra'i yid tshim po 'byung mi thub/ rtsom rig bya ba de bsam blo'i nang don yang gal chen po yin yang / mthar gtugs na rtsom rig cig rtsom rig yin byed de gtso bor kho'i sgyu rtsal gyi rang bzhin steng na yod/ brjod bya'i bsam blo gting zab min dang kha phyir bltas dang nang bltas gang yin yang de sgyu rtsal gyi tshad mthon po'i steng nas mtshon par bya rgyu rtsom rig gi rang mdangs yin/ 'di'i phyogs nas bod rtsom gyis rnam grangs kyi steng nas rtsom tshul mi 'dra ba 'ga' zhig la tshod lta'am 'tshol dpyod byas myong yang / sna de nas zab sar phyin te rang gis grub 'bras blangs yod pa shin tu nyung / tha na da bar du dngos yod dgag sgrub ring lugs kyi 'bri stangs kyi lam du zhugs pa bod rtsom gyi rtsom tshul gtso bo yin yang / 'di'i thad nas 'bras bu mngon gsal can blangs pa cher dkon/ rtsom rig la gsar du 'jug mkhan la dga' snang brtas par byed pa mang du yod kyang /— 86 —

nga da dung yid mi tshim/lo ngo nyi shu'i bod rtsom gsar pa'i dus yun dang bsdur te len 'os pa'i cha nas bshad na dngos gnas yid tshim pa 'byung dka'/des na/ bod kyi yon tan pa spyi dang sgos su bod rtsom gyi las la 'jug pa dag gis/ rtsom rig gi las 'di gzhan rigs kyi zer rjes 'brangs nas gnam bshad sa bshad kyis bar snang gi shing bal lta bu zhig tu mi byed par/rang gi pha ma rgan rgon/ ming sring gnyen nye/ sde ba tsho ba dag gis mgo ba mo dang rkang chu bur/ sen mgo khrag dang sen rting rnag gis 'tsho gnas kyi mtha' mtshams na 'phag 'tshag byed bzhin pa'i gnas bab ya nga ba 'dir/ rtsom pa po zhig gi myong rtog gi tshor ba skyen po des myong rtog zab mo bya bar mkhyen/spyir bshad na nga tsho'i las su bya ba de rgyang ring rgyang ring zhig dang thag ring thag ring zhig na med/ rang gi mig mdun dang nye logs na sha khrag rus rgyud gcig pa dag gis med mug gi smre sngags ji ltar 'don pa dang / dbul phongs kyi sdug rnam ji ltar 'khrab pa 'di kho na nyid do/ / bzang ngan gang ltar rung / nga tsho ni deng gi skye thog 'di'i nang gi mi rigs kyi las byed pa po dang mtho rim rig gnas kyi slob gso thob pa dag red ang /

ma bklags tshad med kyi sgrung gtam/da wa〈tshe ring don grub kyi sgrung 'bring phyogs bsgrigs〉kyi sngon 'gro'i gtam/ljang bu/tshe ring don grub ni sgrung gtam kho na 'bri mkhan gyi rtsom pa po'i rigs su gtogs/ de las kyang sgrung gtam thad grub 'bras legs shos lon pa'i rtsom pa po zhig yin te/ mdor drangs nas bshad na de ni don dag gsum la rag las/ 1 brtsams sgrung de dag gi rmang gdan ni khyod dang nga da lta 'tsho zhing sdod pa'i khor yug 'di yin pas na/ rtswa thang dang dgon sde/ sprul sku dang dad 'bangs/ da dung las byed pa dang dpon po sogs la khyod dang nga 'dra ba'i gson nyams shig shar yod/ 2 brtsams sgrung de dag ni drang bden gyi gzhu rgyud las 'phos pa'i mda' mo re re yin pas na/ klog mkhan rnams kyis dga' bsu dang len byed sla/ 3 sgrung thung dag gi ngos nas bshad na/ khong gi gsar rtsom gyi thabs rtsal khyad du 'phags pa'i phyir/ a ri pa mag khren nam o'u hing ros dang gral gcig la 'khod chog la ma chog tsam du snang / sku ngo tshos khong la‘bod kyi mag khren’lta bu'i‘‘sgro 'dogs’med pa zhu/ khong gis sgrung 'bring brtsams pa mang po med na'ang sgrung thung gi rmang gzhi'i steng nang don gyi sdor ma mang tsam brgyab pa'i tshul yin la/ skabs skabs su dmangs sgrungh+ru phyokā~X sgrig cig klog pa dang 'dra zhing / res 'gar byung ba brjod pa'i

ma bklags tshad med kyi sgrung gtam/snyan rtsom ring bo zhig dang mjal ba 'dra/ spyir btang gi chos la dpyad na/spus ka dag pa'i sgrung gtam zhig thon pa des yar thon byung ba'i spyi tshogs shig shugs kyis bstan yod cing / yang na sgru nga gtam des tshogs pa zhig rmongs gnyid las dkrogs pa'i 'os 'gan khur du bzhes yod/ brtsams chos phyi ma dag ni phyi tshul nas bltas na nye ring chags sdang bral ba'i brkos ris nyams chen zhig dang 'dra na'ang / don du tshogs pa de la 'gro lam rigs shig ston nus pa'i bsam blo pa zhig yin pa ma zad tshogs pa de la phugs 'dun dang brtse dung bcangs yod par sems/ skye bo de 'dra ba'i bsam gzhig gi dmigs yul dang grub 'bras kyang tshogs pa de'i khe phan la thad kar rag las pas/ khong tshos ha cang thabs mkhas ngang khyod dang nga la‘‘'di g.yug zhogade khyer shog’’ces bsgo srid/ de bas dus rabs nges can nam khor yug nges can zhig gi nang du/ sgrung gtam ni sgrung gtam gtsang gtsang min par rgan po tshor phog thug gtong ba'i lag cha re'ang yin srid/ 'on kyang tshe ring don grub mchog gis‘‘ri bong dang sdom pa’’nyis cha zin yod pa de ci nas kyang khas len bya dgos pa zhig red/deng gi char skye bo 'ga' res‘‘srol rgyun’’dang‘‘deng rabs’’kyi 'gal zla'am dbye ba sogs skad cha ya mtshan re gleng gin yod pa ma zad/ rtsom yig re gnyis sil bur gshags nas 'di‘‘srol rgyun’’dang 'di‘‘deng rabs’’zhes skad rgyag gin 'dug ‘‘phyi bcos tshan khag gi sman pa’’de tsho'i mdun du dpe deb 'di bzhag tshe ci zhig ji ltar smra bar sngon dpag bya dka' mod/ sman pa la'ang na tshas gtse srid pas chu ma 'ong sngon la rags shig brtsigs pa yin/mdor dril na/ gus pos 'dir zhu 'dod pa ni/ pha sna tha 'then mkhan zhig la bu sbi rag btung mkhan zhig skyes par/ bu 'dis pha shul ji ltar 'dzin — 89 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/zhes blun pos rang mtshang 'byin pa'i smra brjod med par ‘‘gser zhal’’btsums rogs zhu zhes pa de'o / / gting zab pa'i bsam gzhig dang khyad mtshar ba'i sgrig bkod las gzhan/ tshe ring don grub kyi sgrung gtam gyi rjod byed tshig phreng gseb du rol rtsed kyi cha yis khengs shing / kha mtshar —dang zur zas khengs pa'i rol rtsed de dag kyang gzhan rigs kyi lad zlos min par/ rang rigs kyi ste khyod dang nga yi sems la me btsa' bzhin na ba de yin/ de bas khong gi rol rtsed 'du shes de ni‘‘kha dgod zhor khog na sdug cig 'jog’’thub pa'i tshad mtho sgyu rtsal zhig yin/tshe ring don grub kyi nang sems ni kher sdug gis khengs pa zhig yin pas/kho'i bsam pa'i 'khyer so dang kun tu spyod pa'ang ha cang dmigs bsal ldan pa zhig yin zhing / ha cang gi dmigs bsal de shes rtogs byed sa ni khong gi brtsams chos dag las ma 'das/ klog pa po zhig gi ngos nas bshad na/khong dang gleng mol brgyud de kho'i nang sems la 'dzul ba'i dmigs yul 'grub pa'i byed thabs gtso bo ni/ khong dang mnyam du a rag pi tsi do gsum re rol zhor sha rgya ma gang do zhig za ba de min la/ ‘‘gleng mol tshogs 'du’’zhig las khong la‘‘gsung bshad’’dum bu zhig gnang ba'i re zhu byed pa'ang ma yin te/gal te khyod rang khong dang bar thag ring sar bsdad nas khong gi brtsams chos klog thub na de ni thabs lam 'ba' zhig go/ ngas gong ltar smra spobs pa ni tshe ring don grub kyis nga la yid ches tshad med byas dang byed kyin pas yin la/mi lo nyi shu lhag gi mdza' bshes dang rgyus lon la brten nas/ ngas khyod la dpe deb 'di ngo sprod byas yod de/ klog tshar rjes khyod la 'gyod pa med par ngas da lta nas khas len byas pa yin/— 90 —

go bder btang ba'i rin chen rgyal po/ljang bu/chu tshod bzhi'i sngon la khong gis phran la zhal par btang ste gsham gyi rtsom nyog 'di'am 'di 'dra zhig bri bar bcol gdams gnang ma thag nga la snga na med pa'i dngangs 'tshab cig dang ci bya gtol bral gyi snang ba zhig rang dbang med par skyes byung /gcig na kho bor gra sgrig ci yang med pa'i khar rtsom yig 'di rigs 'bri rgyu ni dngos gnas bye ma btsir nas mar khu la re ba'i las shig yin pas/gang zhig gang ltar gang nas bzung bri rgyu cha ma 'tshal/gnyis na khong gi sgrung gtam〈bzhud pa'i lam bu〉lta bu ni/ don grub rgyal gyi rjes su 'phyur 'ongs pa'i rtsom rlabs kyi yang rtse'i zegs ma lta bu ste brtsams chos ches yag shos su gtogs na'ang / don dang mthun pa'i gdeng 'jog dang khyab bsgrags shig ma thon par brjed nges kyi bye klong du dben sim mer thim par ya re mtshan zhing yid re skyo ba'i gnas so/ /gsum na/ a lo rin chen rgyal po zhes pas bod kyi sgrung gtam/ dpyad gtam/ 'khrab gzhung / snyan ngag gzhas tshig 'khrab khrid/ 'khrab ston/tha na dge 'dun chos 'phel zhib 'jug dang ri mo'i rtsom sgrig brnyan 'phrin las ka sogs la'ang lag pa 'chang zhing de rigs kyi ko gyong la skyed phud myong — 91 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/ba ma zad/ rgya nag pa'i gtam dpe ji bzhin/ ‘‘gom gang spos sar shul re bzhag 'dug’’pas/ khong ni las sla bo'i ngang 'ju thub pa'i kha zas shig ma yin thag gis chod/ lto 'dun can la bslu brid ji 'dra'i che na yang /spyir na/ kho bo ni mtha' gcig tu mi'i‘‘skyon’’kho na mthong ba'i yas zhar gyi u tshugs 'chang zhing / chang mis 'thung na snying na la rang gis 'thung na mgo na ba'i sems khams shig khyer te mthong tshad la mdzub mo 'dzugs shing thos tshad la kha gtong bar spro mkhan zhig yin pas na/ 'ga' res nga ni‘‘khyi smyon’’du mthong gin yod pa thos myong / mi skyon/ kho bo'i lhan skyes kyi gdong 'bag ko gyong 'dra bo 'di la spyir btang gi khab gtsag 'bug gtsag tsam gyis na tsha bzo mi nus la/ 'tshem bu rgyag pa ni de bas kyang dka' tsam gda' snyam mo/ /gong smras tshig dum ni ku re tsam du zad/ yin na'ang / ku re'i rjes su dus rabs shig gi lnga cha'i gcig ste mi lo nyi shu'i ring gi rang re'i rtsom rig las don la phyi mig cig bltas shing phyir 'dang re brgyab tshe/ ‘‘dga' gsum dang 'dar gsum’’gyi snang ba zhig 'gog med du mi skye'am/ dus deb bcu grangs shig dang tshags par gyi‘‘rtsom rig le tshan’’kha shas la dar rgud sna tshogs shig byung la/ rtsom rig‘‘phyogs bsgrigs’’dang‘‘rtsom btus’’bcu phrag kha shas shig snga gzhug tu dpar du bskrun thub pa byung ste/ grub 'bras ni grangs 'bor gyi shugs che ba tsam zhig srid kyi grub 'bras tsam du snang shas che/ rtsom rig rang ngos la bshad na lo nyi shu'i spus tshad phal cher sngar gyi kha mal tsam de dag las kyang yid skyo ba ni‘‘rigs pa'i gzhung lugs’’thad kyi ngo thog gi gnad don de yin te/ 'di'i skor zhib phra kho bo'i ma 'ongs spel 'gyur gyi 'bol rtsom phyogs bsgrigs〈kher lab than thun〉zhes pa'i nang gleng rtsis yod la/'dir〈bzhud pa'i lam bu〉yi gong smras snang tshul dang de dang sbyar nas mdor — 92 —

go bder btang ba'i rin chen rgyal po/bsdus shig gleng rtsis te/ rang re'i rgad po tshos‘‘grogs nye 'dod na skyon la mdzub mo tshugs’’zhes pa'i kha ta 'di'i ngo sor bltas nas zhi lhod bag phebs kyi gleng mol re yod pa zhu/gong nas snang tshul zhes gleng zin pa ltar/ bdag la rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi rnam dbye/ nyams zhib/ sel 'jug sogs kyi 'jon thang ni med/bdag la yod pa ni tshor snang rags pa zhig dang myong ba mkhregs po 'ba' zhig be|/deng sang gi rtsom pa po mang che bas phal cher〈me long ma〉dang lo rabs bdun cu brgyad cu par spel ba'i〈rtsom rig spyi rnam〉lta bu'i rtsa tshig rang bzhin gyi‘‘slob debari’kha shas la nyan thos re byung yod cing / 〈spyi rnam〉de dag las khyod la mdzub mo ri ston ngang 'das zin pa'i rtsom rig(rgya rigs gtso'i)gi sdom tshig re mjal ba'i skal ba ldan zhing / byung dang 'byung mus kyi rtsom rig ces pa de‘‘lung du bstan’’mi 'dug slob dpon chen mo tsho dang rtsom rig‘‘zhib 'jug pa’’tsho'i las ka'ang gzhung lugs nyi tshe ba re la brten nas khyi ra ba skor zhig gis rngon sha bgo bsha' rgyag pa lta bu'i las bgos rags pa re byas nas nang don(brjod bya)dang rnam pa(rjod byed)la dpyad pa zer ba lta bu'am‘‘bsam blo'i rang bzhin’’dang‘‘sgyu rtsal rang bzhin’’la dpyad pa zer ba lta bu'i las thob(yonarnyekhri)len byed kyi dpyad rtsom re las/ rtsom rig gsar pa rang la nyams zhib byed pa'i skad cha la ser sna bla lhag gis che/ de bas rang re'i lo nyi shu bo 'di ni dmigs bsal gyi khor yug cig las rtsom pa po rang nyid kho nar brten la klog pa po kho nar brten pa'i dmigs bsal gyi rtsom rig snang tshul zhig yin pas na/ rkang pa ya gcig la brten pa'i gyol lding gi rtsom rig cig red ces kyang smra spobs/ mtshams rer rtsom mkhan gyi rang snang gang shar dang — 93 da

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/klog mkhan gyi chu sna gar khrid bar la‘‘bklags rjes kyi myong tshor’’zhes pa re gnyis byung ba ni yid skyo ba'i gnas/ de bzhin〈bzhud pa'i lam bu〉la bris pa'i‘‘bklags rjes kyi myong tshor’’rtsom sgrig khang ga ge mos‘‘bor brlag thebs pa’’ni de bas kyang yid skyo ba'i gnas/ gzhan yang rang re'i slob chung nas slob chen bar gyi bod yig slob deb de dag la thengs shig bltas/ slar yang rang re'i rtsom sgrig pa tsho'i‘‘mig rgyang’’la thengs shig bltas na/ da dung yid skyo ba'i gnas/ rgad po tshos bskyur ba'i‘‘rig sa/nas shul rdzas’’la dag ther byed mkhan dang gzhon pa tshos blangs pa'i gzhan gyi legs cha la do khur byed mkhan nyung nas snga ma nyams phyi ma shor la nye dus chang zhor ja zhor la kha pho bshad 'dug pa las/ re 'gar lag len byed mkhan gal mi che'am/brgya bshad tshig gi mdo rtsad wa a lo rin chen rgyal po/ lag len pa khong gi da lta'i thob thang ni zlos gar tshogs pa zhig gi tshogs gtso sku gzhon yin/spyi lo1984lo'i dbyar gzhung gi zi ling mkhar du kho bo'i gcung mo bar mas ngo sprod byas pa brgyud/ slob chen rtsis rig khag gi lo rim dang po'i slob phrug gam na gzhon‘‘rtsom dga'’’khong dang mjal skal ldan/ de dus kho dgung lo bcu dgu lhag yin/ ‘‘rtsom dga'’’zhig yin pa'i khar khong ni‘‘gangs dga'’’zhig kyang yin tshod 'dug ste/ kho'i‘‘pir ming’’la gangs dga' zer/dus de ni rtsom yig gi spus ka'i legs nyes 'byed sla ba'i dus shig ste/ rtsom pa po nyung tsam las med cing rtsom yig yag po zhig thon ma thag kun gyi gleng gzhir 'gyur sla/ gangs dga' yang re ltos che ba'i na gzhon de rigs su gtogs/ rjes su mtsho nub phyogs su'ang‘‘gangs dga'’’zhig byung / de bas snga ma de a lo rin chen rgyal por gyur/ a lo ni khong gi rus tshab yin par snang — 94 —

go bder btang ba'i rin chen rgyal po/ste/ kho'i ming la rin chen rgyal zhes bya/ ri mtho sa gtsang mi skye sa zhig ste mkhas dbang zhabs dkar tshogs drug rang grol dang dge 'dun chos 'phel sogs kyi 'khrungs sa ni khong gi pha yul yin te/ u tshugs sgos bshad na phyi ma'i gnyen tshan du 'gro tshul yang thos myong / nga gnyis gcig na‘‘rtsom dga'ari’gnyis na chang dga'/ gsum na mo dga'/ bzhi na gangs dga'/ lnga nadaga' kha zhen phyogs kyi dbang gis phan tshun ngo shes/ gting lon/mdza' brtse chags/ grogs por gyur/ gu yangs pa'i ngang bshad na nga gnyis slob grogs su'ang gyur/ dbyar kha der/ mtsho sngon zhing chen gyis‘‘skabs dang po'i rtsom rig gso sbyong 'dzin grwa’’zhes pa zhig gnyer zhing zla gnyis lhag ring nga gnyis slob khang gcig tu bsdad myong / (skabs gnyis pa dang gsum pa zer ba'i 'dzin grwa zhig gnyer med tshod la dpyad na a pho rtsom rig gi gnas bab la 'gyur ba byung zin pa'ang rtogs)khong gis thog mar nga yi dang ba 'dren byed ni na gzhon slob phrug de'i las ka'i 'khri sems dang rigs kyi la rgya/ de min khong gi skyes thob kyi shes rab dang bsdongs pa'i rang gshis dod pa'i rnam rig sogs yin/ mi de'i rang gshis dang rtsom gshis bar gyi 'brel ba des da lta'i bar nga la bag chags zab mo zhig bzhag myong / 〈bzhud pa'i lam bu〉ni sgyu rtsal gyi legs grub tsam min par rtsom pa po'i chags zhen dang brtse ba zol med kyi mtho tshad cig yin pa ma zad/ bod pa zhig gi spobs pa dang la rgya'i 'du shes dmar rjen du mtshon thub pa zhig kyang yin pas/ rnam pa tshos〈gangs rgyan me tog〉dus deb cig btsal te mjal kha zhig zhus na‘‘khyi smyon’’gyis bshad pa dag mtha' gcig tu 'bor shob min pa'ang shugs kyis go snyam/ 〈bzhud〉las gzhan da dung khong gi〈 sne mo de nu〉lta ga'i snyan ngag mjal myong mkhan tshos kyang skabs de'i — 95 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/ 'ju skal bzang dang da lta'i skyabs chen bde grol dang gangs zhun sogs dang rigs 'gre bar bya nges sems/bod pa tshor nga rgyal dang phrag dog che tshul zhig go la/ kho bos dpyad pa ltaran phyi ma sa khyab rdo khyab tu snang ste/ rgan po tshos‘‘gzhi gzhan gyi phun tshogs la ma bzod par sems khong nas 'khrug pa’’zhes 'grel bshad go bde zhig kyang brgyab yod pas/ ‘‘phun tshogs pa’’dag la khong dgod 'tsher srid snyam/ 'on kyang nga rgyal de mthong re skan/ lhag par du spobs sems kyis khengs pa'i nga rgyal de/ rmang gzhi dang bcas shing rgya che ba'i nga rgyal de/'thab jus kyi nga rgyal de/ a lo tshos nga la nga rgyal de'i dgos gal bstan byung snyam/zla ngo bzhi lnga re la phan tshun kha par thengs re rgyag pa'am lo ngo gnyis gsum re la mjal 'dzoms thengs re byung ba las dasdigs bsal gyi 'brel 'dris nyung nas nyung du 'gro mus yin na'ang / ngas ni ha cang gdeng tshod yod pa'i lhag bsam rnam dag cig gis khong gi ma 'ongs par re ltos byas yod/mi 'gyangs par/ khong gis/ 'khrab gzhung yag po zhig 'bri rtsis yod tshul thos/ spyi lo2003lor dge chos la dran rten(lo100)gyi〈rnam thar〉zhig bskrun rtsis zer/

〈rkang lam phra mo〉bklags pa'i tshor ba 'ga'/lta lung 'tsho/〈rkang lam phra mo〉ni yid la bag chags bsgo byed kyi tshon ris zhig dang 'dra bas lta klog byed thengs re rer nam yang bsam gzhig byed dgos pa'i dri ba re re ster ba las gces shos du ma brjod par spro/dang po/ ches thog ma'i shing rta ba de su yin nam/lam ni sngar nas yod pa zhig gtan nas ma red/ de ni mtho rim srog chags 'gro ba mi nas dma' rim srog chags grog ma yan chad song ba'i rkang rjes rang red/ 〈rkang lam phra mos〉'di'i thad la bsam gzhig gi dri ba dang po 'phangs yod/brtsams chos las yid 'dzin che zhing kha brda la dga' ba'i rgan rgon de dag gis rkang lam phra mo de ni ldong gzu ba dge legs zer bas chibs rta khyung chen zil gnon zhon te dbyangs rta rus chen mgo gnon bya ba blangs nas brgyugs pa'i shul yin zer ba dang / gling ge sar nor bu dgra 'dul gyis rta rkyang rgod g.yer bar chibs te hor sdig can shan pa rme du rtse ske lcags thag sha ler khrid pa'i shul yin zer ba'am/ yang na/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis spre'u byang chub sems dpa' ri bo po ta lar bsgom du btang ba'i shul yin — 97 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/zer ba dang / la las da dung lha lung dpal rdor gyis glang dar ma bkrongs rjes bros shul yin zer ba sogs bshad tshul sna tshogs byung la/ de dag gis rkang lam phra mo 'di ni ldong gzu ba dge legs dang gling ge sar rgyal po sogs kyi che ba brjod byed cig tu byed/des na rkang lam phra mo de gsar bskrun byed mkhan gyi ches thog ma'i shing rta ba de su yin nam/ de ni rlabs chen gyi mes po su zhig yin pa smos ma dgos la/ khong gis nga tshor bzhag pa'i rlabs chen mdzad rjes 'di gser srang brgya bas kyang khugs pa'i go skabs ga la yod/ 〈rkang lam phra mos〉'di'i skor la gting zab cing go rgyu khyad par can yod pa'i bsam gzhig gnang ba'am sgyu rtsal blos bslangs kyi khyad chos gtso bo zhig lags/gnyis pa/ lam 'di brdal mkhan med par bde ba 'di ya mtshar/mes pos nga tshor bzhag pa'i rkang lam phra mo 'di ni lo rgyus kyi rkang lam phra mo nyag gcig ste/ nam yang rgyang ring nas rgyang ring du bsrings 'dugadus rabs nyer gcig pa bsu bar tshan rig gi mtho rlabs dgung du 'phyur ba'i dus 'di la mtshon na'ang / gzhung lam du 'gro mkhan mang la rkang lam du 'gro mkhan yang sngar bzhin mang / rgyu mtshan 'di dag la brten nas lam 'di brdal ba med par bde ba la mtshar snang skyes pa'i mi skor zhig byung zhing‘‘gna' mi glen pa de tsho/ sa tsub po 'di 'dra zhig nas gzhis chags par 'khang ra byed mi srid pa'i mi skor zhig kyang de dang mnyam du byung / gnyan dang btsan gyi rgyu lam yin zer nas rkang lam phra mo 'di rgya che ru gtong phod mkhan ma byung la/ rgan rgon rnams kyi tshig rtsod kyang rgyun chad ma myong / de ni tshul ji lta bu zhig yin na'ang yin du chug nga rang dga' sa ni rkang lam phra mo — 98 —

〈rkang lam phra mo〉bklags pa'i tshor ba 'ga'/'di yin la/ nga rang skyo sa yang rkang lam phra mo 'di yin’’pa'i rgyu mtshan gang la thug yod/ lam 'di brdal ba med par bde ba la thug yod pa e yin/gsum pa/ nga tsho'i ma 'ongs pa/〈rkang lam phra mos〉nga tsho'i mi rigs 'di'i rnying zhen bag 'khum gyi nad rnying la 'khang ra dang mtshang 'byin drags po byas 'dug ‘‘da lta gzhung lam dang / lcags lam/ mkha' lam/ mtsho lam sogs yod la/ tha na zla ba'i khang bzang du bgrod pa'i lam yang yod pas/ nga tsho'i mi rigs 'di da dung bong bur zhon nas rkang lam phra mo 'di'i thog tu sos dal bag phebs kyis 'gro zhing mchis/’’ yin na'ang‘‘nga'i mig lam du mtshar sdug 'od stong 'bar ba'i mdun lam zhig shar ba'i mod la/ nga'i gom pa'ang rang dbang med par gzhung lam gyi phyogs su spo dgos byung /’’dngos gnas de ltar yin te/ brtsams chos〈rkang lam phra mos〉bod mi rigs kyi tshab mtshon la‘‘nga’’bzhag ste/ nga'i gom pa rang dbang med par gzhung lam gyi phyogs su spo dgos byung zhes nga tsho'i ma 'ongs par lam 'dren gyi sgron me zhig mtho ru btegs yod/

srol rgyun dang deng rabs/da wabod kyi dengs rabs rtsom rig skor gyi bsam gzhigayon tan/bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig la mtshon na lo rabs brgyad cu pa de 'phyi 'dug gam ran pa yin pa cha ma 'tshal mod/ skabs de nas nga tsho'i gom pa thengs dang po nyid de deng rabs kyi phyogs su spos la/ phyi gling dang rgya nag gang la'ang bsdur mi 'tsham pa'i dus de nga tshor mtshon na gzi brjid dang bkra shis pa'i lo rabs shig red/ de nas bzung nga tsho'i gsar gtod kyi khrag rgyun skam nas grog rong ltar gyur pa'i rtsa'i sbubs su yang bskyar 'tsho stobs rgyas/de ni nga rgyal skye 'os pa'i gsar bcad cig yin/ rgyu mtshan ni‘‘ba tshwa dang 'grogs pa'i kha sang gis de ring gi skom pa sel mi thub’’pas yin/ kha sang gi tshwa chus de ring gi skom mi sod/ yin na'ang de ring gi chu rnyog gis sang nyin gyi bzhur rgyun drag po de'i tshab byed nus sam/ lo ngo nyi shu tsam de mi zhig la mtshon na gtam pha la mi 'dri zhing zas ma la mi slong ba'i lo tshod las kyang brgal 'dug 'on kyang mi rigs shig gi bsam blo'i 'phel rim zhig la mtshon na dus tshod de ha cang thung drags pas de la byas rjes yod med kha tshon gcod dka'/ chung sar bzhag nas bshad na rgyal kha chung chung zhig blangs zin/ de tsho snga rabs pa la bstan chog la rjes da 100 da

srol rgyun dang deng rabs/'brangs pa la ngom chog chog yin/ 'o na de tsam gyis chog gam zhe na/ ga la chog bzang ba dang dge ba/ gsar pa'i phyogs la chog shes 'dzin na skye bo su yang‘‘sangs rgyas’’mi thub pa thag gis chod/ 'on kyang da lta tshang ma de tsam gyis yid tshim gyin yod/ nad rnying bskyar du 'phar/ tshwa chu min pa'i chu de da lta chu rnyog tu 'gro bzhin pa 'dra/ mig mdun gyi rgyal kha gcig pur dungs pa de skye ba phyi ma'i bde skyid la deng gi khe phan yang med chog pa'i srol rgyun gyi bsam blo la'ang gzhi nas 'gal/rgyal kha de pham kha'i rting ma ste/ da lta chu rnyog gam 'dam rdzob gzhan zhig tu zug yod/ de'i phyir/ nga tsho'i re ba phran bu des 'dam rtswa nyag ma 'ga' nas ma 'ongs mi bo che'i lag par 'ju dgos/kha sang gi srol rgyun dang 'gal ba de de ring gi srol rgyun tu chags/ de ring dang 'gal ba'i gsar gtod sna tshogs kyang sang nyin gyi srol rgyun du 'gyur srid pas/ nga tshos nam yang kha phyogs gsar pa dang lta ba gsar pa zhig gis srol rgyun la brtse ba med pa'i dgag pa mu nas mu dang phyi mas sngon ma la rgyag dgos/ de ltar byas na da gzod nga tsho'i nyam chag rtsom rig la dbugs kyi 'byin rngub kyi rang dbang stsol thub snyam/nam yin yang nga tsho'i lag tu ral gri zhig bzung yod/ ral gri de thogs yod pas cig shos ni rmongs pa'i bdag po yin la/ cig shos ni gsar gtod kyi kha lo sgyur mkhan smyon pa yin/ 'di ni srol rgyun gyi bdag po dang ma 'ongs pa'i byed po gnyis ka yin/ yin yang don dngos su phung bo gcig gi steng nas 'phros pa'i gzugs brnyan gnyis yin pa ma gtogs/ dus dang yul lam yang na 'byung ba dang dbang bo ji bzhin las so sor phye ba'i phung bo min/de bas lo rgyus kyi stegs bur rtsen gyin pa'ang kho gcig pu ste nyam thag gi — 101 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/gdags gzhi de lags/ srol rgyun de 'ching byed kyi sgrog dang rmongs 'thom bag 'khum gyi lugs srol skyong ba'i rgyu ru gyur tshe/ kho rang rang nyid kyi bkag rgyar tshud nas rang srog len spyad kho nar 'gyur srid/ phyir lo rgyus kyi me long la lta dus nga tshos 'di lta bu'i chos nyid cig rnyed thub ste/ srol rgyun yag shos shig yin na gsar gtod ni kho'i tshe srog yin la/ srol rgyun gyi kha gtad du langs yod pa'ang tag tag gsar gtod yin/ kyag kyog dang bkag 'gog mnar gcod gang mang las bsreg bcad brdar gsum gyis grub pa'i srol rgyun yag shos shig gis nga tshor gsal bshad byas pa ni/ bag 'khum ngang lus pa'i srol rgyun mtha' dag rang shugs kyis rang gi rnying zhen rjes lus kyi cha rnams lo rgyus kyi stegs bu nas ga ler phud srid pa yin/ gzhi de nas nga tshos rnying dor gsar len gyi chos nyid de'i nus pa shes shing de bzhin tu kha ba can gyi lo rgyus kyang dbugs kyi rgyu ba nar nur gyis de ring gi gnas 'dir son/de ring nga tshos phyi rol la zur mig re 'phen dus/ nga tsho ngo gnongs la ngu bro ba'i gnas su lhung 'dug pa gtan nas ma shes pa yin nam/ de yang ma yin te/ dus rabs 'di'i dus 'gor bsam blo'i cang shes la kha lo bsgyur pa'i bcibs pa zhig gis rang nyid kyi blo spobs dang shes rab kyis yun ring la nyar ba'i ka ba dang bum pa bcag yun ring dad 'dun dang mos gus byas pa'i gnya' khri bshig khong gi ming la dge 'dun chos 'phel zer/ khos rang nyid ni gcig pur lus pa'i 'thab mo pa zhig yin pa shes mod/ 'on kyang srol rgyun gyi dug kha ches btsan pa'i khor yug de nas kho'i mdun lam gcig pu'ang tshang ma'i btung gin pa'i rnyog chu de nas kho rang nyam nga bas 'chi dgos pa de yin/ yin na'ang kho'i‘‘smyos’’zin pa'i rnam shes de srol rgyun gyi rmongs pa la kha gtad du yod khus/ nga tshos nam yang kho la bran gshis kyi gsol 'debs — 102 —

srol rgyun dang deng rabs/ma byas pa dang lha sgrung gis ma gos pa'i bsngags brjod dang yi rang byas/rgyun ring ba'i srol rgyun la mtshon na deng rabs ni de ring ltar yun thung la rtag pa'i nges pa med mod/ 'on kyang kho rang srol rgyun dang kha gtad du langs yod pas/ deng rabs kyis nam yang gsar pa mtshon pa dang srol rgyun gyi rdib chad cig yin/ rdib 'gro ba rmongs pa rjes lus dang chad 'gro ba ma bu sbrel ba'i lte thag ste/ nga tshos bsam blo'am bsam blo gzhir byas mtshon byed kyi rtsom rig mtha' dag srol rgyun dang lte srog sbrel yod cing / yang de nas chad de rang srog 'dzin pa'i phyogs su gyes nges/lo rabs brgyad cu pa'i skabs kyi brtsams chos mang po zhig tshod lta'i thog mar gyur la mi rigs 'di'i skad brda dang 'du shes kyi sgo mo phyogs gzhan zhig nas mngon par byas/ de tsho snga mo'i rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi rnam pa las thod brgal byung nas gnas bab la khel ba'i rnam pa can du gyur/ rigs de'i brtsams chos mang tsam gyi bsam blo dang sgyu rtsal sgrig gzhi'am rjod byed sogs phyogs gang rung nas deng rabs kyi mkho gal dang bstun la/ rjes phyogs kyi rtsom rig 'phel rgyas la ljid tig tig gi legs skyes sam rmang gzhi bting ba dang / 'dzam gling rtsom rig gi 'phel lam dang mthun par byas pa red/ de nas bod kyi rtsom rig de ha cang gu dog pa'i mnga' khongs shig nas btson grol thob la/ skabs 'di ni dus rabs bar ma'i yo rob gling dang dus rabs 'di'i dus 'go'i rgya'i rtsom rig gi rig gnas bskyar dar gyi thog ma'i rnam pa dang kun nas mtshungs/yo rob gling gi rig gnas bskyar dar ni skabs de'i lha chos gtso byas pa'i mun pa stug pa'i khor yug nas byung la/ rim bzhin 'gro ba mi'i rigs gtso byas pa'i mi chos mi gshis mchog 'dzin gyi lta ba yang snying byas nas spyi — 103 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/tshogs kyi phyogs so so'i srol rgyun de skabs de'i deng rabs su bsgyur cing /bla med kyi gsar bzo pa tshos dgag rgyag dang gsar gtod zam ma chad pas 'dzam gling lo rgyus thog 'od stong 'bar ba'i byas rjes bzhag pa red/dus rabs bar ma'i rig gnas bskyar dar gyi rlabs rnga ma 'jags par dus rabs 'di'i deng rabs ring lugs kyi rlabs chen gyis yang bskyar lo rgyus kyi mtsho mo la 'gul g.yom thengs shig thebs su bcug pa des/ srol rgyun gyis bcings pa'i rin thang lta tshul dang 'jig rten lta tshul sogs la phyogs yongs nas ljid cing che ba'i dri ba re re 'phangs/ srol rgyun dang 'gal ba'i kha gtad dang dgag gzhag sngar las dza drag tu gyur/ dpe 'di lta bu zhig bzhag chog ste/ srol rgyun yum chen mdun nas deng rabs kyi bu mo bcu drug lang tsho kun nas rdzogs kyin pa des rgas 'khogs dang nyams rgud la dgag pa ma byas rang byas yin/ pha sis bshad pa ltar na/ brtsams chos shig gi rin thang de brjod bya gsar pas mtshon la rnam pa gsar pa bzo ba'am snga na med pa'i byed thabs kyis rnam pa rnying pa sgrig 'dzugs dang / cha med 'jig rten nas cha rgyus med pa'i mnga' khongs shig 'tshol ba de yin zer/〈lang tsho'i rbab chu〉yis skya rengs gsar pa bos/ de ni lo rgyus kyi dkyogs mtshams shig nas thur 'bab pa min te des bsgrags gtam gsal lhang lhang zhig gnyid du yur ba'i yul mi tsho'i rna bar bsgron/ 'di lta bu'i brtsams chos ni brjod bya gsar pa dang rnam pa gsar pa/ go rtogs gsar pa dang thabs lam gsar pa'i 'phyor sgeg gi mdzes ma zhig mngon par bzos pa red/ nga tshos srol rgyun la dgag gzhag byed pa ni de'i skyon kho na ma gtogs yon tan mi brjod pa ma yin te/ mgur dang deb ther rnam thar mang po zhig gi rin thang de sngar bzhin mtho sa na 'od stong 'gyed la/ dgag gzhag gi gad bdar — 104 —

srol rgyun dang deng rabs/byed pas sngar las mdzes par 'gyur nges/ dgag gzhag kyang thabs lam zhig yin/ srol rgyun gyi lta tshul de da lta'i khor yug dang spyi tshogs khrod du nus pa dang rin thang ga tshod yod dam/ nga tshos dri ba rtsag rtsig dang dgag pa rab dang rim pas srol rgyun gyi lta ba la phyin ci log pa'i lta ba zhig kyang 'dzin 'os/rgyu mtshan ni deng mis mthong ba gnal mis ma mthong sa mi nyung ba yod pa'i phyir/ nga tshos dgag gin pa'i srol rgyun ni gsar gtod med pa'i snga ma'i bshu 'bri ste/ phyi tshul dang nang don la tha dad pa so so med pa'i bshu 'bri sha stag yin/ de las ldog ste re 'bod bya rgyu ni sus kyang su yi tshab byed mi nus pa'i gsar gtod kyi rang bzhin ldan pa de yin/ gal te srol rgyun de bskyar zlos sla mo zhig tu gyur tshe/ gtam gleng gi mtshams chad pa yin la/ srol rgyun de'ang skam 'gro ba yin/ de bzhin du deng rabs kyi rgyun bsrings tshe srol rgyun nyid 'gag par 'gyur/ nga tsho'i srol rgyun dang gyes pa'i deng rabs ni da lta dmigs bu med par gyur/ de ni chu rnyog gi rang bzhin te/ de las snying don gser gyi nya mo 'dzin par mthong zhing ral ba'i gzeb dra zhig gis ci nus/nga tsho la nges par du rnyog sel gyi nor bu ste rtsom rig dpyad gleng gi ke ta ka zhig mkho ba de deng gi rtsom stegs kyi dgos mkho yin/ de'ang ral gri yin te ral gri 'chang mkhan de stegs bu'i steng gi 'khrab ston la zhugs dgos/nga tshos zas kyi bcud len par so bar nas yang yang du ldad pa'am lce yis ro myangs byas nas mid pa bzhin/ sems kyi gsos su phan pa'i rtsom rig la'ang btso sbyang dang dag ther snyigs dor bcud len gyi 'gag sgo sna tshogs bskrun dgos/ da lta gang byung lab brdol gyi‘‘brtsams chos’’mang po zhig gis dus deb sogs su 'khod pa'i sa khyon bzung nas rtswa nang la gtso dang bzang bo'i rtsom rig la lhad 'dres par byas yod pa mig mthong lag zin yin pas/— 105 —

nga tshos snyigs ma bsregs pa'i me 'jog dgos la dri ma 'khrud pa'i chu 'dren 'os/ de min na khog stod seng ge 'gying 'dra la rnga ma khyi ro drud 'dra zhig tu 'gyur nyen che bas/ deng rabs la'ang btso sbyang dang kha khar dbye ba'am rdib chad kyi thabs lam 'bral mi rung /

bod kyi byis pa'i rtsom rig gi rtsom lus skor gleng ba/'o bzhugs/bod kyi byis pa'i rtsom rig gi rtsom lus tshigs bcad dang tshigs lhug gnyis su dbye chog tshigs bcad la dbye na byis glu dang khed/ byis pa'i dmangs glu sogs dang / tshigs lhug la yang byis sgrung dang srog chags kyi gtam rgyud/ kha mtshar/ lha sgrung sogs rigs mang po mchis/4 dang po/ chigs bcad kyi skor/1byishā ༵zlo /glu ni ha cang gsal ba dang tshig gi sbyor ba legs pa/ phun sum tshogs pa'i rtog bzo'i nus pa dang ldan pa'i byis pa'i rtsom rig gi rnam pa zhig yin/ de'i tshig rkang gi mang nyung mi 'dra zhing tshig rkang re re'i tsheg bar yang mi 'dra ba sna tshogs yod mod/ 'on kyang bklags tshe kha la bde zhing dbyangs su gler chog dper na/ byis pa gnyid 'gugs pa'i glu〈lo lo ma ngu gnyid la sdod〉ces pa 'di ltar/ ‘‘lo lo ma ngu gnyid la sdod/ / gnyid la sdod dang rta zhig ster/ / rta la sga zhig stod la ster/ / srab mda' dar gyis g.yogs la ster/ / lo lo ma ngu gnyid la sdod/ / bag ma yong na dung zhig ster/ / dung la dar zhig 'dogs la ster/ /— 107 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/lo lo ma ngu gnyid la sdod/ / gnam gyi bye'u 'dzin na ster/ / bye'u'i rnga ma gcod la ster/ /lo lo ma ngu gnyid la sdod/ / tshong pa yong na mdzo zhig ster/ / mdzo la khal zhig 'gel la ster/ /lo lo ma ngu gnyid la sdod/ / ra thong khra ril bsha' la ster/ / mkhal ma tshil gyis g.yogs la ster/ /lo lo ma ngu gnyid la sdod/ / gnam gyi skar ma 'dzin la ster/ / sa yi me tog 'thog la ster/ / lo lo ma ngu gnyid la sdod/ /lo los skyid cig rig rgyu red’’ces kha gsal zhing yid du 'ong ba'i tshig 'di dag dbyangs su gyer tshe/ ngu mtshams mi chad pa'i byis pa rnams kyang snyan zhing 'jebs pa'i dbyangs kyi 'gyur khugs dang bstun nas gnyid khugs par 'gyur/2 byis pa'i dmangs glu/byis pa rnams kyi lo na cher son pa dang bstun nas mthong rgya dang thos rgya yang rim bzhin je cher 'gro bzhin yod pas/ byis pa'i glu yis kho tsho'i bsam pa'i 'tsho ba mtshon mi thub pas/ dmangs glu la lad mo byas te byis pa'i sems khams dang mthun zhing / brjod don go sla la rna bar snyan pa'i glu tshig mang po byung /dper na/ ‘‘nga rta zhig yod no rte'u yin/ / nga'i rte'us rta rjes mi chod gi/mi chod na yang rgyug rgyu yin/ / nga mda' zhig yod no mda' phran yin/ / mda' phran mda' rjes mi chod gi/ mi chod na yang 'phen rgyu yin/ / nga glu zhig yod no byis glu yin/ /byis pa glu ba mi nyan gi/ mi nyan na yang len rgyu yin’’zhes dpe dang dpe can gnyis ka'i sgo nas bstan pa'i glu 'di'i tshig sbyor snyan la tshig 'bru'ang gsal bas/ byis pa tshos snyan mo ngag la bkug nas blangs tshe dbyangs can mas snyan 'jebs kyi pi wang sbrengs pa dang kun nas mtshungs/— 108 —

bod kyi byis pa'i rtsom rig gi rtsom lus skor gleng ba/glu tshig 'di'i nang rang nyid rte'u zhig gi dper bzhag nas spobs pa'i ngang rjes mi chod na yang rgyug rgyu yin zhes spobs pa cher bskyed kyi don gsal bor bstan pa gsal lo/ /3 khed/spyir bod kyi byis pa'i khed ni bod rigs kyi khed kyi grub cha zhig yin la/des byis pa'i blo sgo phye ste shes yon 'byor thub la byis pa'i 'dod mos dang mthun pa zhig kyang red/ spyir btang gi khed la gab bya dang gab byed gnyis 'dzoms dgos/ de yang gang brjod par 'dod pa'i don dngos dang rang byung khams kyi snang tshul/ bya 'gul/ dngos po la sogs pa ni gab bya dang /brjod bya'i don dngos rnams dper bkod de brjod pa ni gab byed yin/khed kyi khed gzhi dang khed lan gnyis mang nyung mi 'dra ste/dper na/ ‘‘bya min pa'i gshog pa can/ / stag min pa'i thig le can/ /'brong min pa'i rwa co can/ / dmag min pa'i mtshon cha can’’zhes pa'i khed lan ni‘‘sbrang ma’’yin/ da dung‘‘nyin dkar brgyag nas 'dug/ nub mo ltogs nas 'dug’’ces pa‘‘lham’’yin/ 'di dang 'di lta bu dngos yo da 'tsho ba'i rgyun shes mang po byis pa'i rig pa rno min tshod dpag byed thabs shin tu legs po zhig tu grub/gnyis pa/ chig lhug gi skor/1 lhasgrung /lha sgrung zer ba ni mi'i rigs kyi shes rig de da dung byis blo can du yod pa'i skabs su/ rang byung khams dang spyi tshogs snang tshul la shes rtogs byed mi — 109 ge

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/thub pa dang thon skyed kyi nus shugs shin tu zhan pas/ rang byung gi stobs shugs mdun du ci bya gtol med du gyur par brten/ rang byung khams kyi 'gyur sdog sna tshogs ni rang byung gi stobs shugs las lhag pa'i gsang ba zhig ste lha zhig gis kha lo bsgyur pazhin yod par sems la/ lha des mi'i rigs la bde skyid dang sdug bsngal gang ster yang rang dbang yod par 'dod pas/ lha la 'jigs shing de la skyabs bcol ba'i 'du shes shig dbang med du skyes te/de la mchod bstod dang skyabs 'jug zhus/ mi rnams kyi rang byung khams chen po'i gsang ba lkog gyur sna tshogs la ya mtshan zhing zhib rtog gi dga' ba ngang gis 'phel te skabs de'i shes rtogs kyi nus tshod kyis 'grel bshad byas nas/kho tsho'i yid kyi 'char snang gi shugs la brten nas rang byung stobs shugs sna tshogs sems ldan gyi dngos por rab btags byas pa dang gzugs brnyan can du bsgyur thog ngo mtshar ba'i sgrung dang gtam rgyud sna tshogs gsar skrun byas pa red/ de bas mtshar snang che ba'i lha sgrung lo na chung ba'i byis par mtshon na ha cang blta bar dga' zhing nyan par spro ba'i rtsom rig gi rnam pa zhig yin pas/ da lta'i bar du bod kyi byis pa tshos〈gling ge sar rgyal po'i 'khrungs rabs〉dang〈khyi ni ji ltar sgo phyugs su gyur pa red〉 da dung〈bya ngur ba'i brang kha ser po yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin〉zhes pa la sogs lha sgrung dang gtam rgyud mang po bshad kyin yod pa red/2 byis sgrung /byis sgrung ni bod dmangs khrod gtam rgyud kyi grub cha zhig yin la/ byis sgrung de mi rnams kyis 'phrul snang la brten nas bsgrigs pa zhig yin mod kyang /'phrul snang de la gzhi 'dzin sa spu tsam yang med pa zhig ma yin par dngos — 110 —

bod kyi byis pa'i rtsom rig gi rtsom lus skor gleng ba/yod kyi 'tsho ba rmang gzhi byas pa zhig yin zhing / de'i 'grel bshad rgyag stangs dang brjod lugs mi nyung ba zhig bltas tshod la ha cang dgod bro zhing snying bo med pa zhig tu snang yang / de yang rtog pa'i 'gyu ba kho na tsam ma yin par gzhi grub pa'i don dngos dang 'tsho ba'i snang tshul mtshon pa 'ig red/byis sgrung du shod pa'i 'phrul snang rang bzhin de lha sgrung dang mi 'dra ste/ lha sgrung gi mi sna gtso bo lha dang 'brel ba'i rdzu 'phrul can dang / byis sgrung gi skabs su mi'i sha tshugs can rnams mir 'brel zhing / phan gdags tshul bstan pa dang ngag rgyun khrod kyi mi sna dag las cung rang dbang du spras chog la sna 'dzoms shig kyang yin/ dper na/ 〈sprang po'i bus bdud btul ba〉zhes pa'i nang du/ byis pa dbul bo zhig gis dka' ba brgya phrag spyad de bdud kyis rlung 'tshub las drangs te brag phug tu khur ba'i rgyal po'i sras mo bskyabs shing mthar kho mo dang gnyen bsgrigs pa'i gtam rgyud lta bu dang / yang na〈rin po che 'tshol ba〉sogs dper 'os pa'i gtam rgyud mang po bod dmangs khrod du dar khyab chen po 'dug byis sgrung gi bsam blo'i nang don ha cang phun sum tshogs pa zhig yin la/ gtam rgyud kyi go rim kyag kyog che zhing ngo mtshar ba/ skad cha go sla zhing snyan 'jebs ldan pa zhig yin no/ /3 srog chags kyi gtam rgyud/srog chags kyi gtam rgyud ni bod kyi byis pa'i rtsom rig gi grub cha gtso bo zhig yin/ kor khi yis‘‘srog chags kyi gtam rgyud ni srog chags rang gi gtam rgyud min par mi'i gtam rgyud la srog chags kyi gzugs kyis spras pa yin’’zer/ de ni rtsom rig gi sgro 'dogs la brten nas mi'i rigs kyi bsam — 111 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/blo dang skad cha spyod stangs sogs srog chags kyi steng la sbyar nas brjod don gsal bor ston pa zhig yin la/ rtswa rtsi shing dang ri dwags sogs la mi'i kun slong dang bya ba'i khyad par rtog btags byas pa'i 'gul skyod kyi nyams la brten nas gzhung bzang dang yang dag par bstod bsngags dang / g.yo sgyu can sogs skyug bro ba'i bya spyod la zhe sdang ba'i tshul gsal bor mtshon pa yin/dperan/ 〈chang gi bzi ba'i mchil ba〉zhes pa'i gtam rgyud la mtshon na/thengs shig zhing pa'i 'bru rigs za bar goms pa'i mchil ba zhig gis g.yul khar gtor ba'i sbang ma zos pas/ de ma thag bzi nas lcang sdong zhig gi thog tu 'phur te chang skyon byas te cha ga pa bdas shing khu byug ded/ skya gar yang mchu tos brgyab nas bskrad par ma zad/ kha nas da dung mtshams mi chad par nga gnam la mi skrag sa la mi skrag bya rgyal khyung chen ma gtogs nga las ngar ba med ces dbyangs la gyer nas blangs/ don de khras mthong rjes khros pa'i ngang nas gshog pa brkyangs te sdong thog tu 'phur yong bas/ rlom sems skyes nas rang tshul brjed pa'i mchil bas glo bur du thon pa'i khra de mthong ma thag skrag nas tsher ma'i gseb la 'phur te/ khra la mtshams mi chad par khyed ni bya rgyal khyung chen las kyang che zhes bstod bsngags byed pa'i tshul de skya ka dang khu byug rnams kyis mthong bas/ mchil bar mthong chung gi ngang nas 'phya dmod byas pa lta bu'o/ / gtam rgyud 'di'i nang rang tshugs med pa'i mi'i bya spyod mchil ba'i steng du sbyar nas byis pa rnams la chung dus nas mi brtan po zhig byed byu dgos pa'i gnas lugs zab mo zhig bstan 'dug da dung〈bya rog dang 'ug pa'i gtam rgyud〉〈bya sprel gtam rgyud〉〈rdza tsig gtam rgyud〉sogs srog chags gtam rgyud kyi khyad chos yongs su ldan pa'i gtam rgyud mang po mchis/— 112 —

bod kyi byis pa'i rtsom rig gi rtsom lus skor gleng ba/ 4 kha mtshar/kha mtshar ni bod mi'i 'tsho ba'i khrod med du mi rung ba'i bsam pa'i 'tsho ba'i rgyags phye yin la/ bod kyi byis pa'i rtsom rig gi grub cha gtso bo zhig kyang yin/ gzhung rgyud drang ba'i bod kyi byis pa tsho lhan du 'dzoms dus dgod bro ba dang zur za'i bro ba ldan pa'i kha mtshar nyan rgyur spro zhing bshad rgyur yang spro ba che bas/ kho tshos kha mtshar bshad nas mchi ma yang rang dbang med par 'thor gyi 'dug yin yang kha mtshar gyi rtsom stangs 'dis mi rnams la dgod kha slong ba kho na ma yin te/ nyan mkhan tshos hab cha'i khrod nas go rtogs byung ste shugs su ston pa'i chags sdang yang shes thub/ dper na/ dmangs khrod du dar khyab che ba'i gtam rgyud〈glen pa rta las rtul〉las〈rta'i lham phud pa〉lta bur mtshon na/ nyin zhig glen pa rta las rtul bud shing 'thu ru 'gro khar/ phu bos chu khar thon tshe lham phud nas chu la brgal dgos zhes gdams/ de nas glen pa rta las rtul gyis rta khrid nas chu kha zhig tu thon pas sngon la rang nyid kyis lham phud rjes/ rta la phu bos bshad pa bzhin 'u gnyis kyi lham phud la 'gro zhes pa la/ rta rang gnas su grags 'gul ci yang med pa mthong bas phar song ste rta'i rmig par sta res brgyab nas rmig shun phud/ kha mtshar 'dis shugs su mi rnams la gnas lugs zab mo zhig bstan 'dug da dung〈a khu ston pa'i gtam rgyud〉sogs dgod gtam gyi bro ba ldan pa'i gtam rgyud mang po 'dug dper na/ 〈skyag pa gter ston〉te sngon rab byung pa zhig gis mi rnams rang la dad sems skye ched du dpe cha sna ring zhig sa 'og tu sbas te sang nangs mor ngas gter 'don nges zhes sa de'i mi rnams la bsgrags/ khos sa 'og tu gsang stabs kyis sbed skabs mi zhig gis mthong ste mi des dpe cha de blangs — 113 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/pa'i shul tu rtug dri zhig btang ste song /phyi nyin rab byung pa des mi tshogs kyi khrod du kha nas gsung 'byon khul dang lus kyi bzo lta gang mang bstan nas blangs dus lag par stug dri 'byar te yar 'phyar bas/ mi rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu‘‘skyag pa gter ston’’zhes zer/ dgod gtam 'dis mi ngan pa chos lugs par brdzus ste mi dmangs la mgo bskor gtong mkhan tshor zur za dang kha rdung drag po gtong bzhin yod pa red/

mi yi rin thang /da wa yon tan gyi〈srol rgyun dang deng rabs〉zhes pa bklags pa/zhi bde nyi ma/rig gzhung 'gran gleng gang mang byed rgyu de ni bod kyi spyi tshogs khyab khongs khrod bsam blo sna tshogs 'byung bar sgul shugs kyi rang bzhin ldan la/bod kyi shes yon can dag gis dmigs bsal gyi rang nyid cig dang rang gshis shig gi rin thang 'tsho gnas byed par ra sprod byed thub pa ma zad/srol rgyun rig gnas khrod 'gal 'dzing ci yang med par yid tshim pas ngang gnyid du yur zhing / de yi dge mtshan 'ba' zhig gis rang nyid bzi bar gyur cing 'thom par lus pa'i bod kyi‘‘shes yon can’’dag lo rgyus dang dus rabs kyis rgyang du bskyur zin pa'ang ra sprod byed thub/snang tshul de lta bu zhig gi 'og tu yon tan lags kyi〈srol rgyun dang deng rabs〉zhes pa'i dpyad rtsom de thon pa dngos yod gnas babs la shin tu 'tsham pa zhig red/ dpyad rtsom de las srol rgyun rig gnas kyis bod kyi spyi tshogs 'phel 'gyur gyi khrod du go gnas ga 'dra zhig bzung yod pa dang/ de yis nga tshor ci zhig gi pham kha khyer yong ba gsal bshad byas yod pa ma zad/deng rabs dpal yon gyis bod mi'i spyi tshogs kyi ma lag so so dang bsam blo'i khyab khongs nang dge mtshan dang 'pho 'gyur gsar pa ci zhig khyer yong ba — 115 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/rags bsdus kyis 'grel bshad dang dgag pa brgyab yod/ dpyad rtsom 'di dang 'brel te kho bos lta tshul re gnyis re gleng /khyod kyis‘‘dgag gzhag byas tshe sngar las mdzes par 'gyur/ dgag gzhag ni thabs lam legs po zhig red ’’ces brjod pa ltar bya dngos gang zhig dang snang tshul gang zhig yin na der dgag gzhag byed pa de de'i zhan cha ther 'don dang de'i dge mtshan la yi rang byed pa zhig yin la/ srol rgyun la dgag pa de 'phel rgyas kyi ched red/nga tsho'i bod kyi shes yon can dag la mtshon na kho tsho'i ches 'bur du thon pa'i mi gshis de ni gna' rabs mes po'i shul bzhag rig gnas la mtshang 'byin byed pa'i mig rgyang gsar pa med pa dang / srol rgyun gyi lta stangs dang yongs su 'gal thub pa'i phar rgol gyi spobs sems med pa/ rnying hral mkhregs 'dzin gyi khyab khongs dang ma lag dag gtor bshig byed pa'i nyen mchong gi chod sems med pa ma zad/ dngos gnas la mthong chen dang dngos gnas la bsgyur pakod/ rang nyid la mthong chen/ rang nyid kyi ches rtsa bar gyur pa'i nyams zhan nus med kyi grub cha dag rbad chod kyis gtsang sel byed pa'i blo'ang gtan nas med pa red/lo rgyus kyis nga tshor 'di ltar gsal 'don byas yod de/ nying bcud cig yin phyin ci ltar dgag kyang brlag thub pa'i nges pa med/ de las ldog ste rbad chod dang gting zab ngang srol rgyun dgag pa'i khrod du nying bcud ni de las kyang lta na sdug pa'i ngang gnas srid/ srol rgyun la dgag rgyu ni srol rgyun dang brgal dgos pa'i thabs lam nyag gcig dang/ snga 'phyi gang yin rung 'dor dgos pa'i dngos po rdzob hral dag yongs su dor dgos pa'i sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen red/— 116 —

mi yi rin thang /nub gling rgyal khab dag gi 'phel 'gyur gang zhig la mtshon na'ang srol rgyun la dgag pa dang srol rgyun dang gīs pa'i 'phel 'gyur zhig red/ dus rabs bar ma'i nub gling rig rtsal bskyar dar gyis 'dzam bu gling la dpal yon gsar pa'i skya rengs thog mar shar du bcugaya gling gi sngon thon rgyal khab 'jar pan la mtshon na'ang lo rgyus steng mchong skyod chen mo thengs gnyis byung myong ba dang / de lta bu'i 'pho 'gyur rlabs po che de yang phyi yi dpal yon nang 'dren byas pa las byung ba zhig red/rnying pa zhig nyams 'jig dang gsar pa zhig mnga' brnyes dgos tshe bsam blo'i steng gi rtogs sad ni ches rin thang ldan pa'i srog shing lta bu red/khyod kyis‘‘nga tshos nam yang kha phyogs gsar pa dang lta ba gsar pa zhig gisasrol rgyun la brtse ba med pas ngang dgag pa mu nas mu bar rgyag dgos/'di ltar byas tshe da gzod nga tshor dbugs kyi 'byin rngub kyi rang dbang bstsol thub’’zer ba ltar nga tshos mi su zhig yin na'ang rang nyid gces 'dzin dang /rang nyid 'phel rgyas/ rang nyid mngon 'gyur byed pa'i thog ma'i cha rkyen ni srol rgyun dang gyes dgos la rang byung la dbang bsgyur rgyu de yin la/ rang byung la dbang bsgyur ba'i thog ma'i cha rkyen ni spyi tshogs hril bo'i stobs shugs red/ spyi tshogs hril bo'i stobs shugs de'i 'byung rkyen ni mi sger las byung ba zhig yin/ nga tsho mi rang nyid(rang sger)kyis rang gshis 'ching ba las 'grol rgyu ni mi rigs sngon thon 'phel rgyas su 'gro ba'i sngon 'gro red/zhogs dung lags kyis‘‘skyabs su 'gro yul ji ltar mang na de ltar bran g.yog gi 'du shes che/ ji ltar bran g.yog gi 'du shes che na de ltar mi tshe 'dir sdug bsngal ba yin/ 'u tsho sus kyang bskyabs ma myong la sus kyang skyob mi srid’’ces bshad pa ji bzhin nga tsho'i 'tsho gnas la 'gal 'du med pa dang/— 117 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/tshor 'du med pa/ dgag rgol gyi 'du shes med pa/ tshe srog gi rang mdangs la 'khang ra med pa'i ngang tshogs pa zhig dang spyi tshogs shig la nam yang skyabs bcol te 'tsho ba ni srog chags(dud 'gro)nam yang rang byung khams chen mo dang bral thabs med pa dang de la skyabs bcol nas 'tsho gnas byed pa dang khyad mi 'dugang tsho'i srol rgyun rig gnas kyis dus dang rnam pa kun tu mi rang nyid gces 'dzin dang / rang nyid mngon 'gyur byed pa'i tshe srog gi snang tshul zhig la mi brtsi bar mi zer ba de nges par du gang dang su zhig gis mdzub ston bka' gsung dang / snying rje rdogs res kyi skyabs 'og tu 'tsho dgos pa'i kun spyod kyi yo byad cig la rtsis pa red/ 'di ltar rtogs sad med la rang gshis med pa/ 'gran rtsod med la 'khang ra med pa'i rig gnas shig gi khrod du mjug mthar rang nyams rang brlag tu 'gro nges red/nga tsho'i shes yon can dag gis nges par du rtogs dgos pa zhig la/gna' mi'i zhabs rjes 'ded cing / gna' rtsom gyis rang nyid ngom pa/gna' bo'i bsam blo zhig gis rang nyid la 'grel bshad byas te dus 'da' ba'i lo rgyus de bskyur 'os la/ bod kyi rig gnas lo rgyus ni phan tshun bskyar zlos kyi lo rgyus shig dang / bod kyi shes yon can gang mang zhig ni bskyar zlos kyi lo rgyus 'dir 'tsho bcud stsol mkhan 'ba' zhig yin pa rtogs dgos/ nga tsho'i rtsom rig sgyu rtsal khyab khongs la mtshon na'ang rgyun 'dzin byed pa las gsar gtod med pa dper na lha bzo mkhan dang 'dra bar/ gdod ma nas dar zhing rgyun 'byams su song ba'i lha chos kyi dpe ris 'dra sku dag la thad kar chad lhag nor 'gal med la zhib tshags ldan pas ngang lad zlos dang bshu 'bri byas pa lta bu yin la/ 'di lta bu'i tshe srog gi rabs rgyun dang 'gul skyod bhe 118 —

mi yi rin thang /kyi go rim las shes tshor myong tshor med pa dang 'gal 'dzing dang thod brgal med pa'i brtsams bya zhig la sgyu rtsal zer rgyu ha cang dka' la/ bsam blo dang gsar rtsom gyi rang gshis ci yang med pa'i lad 'bri'am bshu 'bri byed mkhan de la'ang sgyu rtsal pa dang bsam blo pa zer rgyu ni de las kyang dka'/ de ni ha cang zhib cha ldan pa'i lag bde ba zhig dang kho'i‘‘brtsams chos’’ni bskyar bzo byas pa'i thon rdzas shig red/dngos nas de 'dra red/ mjug mthar nis cha(khyalko )yis‘‘nga'i rjes su ma 'brangs shig khyod ni khyod rang nyid red’’ces pa'i skad cha des mjug bsdu bar bya/

skyo 'os la ngu bro ba'i rdog phres lci mo zhigad wa〈srin po g.yu rngog dang nyi ma lha sa〉bklags rjes/'phrin khyung /1 bkra bha'i sgrung gtam la thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos shig ldan pa ni bud med kyi brjod bya shas che ba de red/ dper na/ 1994lor par du bskrun pa'i sgrung thung deb chung〈sgrol ma nyer gcig〉lta bu yin la/ brjod bya de rang〈srin po g.yu rngog dang nyi ma lha sa〉ru'ang bsrings 'dug gsar rtsom skyed khungs steng nas dpyad na/ bkra bha la bod kyi bud med kyi gnad don las myong tshor khyad par ba zhig thob yod pa 'dra/ 〈srin po g.yu rngog dang nyi ma lha sa〉ru khos mi sna dang don bya je mang je cher btang nas/ gnad don 'di gting je zab tu gtong 'dang yod snyam/ dper na/ mi sna gtso bo a ye sgrol ma ni srin po g.yu rngog dang nyi ma lha sa bcas kyi bar mtshams su tho bzhin du bslangs shing / kho mor rig gnas(lorgyus)kyi rdog phres khur du bcug rdog phres 'di srol rgyun dang deng rabs bar gyi bsam blo'i rtsod res ma yin par/srol rgyun dang srol rgyun bar gyi klan ka tsam du zad/ rdog phres don med 'dis bod spyi tshogs kyi bsam blo dngos gzugs su bkod yod de/ nyi ma lha sa la mjal ched/ stong dpon nyi ma 'khor dang bcas pa srin po g.yu rngog gi sder mosdo ༵ga n+d+ras thar thabs bral song / de nas yang mi rabs shig nyi ma lha

skyo 'os la ngu bro ba'i rdog phres lci mo zhigasar 'gro ched dbus lam g.yung drung rang 'khyil la zhugs mod/ tshan rig gi rlangs 'khor la brten nas kho tsho skog jus kyi rnyi de las thar thub bam/ji 'dra'i skyo ba la ang / ji 'dra'i yi mug pa la ang / rig gnas kyi rgyud 'dzin mkhan mi rang yin la/ lo rgyus kyi rgyun skyong mkhan yang mi rang yin mod/ mi tshe 'di 'drar rig gnas zer ram/ 'di 'dra'i spyi tshogs la lo rgyus ldan nam/ 'di gtam rgyud kho na min par/ skyo 'os la ngu bro ba'i rdog phres lci mo sha stag cig go/bod spyi tshogs kyi bsam blo dus yun ring mo zhig la grib ma dang grib ma/rmi lam dang dngangs skrag bcas kyi srubs ka na 'phag pas/ ‘‘rkang lam phra mo’rinas lam sne rgya che zhing gsar pa zhig rnyed med par sngar gnas su bskyar skor rgyag bzhin gda'/ tho yor 'dra ba srin po g.yu rngog gi 'jigs pa las thar nas/ lha yul lta bu'i nyi ma lha sar 'byor ba'i dbang du btang rung / go rim 'di'i 'thab rtsod la spyi tshogs kyi don snying ba spu tsam yang med snyam/ de los yin/ bod mir 'jig rten gyi don dag thag gcod pa'i thabs dang spobs pa sogs zhan pas/ rang sems stong bsam gyis gso ba ni 'bangs spyi'i rang bzhin du chags/2 rtsom dpyad dang gsar rtsom ni spun zla nang bzhin gcig grogs gcig gis 'khyongs 'os/ rtsom dpyad kyi mtshan nyid phal cher gshag bcos spu gri lta bu'i rtsom rig dgag gzhag gi don la 'jug 〈sgrol ma nyer gcig〉nang gi brtsams chos yag shos ni〈mtshan mo de〉red bsams/ de ci yin zhe na/klog mkhan gyi yid dbang 'gug spyad cig ste/ gsang ba lkog gyur yin pas rkyen no/ / gsang lkog de〈srin po g.yu rngog dang nyi ma lha sa〉yi nang du/ nyi ma stong dpon sogs yul la jag tu song ba'i byung rim dang / de min mtha' — 121 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/mjug gi 'khrug rtsod dmar 'dzing bcas las rnam par mtshon yod pas/cung lji zhing ring ba'i don brjod nyid la skyabs bcol 'dug sgrung gtam(dmangs khrod gtam rgyud dang ltos bcas kyi)du don brjod kho nas mgo rnga ma skyong dka' ste/ phyi yul ljongs dang nang 'gyur pa bcas kyi zhib 'bri med pa'am dben na/ sgrung gtam gyi shong tshad chung bar 'gro ba ma zad/ klog mkhan gyi spro ba'ang ngang ngam shugs kyis nyams 'gro 〈srin po g.yu rngog dang nyi ma lha sa〉yi nang du/ a khu klu skyabs kyis rdo log cig gis 'phyi bar brgyab pas ma phog par rtug dri shor ba'i zhib cha des tag tag 'tsho ba dngos mtshon yod/ gson nyams ldan pa'i byung rim 'di lta bu ji tsam mang na de tsam gyis sgyu rtsal gyi nyams thon la/ de tsam gyis klog pa po'i spro ba bskyed par byed/bkra bha la sgrung gtam gyi las la gzhol gang thub kyi brtson sems chen po mchis pas/ nga tshos khor re gdung rnam dag bcol yod/

nga tsho'i rtsom rig gi mi 'dang sa gang na yod/ khyung thar rgyal/dus rabs nyi shu pa'i lo rabs brgyad cu pa nas bzung mes rgyal gyi sa gnas so so dang 'dra bar bod kyi rtsom rig la'ang gson shugs gsar pa rgyas byung / sgrung gtam dang / snyan ngag lhug rtsom/ dpyad mol sogs gang la bltas na'ang bod rang gi khyad chos ldan pa'i rtsom rig gi ma lag hril bo zhig grub yod pas ngo ma dga' 'os pa'i don bzang zhig yin pa smos ma dgos/yin na'ang / nga tsho'i gsar rtsom gyi khyab khongs su skyon cha med pa'ang gtan nas min te/ ngas bltas na nga tsho'i rtsom rig la mi 'dang sa da dung ha cang mang mod/ gtso bo phyogs gsum gyi thad la mnyam 'jog byed dgos snyam/dang po/ skad cha'i sgru rtsal gyi dka' ngal/rtsom rig ni skad cha'i sgyu rtsal kho nar gtogs pas skad cha ni rtsom rig gi grub cha dang po de yin/ skad cha'i zhun brdar dang skad cha'i bkol spyod ni rtsom yig gi legs nyes la thad kar 'brel ba yod de/ rtsom rig gis skad cha ma bshad na mi chog la/ bshad na'ang bshad shes dgos/ kor khi yis‘‘rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi man ngag ni thog mar skad cha la zhib 'jug byed rgyu de yin te/ skad cha ni brtsams chos mtha' dag dang khyad par du rtsom rig gi brtsams — 123 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/chos 'grub byed kyi rgyu cha yin pa'i phyir ro’’zhes gsungs pa ltar skad cha la zhib 'jug dang 'dor len byed rgyu ni rtsom pa po zhig gi ngos nas bshad na rtsom mkhan du 'gyur ba'i cha rkyen dang po de yin/ de yang skad cha la slob sbyong dang zhib 'jug byed rgyu de yig thog kho na min par rgya che'i mang tshogs kyi ngag thog na yod/ rgya che'i mang tshogs ni skad cha'i bang mdzod yin te/ mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis‘‘lhag par du rtsom dang snyan ngag phun sum tshogs pa zhig 'bri ba la rang gi lung ba'i skad de la gting nas goms 'dris mthil phyin pa zhig med na/ tshig don dang sgra don sbyor tshul snyan po dang zab po yong rgyu khag po red 'dug’’ces gsungs pa'ang mkhas pa chen po'i legs bshad de nga tshos mang tshogs kyi sa nas skad cha la slob sbyong dang zhib 'jug byed dgos par ma zad/ gsog 'jog dang 'dor len byed pa las rtsom rig gsar rtsom byed skabs dug sdom la‘‘g.yul kha rdung rdung’’dang spyang ki la‘‘a ma’’lta bu'i grong tshig nyi tshe ba rnams lag la ci yong ltar gtan nas 'bri mi 'os te/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni nga tsho'i rtsom rig gi zhabs 'degs zhu yul ni mi rigs hril bo zhig yin pa'i rkyen gyis red/ der ma zad/ nga tsho'i skad cha la nyung bsdus rang bzhin dang sgyu rtsal rang bzhin yang yod dgos te/ dper na/ ‘‘rma gzhung na rtswa chu 'dzoms’’zer dgos par‘‘rma gzhung na rtswa mang / chu mang’’lta bu'i bod skad kyi khyad chos dang mi mthun pa'i tshig tshogs rnams spangs te/ nges par du nying bsdus dang zhib tshags kyi lam du 'gro ci thub byed dgos/ der ma zad/skad cha'i sgyu rtsal rang bzhin la'ang do snang byed dgos te/ dper na/ ‘‘nga tsho mal du nyal nas cung ma 'gor bar ra lo'i shi rgan ngo tsha med pa zhig nga'i rum la slebs par ma zad brtsi bkur med pa'i sgo nas nga'i mchan khung nang la so zhig btab byung’’zhes pa lta bu'i rtsed mtshar gyi nyams dang ldan pa'i skad cha — 124 —

nga tsho'i rtsom rig gi mi 'dang sa gang na yod/ bkol spyod byas tshe da gzod nga tsho skad cha'i dka' ngal las thar bar ma zad/nga tsho'i rtsom rig gi skad cha de sngar las phun sum tshogs pa'i re ba yod/gnyis pa/ 'cho ba ngo ma mtshon med pa'i steng na yod/sku zhabs h+phun yus kru'u yis‘‘sgyu rtsal gyi dpe gzhi gang zhig yin yang gnam nas lhung ba zhig min par/ 'tsho ba'i sa zhing gshin po las skyes shing /'tsho ba'i rang gzugs nges can la gzhi bca' dgos pa red’’ces gsungs pa ltar/ rtsom rig ni spyi tshogs 'tsho ba las byung zhing / des slar yang spyi tshogs 'tsho bar zhabs 'degs zhu dgos pa'i cha nas nga tsho'i sgyu rtsal rtsom rig gang zhig yin yang ches thog ma'i blang bya ni spyi tshogs 'tsho bar kha 'bral mi rung ba de red/ de'i tshul la sku zhabs lu'u zhun gyis‘‘skyes thob kyi shes rab can rnams kyis sgro 'dogs ji 'dra byas kyang mthar gtugs na rtog bzo kho nas mi chog ste/ lha 'dre'i 'dra gzugs 'di yin de min gyi bden dpang byed sa med pas/ rta ljang mkha' spyod lta bu'i 'char snang ltar bris chog mod/ 'on kyang kho tshos bris pa'i spyan gsum can dang ske ring can dag kyang rgyun ldan gyi mi'i lus steng du spyan gcig bsnan pa dang ske je ring du btang ba tsam mo’’zhes gsungs pa ltar sgyu rtsal rtsom rig la sgro 'dogs ji 'dra zhig byas kyang de'i rmang gzhi ni spyi tshogs 'tsho ba dngos las byung zhing dngos yod kyi 'tsho ba zhig mngon par mtshon gang thub byas pa de yin/ yin na'ang mig snga'i nga tsho'i bod kyi rtsom stegs nas bltas na rang nyid kyi rtsom rig gis mi rigs rang gi dngos yod 'tsho ba mtshon pa mi 'dang ba'i snang tshul byung yod de/ dper na/ rtsom pa po skor zhig ni grong khyer gyi 'tsho ba dang slob gling gi brtse dung sogs la mgo 'khor te mi rigs rang gi dngos yod kyi khyad chos dang mthun pa'i spyi tshogs — 125 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/'tsho bar bar thag cung ring ba lta bu red/ nga tshos mang po bshad mi dgos te/19tshilo'i sbrang char deb gnyis pa'i steng gi〈ang bcu dgu pa〉dang19milo'i〈sbrang char〉deb bzhi pa'i steng gi〈skrag〉sogs kyis mtshon pa'i brtsams chos skor zhig la mi rigs rang gi mdzes dpyod kyi lta ba phar zhog bod kyi yongs khyab kyi 'tsho ba zhig kyang mtshon med do/ /de bzhin du brtsams chos kyi brjod bya yin na'ang 'dra/ rjod byed yin na'ang 'dra/ mi rigs rang gi 'tsho ba mtshon med pa'am yang na dngos yod 'tsho ba mtshon med pa'i gnas tshul yod de/dper na/ 1987lo'i〈sbrang char〉deb gsum pa'i steng gi sgrung thung〈grub thob rta nag can〉zhes pa'i nang du 'di ltar bris 'dug ste/ ‘‘‘skabs der don 'grub kyis rta pho rag ra'i yob cung bsgul bas bya 'phur ba ltar yul la slebs/khyim tshang gang bo'i gdong 'dzum gyi ler song nas don 'grub la bsu ba byas shing bu mo skyid los rta kha bzung ba dang mnyam du sems la smra mi shes pa'i spro ba skyes te’6dka' las e myangs thal’ ‘ma myangs thal/ ma myangs thal’ zhi lu bde legs kyis byis pa rum nas blangs te don 'grub la byin tshe des rum du bcug te 'o byed bzhin 'dug‘ha ha ha/ khyod pha bu gnyis do dgong rta thog tu nyal rgyu yin nam’ de ni dar rgyas kyi skad red’’lta bu'i don dngos dang mi mthun pa zhig bris 'dugatshang mas shes gsal ltar/ don 'grub kyis rta zhon nas yul la thon tshe/nges par du rta thog nas 'bab dgos mod/ ma babs par zhi lu bde legs kyi rum nas byis pa blangs te rang gi rum la bcug rjes rta thog nas 'bab rgyu yin pa sogs ni dngos yod 'tsho ba las ring du gol ba'o/ /— 126 —

nga tsho'i rtsom rig gi mi 'dang sa gang na yod/gsum pa/ mi rigs la 'gan khur med pa'i steng na yod/nga tsho'i rtsom rig la da dung gnad don zhig yod pa ni rang gi mi rigs la 'gan khur med pa de red/ bod yig gis thad kar bris pa'i rtsom yig tshang mas mi rigs la 'gan khur dgos zhes bshad pa min mod/ 'on kyang tshang mas 'gan ma khur na de ni nga tsho log lam du phyin pa'i snang tshul las ma 'das/rtsom rig gi mi rigs 'gan khur de gtso bo mi rigs rig gnas kyi gnad don bshad pa dang yang dag pa'i phyogs su khrid ston byed pa'i steng na yod/ rtsom rig ni spyi tshogs 'tsho ba las byung zhing des slar yang spyi tshogs 'tsho bar zhabs 'degs zhu dgos pa'i cha nas rtsom rig gi mi rigs 'gan khur yang gsal bor bstan pa red/ de bas rang gi rtsom rig gis rang gi mi rigs la 'gan khur min de ni mi rigs rang gi ma 'ongs pa'i las skal la sems khur byed min la thug yod pas/ mi rigs la sha tsha ba'i rtsom pa po zhig yin na thog mar gnad don 'dir bsam blo gtong dgos te/ sku zhabs lu'u zhun gyis kyang dang thog gso rig gis mi rigs skyob 'dod mod/ mjug mthar bsam blor 'gyur ldog byung ste/ thad kar du rtsom rig la 'jus pa la'ang rgyu mtshan zhig med pa sa/tan nas min te/ khong gis rtsom rig kho nas da gzod thag gcod byed thub pa'i mi rigs kyi 'gan khur rang bzhin shes rtogs byung bas yin/ mi rigs shig nyams rgud du gyur nas‘‘ngu’’ba'i dus su/mi rigs de'i rtsom rig gis da dung 'gyur khugs lhang lhang gi spro glu blangs te bsdad na ji 'dra zhig yin/ sngon chad snyan pa'i grags pa 'bar ba'i man ju'i skad yig gi nyams rgud nge/ rang gi mi rigs kyis rang gi rig gnas dang sgyu — 127 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/rtsal yal bar dor bas lan pa yin la/ da lta nga tsho'i mig sngar yang rang gi mi rigs kyis rang gi rig gnas slob gsor do snang mi byed pa dang / rang gi rtsom rig dang sgyu rtsal gyis mi rigs rang gi 'gan 'khri dang len mi byed pa'i snang tshul zhig mngon 'dug gnad don 'di ni gzhan zhig ma yin par mi rigs rang la rag las shing / lhag par du mi rigs 'di'i rtsom pa po rnams la thad kar 'brel ba yod de/ kho tsho'i brtsams chos kyis mi rigs kyi 'gan khur de dang len ma byas pa'am/ yang na dang len byas pa ma 'dang ba red/de'i rgyu mtshan gyis nga tsho'i 'tsho ba dang rtsom rig la bar thag byung ba dang / nga tsho'i rtsom rig la ches spyir btang gi snang brnyan tsam las mi rigs kyi gnad don gsed bkrol dang 'phel rgyas la skul 'ded byed pa'i phyogs ston gyi nus pa zhig dang sgul shugs shig med song ba red/ deng phyin nga tsho'i rtsom rig de tshad ji 'dra zhig gi steng nas mngon rgyu ni kho bos gong du smras pa'i gnad don 'di dag gi steng na yod par 'dod pas shes nas smra ba'i blo ldan dag gis dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang rgyu mkhyen/— 128 —

snyan ngag thad kyi bsam gzhigatshe grub/ snyan ngag la dpyad pa brjod pa ni las sla mo zhig min te/ lhag par du deng skabs shig la go dka' ba snyan ngag gi khyad chos nyid du sgom pas/ snyan ngag mang po zhig la bsam gzhig ga 'dra byas kyang brjod don nyid ci yin mi shes par ma zad/ rjod byed tshig gi cha nas kyang bod rang skad kyi brda sprod dang mi mthun pa dang rtsom mkhan rang rang gis gang 'dod du bsgyur pa'i tha snyad gsar bas bod rang chos dben pa'i gnas su bskyal yod la/ snyan ngag de lta bu la mi dmangs la zhabs 'degs zhu dgos zhes rtsom pa po zhig la mtshon na ma mtha'i 'os 'gan du gyur pa'i bsam blo med par ma zad/ bod rang gi skad brda spus gtsang du bkol ba la'ang gtor brlag tshabs chen bzos 'dug lhag par du slob grwa che 'bring chung gsum gang yin rung tshang mas tha snyad 'ga' rdo chag btsan sgrig sgos snyan ngag tu rlom pa'i ngan shan thebs 'dug de dag la don dngos su 'phrin yig kha gsal don 'dus shig 'bri ba'i nus pa'ang med/ des las dang po ba zhig la mtshon na gol lam du ngan khrid byas pa ma zad/ ma 'ongs pa'i bod kyi rtsom rig dang lhag par du mi rigs kyi rig gnas/ tha na mdun lam la'ang god chag tshabs chen thebs nges — 129 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/spyir rtsom rig la mtshon na rtsom pa po rang gi myong snang dang phugs bsam sogs sgyu rtsal gyi thabs rtsal la brten nas klog pa po dang spyi tshogs yongs la yar skul dang 'tsho bar re snyeg gi brtson sems skyed pa dang lhan spro bsang dang mdzes pa'i myong snang sbyin dgos pa de'i rtsa ba'i khyad chos su mngon/ der brten rtsom rig gi tog ltar gyur pa'i snyan ngag la lhag par du nus pa de thon dgos par ma zad rtsom rig yongs kyi lam sna 'khrid pa'i nus pa'ang ldan dgos/ mi rig shig la mtshon na rtsom rig ni mi rigs de'i rig gnas kyi sngon 'gro yin pas rig gnas kyi dar rgud kyang rtsom rig gi chu tshad las 'jal thub/ rig pa'i gzhung lugs gang dang gang yin rung rtsom rig gis sgyu rtsal du tshogs grub byas pa brgyud de dpe 'jog can dang snang brnyan rang bzhin las ston thub la/ lta ba'am bsam blo'ang skad cha'i sgyu rtsal gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i mdzes pa'i myong snang khrod klog pa por sbyin thub pa ma zad der shan shugs kyang zab mo re thebs thub/ 〈thog khang dmar po'i rmi lam〉gcig pu'i nang du bzo gso nang don/ rol mo tha na zas kyi g.yos sbyor sogs rig pa'i gnas mang po zhig 'dus yod la/ der brten rtsom rig pa zhig yin na bsam blo pa zhig kyang yin nges zhes pa'ang rgyu mtshan de la thug yod/ 'dzam gling grags can rtsom rig brtsams chos mtha' dag lus gang gi lam nas spel yod cing / mi rabs nas mi rabs brgyud de klog pa po grangs las 'das par zad med kyi zil shugs dang 'gran med kyi bslu brid kyis yid sems gsos shing / mi dang khyim tshang / rgyal khab dang bsam blo'i kun spyod/ mi re re'i phugs bsam dang 'tshol snyeg sogs gang ci'i thad du'ang nus pa bton yod pa ma zad/ mi rigs shig gi bla srog gi gnas gzhi nyid du gyur pa'i nus pa'ang thon yod/ 'di ni da gzod rtsom rig gi tshe srog yin/ 'di ni rtsom — 130 —

snyan ngag thad kyi bsam gzhigamakhan zhig la mtshon na ches bla na med pa'i rin thang gi dan rtags shig kyang yin/deng rabs bod kyi rtsom rig la mtshon na nya nyung mnyam bsres kyi rnam pas khengs shing/ rgya bod yig rigs gnyis kar sbyangs pa dag la rig gnas sna mang gi shan shugs thebs pas sems khams kyi sgrig gzhi dang lta tshul/ spyod stangs sogs kyang gzhi gcig tu gnas med stabs bris pa'ang rnam pa dang lag thabs/ brjod don dang gshis nyams sogs gang ci'i thad du sngon thon dang log lam ste phyogs gnyis su gzhol che/ gzhan gyi legs cha sdud len byed pa bod mi'i rang gshis su mngon yang/ mtha' gcig tu lag gang thob zas su sgom na mtshang du che/ bya dngos gang yin rung tshad cig yod pas de las brgal na sdug 'bras 'byung ba ches spyir btang gi chos nyid cig yin/ snyan ngag par rlom pa kha shas kyi rang chos bskyur te mtha' gcig tu gzhan lugs kho nar snyeg bzhin se'u bcu ba'i ngag bzhin ci zhig brjod pa mi shes pa'i tshig tshogs shig la snyan ngag gi 'tshol snyeg tu sgom pa ni shin tu phangs pa'i gzhi ru gyur/ deng srol rgyun la dgag pa/ brda sprod kyi gtan tshigs la dgag pa/dgag pa sna mang zhig sgrog zhor rang nyid‘‘snyan ngag gsar pa'i’’srol gtod mkhan por rlom yang / de dag don dngos su gzhan lugs rang chos su g.yag sna khu tshur gyi dpe bzhin lad zlos tsam las ma 'das/ spyir rtsom rig ni spyi tshogs kyi lad zlos su mngon che yang gzhan gyi brjod bya dang rnam pa sogs ji bzhin du lad zlos byed pa ni ma byin len pa'i las su zad pa las 'tshol snyeg gam gsar gtod kyi cho lo re e 'bab la bsam gzhig gyis/ las dang po ba zhig la mtshon na lad zlos ni rtsom rig tu zhugs pa'i sngon 'gro lta bu yin yang/thog mar lad zlos byed yul de la go rtogs zab mo zhig byed pa ni ma mtha'i cha — 131 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/rkyen yin/ de tsam yang mi byed par phyi skogs tsam la lad zlos byed pa ni dmus long gzugs la brtag pa'i dpe ru 'gro ba bzhin/ deng snyan ngag tshig rkang bcu bzhi ma zhes/ de'i 'bri thabs dang cha rkyen ci zhig tshang dgos pa'i dgongs don ci yin spu tsam yang ma rtogs par phyi'i rnam pa tsam la lad zlos thabs rdug cig byed bzhin yod pa dang / pho mo'i brtse dung brjod pa'i snyan rtsom phyogs la skya ser gnyis ka shwa 'od bzhin 'tshang kha rgyag pa lta bu yin/ pho mo bar gyi brtse dung de dus gtan du gnas pa'i rtsom rig gi brjod bya yin yang/ brjod stangs/ sgrig gzhi/ rnam pa sogs gang ci'i thad nas phan tshun mtshungs drags na glu brgya ngag gcig gi skyon 'byung ngo / /srol rgyun la dgag pa zhes pa'ang srol rgyun nyid kyi ngo ngo'am rang bzhin ci yin gyi cha tsam yang ma rtogs par smyon pas dpa' gtam sgrog pa kho nar zad 'dug spyir srol rgyun zhes pa ni yun ring gi lo rgyus khrod brgyud de grub cing/ khyad chos nges can ldan pa'i bsam blo dang rig gnas/ kun spyod/yul srol/ lam lugs/ sgyu rtsal/ dad mos/ sems khams sogs la zer ba las spyi tshogs kyi phyi'i rnam pa tsam dang bya ba'i spyod stangs tsam la zer ba gtan nas min mod/ 'on kyang srol rgyun nyid lo rgyus kyi dus rim khrod bsag cing grub pas der snyigs 'dor bcud len byed pa dang / 'dzam gling mi rigs so so'i legs pa'i cha rnams sdud len byas te phun sum tshogs par gtong ba ni nged cag yongs kyi 'os 'gan du gda' yang / bus pa dang de'i bkrus byed kyi chu gnyis dgos med du mnyam 'pho byed pa ni mtshang du che yang rnying zhen dang bag 'khum par sdod pa'ang rgud pa'i rgyu ru cis mi 'gro/ mi rang nyid dang yang na mi rigs shig la mtshon na gsar gtod kyi spobs pa dang bral na rang nyid bkums pa'i gzhi ru grub pas/ gsar rnying gnyis zung — 132 —

snyan ngag thad kyi bsam gzhiga'ajug sgos rim bzhin phan tshun rgyud mthun byed pa ni byed thabs yang dag cig yin snyam/ bsam blo'i rigs gang yin rung de 'phel 'gyur ni bsam blo de nyid las gal 'gangs che ste/ bod brgyud nang bstan zhes rgya gar nas brgyud cing lo rgyus kyi 'phel rim khrod bod rang chos dang ldan pa'i bsam blo'i ma lag thun mong ma yin pa zhig grub pa des kyang bden dpang legs po bya thub/ snyan ngag gam rtsom rig gang la mtshon na'ang thog mar mi rigs rang gi skad brda spus gtsang du bkol te lag thabs sna mang sdud len sgos dmangs yongs kyi 'tsho ba don yod bya phyir dang kun gyi yid sems su bag tu nyal ba'i phugs bsam gyi rgyal khams su spobs pa chen po'i ngang 'jug par skul lcag gi shan stobs thon dgos/ deng spyi tshogs steng snyan ngag la dung ba lhod pa spyi tshogs kyi rkyen sna tshogs ldan mod/ gtso bo dmangs sems kyi re 'dun de ji bzhin phyir mtshon ma thub pas lan pa yin/ snyan ngag par mtshon na snyan ngag gi lam nas rang nyid kyi 'jig rten bskrun pa ni rang gi khe dbang yin mod/'on kyang der nges par du mi rigs kyi khyad chos ldan dgos/ khyad chos de yang phyi rnam pa'i cha lugs tsam ma yin par mi rigs de'i snying stobs kyi nying bcud de sgyu rtsal gyi lam nas myong thub pa zhig yin dgos/ 'jar pan gyi rtsom rig pa khron ton khang khrin()//oṃ.oṃtsho)gyi brtsams chos las rigs rgyud de'i rnam shes kyi rang gzugs dang 'dzad med kyi snying stobs myangs thub ces pa bzhin/ lo rgyus kyi 'os 'gan ldan pa'i snyan ngag pa zhig la mtshon na mig rgyang de rang nyid kyi bde sdug las brgal te mi'i rigs kyi dngos yod dang skyo gdung la phyogs na 'os so/ /

myong chor rigs shig gi gsed 'grol/da wamig snga'i bod yig sgrung gtam gsar rtsom skor gleng ba/tshe grub/bod kyi sgrung gtam gsar rtsom de don dam du kha phyogs gang la gtod dgos zhe na sus kyang mi kun gyi blor 'bab pa'i lan zhig ldon dka' bar nges/nga tshos dus rgyun bod kyi sgrung gtam gyi zhan cha gleng skabs gtam rgyud kyi rang bzhin che zhes tha nyad rgas 'khogs de las gnad don rang thad kyi 'gag rtsa bstan pa zhig mthong dka' bar 'dug rtsom rig gi grub mtha' gang yin yang re rer dge skyon gyi cha ci rigs mchis shing / nga tshos mtha' gcig tu‘gsar gtod mtha' dag dang len ci thub byed pa zhig sngon thon du sgom zhing rgyug che 'bri thabs te dngos srid ring lugs sogs la rjes lus yin par snyam pa'i lta stangs 'dzin pa'ang phyogs lhung zhig min mi srid/ deng gi skabs 'dir bod kyi sgrung gtam la gtam rgyud kyi shan che ba dang brjod bya rgas 'khogs yin par 'dod pa ni 'bri mkhan dang klog mkhan gnyis ka'i cha nas ma gros gcig mthun du gnad gcig la khel yod kyang / gnad don de rigs thag gcod byed pa ni da dung 'byung 'gyur gyi mthun rkyen ga ge mor bsgug dgos par snyam/—giṭ+wāṃ 4sgrung gtam zhig yin phyin gtam rgyud kyi cha nges par du ldan dgos

myong tshor rigs shig gi gsed 'grol/zhes bshad mi thub mod/ myong rol pa'i lta 'dun slong byed dang blo sna 'dren pa la gtam rgyud kyi cha de yang nges par du ldan dgos snyam/ 〈lo brgya'i kher hreng〉lta bur mtshon na'ang sgrung ring de'i byung rim zhib brjod dang sems khams zhib 'bri/ khor yug cig las grub pa'i rigs rgyud cig gi 'jig rten lta tshul/ sgrig gzhi sogs gang ci'i thad nas skabs thog de'i 'dzam gling rtsom rig yongs la mtshon na'ang ches sngon thon pa dang / ‘‘gtam rgyud’’kyi rgya las thod rgal byung yod pa sha stag yin yang / spyir btang gi klog mkhan zhig la mtshon na der lta 'dun slong byed kyi thog ma'i rgyu rkyen ni de'i khrod kyi‘‘gtam rgyud’’kyi cha de yin/ bod rigs sgrung gtam pa a le la gsar 'god pas bcar 'dri byed skabs/ gsar 'god pas dris don/ khyed kyi〈sa rdul zhom 'jags〉zhes pa'i khrod kyi byung rim mam gtam rgyud kyi cha de mang shos kyis sgrung gtam gyi brjod byar ram 'degs kyi nus pa ci yang thon med mod/ 'on kyang khyed kyis sems shugs mang po bkol te 'bri don ci yin zhes par/ khos de ltar byed don ni/ gcig na sgyu rtsal brtsams chos gang yang mi sems 'gug byed dam sems ngal gso byed/ yang na spro ba slong byed sogs rol rtsed kyi nus pa ldan dgos/ de ni myong rol pas sgyu rtsal de'i yang snying lon byed kyi thog ma'i sta gon nam myong 'dun slong byed kyi rgyu ru gyur phyir/ ngas kyang‘‘gtam rgyud’’kyi cha de dag bkol te mi sems 'gug bsams pa yin/ klo ga mkhan gyi klog 'dun gyi spro ba ma bslang na rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gang yin yang de'i rin thang 'jal thabs bral ba yin/ gnyis na sgrung gtam khrod kyi spros brjod(ma7)ni sgrung gtam sgyu rtsal de mngon 'gyur byed pa la med du mi rung ba'i grub cha gal chen zhig yin/ nga tshos grub mtha' gang gi lugs su sgrung gtam ci lta bu zhig bris kyang‘‘don rkyen’’zhig gi byung ba la nges par du sbrel dgos — 135 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/phyir/ byung brjod der gtam rgyud kyi cha til 'bru tsam yang 'dres su mi 'jug ces bshad thabs e yod ces phyir dri ba de lta bu zhig bton byung / ngas‘zhung’’'di ltar drangs pa'i dmigs yul ni sgrung gtam dang gtam rgyud gnyis gzhi gcig tu bsgrub 'dod pa dang / gtam rgyud sgrung gtam du rlom mkhan dag gi dpung rogs su bud pa'ang gtan nas min mod/ spyir deng gi nga tsho'i sgrung gtam gsar rtsom la mtshon na 'thus tshub kyi dpe gzhi zhig 'dzin rgyu dang srol rgyun zhig gi rgyun skyong yul med phyir/ deng rabs sgrung gtam zhes pa de'ang‘‘nang 'dren’’gyis sne drangs pa bsnyon du med/ gnas bab de lta bu'i 'og bod kyi sgrung gtam 'di'i thog ma'i rkang 'dzugs sa phyi tshul las gzhan rigs kyi grub 'bras su rkang stegs 'cha' khul byas yod kyang / goms pa'i dbang gis dmangs khrod kyi gtam rgyud brjod pa'i srol de thog ma'i sgrung gtam gyi spros brjod khrod gzhi rkang du mngon zhing sgrung gtam gyi byung rim zhig tu 'khrul cing nor ba de gsar rtsom gyi gom kha dang bstun nas rgyun 'byams su gyur te rim bzhin bod kyi sgrung gtam gyi‘‘srol’’zhig grub pa dang / lo ngo nyi shu lhag gi gsar rtsom gyi go rim khrod de ni ngan gshis su sus kyang rtogs mod gshis su grub pa mtha' dag la rengs po'i cha de ldan phyir da dung 'dor thabs ma byung / nye ba'i lo 'ga'i ring gi sgrung gtam la bltas na'ang mang mang zhig la spros brjod khrod gshis ngan de ldan par ma zad/ brjod bya'i thad nas kyang byung 'das ci rigs brjod par mos pa'i gtam rgyud kyi brjod bya mngon yod pa'ang mthong thub/ der brten rig gnas goms gshis ni phyogs gzhan zhig nas mi rigs shig la mtshon na blo sna gcun byed kyi btsan rdzong lta bu yin/lhag don rig gnas des mi gshis spyi 'gros can du sgyur skabs/ goms gshis de ni skabs thog de'i spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas dang phog thug byung ba'i dus — 136 —

myong tshor rigs shig gi gsed 'grol/yin/ der brten nga tsho'i sgrung gtam dang rtsom rig gsar rtsom gang la'ang rig gnas goms gshis de las grub pa'i sems khams kyi dbang gis brtsams chos khrod mngon pa'i mi sna'i dper mtshon rang bzhin gcig tu 'khums pas brjod bya bskyar bzlos dang brjod stangs dpe 'gre can gyi snang tshul de lta bu byung ba yin/ rkyen de'i dbang gis sgrung gtam gang mang zhig la‘‘thun mong gi khyad chos’’de 'dor yun ring ba'ang rgyu mtshan de la thug yod par snyam/ 'o na bod kyi sgrung gtam gsar rtsom de da dung 'phel rgyas til tsam yang med par gtam rgyud kyi gnas na‘‘byis pa’’skor zhig la mgo skor bzhin bsdad yod dam zhe na/ de yang min de nga tshos gtam rgyud de sgrung gtam gyi rnam par bsgyur pa'ang gsar gtod cig dang mdun skyod cig tu cis mi sems/ lhag don rang grol lags kyi〈mi rtag sgyu ma'i rmi lam〉du nga tshos deng rabs kyi khyad gshis ldan pa'i sgrung gtam gyi rang gzugs mthong thub la/ nye ba'i lo 'gar byung ba'i sgrung gtam 'gas 'phel rgyas de rigs la dpang rtags bzhag dang 'jog bzhin yod/yid ches de rigs rang sgra'i〈byi la'i gtam rgyud〉dang bkra bha'i〈'tshub ma kher rkyang〉 pad ma tshe brtan gyi〈gangs〉 rig ldan rgya mtsho'i〈mig gsum pa〉chos skyong gi〈2031lo'i gtam rgyud〉 sogs las rnyed thub/ de dag las mngon pa ni bod kyi sgrung gtam de yang byung rim rkyang rkyang la brten pa'i rgya de lal brgal te mi gshis kyi zur nas sems khams 'ba' zhig gi rang bzhin 'tshol ba'i gnas der bskyod pas/ nga tshos mthong ba'am spyi 'gros rang bzhin gyi dper mtshon mi sna'am 'ud kyi cha mang ba'i mgon skyabs sam dpa' bo'i rigs shig gi ched brjod min par/ rang gshis can gyi bsam blo las mngon pa'i spyi tshogs kyi ngos zin dang / ngos zin de las thon pa'i tshe srog gi — 137 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/ lta stangs shig yin/ de dag la rang gi brtsams chos des mi'i blor bkod 'doms dang 'tsho dngos kyi gnad don thag gcod byed par 'dod pa'i ham pa med par ma zad/ 'tsho ba'i phyi tshul tsam gyi spros brjod la brten nas dus rabs kyi me long du brdzu 'dun yang med pa yin/ spyir deng gi spyi tshogs kyi sgrig gzhi thad nas bsam blo btang na'ang / rtsom rig ni rig gnas kyi sngon skyod pa'i go sa nas mar babs te‘‘dgun nyal’’gyi dus la gtug pa'i nyen kha dang / de'i tshab tu spyi tshogs gnas bab dang 'tsho ba'i dbang gis dpal 'byor rig pa'am khrims lugs/ rang rang 'tsho thabs kyi lag rtsal sogs rig gzhung ci rigs dang / glog brnyan/ brnyan 'phrin zlos gar sogs kyis tshab byed la rem pa'i dus skabs 'dir/ nga tshos btsan gyis rtsom rig de‘‘rmongs gnyid’’sangs byed du bsko ba ni ji 'dra'i blo la 'khor dka' ba zhig red ang /pad ma tshe brtan gyi〈gangs〉lta bur mtshon na/ spyir btang gi byung rim brjod pa las 'das te rang gi bsam blor 'khor ba'i phugs bsam gyi mi gshis te‘‘gangs’riganyis las mngon du bcug nas/ de gnyis kyi kun spyod dang rang bab kyi khor yug gnyis kyi go sdur khrod/ brtsams chos las mngon pa ni rig gnas kyi phyi shun phud pa'i mi gshis kyi rang gzugs yin/ tshe srog gi rgyun bsrings 'dod kyi 'dun pa ni mi'i rigs la mtshon na sus kyang 'gog thabs med pa'i‘‘'dod ham’’yin/ rtsom mkhan gyis mthong sne der brten nas rig gnas shig gi rang gshis mtshon byed de‘‘gangs’’nyid rig gnas des shan shugs thebs pa'am lag len gyi gnas gzhir mchis pa'i dmangs khrod khyi khor yug na mngon pa'i 'gul skyod skyi rnam pa'i khrod/ mi'i rin thang lta tshul gyi 'phel 'gyur dang rig gnas goms gshis bar gyi 'gal ba de cung — 138 —

myong tshor rigs shig gi gsed 'grol/gting zab mor mngon pas/ nga tshos gtam rgyud kyi bar gseb cig las don med kyi snyigs ro 'tshol ba'i ngal ba ba mi dgos par ma zad mi gshis kyi rang bzhin de rang steng du tshor rtog 'byung thub pa'i mdzes dpyod kyi nus pa 'byin thub/ ‘‘rnam pa ni nang don no’’zhes phyogs lhung gi lta tshul 'dis nga tshor gnad don rigs shig gsed 'grel byas pa ni sgrung gtam〈gangs〉las mngon pa'i mdzes dpyod kyi rin thang de brjod stangs sam rnam pa des tshod 'dzin thebs yod pa dang / sgrung gtam byung rim gyi rtogs 'phrul khrod dngos yod las 'das pa'i dngos yod kyi 'tsho ba de myong thub pa yin/ der brten sgrung gtam de las mngon pa ni spros brjod thad kyi 'phel 'gyur zhig yin par ma zad/ bod kyi sgrung gtam gsar rtsom thad du'ang thun mong ma yin pa'i blo bkod ldan pa'i khyad gshis mngon yod pa yin/ nga tshos dus yun ring bo zhig la byung rim sna gcig can gyi sgrung gtam klog par goms gshis su gyur pas mdzes dpyod de'ang spyi 'gros 'ba' zhig gi rgya nu tshud yod phyir/ brjod stangs sam rtsom thabs de lta bur de ma du goms dka' bas zol rdzus sam lha sgrung ya ma brla zhig bklags pa lta bu'i nyams snang ster yang / spyir sgyu rtsal gyi bden pa de ni rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gsar rtsom gyi rtsa don du 'khums kyang / sgrung gtam lta bur mtshon na bden pa de ni 'tsho ba'i nyams myong las byung ba'i rtog bzo rigs shig la brten nas mngon 'gyur byas pa yin/ de ni rtsom mkhan gyi mdzes dpyod myong snang las 'phros shing rang tshor du mngon pa'i bden byams mdzes gsum de dkyus gcig tu 'dril ba'i bden pa yin/ de mthar gtugs na lo rgyus mtshan nyid rig pa'i ngos su lo rgyus kyi bden par gtogs shing / don dam du de ni 'tsho ba'i bden pa mdun du bskyod pa zhig gam thod rgal rigs shig yin/ sgyu rtsal gyi blos bslangs de gal te sgyu rtsal gyi bden pa — 139 —
