mu tig gling gi dga' ston/dmigs gzhir ma gtad par rtsa don de'i ngo bor 'gyur du bcug na/brtsams chos la zhan cha chen po 'byung ba'ang chos nyid yin/ 〈gangs〉lta bur mtshon na dngos yod kyi phyi tshul las brgal ba'i dngos yod kyi rang bzhin 'tshol snyeg byed pa yin phyin/ 'tsho ba dngos kyi gtan tshigs dang 'gal ba ltar snang yang rtsa ba'i 'tsho bar brten yod phyir bden pa'i ngo bo 'gyur med/deng skabs 'dir spyi tshogs sgrig gzhi thad kyi 'phel 'gyur dang mi tsher bzung ba'i rin thang lta ba/ mdzes dakhyod kyi goms gshis sogs bsam bya'i rigs kun la phyogs yongs nas sngon srol dang 'gran bslangs pas/ sgrung gtam myong rol gyi goms gshis de'ang dngos yod kyi byung brjod rkyang rkyang las 'gongs te mi'i gnas bab kyi khor yug dang bstun te/ 'gal 'brel sna tshogs kyi rang bzhin ci rigs mthar gtugs na mi gshis kyi ngo bo 'tshol ba'i gnas der phyogs pas/ nga tshos sngar goms dang bsdongs pa'i sgrung gtam rtsom lugs der klog gang mang zhig gis 'dod mos btang ba'ang rgyu mtshan phyogs gcig yin nges/ der brten nga tsho'i sgrung gtam gyi gnas bab la mtshon na 'gro ba mi'i mdzes dpyod kyi 'phel 'gyur dang / deng gi gsar rtsom de sngar srol las mi rgal rang brgal du gyur cing / 〈gangs〉sogs tshod lta'i rang bzhin gyi brtsams chos de rigs byung ba'ang chos nyid cig yin/ dper na bkra bha dang rang sgra sogs kyis rang rang gi gshis su grub pa'i rtsom srol las gom gang mdun spel du tshod lta'i sgyu rtsal gyi gras su zhugs pa'ang rkyen de dag la rag las nges/ spyir rtsom stangs de rigs rgya mi rigs la mtshon na sngon thon gyi gras su mi 'gro zhing / brjod bya'ang rgya'i tshod lta'i sgyu rtsal ltar rab rib dang nges gtan min pa zhig min mod/ sngar goms dang bsdur na spros brjod byed stangs dang blos bslangs/ sgrig gzhi'i thad la 'pho 'gyur — 140 —

myong tshor rigs shig gi gsed 'grol/byung yod par mngon/ dper na bkra bha'i〈'tshub ma kher rkyang〉lta bur mtshon na kho'i sngar gyi brtsams chos〈sgrol ma nyer gcig〉dang〈srin po g.yu rngog dang nyi ma lha sa〉sogs byung rim gyi gtan tshigs rkyang rkyang la gtam rgyud cig gi spyi khog bkod sgrig byas te dngos yod 'tsho ba'i phyi tshul las mngon pa'i gnad don rigs shig phyir mtshon byed pa las 'phel rgyas byung ste/ mi sger gyi sems gshis mtshon pa brgyud nas de'i 'tsho ba'i khor yug dang mi'i bar gyi 'gal 'brel sogs bye brag gi snang tshor ci rīgs cung zhib cha dod por phyir mtshon byas pas/ rgyun ldan gyi rtsom srol las mngon pa'i 'jig rten spyi la khyab pa'i nyams myong de dag las‘‘brjod bya gtso bo’’de'ang cung rim pa mthon po zhig la bslebs 'dug snyam pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi ro bro myong thub pa yin/ bod kyi sgrung gtam de yun ring bo zhig la dngos yod ring lugs zhes ring lugs de'i phyi tshul ldan zhing gtam rgyud kyi shas che ba'i lugs srol zhig tu sngar byung gtam rgyud mang po zhig ngal med du len bzhin de dag la dus rabs kyi phyi gos tsam bklubs te/ dngos yod ring lugs bsu brdzus pa'i‘‘'khor ba'i’’'dam rnyog cig na rang mgo 'thoms shing gnas la/ cung rang gshis ldan pa dag kyang mtha' gcig tu phyi dngos sam 'tsho ba'i phyi shun tsam phyir mtshon byed pa rkyang rkyang du bying ste/ mi sna rang rkya ba'i tshe srog gi myong tshor de bor brlag byung ba'i rkyen gyis sgrung gtam la ldan 'os pa'i rang nus shor ba yin/ de las ldog ste〈gangs〉dang〈'tshub ma kher rkyang〉lta bur mtshon na dmigs gzhi ni mi sna rang rkya ba'i sems khams kyi gdod gshis sam bden pa de sngog 'don byas te/ tshe srog cig gi bgrod rim dang de'i gnas rkyen gyi gnad don phyir 'byin bzhin/spros brjod rigs shig gis gsar brje de'ang mthong sne rang mtshan pa dang brjod bya'i 'phel 'gyur gyi dbang la bstun phyir sngar gyi byung brjod ci rigs — 141 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/dang bsdur na/ rtsom mkhan rang gi rang myong ste 'tsho ba dngos las thon pa'i rang tshor rnal ma de las bton phyir lhag don bden shas che bar 'dug sgrig gzhi bkod sgrig thad du'ang sngar srol ltar don rkyen zhig gi byung brjod de 'tsho ba'i gtan tshigs ji bzhin du mi 'jog par rang rtog la brten pa zhig yin/dper na chos skyong gi〈2slo1lo'i gtam rgyud〉lta bur mtshon na 'go brtsams ma thag nas spyir btang gi klog mkhan zhig la mtshon na sngar goms dang mi mthun pas myong rol la dka' khag ldan zhing / gtam rgyud kyi byung rim de nyung bas der 'jug dka' bar ma zad/ bklags tshar nas phyir 'dang re brgyab na sngar srol ltar 'dis gnad don de dag bstan 'dug snyam pa'i tshor ba med kyang srid mod/ nga tshos sems rnal du phab nas zhib mor bklags na thog mar brtsams chos de ni rtsom mkhan rang gi rang gshis kyi lhug brjod red snyam pa'i tshor snang de sbyin thub par ma zad/ brtsams chos de'i brjod stangs las rgya'i sgrung gtam pa ma yon gyi〈gangs dkar ti se'i bslu brid〉dang yus hwa'i〈zha'u san kon gyis khrag btsong ba'i zin tho〉sogs sgrung gtam de dag gi gzugs brnyan yang mthong thub pa yin/ 'on kyang‘‘dpe 'gre’’dang brje spor de rigs ni ji bzhin du spyod pa zhig min par/ chos skyong sogs kyis sngar nas grub zin pa'i bod kyi rtsom rig lugs srol der yid mi tshims par/ rang nus ci yod bton te gzhan las brgal bar 'dod pa'i brtson sems ldan phyir/ kho tshor rgyal khab phyi nang gi sgrung gtam mkhas pa 'dra yin yang der bkur pa las skyabs su 'dzin pa'i 'du shes med la/ de dag gi legs cha ci rigs sdud len dang gso bcud slong ba'i go rim khrod‘‘dpe 'gre’’ci rigs byed pa'ang spyir btang gi‘‘bskyar dpar’’tsam min par rang rang gi sgyu rtsal gyi tshor shes dang 'jig rten go 'byed kyi shes rtogs/ lhag don rang gshis kyi khyad chos la — 142 —

myong tshor rigs shig gi gsed 'grol/bstun mkhas pas brtsams chos der yang mi gshis kyi grub cha ldan pa mngon gsal yin pa las gzhan/ ‘‘gsar gtod’’kyi shas kyang che bar mngon/ sgrung thung de las rtsom mkhan gyis spros brjod kyi mthong sne de rang steng las bsrings de rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i khor yug dang 'tsho ba/ bsam blo bcas mi rang rkya ba'i bye brag gi nyams myong de skabs thog de'i sems kyi 'phro 'du ltar lhug brjod byas pas spyir btang gi byung rim de dag med pa dang / sgrig gzhi'i thad du'ang gtam rgyud 'ba' zhig gi blos bslangs ltar go rim nges can du'ang ma bsdebs pas sngar srol la goms pa'i klog mkhan dag la mtshon na myong rol la dka' khag bzos pa yin/ rgyu mtshan de'i rkyen gyis rtsom stangs de rigs spyir btang gi klog mkhan dag gi myong rol gyi tshad gzhi steng du skyon du mthong mod/ 'on kyang sgrung gtam rang ngos kyi‘‘gsar gtod’’thad nas bsam blo btang na mdzes dpyod kyi 'phel rgyas shig tu bzhag mi chog pa ga la yod/ sgrung gtam las mngon pa'i‘‘rang bzhin brjod pa’’kun sba gsang ci yang med pa'i glen bshad cig min par/ rang gshis rigs shig gi lhug brjod du mngon zhing / ‘‘nga’’la na tsha byung skabs kyi sems byung ci rigs dang /grogs mo'i phyi rnam pa'i steng gi 'gyur pa dang‘‘nga’’yi sems 'du/ tha mag bcad pa las byung ba'i don rkyen/ gcod skabs kyi spyod stangs dang slar der longs su spyod skabs kyi bsam tshul/ pha yul gyi‘‘dpa' bo'am bla gsang’’ de las mngon pa'i mi'i sems khams rigs shig dang / ‘‘nga’’yis der 'chang ba'i lta tshul/ lhag don‘‘ltogs skom’’gyis mnar ba'i dus skabs kyi bsam stangs spyod stangs sogs rang gi myong ba las thon pa'i lhug brjod de rigs las nga tshos‘‘sgyu rtsal gyi bden pa'am’’'tsho ba dngos dang mthun 'dug ces go rtogs nyam nga de rigs kyi 'dod blo skong mtha' chod pa zhig byas yod pa mthong — 143 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/thub par ma zad/ mi rang rkya ba zhig gi 'tsho gnas kyi khor yug dang / khor yugade lta bu las grub pa'i sems khams kyi rang gshis dang‘‘nga’’yi gzhan dbang du mi 'gro zhing rang rkya 'pher ba'i gshis ka de'ang mthong sla ba yin/der brten sgrung gtam 'dis nga tshor 'tsho ba dngos su byung dang 'byung bzhin pa'i gnad don 'ba' zhig dang gnad don de rigs thag gcod byed stangs spyi mtshan pa re yang ma bstan mod/ nga tshos mthong ba ni bod kyi na gzhon shes yon can zhig gi rang gshis dang / rang gi go rtogs las thon pa'i 'ji rten nyams myong rigs shig gi rnam 'gyur 'dzin stangs/ bye brag pa'i nyams myong de rigs kyi yang snying du rang gshis‘‘rang rkya’’ba dang de srung 'dzin gyi snying stobs shig ldan par ma zad/ ‘‘nga’’dag gi bsam blor mngon pa'i lo rgyus ni byung zin pa zhig dang rang nyid 'tsho sdod kyi dus skabs de ni gzhi grub tu 'dod pa/ mi'i rigs kyi spyi tshogs ni rang nyid dang 'brel ba'i byung 'das mtha' dag las brgal ba/ der brten‘‘nga’’dag la srol rgyun dang yul goms gshis lugs/ mes po dag gi re bzhag sogs gang gis kyang tshod 'dzin thebs mi nus pa'i mos 'dun de'ang‘‘nga’’yi gzhan dbang na med pa'i spyod stangs las mngon yong ba yin/ der brten sgrung gtam de rigs la sngar goms ltar‘‘brjod bya’’'bur thon gyi khyad chos med pas klog mkhan mang po zhig la ci yin cha mi 'tshal ba'i rtog pa de byung ba yin/ lhag don sgrig gzhi thad‘‘'chal 'chol’’du gyur pa de'i rigs kyis‘‘mi ro rtse sgrung’’gi rgyun de mthud ma thub pas/ spyir btang gi klog mkhan dag la mtshon na lhag par du brjod bya‘‘rab rib’’kyi rtog pa de spyin pa yin/ gong du gleng ba kun sgrung gtam rtsom srol de rigs kyi bye brag gi khyad chos sam dge mtshan du rtsis chog mod/ kha phyogs de rigs la skyon du mthong ba — 144 —

myong tshor rigs shig gi gsed 'grol/dag la mtshon na skyon du 'dzin byed kyi dpang bo ru 'gyur mi srid pa'ang min/spyir sgyu rtsal gang rung zhig spyi tshogs sems khams sam klog mkhan gang mang gi myong rol bya yul du ma gyur pa dang khas len ma thob na de'i rin thang mngon gyur ram tshad 'jal thabs bral ba yin/ ‘‘yul’’de dang‘‘khas len’’khrod ched las pa las gzhan pa'i klog mkhan gang mang zhig la mtshon na‘‘rin thang’’de rigs 'byin par dka' khag ldan par smra na/ phyogs gzhan zhig nas klog mkhan gyi sdur tshad dang bstun na de'ang‘‘skyon’’du brtsi rung mod/ sgyu rtsal gyi chos nyid dang bstun na 'phel rgyas shig gi rtags su'ang cir mi 'gro/ gang ltar kyang nga tshos sgrung gtam de dag las bod kyi sgrung gtam yang‘‘rtsom rig ni mi'i rig pa'o’’zhes pa'i phyogs su rjes shul mngon gsal re 'jog bzhin mdun du skyod pa'i gzi nyams mthong thub pa yin/gsal bshad/〈pe rtag sgyu ma'i rmi lam〉19'phro'i〈sbrang char〉deb dang por gsal/〈bye la'i gtam rgyud〉2'a lo'i〈sbrang char〉deb gsum par gsal/〈'tshub ma kher rkyang〉2'khokho'i〈sbrang char〉deb bzhi par gsal/〈gangs〉19༅glo'i〈sbrang char〉deb gnyis par gsal/〈peg gsum pa〉2kro2lo'i〈sbrang char〉deb dang por gsal/〈2tsā1lo'igatam rgyud〉2①2lo'i〈sbrang char〉deb gnyis par gsal/〈srin po g.yu rngog dang nyi ma lha sa〉1sgrabalo'i〈sbrang char〉deb dang po dang gnyis par gsal/

khong 'dar/da wadamigs bu'i〈zhwa mo dmar po〉bklags rjes/bya gzhung dbyangs bha/khrung khrung klu sgra lho la bzhur zhing / sdong lo ser po'i las dbang byang rlung gis bsgyur pa'i ston mjug gi phyi dro zhig la/ rdzong mkhar chung chung zhig gi gru gar 'dzul nas gcig pus stong sang nger/ mtsho byang gi dmigs bu zhes pa'i gsar bu cha med cig gis bris pa'i〈zhwa mo dmar po〉(zla11pa'i tshes10nyin gyi〈mtsho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyur〉du bkod yod)zhes pa'i sgrung gtam thung thung zhig dbugs thengs gcig la bklags rjes/ khong 'dar yang yang brgyab/mig zung rab rib tu gyur na'ang yid du 'ong ba'i zhwa mo dmar po zhig rlung 'tshub kyis gad snyigs khrod du 'khyer tshul mig lam nas yal ma thub/ don ngo mar/ phyi lus nas nang sems te phyi nang gnyis rang dbang yin la chang kha la mi reg pa'i gsar bu zhig grong khyer nas zhwa mo dmar po zhig gyon nas/ ‘‘sbag sbag 'khor lo me shugs 'phur mda' bzhin 'khyug pa'i’’grong brdal du 'ongs shing / zhwa mo dmar pos bslangs pa'i chag sgo rab dang rim pa'i rjes su bzhi mdo'i za khang las chang rag spyod pa'i‘‘a tsa rar’’gyur pa ma zad/ rlung 'tshub khrod yun ring la ngus mthar gzhi nas‘‘a tsa ra smyon par’’gyur pa'i brgyud rim tsam las ci yang brjod mi 'dug da lta'i dus 'dir/ brgyud rim de ha cang — 146 —

khong 'dar/rgyun ldan yin drags nas brjod rin med pa'i tshad la slebs 'dug na'ang /nga la khong 'dar yang yang brgyab/ nga la ci zhig bshad 'dod skyes/ka dpyid kar rnyid pa'i me tog gi gang bu/nga tsho bod la mtshon na/ gsal bshad sum cu'i sbyor klog gi man ngag gsar du rnyed nas mi lo stong phrag lhag 'das tshod 'dug kyang / de'i ring la gsal bshad kyi son rdog sum cu bo dmangs khrod du khyab ma thub pa dang / mi rigs spyi'i bsam blo 'du shes kyi khyab khongs dang ngal rtsol thon skyed sogs kyis mtshon pa'i spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas la dgos nges kyi nus pa ci yang 'don ma thub pa ni bsub thabs med pa'i pham nyes shig red/ dus rabs phyed tsam gyi sngon du slob gso dmangs khrod la dngos su dar ba nas bzung / nga tsho la'ang chos pa las gzhan pa'i grong pa'i shes yon can yod par gyur la/ lhag par dus rabs sngon ma'i lo rabs brgyad cu pa'i tshun la grangs 'bor gyi 'phar tshad cung mgyogs/ nye ba'i lo 'di gar rkyen sna tshogs kyi dbang gis gom 'gros je dal du 'gro bzhin na'ang / da lta grangs 'bor gyi cha nas bshad na/nga tshor yang bod spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi las dbang la rgyang lta dang kha lo bsgyur chog chog gi dpung sde zhig chags 'dug kho tsho grong dang grong rdal gyi gru ga gang rung nas rang dang 'tshams pa'i las ka gang rung la 'jus nas nyi ma 'phud kyin 'dug na'ang / hol gyis bltas tshe ha cang rngam brjid ldan pa'i dpung sde gsar pa 'dir zhib tu tshang rtsis rgyobs dang / khyod kyis yod tshad rtogs 'ongs la khyod rang ha las su 'jug ste/ de dag las brgya cha'i drug cu lhag la khyim gzhi chung chung zhig gi 'char gzhi las phugs 'dun zer ba zhig ye nas yod myong med/ kho tshos rdog sne tsam las ci yang mthong gin med na'ang — 147 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/ha cang sgam mdog gis‘‘rang don 'khyongs na yod tshad yin’’zhes 'chad srid/kho tsho yon tan par skyed bsring byas zin kyang / rang nyid las gzhan pa'i mi rigs dang spyi tshogs kyi 'phel rgyas sogs rang gi lto rgyab dang thad kar 'brel ba med pa'i don bya yod do cog la do snang dang nus pa ci yang mi 'don pas/ngas kho tshor‘‘yi ge tsam shes pa'i yig rmongs pa’’zhes bos pa yin/de bas/ kho tsho da lta nga tshos gleng gin pa'i bod kyi yon tan pa'i dpung sde yi gras su bgrang thabs med pa yin/ don dam gyi yon tan pa ni shul gyi brgya cha'i sum cu lhag yin te/ kho tshor rang tshugs kyi 'du shes dang rang gshis/ spobs pa/ chu tshad sogs yod la/ de las kyang yid du 'ong ba ni kho tsho'i lta ba gsar zhing rlabs che ba'i phugs 'dun yod pa de yin/ kho tshos bla na med pa'i phugs 'dun zhig pang nas slob grwa las thon cing / mi rigs kyi ched du dka' sdug dang pham nyes tha dag dang len phod pa'i spobs pa zhig khyer nas spyi tshogs su zhugs/ khong tsho ni mi rabs 'di'i nying khu lta bu dang re ltos 'cha' sa yin/yin na'ang / lo re gnyis kyi spyi tshogs gtsub brdar brgyud rjes/ lo re gnyis la gdung 'bod drag tu byas rjes/ grong dang grong rdal du thor ba'i kho tsho‘‘bzhi mdo'i za khang du 'tshang nas chang rag bag med 'thung’’ba'i‘‘a tsa rar’’gyur don ci yin nam/kho tshos nam yang ha cang sgam brling gis‘‘de ni phugs 'dun shi bas yin’’zer don yang ci yin nam/gong du brjod bzhin pa'i bod spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi las dbang la kha lo bsgyur chog chog gi yon tan pa'i dpung sde las da lta don ngo mar du cha'i du tsam lhag yod dam/ spun zla/ khyod la khong 'dar rgyag gam/— 148 —

khong 'dar/kha rnar mi 'gro ba'i shong rgya/‘‘sa’’grong gi gtam rgyud thung thung 'di tshar gcig bklags pas kyang nga tsho'i mi rigs 'di'i bsam blo'i shong rgya rnar 'gro dka' ba'i tshad la slebs 'dug pa mthong thub ste/ shong rgya che drags te rnar 'gro dka' ba'i cha nas bshad na/ rgya lam steng du‘‘sbag sbag 'khor lo me shugs 'phur mda' ltar 'khyug’’yong nas mi rnams kyi tshe srog la 'jigs skul byas dang byed kyin na'ang mi tshang mas mi 'thad pa'i rnam 'gyur tsam yang ston mi srid pa dang /pho lo bco brgyad la son pa'i‘‘sku lo tshang ci phu rlangs 'khor zhig dang lhan du skya sar babs’’pas/‘‘dang thog tsha tsha 'ur 'ur du gyur yang’’rjes su‘‘deng sang rig ma khab tu bzhes te rigs drug rjes su 'dzin pa khong tshang gcig pu ma red’’ces rang sems bde la 'bab tu 'jug pa dang‘‘dad pa sngar bas kyang ldab 'gyur gyis je brtan du 'gro’’ba red/ da dung rig rig thug thug la‘‘a khu’’dang‘‘a ne+e’’zhes 'bod cing dge rgan gyi las bya gnyer ba'i khos slob ma bu mo chung chung gnyis la btsan g.yem byas na'ang / ‘‘sagrong gi mi tshang mas kho pa phal cher brjed la nye’’ba lta bu red/shong rgya chung drags te rnar 'gro dka' ba'i cha nas bshad na/mi zhig gis rang gi dga' phyogs ltar zhwa mo zhig mdun rgyab la nges gtan med par gyon pas kyang / las khungs dang mi dmangs/ tha na grong rdal hril bo zhig la‘‘phog thug’’bzo srid ang /kun spyod la gcig mthun gyi tshad gzhi zhig nam yang yod mi srid pas/legs nyes dang bden rdzun/ yag btsog gi bar na'ang dbye mtshams gsal thag chod pa zhig nam yang yod mi srid/ de ni rig gnas 'khyer so dang khor — 149 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/yug srol rgyun/ 'jig rten lta ba sogs kyis thag gcod byed pa yin/ lo ngo stong phrag gi rig gnas kyis bskyed pa'i bod mi'i kun spyod dang 'du shes khyab khongs su ches gsal ba ni bran g.yog gi 'du shes yin pas/ rang dbang gi gdam ga dang rang gshis kyi 'tsho gnas ni ha cang ha cang gi khag po red/ltos dang / 'chal po 'chal mo khram pa dag gi mngon skog gang rung gi bya byed yod tshad ‘‘sagrong’’la shong thub na'ang / ‘‘zhwa mo dmar po’’zhig nam yang‘‘sagrong’’la mi shong ba'i skabs 'dir/ spun zla/ khyod la khong 'dar rgyag gam/ga ban thag cig gi 'grel stangs/gong du bshad pa'i shong mi shong gi mthar thug ni bar thag chen po zhig yin la/ mi rabs 'di'i nying khu lta bu'i yon tan pa'i dpung sde des‘‘de ni phugs 'dun shi bas yin’’trezer don yang bar thag de'i dbang gis yin/bar thag de dus rabs phyed tsam gyi sngon du bod la grong pa shes yon can byung ba nas bzung thog mar tshor na'ang / dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i 'go 'am da lta'i dus 'di lta bu'i dngangs 'jigs dang zing cha zhig byung ma myong / rgyu mtshan ni myur 'gros tshad las brgal ba'i dus kyi shing rtas bong bur zhon pa dag la ngang sgug dang go skabs nam yang ster mi srid pas yin/ gsal bor bshad na/ de ni shes rig yod tshad dpal 'byor gyi rnam pas dar zhing tshan rtsal dang cha 'phrin gyis kha sang dang de ring la bar chad bzo ba'i deng rabs dpal yon gyi mgyogs 'gros dang / mi lo stong phrag la dus dang bstun pa'i 'pho 'gyur dang 'phel rgyas ma byung ba'i srol rgyun rig gnas kyi dal khom gnyis kyi bar thag de yin/bar thag de mthong bas bu rus pa can skor zhig gi snying khong la me mdag — 150 —

khong 'dar/ blugs byung / kho tshos grong khyer nas deng rabs dpal yon gyi 'o zho reg cing /rang gshis dang rang tshugs/ phugs 'dun/ lhag bsam/ spobs pa bcas khyer nas bar thag de snyom du 'ong na'ang / yig rmongs pa mang po rgyab rtsar langs pa'i rngam mthug pa'i srol rgyun rig gnas kyi kha dbugs mkhregs po der dgos nges kyi shugs rkyen ci yang bzo ma thub par ma zad/ kho tsho‘‘khong khro/yi mug 'jigs skrag skyo gdung sogs kyis dus gcig tu mnar’’nas/bar thag de'i bar dor 'khyar ba'i‘‘a tsa rar’’gyur pa ji 'dra'i phangs/ bar thag de snyom reg bar du/ da dung yang‘‘bu rus pa can’’ji 'dra mang po zhig bar thag de'i gtsub brdar khrod bar dor 'khyar nges pa red ang / spun zla/khyod la khong 'dar rgyag gam/nga shes rig gi 'byor phyug dang rang gshis kyi khrab rmogabang kha rlung gis bsgyur pa'i dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i rta mchog gi rmig pas nga tsho srin 'bu bzhin gcir la nye dus 'dir/ nga tshor gdam ga byed long med par skad cha tshig gcig cis kyang bshad dgos byung ste/ de ni‘‘bod rig pa da lta 'dzam gling spyi'i rig pa zhig tu 'gyur pazhin 'dug’’ces pa de min par/ spyi tshogs kyis nga tsho 'jam por ma gzhog pa'i yar sngon du nga tshos nges par du spyi tshogs gzhog dgos zhes pa de yin/ nga tshos skad cha de cis kyang bshad dgos don ni/ nga tshos nyam 'jig dang 'phel rgyas gnyis las 'phel rgyas bdams pas yin la/ de bzhin ‘‘bran g.yog’’dang rang dbang / chog shes dang ham sems/ yid chad dang brtson len/ da lta'i lto rgyab dang ma 'ongs pa'i las dbang dag las kyang phyi ma bdams pas yin/ da dung / ha cang rnying drags pa'i spyi tshogs kyi rul dri'i mdun du nga tsho kha rog — 151 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/ger 'dug thabs bral bas yin/de yang nga tshos skad cha tshig gcig po de bshad pa de 'dra sla na'ang / spyi tshogs kyi gtsub brdar khrod rang nyid bor nas‘‘a tsa rar’’mi 'gyur pa bya rgyu las sla bo zhig min/ lo ngo stong phrag gi rig gnas kyis bskyed cing dus rabs gsar pa'i chang rag gi ngar blud pa'i spyi tshogs zhig la kha gtod pa dang gris gzhog rgyu ni de bas kyang las sla bo zhig ga la yin/ de'i phyir/ nga tsho la shes rig gi 'byor phyug 'dzoms po zhig gi nang snying dgos pa dang bsgyur du mi gtub pa'i rang gshis kyi khrab rmog cig gi srung ba dgos pa ma zad/ bsam blo gsar pa dang bsam gzhig rnal ma'i ral gri rnon po de'ang dgos pa yin/de lta byung tshe/ lam thag ci 'dra ring na yang / lam grogs ji 'dra nyung na'ang / nga tshos bar thag de'i bar do nas rang nyid bor don med la/ nam zhig mgo bo yar dgye zhing skad gzengs mthon pos‘‘a ma lags/ nga khyod kyi bu yin’’zhes kyang bshad chog pa yin/de lta byung tshe/ nga tshos‘‘zhwa mo dmar po de rang gi dga' kha 'khyer so ltar zhwa lce la nges gtan med par gyon’’nas song chog chog gi dus shig kyang slebs yong bas/ spun zla/ khong 'dar rgyag don ci la yod/

slar yang bod kyi snyan ngag gsar par 'khyug tsam lta ba/skyabs chen bde grol/phran gyis snyan ngag ni sa yom dang me ri/ shwa 'od sogs skye dngos kun la phog thug gtong byed kyi nus shugs 'dzad mtha' med pa de'i dpe ru drangs zin la/ de ni mi sems kyi 'gyur ba dang bstun nas rnam pa'am ngo bo du mar gyes kyang chog pa zhig ci la min/ rang re'i bod la mtshon na mi rnams tsha tsha 'ur 'ur gyis snyan ngag gi zhing sar zhugs pa'i mtho rlabs shig 'gog med du 'phyur zhing des klog pa po rnams la bsam pa'i rgyags phye ji snyed cig mkho sprod byed bzhin 'dug khyed kyis gzigs dang / slob 'bring slob ma dag gi dpe khug tu'ang sngon chad kyi lugs las 'das pa'i sbyangs rtsom rigs shig yod pa cini snyan ngag ma yin nam/ kho tshos nam yang gting zab pa'i tha snyad kha shas(dper na sdug bsngal dang rnam shes/ lha yul sogs lta bu)tsheg khyim gyis sbrel bas dge rgan yang ci bya gtol med kyi gnas su mang por skyel gyin 'dug de ltar yi ge ngos zin rjes kyi las ka dang po ni snyan ngag 'bri rgyur ngos 'dzin bzhin yod pa'i yul gru 'dir slob grwa re la dus deb re dang sde ba re la‘‘snyan ngag pa’’re yod tshod 'dugatshul de snyan ngag gi thang stong du smug pa mthug po zhig 'thibs pa dang gnyis su ma mchis la des bskyed pa'i 'bras bu ni snyan ngag dang snyan ngag pa'i — 153 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/rin thang mngon thabs bral ba dang snyan ngag pa rnams snyan ngag la kha mi 'bral thabs med yin pa de red/dang po/ kho cho'i shes rab/don grub rgyal/ khong gi snying stobs dang spobs pa rang re'i las dbang dang dam du sbrel yod la de ni lo rabs des khong la gnang ba'i bgrod lam yang red/ 〈lang tsho'i rbab chu〉ni skad yig nyams gso dang pha yul 'dzugs skrun gyi ched du 'phyur ba yin mod da lta de nyid rka chu thung thung zhig tu gyur 'dugaljang bu/ nang sems kyi myong ba phra rags dag dbyangs gsal gyi khong du thim par byed pa'i kher rkyang gi 'grul bzhud pa zhig khong gis gangs ri kha shas kyi gtam rgyud bshad bzhin pa 'dra la de'i khrod kyi gcig rang nyid la ngos 'dzin bzhin yod/ khong gi smyug kha bod yul nas 'dzam gling la bsgyur pa ma yin par 'dzam gling nas bod yul la bsgyur pa yin pas mi mang po zhig gis‘‘ljang bu'i snyan ngag ha go thabs bral’’zer/'ju skal bzang / khong chos glu len mkhan mang po zhig gi sems khong du 'dzul nas phyir log dus snyan ngag pa zhig tu gyur 'dug khong gis dgon sde'i rig gnas pa dag la snyan ngag ces pa ni skya ser kun gyi thun mong gi longs spyod cig yin pa gsal bor ngo sprad pa red/zhi bde nyi ma/ nam mkha' dang sa gzhi'i ched du glu len mkhan zhigasnyan ngag ni‘‘'phyur’’dgos par 'dod mkhan zhigagacan me stag 'jig rten gyi mi sdug pa'i ngos la zhib lta byed par brel ba'i mi 'dis snyan ngag legs po gcig gnyis tsam las 'khyongs med na'ang — 154 —

slar yang bod kyi snyan ngag gsar par 'khyug tsam lta ba/de ni khong gi rlabs che ba'i grub 'bras su brtsi chogagangs zhun/ snyan ngag gsar pa'i lam nas 'jig rten gyi snying bor dpyad mkhan zhig khong gis mang tshogs ni snyan ngag pa'i mgon skyabs dang go sla ba ni snyan ngag gi khyad chos yin par 'dod/khyung thar rgyal/ spang ljongs la brtse zhen lhag tu che ba'i mi zhig khong gis rdzi glu lta bu'i snyan ngag mang po zhig bris yod/gnyis pa/ chig gi sbya ba/tshig gi wu ba bar med du 'phyo ba'i ngang tshul de'i rkyen gyis rang re'i snyan ngag gi gtsang bo brjid rngam bral zhing bzhur shugs med pa'i ngang phran gyi brang khog tu bzhur byung / sngon chad rnal 'byor pa dag gis mgur glu len sa'i ri brag chu gsum yang snyan ngag gi longs spyod kyis dbul nas nyam thag tu lus/khom pa re yod na gang byung du nyog bshad re rgyag cing go skabs re ldan tshe don med du snyan ngag re 'bri ba'i skye bo mang po zhig ja kha chang kha nas mnyam 'dzoms byed pa'i dus tshod bgrang gis mi longs la kho tsho'i gleng gzhi gtso bo yang snyan ngag dang snyan ngag pa red/ gleng nas thang chad pa'am gleng 'dod med par gyur pa'i dus su kho tsho gzhi rim gyi slob grwa khag dang grong rdal gyi las khungs rnams su snyan ngag dang 'brel ba med pa'i las ka zhig bsgrub par 'gro bzhin yod/ kho tsho ji ltar u tshugs kyis snyan ngag la 'thams rung snyan ngag gis kho tshor kha bral ba'i re ba 'don bzhin 'dug rgyu mtshan ni kho tshos snyan ngag la bzung ba'i lta ba dog drags la snyan ngag la dpyod pa'i shes rab kyang phra drags/kho tsho na re/ snyan ngag ni gzhan gyi mnar gcod la ngo rgol byed stangs — 155 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/shig yin/ de nyid rang nyid kyi 'bod sgra yin pas gang byung du bris chog la khyod kyis nam yang ag ring zhig thos thub/phran gyis lan du/ khyed kyis bcos su med pa'i rten 'brel gyi chos nyid kun rang gi dgra zlar bzung yod dam/ mngon sum gyi bkod pa dag gis khyed nyid 'khos chung gi mi zhig tu bsgyur ba su yis bsnyon/kho tsho na re/ lha mo dbyangs can ma/ nga ni khyod kyi bu phrug ngo ma yin/phran gyis lan du/ khyed la lha chen tshangs pa bzhin kho mor lo ngo stong la sgug pa'i khom long yang yod dam/kho tsho na re/ nga la snyan ngag 'bri byed kyi tha snyad mang po zhig yod na ci ma rung /phran gyis lan du/ nga tshor sdeb sbyor rig pa zhes pa'i snyan ngag la mdzes nyams btod byed cig yod pa brjed song ngam/ tha snyad re re'i sgra gdangs kyi drag zhan dang pho mo'i rnam dbye/ brtse dungs kyi tshon mdog sogs phan tshun la sdeb thub pa min na khyod kyis nam yang tshos kha gcig kho nar brten nas ri mo 'bri bzhin yod pa kho thag red/kho tsho na re/ bdag gis rang nyid kyi yod tshad snyan ngag tu bris tshar/spun zla dang grogs mo tshor phul ba'i snying gtam yang snyan ngag tu bris tshar/gangs ri dang dar lcog sogs kyang snyan ngag tu bris tshar/ da nas bzung bdag la 'bri rgyu mi 'dugaphran gyis lan du/ khyod kyis bris pa ni phyi shun yin pa las rnam shes ma red/ de ni khyod kyi snyan ngag la brjid rngam med pas so/ /— 156 —

slar yang bod kyi snyan ngag gsar par 'khyug tsam lta ba/gsum pa/ nga cho'i las 'gan/snyan ngag legs po zhig gis spyir btang gi klog pa po rnams la sun snang dang ngal dub ster ba ni chos nyid cig red/ rgyu mtshan yod de de ni tshad mtho ba'i shes rab kyi mngon stangs shig yin pa las/ dmangs glu dang ston bshad/'bel gtam/ kha shags ji bzhin kun gyis longs spyod byed sla ba zhig ga la yin/ de'i phyir phran gyis snyan ngag gsar rtsom la 'jug 'dod pa'i grogs po tshor gsham gyi re ba dag 'don rgyu yin la 'di dag ni nga tsho'i las 'gan yang yin par snyam/ snyan ngag ni rang nyid kyi bsam blo'i gting zab sar sbas pa'i gnas lugs dang brtse dungs phyir byo ba yin pas/ des dngos po'i 'jig rten gyi gshis lugs dang de dang 'brel ba'i ltar snang gi bkod pa mang dag cig la brtsi bkur byed dgos pa ma yin/snyan ngag 'khrungs pa nas khyod kyis dag zhing ngam dmyal khams lta bu'i zhing khams shig gsar du rnyed zin pas dus nam yang klog mkhan tsho'i bstod tshig gi cho lor sgug dgos don ci yod/ khyod la mtshon na kher rkyang du sdod pa ni gzi brjid cig dang rgyal kha zhig ma yin nam/snyan ngag gi mchod stegs mdun du pus tshugs su sdod pa'i khyod kyis dge sdig dang legs nyes/ bzang ngan dang mchog dman sogs tshad shing mang po'i zhal zas tsam bshams te snyan ngag gi lha chen po'i dngos grub la sgug gam/khyod kyis dus snga mo nas rang nyid la dbang ba'i shes rab kyi bang mdzod ni ji 'dra zhig yin pa dang / de'i nang du shes rig gi rin po che ci tsam shong — 157 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/ba'i thad la bsam gzhig btang med par mgo 'thoms pa'i ngang snyan ngag 'bri bzhin yod na/ cung mi 'gor bar khyod kyis 'di ni ches snying bo med pa'i tshul 'chos kyi las ka zhig yin pa gsal bor tshor nges/khyod kyis sngon chad byon myong ba'i snyan ngag pa chen po dag dang bgro gleng byas pa brgyud de rang nyid kyi brtsams chos la thar lam ster rgyu gal ha cang che/mtha' 'khor gyi 'phrul chas dang shog dngul ji ltar 'gul rung khyod kyis rang la snyan ngag gis bzos pa'i rnam shes shig yod pa dran par gyis/de ltar na/ khyod nyid dngos don gyi snyan ngag pa zhig tu 'gyur srid pa ci la min/

blo 'byed bsam blo—bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig cigis nam yang g.yol mi rung ba'i brjod gzhi zhigame lce/deng gi bod kyi rtsom rig spyi la bltas na/ lo rabs brgyad cu pa nas bzung da lta'i bar du rtsom pa po'i dpung khag cig chags yod cing brtsams chos kyi grangs 'bor yang mi nyung ba zhig spel yod/ dus kyi pho nya spyi lo2001la slebs pa'i dus rabs gsar pa'i 'go ma 'di la/ bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig gi 'das zin pa'i bshul lam dang las dbang la phyir rtog thengs shig byas tshe/ nga tsho blo pham zhing zhe mug pa'i gnas shig kyang cig car du skyes yong /de dag mdor bsdus na/ gcig rtsom pa po dang brtsams chos gnyis kyi bsdur tshad phyin ci log pa ste/ rtsom pa po'i kha grangs je mang du 'gro ba dang bstun nas brtsams chos kyi spus tshad je zhan du 'gro ba dang / gnyis/brtsams chos su phyi'i snang tshul tsam las nang gi rtsa ba'i srog snying brjod thub pa nyung ba/ gsum/ dus rabs kyi snying stobs dang blo 'byed bsam blo(tshem+mutshoṣ+ṭha0)yis phyug pa'i brtsams chos de bas kyang nyung ba'o/ /spyir rtsom rig gi gzhi grub rin thang de sgyu rtsal gyi steng nas mngon par mtshon pa 'ig dang yang na khe phan rang bzhin gyi thog nas mngon pa zhig red/lhag par du phyi ma 'di 'a/ 3ga tshon na spyi tshogs gsar rnying gi dkyosdas ༵rdomadze+e kyi

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/dus skabs dang / gsar brje'i las 'gul/ lta ba gsar rnying gi 'thab rtsod sogs lo rgyus kyi byung ba gal chen gyi skabs su rtsom rig 'di lag cha byas te/skabs de'i spyi tshogs kyi dmigs yul nges can zhig 'grub par brtson pa zhig red/ yo rob gling gi rig rtsal bskyar dar skabs kyi〈lha'i rol dbyangs〉de ltar red la/ h+pha ran si'i blo 'byed las 'gul skabs kyi〈mi gzhung drang〉dang / rgya nag gi‘‘lnga bzhi'i’’las 'gul dus kyi〈smyon pa'i nyin tho〉dang〈a0〉yang de ltar red/bod du rtsom rig gsar pa'i myu gu 'bus 'go tshugs pa'i skabs der rgya nag tu rig gnas bsam blo tsha tsha 'ur 'ur che ba'i skabs yin te/ mtshan nyid rig pa dang / rtsom rig sgyu rtsal/ chab srid darma ngas gtso bcas kyi bsam blo'i mtho rlabs 'phyur ba dang / srol rgyun dang deng rabs/ sngon thon dang rjes lus/ nub phyogs dang shar phyogs rig gnas bar gyi rtsod gleng sogs byung ba red/ de las kyang‘‘srol rgyun dgag sgrub’’kyi ral gri dgung la 'phyar te lo ngo stong phrag 'ga'i ring gi srol rgyun gyi dug sdong rtsad nas gcod pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i dus skabs shig red/ lo rgyus kyi dus skabs de lta bu zhig gi 'og tu rang re'i bod kyi shes yon can gang mang zhig la‘‘bsam blo bzhi gsum bcu gnyis dang blo rtse nyi shu rtsa lnga sgrim’’pa'i bskal pa byung ste/ rig gnas gsar pa'i chu klong chen mo'i khrod nas rtsom rig gi chu phran de‘‘gangs ri'i ra bas bskor ba'i’’bod yul du 'dren 'go brtsams/ sku zhabs rang grol mchog ni las 'di'i thog ma'i byed po yin pa dang / khong gis kyang‘‘rtsom rig gis mi rigs nyen kha las skyob thub pa’’la yid ches brtan po bcings te〈lang tsho'i rbab chu〉dang〈sprul sku〉〈rkang lam phra mo〉sogs brtsams chos gang mang spel nas blo 'byed bsam blo'i las 'gan phrag ru blangs/ yid pham pa — 160 —

blo 'byed bsam blo—deng rabs rtsom rig gis g.yol mi rung ba'i brjod gzhi zhigazhig ni khong gi 'phrin las ches dar ba dang bsam blo'i nga ro sgrog pa'i sgang ste rang lo so gnyis steng 'jig rten mi yul dang kha gyes/ de'i rjes su sku zhabs 'ju skal bzang dang ljang bu sogs rnam dpyod kyi blo gros mnga' ba'i rtsom pa po kha shas kyis 'phrin las 'di'i mjug mu nas mur bskyangs pa red/da lta'i rtsomā rig gi brtsams chos spyi la bltas tshe phyi'i rnam pa'i cha nas legs shos su snang yang don du bsam blo'i cha nas chu mgo skam po lta bu zhig tu gyur 'dug 'di'i rgyu gtso bo ni kho bos gong du brjod pa'i blo 'byed bsam blos dben pa'i rkyen gyis red/ rang re'i rtsom pa po gang mang zhig gis gsar rtsom gyi myong tshor gleng skabs/ rtsom rig gi zhabs 'degs zhu yul ni mi dmangs mang tshogs yin pas brtsams chos kyi brjod bya yang dngos yod spyi tshogs 'tsho ba yin dgos par brjod/ de ni shin tu bden te rtsom rig ni dngos yod 'tsho ba las byung zhing der phyir phan gyi nus pa 'byung dgos pa red ang / yin na'ang deng gi gsar rtsom gyi phyogs nas bsam blo'i nang don de dngos yod spyi tshogs dang nye bar btud yod kyang / spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i snang tshul tsam rtsom du 'khod pa las rgya che zhing gting zab pa'i bsam blo can shin tu nyung / ‘‘drag tu mchong lding byed bzhin pa'i snying gson po’’dang ldan pa zhig yin na bod kyi ya nga ba'i spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i gnas bab 'di yid la wa ler 'char srid de/ gyon lhan pa dang 'thung bag skyo/ 'gro rkang thang dang nyal sa khang / dbyar dgun ston dpyid kyi dus tshigs dang pho mo rgan gzhon gyi dbye ba med par/ 'tsho gnas kyi mtha' mtshams na 'gre log rgyag bzhin pa'i skyo sdug gi gnas bab 'di ni 'u cag mi rigs kyi 'tsho ba'i rang dmangs dang me long red/ deng sang rtsom yig 'bri mkhan du rlom pa'i rtsom pa po(rtsom rig las gzhan rigs gzhung gnyer mkhan yongs su 'du)yongs kyi bsam gzhig gi — 161 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/sgo mo phye sa dang smyu gu'i rtse mo gtod yul ni‘‘'bur’’du dod pa'i rgyu cha 'di las gzhan ci yang yod pa ma red/rig gnas mi'i rigs rig pa'i dgongs pa ltar na/ ‘‘mis rig gnas bskrun la/ mi ni rig gnas kyi thon 'bras yin’’zhes 'dod/ des na mi rigs gang dang gang zhig yin yang de'i rnam shes de rang gi rig gnas kyis bskrun par gor ma chag bod mi rigs kyang de las ma 'das te da lta'i rjes lus kyi rnam pa 'di lta bu zhig yin byed kyang rang gi rig gnas kyis bzos pa yin/ spyir rig gnas zhes pa sgra yangs 'jug dang dogs 'jug gnyis ldan gyi go don rgya che ba'i tha snyad cig red/ 'dir brjod pa'i rig gnas zhes pa ni gtso bo bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gnas te lha chos rig gnas la rjod kyin yod/ lha chos rig gnas ni 'u cag bod kyi 'jig rten lta tshul dang /mi tshe lta tshul/ rin thang lta tshul/ mdzes dpyod lta tshul sogs lta tshul sna tshogs pa'i gzhi yin pa ni smos med red/ de'i rkyen gyis bod pa'i stod bsam blo man chad nas smad 'tsho ba'i lag len yan chad bar du rig gnas 'dis snum gyis gos zin pa ltar du byas yod/ rtsom rig gi phyogs nas kyang btsan po'i skabs kyi mgur tshun chad nas bzung dus rabs nyi shu pa'i lo rabs brgyad cu pa'i 'go'i bar gyi rtsom rig la bsam blo 'dis dbang bsgyur ba zhig dang yongs su khyab pa zhig red/ deng gi shes yon can re gnyis kyis bod la‘‘mi bu'i rtsom rig’’byung myong med ces 'o dod 'bod pa yang rgyu mtshan 'di la rag las yod/lha chos rig gnas kyi na bun stug po'i 'og na 'tsho ba'i 'u cag mi rigs 'di la mtshon na blo 'byed bsam blo ni shin tu gal che ba'i las don zhig red/rtsom rig gis las 'gan 'di phrag tu bzhes nas mi lo nyi shu lhag 'gor na — 162 —

blo 'byed bsam blo—deng rabs rtsom rig gis g.yolamirungaba'ibarjodagazhizhigayang da dung kyag kyog gi lam de brgyud tshar med/ lo ngo bcu lhag gi yar sngon gyi brtsams chos 'ga' la phyir lta zhig byas na/ de ni dngos gnas rang re'i bod kyi deng rabs rtsom 'byung lo rgyus thog gi gzi 'od chem chem du 'bar ba'i mu tig re re ste/ snyan ngag〈lang tsho'i rbab chu〉〈gangs dkar lha mo'i slud brid kyi dbang gis〉〈dge 'dun chos 'phel〉〈skyur rtsi las gzhibs pa'i mngar kha〉〈gna' bo'i cong rnying〉dang / brtsams sgrung〈gtsug g.yu〉〈rta nag sgrog 'gros〉〈ra lo〉〈nyin gcig gi cho 'phrul〉 lhug rtsom〈rkang lam phra mo〉 snyan zhu rtsom rig〈gangs skyon〉lta bu'o/ / de dang bsdur na nye ba'i lo 'ga'i ring la spel ba'i brtsams chos rnams bsam blo'i cha nas srin bu me khyer gyi ngang tshul las ma 'das/ dper na/ lo rgyus brtsams sgrung〈thon mi sam bho ṭa〉(rang sgras brtsams)lta bur mtshon na lo rgyus kyi mi sna thon mi sam bho ṭa'i snang brnyan gson po zhig dang skabs de'i mi digs kyi snying stobs(lo7)de klog pa po'i spyan sngar bstar thub med pa lta bu dang / de bas kyang brtsams sgrung ring grasadzñornam shes kyi dgod sgra〉(reb gong rdo rje mkhar gyis brtsams)ni mda' gri mdung gsum gyi sing sgra dang gsod gtub rgyob gsum gyi ki sgra bcas kyis grub pas/deng gi zhang kang gi drag 'dzing glog brnyan dang kun nas mtshungs par dbang po'i spro ba lhur len pa las bsam blo'i rin thang ci yang med/ brtsams chos 'di'i rigs ni klog pa pos thengs gcig bklags rjes dpe cha'i kha zum ste thal rdul gyi khrod nas 'jog pa las thabs med pa yin/ rtsom pa po zhig yin naspyi tshogs la 'gan 'khur ba dang / lo rgyus la 'gan 'khur ba/ rang gi las gnas la 'gan 'khur ba zhig ci nas kyang yin dgos na'ang bod kyi rtsom pa po rnams la tag tag 'di phyogs kyi 'gan 'khur gyi 'du shes yod pa phar zhog tha na 'di'i skor gyi rgyun shes tsam yang med pa ni ji 'dra'i yid skyo ba — 163 —

rī mu tig gling gi dga' ston/zhig red ang / gzhan yang rtsom pa po'i phyogs nas gangs zhun lags kyis‘‘rtsom rig ni ma gzhi nas 'du shes 'dzin stangs shig gi mtshon byed dang rin thang lta tshul zhig gi mngon tshul yin ’’zhes dang / yang‘‘ de bas grwa rigs kyi rtsom rig la bod kyi khyad chos gtsang ma ldan zhes kho bos 'dod cing /grwa pa'i snyan ngag gis bod kyi snyan ngag spyi'i g.yul sa'i btsan rdzong gi gzhi ma bzung yod ces kho bos smra bar 'dod’’(〈zhu tshig gtsang ma—ldong yon tan lags la〉〈mtsho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyur〉2001 9 30par ngos gsum pa)ces gdeng tshod yod pa'i sgo nas brjod yod/ tshig 'di la brtags na khos rtsom rig ni chos lugs(gong du brjod zin pa ltar bod kyi 'du shes 'dzin stangs dang rin thang lta tshul sogs kyi gzhi ni lha chos rig gnas yin)dril sgrog pa'i yo byad lta bur 'dod pa dang / rtsom rig gi brjod bya'i nang don dang khyad chos de gtso bo mi chos rig gnas ring du dor nas lha chos rig gnas kyi steng nas mngon pa sogs shugs nas bstan 'dug 'di las nga tshos gangs zhun lags dang kho'i rjes 'brangs pa kun la chos lugs rig gnas(srol rgyun)kyi bag chags shin tu stug pa dang / phyi 'ong gi rig gnas gsar pa la rgyang bkyed bzhin pa'i rnam pa zhig mthong thub pa yin/ 'dir gsal bshad byed rgyu zhig ni phran gyis rab byung pa'i rtsom rig la mtha' gcig tu dgag pa ma yin par/ snang tshul 'di las 'phros te da lta'i bod kyi rtsom pa po rnams kyi rig gnas sems khams la dbye zhib byed 'dod pa yin/ ngas bsam na rig gnas kyi sems khams 'di'i rigs ni 'thus tshang ma yin pa dang ya ma gzugs kyi sems khams kyi 'phel rgyas shig yin pas/ 'di lta bu'i sems khams kyi rnam pa'i 'og tu gsar rtsom gyi rang dbang dang / rang gshis kyi 'phel rgyas/ rtsom rig gi rang mdangs sogs gleng sa ye nas med/ de bas kyang deng rabs rtsom rig — 164 —

blo 'byed bsam blo—deng rabs rtsom rig gis g.yol mi rung ba'i brjod gzhi zhigagis nam yang g.yol mi rung ba'i brjod gzhi ste—blo 'byed bsam blo ni spang bya nyid du sgom mo/ /mi chos kyi bsam blo nyams dmas dang / shes yon can gyi gzi rngam bor brlag brtsams chos kyi spus ka je zhan du 'gro ba'i skabs 'dir rang re'i na gzhon bsam blo pa sku zhabs zhogs dung lags kyis gnas bab la rkang btsugs te/ lo rgyus la phyir rtog dang ma 'ongs par rgyang mig gtad de blo 'byed bsam blo'i las su zhugs/ khong gis rtsom rig gis blo 'byed bsam blo'i las don gyi rgyun de legs po zhig skyong thub kyin med pa mthong nas/'bol rtsom(lkospra)gyi lam nas〈mtsho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyur〉steng du〈rmongs skran 'joms pa'i gtar kha〉(〈'phag 'tshag gi nga ro〉)dang〈bag chags dong sprug〉gnyis snga phyir spel te bod khul yongs la grag 'gul mi chung ba zhig bzos/ 'di ni rig gnas bsam blo'i ngos nas gleng rin yod pa dang / rtsom rin yod pa/ 'bri rin yod pa zhig red/ bod kyi rtsom pa po rnams la mtshon na'ang 'di na bsam gzhig gi rba rlabs dgung du 'phyur dgos pa'i gnas shig yod pa yin/ rtsom pa po ni ma gzhi nas 'tsho ba'i tshur snang mkhan ma yin par nges pa don gyi gsar gtod mkhan yin pas/ bod kyi lo rgyus steng gi byung dang 'byung bzhin pa'i tshe srog gi skyo gar dang / mi gshis kyi skyo gar/ rig gnas kyi skyo gar sogs la myong rtog zab mo byas te bsam blo'i 'od zer 'phro ba'i gsar rtsom gyi lam du zhugs par 'tshal/

skan chogs rnam par bkra ba'i mtshan mo/da wadus rabs bcu dgu pa'i u ru su'i rtsom rig la 'khyug tsam lta ba/me lce/thog ma'i gleng gzhi/dus rabs bcu dgu pa ni u du su'i deng rabs blo 'byed dang dmangs gtso las 'gul/ 'gro ba mi'i thob thang brtson len sogs kyi yo lang rab tu 'phyur ba'i dus rabs shig yin pa dang/ dus mtshungs su rtsom rig kyang ches cher dar te lo rgyus steng dus skabs 'di'i rtsom rig la u ru su'i rtsom rig gi‘‘rdzogs ldan dus rabs’’zhes 'bod pa red/ skabs de'i rtsom rig gis spyi tshogs bcos sgyur dang drang bden brtsi srung / rang dbang dang 'dra mnyam brtson len byed pa'i 'gan 'khri rlabs po che phrag tu blangs shing / rtsom rig gi bya 'gul gang zhig yin yang rgyal khab 'phel rgyas dang mi rigs dar rgyas su 'gro ba de srog snying du bzung ste bden pa'i lam du khrid pa red/ lo rgyus kyi dkyogs mtshams 'di la rtsom rig gis u ru su'i lo rgyus skul 'ded la nus pa bla med bton pa dang / de 'brel gyi rtsom mkhan rnams kyis rang gi shes rab dang blo gros kyi rtsal la brten nas bsam blo'i me stag phyogs bzhir gtor/‘‘zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i skyid sdug gi mi'i 'os langs’’nas‘‘sku drag shes yon can gyi las 'gul’’dang‘‘mi ser dkyus ma'i shes yon can gyi las 'gul’’bar du — 166 —

skar tshogs rnam par bkra ba'i mtshan mo/dpa' ngar ldan pa'i snyan ngag mkhan dang rtsom mkhan rnams kyi 'phag 'tshag gi nga ro lhing nger yod la skyo zhing brjid pa'i lo rgyus kyi zhabs rjes gsal ler mngon yod pa dang / khong tsho'i phul byung gi brtsams chos khrod du'ang u ru su'i rnam shes gson nyams ldan pa'i ngang bzhengs skrun byas yod/ rtsom rig gis mi rigs shig gi bla srog dang rgyal khab cig gi bya gzhag la 'di lta'i shugs rkyen thebs shing khyad nus bton pa ni/ 'dzam gling shes rig lo rgyus thog rgyal khab dang mi rigs gang zhig yin yang u ru su lta bu zhig byung myong yod pa ma red/gser gyi ri lta bu'i skyes chen de dag byung bas khong tshos rtsom rig gi lam nas 'od zer 'phro ba'i bsam blo'i sgron me u ru su'i mun nag gi gru zur re re nas bkar cing / khong tsho'i bla med kyi phugs bsam dang lhad med kyi mi gzhi/mi bu'i rtsis thang la srung skyong byed pa'i mdzad spyod dag gis‘‘mi’’zhes pa'i rin thang mngon par mtshon pa dang / ‘‘mi bu ni 'jig rten gyi mdzes pa yin’’(shig se pher gyi gsung)pa de slar yang ra sprod byas pa red/ dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i u ru su'i shes yon can dang rtsom mkhan rnams ni mtshan mo'i skar tshogs ji bzhin zla ba med pa'i nam mkha'i dbyings su rnam par bkra zhing / u ru su'i mun pa'i spyi tshogs la dpyod shes kyi 'od zer thog mar 'phros nas dmangs gtso dang rang dbang / 'dra mnyam/ 'gro ba mi'i thob thang sogs 'dzam gling shes rig gi bang mdzod khrod gzi 'od lam lam du 'phro zhing rin thang gzhal du med pa'i rin chen nor bu dag sgam dkyel dang blo gros kyis phyug pa'i u ru su'i mi rigs kyi gzhal yas khang du gdan drangs/ gsham du u ru su'i mtshan mo'i mkha' dbyings na rnam par bkra ba'i skar tshogs las 'thus tshab rang bzhin ldan pa'i‘‘skar chen’’'ga' klog pa po rnams kyi spyan sngar 'bul 'dod — 167 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/do/ /skar chen lta bu'i skyes bu/pe lin si khe/ u ru su'i‘‘gsar brje'i’’rang bzhin ldan pa'i dpyad brjod kyi srol 'byed pa dang / 〈mes rgyal gyi bya ba'i zin bris〉dus deb kyi dpyad brjod ched sgrig le tshan gyi dbu mdzad pa yin/ lo ngo bcu lhag la ljags rtsom gyi lam du zhugs te u ru su'i rtsom rig de gna' rabs 'char yan ring lugs nas dgag sgrub dngos yod ring lugs kyi lam du khrid de byas rjes bla med bzhag gsung rtsom gtso bo ni〈rtsom rig gi 'char sgo〉sogs mang po 'dugahin zin/ u ru su'i rlabs che ba'i gsar brje dmangs gtso ring lugs pa dang dngos gtso smra ba'i mtshan nyid rig pa mkhan/ srid don dpyad brjod mkhan/ rtsom mkhan bcas yin/ khong gis sgyu rtsal snang brnyan gyi bden pa'i rang bzhin dang brtsams chos kyi bsam blo'i rang bzhin ni shin tu gtso bar 'dod/ bsam blo mkhan chir nis zhe h+phi si khe lags kyis‘‘'jon thang gi 'od zer ngos nas gleng na yo rob gling du hir zin gyi do zlar yong ba'i srid don dpyad brjod mkhan da dung gcig kyang med’’ces gdeng 'jog byas yod pa red/ gsung rtsom gtso bo ni rang rnam 'dres ma'i brtsams sgrung〈sngon gyi byung ba dang dran 'char〉sogs mang po 'dugachir nis zhe h+phi si khe/ u ru su'i rlabs che ba'i gsar brje dmangs gtso ring lugs pa dang bsam blo mkhan/ rtsom mkhan/ rtsom rig dpyad brjod mkhan bcas yin/ khong nyid u ru su'i srid gzhung gis zhi pa'o li ya sa char mthar skrod btang ste phal cher lo ngo20yi ring la mnar gcod myangs/ de lta — 168 —

skar tshogs rnam par bkra ba'i mtshan mo/na'ang khong gis dka' sdug yod tshad khyad du bsad nas gsar rtsom gyi las la zhugs/ snyan ngag mkhan ne khi ra so h+phi dang mnyam du〈deng rabs kyi mi〉zhes pa'i dus deb gtso sgrub mdzad cing na gzhon rnams la bsam blo gsar pa'i zhing sa gshin po bskrun pa red/ khong ni‘‘u ru su'i sgal tshigs yin’’zhes lo rgyus smra pos 'dod/ 〈mtshan nyid rig pa'i khrod kyi mi gtso ring lugs kyi rtsa ba'i rigs pa〉dang / brtsams sgrung ring gras〈gang 'dra byed dgos〉 〈sgyu rtsal dang dngos yod bar gyi mdzes rig gi 'brel ba〉sogs mang po 'dugatob rol yu'u po gli/ u ru su'i phul du byung ba'i na gzhon dpyad brjod mkhan yin/ sku tshe thung thung gi ring la mi sems g.yo skyom byed pa'i rtsom yig gang mang bris shing / khong gi rtsom yig las lang tsho'i zil shugs shig dang rbab rdo lta bu'i 'gril shugs shig mngon yong bas skabs de'i u ru su'i rtsom rig la tshe srog gsar pa zhig sbyin pa red/ khong gi snyan grags dang 'phrin las ha cang dar ba'i sgang la 'jig rten mi yul dang zhal gyes/ sku gshegs dus dgung lo26las son med/ de bas rtsom mkhan pa na ye h+phi yis‘‘'jon thang ldan zhing shes rab kyis phyug pa'i u ru su'i mi bu rnams 'jig rten du bzhugs yun thung ba dang sku tshe mi brtan pa 'di ci'i phyir yin nam’’zhes pa'i smresngags bton myong ba red/ gsung rtsom gtso bo ni〈u ru su'i rtsom rig 'phel rgyas khrod du mi dmangs rang bzhin sim 'dzul byed pa'i chu tshad〉sogs mang po 'dugaphu'u zhi kin/ u ru su'i rlabs che ba'i mi rigs kyi snyan ngag mkhan dang dge phyogs 'char yan ring lugs rtsom rig gi 'thus tshab mi sna/ dgag sgrub dngos yod ring lugs rtsom rig gi rmang gzhi 'ding mkhan bcas yin/ khong gi rtsom yig gis u ru su'i bcings 'grol las 'gul khrod nus pa gal chen — 169 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/bton zhing / u ru su'i rtsom 'byung lo rgyus thog mtshar sdug 'od stong 'bar ba'i go gnas yod pa red/ rtsom mkhan kor khi lags kyis phu'u zhi kin la‘‘u ru su'i rtsom rig gi pha yab’’dang‘‘rlabs che ba'i u ru su'i mi dmangs kyi snyan ngag mkhan’’zhes bsngags brjod byas yod/ sger gcod gdug tsub can gyi srid dbang la ngo rgol dang chab srid rang dbang can la bstod glu phul ba'i snyan ngag mang po bris pa dang / shi gson thag gcod kyi 'dzing mo zhig las rmas lci mo phog cing pho brang nas jus ngan 'then pa'i lkog g.yo zhig las sku tshe'i 'phen pa rdzogs pa'i phu'u zhi kin lags kyis 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyis me mda' dang ral gri yis snyan ngag mkhan dgrong thub na'ang / snyan ngag‘‘dgrong’’thabs med pa dang / bden don dang drang bden dgrong thabs med la/ mdzes pa dang brtse sems nam yang dgrong mi thub pa'i bden pa de gsal bshad dang bden dpang byas yod pa red/ gsung rtsom gtso bo ni〈rang dbang la bstod pa〉dang〈cha ta ye h+phi la phul ba〉sogs snyan ngag ring thung mang po 'dugato si tho ye h+phu si khe/ u ru su'i dngos yod ring lugs kyi rtsom mkhan dang / ‘‘'dzam gling steng ches rlabs che ba'i brtsams sgrung mkhan gras kyi gcig yin/’’ brtsams chos su dza drag gi spyi tshogs dgag sgrub dang gting zab kyi mi gshis gshag bcos/ rno ngar gyi rnam shes tsha 'dri dang tshe srog gi ngo bo la ldog 'dri dang dogs 'dri byas pas sngon med kyi bsam blo brjod bya gtso bor byed pa'i brtsams sgrung(tshowu0rtsa྾71no7)gi yang rtse ru son/ der brten khong la‘‘rnam shes 'tshol dpyod byed po’’dang‘‘rnam shes la tsha 'dri gtong mkhan’’‘‘gdug tsub che ba'i shes rab can’’sogs su 'bod pa red/ gsung rtsom gtso bo ni brtsams sgrung ring gras〈nag nyes dang nyes chad〉dang〈glen pa〉sogs mang po 'dugage 170 —

skar tshogs rnam par bkra ba'i mtshan mo/ne khi na so gli/ u ru su'i snyan ngag mkhan dang gsar brje dmangs gtso ring lugs pa yin/ snga gzhug tu dus deb〈deng rabs kyi mi〉dang〈mes rgyal gyi bya ba'i zin bris〉kyi gtso sgrig pa'i 'gan khur myong ba dang / smra brjod rang dbang dang bsam blo'i rang dbang sogs brtson len byed pa'i thad bsub tu med pa'i byas rjes bzhag yod/ brtsams chos su zhing bdag gi snying rje med pa'i bshu gzhog dang zhing bran gyi dka' sdug gi 'tsho ba de bris pa mang zhing /mi ser dkyus ma'i bde sdug la dus rtag tu do khur byed pa red/ gsung rtsom gtso bo ni〈mes rgyal〉dang〈u ru su bud med〉 snyan ngag ring mo〈u ru su nas mi su yis bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba rol thub bam〉sogs mang po 'dugamajug gi bsam gzhigadus rabs kyi 'phar rtsa drag tu lding zhing mi chos kyi dgongs pas phyir bur gtams pa'i dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i u ru su'i rtsom rig gis 'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi rtsom rig gi bang mdzod khrod gdan thob nges can zhig zin yod pa dang / u ru su'i mi rigs kyi skyo sdug gi las dbang la kha lo bsgyur nas lo rgyus kyi shog lhi gsar pa'i dbu khyud bris pa'i dus mtshungs su/ 'u cag phyi rabs pa rnams la'ang spyad na tshar rgyu med pa'i bsam pa'i rgyags phye phun sum tshogs pa zhig bstsal yod pa red/ skabs de'i u ru su'i rtsom rig gi khyad chos gtso bo ni rtsom rig dang bsam blo gnyis ngo bo gcig tu thim zhing / ṭam ka'i ngos gnyis dang 'dra bar ngo bo dbyer med du yod pa dang / bsam blo dang rtsom rig thabs rtsal gyi ngos gnyis ka yod pas da gzod‘‘tam ka’’ste phul byung gi brtsams chos grub pa red/ u ru su'i bsam blo mkhan hir zin lags kyis kyang skabs de'i u ru su'i bsam blo de rtsom rig gi thog nas gcig bsdus — 171 —

da mutigaglingagi dga' ston/ cikyis mtshon yod par 'dod la/ don dngos su'ang u ru su'i bsam blo de rtsom rig brgyud nas 'phel rgyas su song yod pa zhig red/ bsam blo de'ang gtso che ba rig gnas dgag sgrub kyi bsam blo dang dngos yod kyi 'gan 'khri phrag tu len pa'i bsam blo/ mi ser gyi bde sdug la do khur byed pa'i bsam blo/ dus rabs kyi 'phar rtsa dam por 'dzin pa'i bsam blo/ bden pa skyong ba'i bsam blo/ rang dbang 'dod pa'i bsam blo/ mi'i rtsis thang rtsod pa'i bsam blo/tshe srog la dga' zhen che ba'i bsam blo/ mi'i rang bzhin 'tshol dpyod byed pa'i bsam blo sogs la zer ba red/rtsom 'byung lo rgyus zer na'ang 'dra/ rtsom rig zer na'ang 'dra/ de ni mthar gtugs na bsam blo'i lo rgyus dang bsam blo can yin na 'grig pa red/brtsams chos shig la mtshon na dka' sdug ces pa'i rmang gzhi med pa dang /bsam blo'i rgyab rdzong med pa/ rgyu 'bras kyi blo mig med par lo rgyus la 'gan ma khur ba dang / dngos yod la g.yol ba'i ngang nas bris pa'i brtsams chos shig yin phyin de ni chu yi lbu ba las ma 'das/ rang re'i bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig la bltas pa yin na da gzod‘‘lbu sob rtsom rig’’ces par nges shes zab mo rnyed thub/ 'tsho gnas kyi mtha' mtshams na 'phag 'tshag rgyag pa'i dka' sdug gi 'tsho ba las ma thar bar/ longs spyod dar ba'i grong khyer du hol rgyug thod brgal byas nas brtsams sgrung〈grong khyer gyi 'tsho ba〉byung ba dang /dpyod shes dang blo 'byed brtson pa'i dus rabs khyad par ba'i nang du blun rmongs dang 'khral 'khrul dar spel gtong ba'i〈rdul 'tshub dwangs song〉bsgyur ba/ dkyel yangs dang byams brtse/ zhi bde bcas kyi dge ba'i spyi tshogs kyi khor yug cig chags par rmang 'ding ba'i skabs la/ gtum drag che zhing gdug rtsub can gyi spyang ki la dad pa'i〈nga tshos spyang ki la slob sbyong byed — 172 —

skar tshogs rnam par bkra ba'i mtshan mo/dgos〉zhes pa'i‘‘spyang tshogs’’shig byung ba/ don dam gyi snyan ngag ma byung bar ri bong cal 'drogs kyi rnam thar skyong ba'i‘‘cal 'drogs pa’’skor zhig gis‘‘go dka' ba snyan ngag gi yon tan yin min’’ rtsod pa sogs dang /gzhan yang phyi gling gi rtsom rig thabs rtsal gyi bran g.yog tu gyur pa'i skyabs chen bde grol gtso byas pa'i na gzhon skor zhig gi rtsom yig dang / tshor ba than thun la brten nas 'ong zhing rdo chag btsan sgrig byas pa'i‘‘snyan ngag skam po’’dgamemathong ba na 'u cag gi rtsom rig ni‘‘lbu sob rtsom rig’’ci la min/deng gi rtsom rig gi snang tshul 'di las 'phros te dbye zhib byas tshe/ 'u cag gi rtsom rig la dngos yod ring lugs kyi rtsom rig gi zhing sa gshin po med pa dang dus rabs kyi 'phar rtsa gson po bzung med pa gsal bor mtshon thub pa red/ dngos yod ring lugs kyi rtsom rig gi bsam blo'i mtho rlabs rgya cher ma dar ba'am dngos yod ring lugs kyi rtsom rig gi rmang gzhi brtan po zhig chags med pa'i rkyen gyis/ gong du brjod pa'i‘‘lbu sob rtsom rig’’dag byung zhing mi rigs kyi bsam blo rig gnas la tshe srog gsar pa ci yang ster thub kyi med par/ bod kyi rtsom rig gsar pa zhes brjod pa'i tshe na/ mi rigs gzhan gyi snang ngor rtsom rig gi grub mtha' sna mang dar cing 'phel rgyas chen po byung yod pa dang / rang mi rigs kyis zhib tu dpyad pa yin na khra lam lam gyi chu yi lbu ba las ma 'das pa'i rnam pa 'di chags pa red/ der brten/rjo lo 'di 'ga'i ring la snyan ngag 'bri shes min thams cad kyis zhing kang gyi lang dpe skrun tshad yod kung zi'i dpe rtags la brten nas snyan deb mang po par skrun byas pa 'di bzang ltas shig ma yin pas/ kho bos 'di ni bod kyi rtsom rig bde thang min pa'i lam mam log lam du 'gro ba'i rtags shig tu ngos 'dzin gyin yod/— 173 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/bdag gis bsam na dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i u ru su'i rtsom rig ni 'u cag gi dpyad gzhir 'dzin yul dang / de'i skabs kyi shes yon can dang skar chen lta bu'i rtsom mkhan rnams ni 'u cag gi mig dpe lta sa byed pa yin na/ bod kyi rtsom rig de bde thang ngang nar son nges pa dang tha na bod kyi rig gnas bsam blo'i thad la'ang 'dzugs skrun rang bzhin ldan pa'i nus pa mi dman pa gdon srid/dhiyang grogs po kha shas dang lab gleng byas pa na/ kho tsho'i lta tshul ni sgyu rtsal gyi ched du sgyu rtsal gnyer ba dang bsam blo las mdzes dpyod gtso bo yin tshul smra bzhin 'dug dngos yod spyi tshogs thed la bor nas yan gar gyi sgyu rtsal zhes pa zhig bzhengs skrun byed pa ni bar snang nas khang chen las pa kho na red la/ spyi tshogs dang rig gnas gnyis kyi ka ba med na mdzes dpyod kyi khang bzang yang bzhengs thabs gtan nas med pa red/ rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi gzhung lugs na'ang brtsams chos de bya sgong lta bu zhig la cha bzhag na/ sgong shun ni spyi tshogs dang / sgong spri ni rig gnas/ sgo nga'i ser thig ni mdzes dpyod kyis grub cing / de'ang spyi tshogasagerig gnasagemadzes spyod bcas rim pa bzhin du bsam blo dang sgyu rtsal gyi rin thang gong nas gong du gtod bzhin yod par 'dod/ des na 'u cag gi rtsom rig la spyi tshogs kyi sgong shun med par ma zad/ rig gnas kyi sgong spri yang med pas sgo nga'i nang snying ser ril te mdzes dpyod ni ci ltar 'byung ngam/ yang gcig brjod na 'u cag gis bu zhor du bdag gi〈bod kyi rtsom rig gsar pa'i snang tshul thad kyi bsam gzhig〉ces par gzigs rogs zhu/ 〈mi gzhi'i snying stobs〉me lces brtsams/ yun nan mi rigs dpe skrun khang / 2003lo'i zla6pa'i par/ shog ngos57—67par gsal/— 174 —

skar tshogs rnam par bkra ba'i mtshan mo/'tsho gnas dang spyi tshogs kyi gnad don thag gcod byed thub kyi med par/mtha' gcig tu sgyu rtsal rnal ma dang mdzes dpyod rkyang rkyang gnyer dgos zer na/ de ni lo rgyus la khag ma khur ba dang dngos yod la g.yol ba'i rnam 'gyur zhig yin par ma zad/ rang nyid kyi khe phan dang snyan grags srung bar kha g.yar sa'i thabs shes‘‘legs po’’zhig kyang red/ 〈sngon gyi byung ba dang dran 'char〉gyi rtsom pa po hir zin lags kyis kyang spyir 'jar man gyi rtsom rig mkhan kir thi lags la bsngags brjod kyi me tog mkha' la gtor bar byed/ riyin na'ang h+pha ran si'i gsar brje chen mo'i skabs su kir thi yis rang khyim du mgo bo bsgur te rang rnam rtsom par brel nas phyi rol gyi dngos yod spyi tshogs la kha ya ma byas pa thos 'phral/ hir zin lags kyis tshig nan po'i sgo nas kir thi dang 'brel ba gtan gcod byas pa de gsal bsgrags byas pa red/‘‘'gro ba mi'i rigs kyi rnam shes bzo bkod pa’’ru bsngags pa'i rtsom mkhan rnams kyis gong gi gtam rgyud thung thung 'di la mno bsam yang yang gtong ba'i dgos gal shin tu che la/ lhag par du rang re'i bod kyi rtsom pa po dag gis‘‘kir thi’’yi brtul zhugs mi 'dzin par‘‘hir zin’’gyi snying stobs 'chang dgos pa'i re smon dang bcas rtsom yig 'di re zhig mjug rdzogs par byas so/ /

snyan ngag gsar ma'i dus skabs/bya mdo don grub tshe ring /ka rgyab ljongs/snyan ngag gsar ma dang snyan ngag rnying ma zhes gcod lugs 'di la dus kyi snga phyi'i steng nas gcod tshul zhig dang rnam pa'i(lus)steng nas gcod tshul zhig nang don gyi steng nas gcod tshul zhig da dung rtsom gyi grub mtha'i steng nas gcod tshul mang po zhig yod na'ang / 'dir snyan ngag gsar ma'i dus skabs zhes ming gsar du btags nas 'chad pa ni/ gtso bo dus kyi snga phyi la gzhigs nas brjod pa yin/des na/ snyan ngag gsar ma 'di bod kyi rtsom rig gi gar stegs steng thog mar ji ltar byung tshul gyi rgyab ljongs la gsum ste/1 nub phyogs rgyal khab kyi snyan ngag gsar ma dang su'u len rgyal khab kyi snyan ngag gsar ma de rgya nag yul la dar ba dang / des bod kyi rtsom rig la thad kar shugs rkyen thebs pa ni phyi rkyen gtso bo yin pa dang / rang re'i rig gnas kyi 'jig nyen tshor ba dang / rtsom rig la brten nas mi rigs kyi sems khams skyob pa'i man ngag rtogs pa'i gsar skyes na gzhon skor zhig gi spobs pa'i bsam blo'i stobs la brten nas/ snyan ngag gsar ma'i dus — 176 —

snyan ngag gsar ma'i dus skabs/skabs kyi las 'gul 'di bslangs pa ni nang rkyen gtso bor gyur/2 spyir 'dzam gling rig gnas kyi 'brel 'dris go rim khrod du/ rtsom rig gi 'brel 'dris/ snyan ngag gi 'brel 'dris/ snyan ngag gsar ma'i 'brel 'dris bcas kyi go rim zhig brgyud/3 rnying pa rnying pas gsar pa gsar pa'i dgos mkho skong mi thub pa bzhin/ rtsom rig rnying mas rtsom rig gsar ma'i tshab byed mi thub pa dang /dgos mkho skong mi thub pa'i spyi 'gros 'di la brten nas/ snyan ngag gsar ma 'di rtsom rig byung 'phel gyi chos nyid la brten nas byung ba las glo bur du byung ba zhig min/kha snyan ngag gsan ma'i khyad rtags/snyan ngag gsar ma rkang tshugs pa'i dus kyi tshab byed brtsams chos ni/〈sbrang char〉 (1983 2)steng 'khod pa'i〈lang tsho'i rbab chu〉yin dgos la/snyan ngag gsar ma rkang tshugs pa'i dus kyi tshab byed mi sna ni rtsom rig gsar pa'i srol 'byed pa po dgu rong don grub rgyal lags so/ /bshad ma thag pa'i brtsams chos de dang mi sna de'i rjes su/ snyan ngag gsar ma'i dpyid rlung bod gangs can gyi ri lung thang gsum la ldang 'go tshugs la/ de'i khyad rtags gtso bo 'ga' tsam bgrang na/1 snyan ngag gsar ma'i brtsams chos phal mo che zhig la rtsom mkhan gyi yid 'gyur drag po'am dungs sems rnal mas phyug cing / klog ma thag sgyu rtsal gyi zhing khams shig la khrid de ro myong gi longs spyod zad mi shes pa'i snang ba bcos min ster/2 rang re'i la rgya dang las dbang brjod byar byas pa'i snyan ngag gi — 177 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/brtsams chos mang po zhig kyang de'i skabs su 'phro rim 'phror byung bar mngon/3 rang nyid kyi sems kyi zug gzer drag po de thad ka thad sor brjod na mi 'os par brten/ cung zad gab ste brkyang bskum gyi lam nas klog pa por go brda sprod pa lta bu red/4 bcad pa la bcad pa'i lus kyi brtsams chos byung ba dang grol ba la grol ba'i lus kyi brtsams chos byung / 5 dga' skyo chags sdang / dam lhod mngon lkog gang rung gis mtshon pa'i rtsom gshis rigs mang po'ang byung myong /ga dpe drangs te brtag pa/〈lang tsho'i rbab chu'i〉rjes su/ 〈gangs dkar lha mo'i bslu brid kyi dbang gis〉dang〈nor nag〉〈kye ma phangs pa'i mchi ma dbang med bzhur〉〈sa rub thengs re rer〉zhes pa sogs snyan ngag brtsams chos mang po byung la/sgos su lo rabs dgu bcu pa'i dus dkyil dang dus mjug la slebs mtshams/〈gangs rgyan me tog〉gtsos bod khul gyi dus deb dang tshags par 'ga'i nyin srib kun la pir ming gsar pa dang rtsom byang gsar pa/ rtsom stangs(tshod lta)gsar pa'i snyan ngag gi mkha' dbugs stug po zhig ngang gis 'thibs 'ongs/nga sngon dpagasnyan ngag gsar ma'i dus skabs las 'gul gyi gleng gzhi de lo rabs brgyad cu pa nas mgo bslangs pas/ phran gyis lo rabs brgyad cu pa ni snyan ngag gsar ma rkang tshugs pa'i dus skabs dang / dus rabs nyer gcig pa ni snyan ngag gsar ma lang tsho dar la babs pa'i dus skabs sam snyan ngag gsar — 178 —

snyan ngag gsar ma'i dus skabs/ma la gzhung lugs shig gsar du chags nges pa'i dus skabs su ngos 'dzin chog par snyam/yin na'ang / da lta'i bar byung ba'i snyan ngag gsar ma yod do cog ni legs pa'i nges pa med la/ snyan ngag 'di ni snyan ngag gsar ma'i rtse mo yin no zhes mtha' gcig tu kha tshon gcod par mi rigs so/ / sgyu rtsal gyi rigs la mtha' dang rtse mo med pas gtso bo lo rabs rim byung gi khrod lo rgyus la 'gan 'khur ba'i gsar skyes snyan ngag pa rnams kyi dka' spyad dang lag len gyi shugs la brten dgos/ da dung nga tshos yid la nges dgos pa zhig ni/ da lta'i snyan ngag gsar ma 'di'ang dus yun nges can zhig brgyud pa'i mthar rnying shos su 'gyur nges pa dang / de las kyang nyams rgud du 'gyur yang srid mod/ 'di ni dmigs bsal gyi mi rigs shig gi dmigs bsal gyi dus rabs shig tu byung ba'i dmigs bsal gyi gzhon nu skor zhig gi ma bcos sems kyi rol mo zhig dang / rtsom rig las 'gul gyi snang tshul zhig rang nyid la ngos 'dzin thengs shig gnang ba bcas yin pa sus kyang brjed mi rung ba yin no/ /

〈byu ru'i las dbangardzas byin pa'i dmigs bsal chor ba/bkra shis rgyal/lo ngo 'ga'i yar sngon du/ 〈byu ru'i las dbang〉gis na zug gis gcir ba'i bsam blo zhig dang / brtse dung gis bcings pa'i sems gso zhig da dung rang dbang dang rjes snyeg gi blos bslangs shig gi sngon 'gro drud nas nga tsho'i mthong lam du slebs 'ongs/ de ni rang lo nyer lngar ma son pa'i khyim thab ma zhig gi dka' sdug gi bzhud lam las thon pa'i sems gso zhig dang /'gyur med ther zug gi dad 'dun gyis btegs pa'i sems khong gi snang ba phyi ru lud pa'i mngon stangs shig red/ skabs 'di nas ngas rang sems la dran tshul zhig gi me kha gsos te kho mo'i brtse dung gi 'jig rten las lhad med dwangs gtsang gi sems gzhas shig 'tshol 'dod kyi 'dun pa shar mar phyo 'dod/ spyir bshad na/ kho mo'i snyan ngag las mthong sne mi gcig pa'i bsam blo'i cha mngon yod la/ dran gdung dang re sgug gis gtses pa'i gnon thabs bral ba'i brtse dung gi cha mngon pa'ang yod/ lar 'jig rten spyi ngos nas gleng na yang / pho gshis ni brjid cing drag la bsam blo'i cha de la mnyam 'jog gi 'du shes lci ba zhig red/ mo gshis ni 'jam zhing dul la brtse dung gi cha de la blo gzur ba'am do khur gyi 'du shes lci ba zhig red/ ngas bltas na gzungs phyurngi skyisdo ༵ maḍon na yang snga ma bsam blo'i cha na dge chen po lon med pa yin/

〈byu ru'i las dbang〉gis byin pa'i dmigs bsal tshor ba/rgyu mtshan ni mo'i snyan ngag tu mthong sne mi gcig pa'i bsam blo sil bu ba mang po zhig byung yod na yang de ni ches rags pa'i phyi ngos kyi snang tshul tsam las bsam blo'i gting rim na gnas pa'i de nyid de ston thub kyi med/ 〈bsam gzhig gi khyed〉〈a pha nga gnas la mi 'gro〉〈dbyangs can ma〉〈kha ba'i rmi lam〉〈bar thag gi bsam gzhig〉〈'tsho stangs gzhan zhig〉sogs kyis mtshon pa'i bsam blo'i char gtogs kyi snyan ngag gang la bltas kyang dus rabs kyis zin pa'i tshor ba yin na'ang 'dra/ phyi ngos nas mthong ba'i dbul phongs kyi snang tshul yin na'ang 'dra/ brtse dung gi rang dbang la dma' 'bebs byed pa'i snang ba yin na'ang 'dra/ yod tshad phyi ngos kyi brda 'phrin chig rkyang ba zhig gi lam nas ngo sprod pa tsam las de'i nang gnas kyi rig gnas rgyab ljong mthug por sen 'brad tsam yang byed ma thub pas nga yid cis kyang mi tshim/ (snyan ngag pa'i gsob rdzu lhur len byed pa dag las tshad mtho ba'i re ba zhig dang sha tsha ba'i gros 'debs shig)yin na yang / kho mos kyang 'di phyogs nas dge mtshan sngog 'don byed rgyur de 'dra'i 'bad pa ma byas par phyi ma rang gi dge mtshan de rang steng la lhur len byas yod pas rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i snyan ngag gi gdangs dbyangs grub pa yin/ 'di'i steng nas bltas na gzungs phyug skyid la rang gi rtsom stegs steng na rang la mnga' ba'i 'byor phyug cig cis kyang yod nges la/ klog pa po mang po zhig dga' mgu bskyed pa'i gnad dam pa yang 'di'i steng na yod/ der brten/ 'jig rten gyi bgyi ba ma lus legs nyes yag btsog dang mnyam bgrod mnyam 'dug yin par bsam blo re 'khor na de ni ches rgyun ldan gyi snang tshul zhig yin pa las mi rung ba zhig gtan nas min/gal che ba ni skyon yod kyi grangs ka'i che chung yin pa las/ skyon phran tsam yod pas g.yug dgos dang / dge bzang tsam yod pas mjal dgos zer ba 'u tsho — 181 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/rtsod sgrub kyi lta ba med pa dag gi mtshang ma yin nam/ ga ler bsam na/ mo'i snyan rtsom du snga ma las phyi ma gzengs su mtho ba'i snang ba btsan po zhig gis rang nyid kyi mos 'dun dang rang nyid kyi rjes snyeg rang nyid kyi 'dun pa sogs pho mo'i shigs med kyi mdza' sems dang dran gdung gi snang ba/ re sgug dang yid smon gyis bskrun pa'i brtse dung gi 'jig rten zhig nas mngon par byas yod/ 〈khrung khrung dkar mo〉〈khyod kyi gtsang 'gram na〉〈zla ba'i 'jig rten〉〈lha bya khu lo〉〈lug khyu dkar po da dung khyed〉〈yu mo kha skya ma〉〈pha yul gyi kun dga' rol mtsho〉〈dgun zla ljang khu〉sogs kyis mtshon pa'i yid sems nas khegs med shar gyis bzhur 'ongs pa'i brtse dung gi zhun thigs re res rang nyid kyi sems khong gi gnon thabs bral ba'i brtse ba ngo ma de phyi ru phud yod/ mos dungs pa de ni rlung 'tshub kyis gyil rgyag byed pa'i srubs ka las brdol 'ongs pa lta bu zhig ma yin par/ 'jam mnyen yang zor ldan pa'i ming tshig gi bar gseng re re nas dal gyis bzhur 'ongs pas snyan ngag rang steng na 'jam mnyen mnyen mnyes gshin gyi khyad chos 'dzoms por yod la/ der rang gi gshis nyams kyis thag bcad pa'i 'tsho ba'i bkrag mdangs dang mtshon mdangs kyis rnam par phyug yod/ ‘‘gnas 'di na mtshan mo zhig gam yul ljongs shig gi mig chusamokhyod kyi kha dog dang rgyang bzhud ring mo bskyar du bris shing dgu tshigs la btab pa'i skar tshogs kyang de ltar bzhur’’zhes pa'am‘‘re sgug du ma'i pha rol nasamozla ba'i lo ma khu byug gis 'degs bzhin(skar ma'i blos bslangs me tog gis dkrogs(nga rang sge'u khung nas mjal ba'i zla ba dang lhan duphro mtshan mo'i mkha' dbyings su spro gseng gis phyin yang('jig rten dogs pa'i dbang gisamo ngas su zhig gi rdog sgra ma thos’’zhes rang gi nang sems kyi phra sa nas brdol ba'i dran snang de phyi rol gyi yid gzugs — 182 —

〈byu ru'i las dbang〉gis byin pa'i dmigs bsal tshor ba/steng la 'pho bar byas te slar yang rang gi 'dod 'dun de nyid bcos min du ston pa zhig las dran pa'i 'o dod 'don pa'i smre ngag gi shul tsam yang mthong mi thub/ 'di las ches snying du sdug pa'i mdzes chos rnal ma zhig gi sgo glegs nga tshor phyes yod/ 'di ltar bltas na mo'i snyan ngag la drag pos dpung gis bsgyur pa'i rtsub cha med la/ rang sems rba ru 'phyo ba'i 'khrug slong yang med par lhod 'jam bag phebs kyi bsam gzhig khrod na brtse dung gi snang ba me ru sbar ba'i mo gshis kyi mdzes pa zhig 'thul gyin yod pas/ mo'i snyan ngag gi mdzes pa de mo rang nyid kyi gshis su grub yod ces na'ang mi chog rgyu med/gzhan du na/ rtsom yongs kyi steng na thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos gzhan zhig yod pa ni gzhan skad kyi shan ma shor bar bod gnyug ma'i skad cha'i khyad chos kyis yongs su phyug yod pa de'o/ /

'u chor blo 'byed byed dgos don ci red/da wa〈o li h+pher dang rnga bya gzhan dag〉bklags pa'i 'char snang /byang skar/1784lor khan thi yis〈blo 'byed go don thad kyi dris lan〉zhes pa'i dpyad rtsom du/ blo 'byed ces pa ni skye bo dag rang gis rang la bzos pa'i byis blo'i tshul bab las sgrol bar byed pa la go dgos gsungs 'dug 'di las nga tshos don dag gnyis shes thub pa ni/ skye bo la byis pa'i skye bo dang dar ma'i skye bo'i khyad par yod pa dang / byis pa'i skye bo las dar ma'i skye bor 'phags par byed na blo 'byed la rag las zhes pa de red/ 'dir byis pa dang dar ma ni mi'i na tshod la mi go bar skye bo spyi'i rtogs pa'i mtho dma' la go gi yod pas/ byis pa'i spyi tshogs dang dar ma'i spyi tshogs/ yang na byis pa'i mi rigs dang dar ma'i mi rigs zhes kyang zer srol yod pa red/tshad nges can zhig nas bltas na/ bod kyi shes yon can dag ni lung 'dzin gyi ched du skye ba ltar snang ste/ lung gi don du gnas lugs 'dor la lung gi don du 'tsho gnas kyang spong tshod red/ kho pa tshos rang nyid mi gtso skyabs gnas gtso ba dang de bas kyang rdo rje'i bka' lung zhes lung gtso bor 'dzin pa red/ mtha' gcig tu lung tshad mar 'dzin pas rigs pa mkho med du bzo gi 'dug cing / kho pa tshos kha nas dbang rnon rigs pa'i rjes 'brang — 184 —

'u tshor blo 'byed byed dgos don ci red/zhes zlo yang / don du lung de yang dag par sgrub byed tsam du zad pas rigs pa de ni rigs pa tsam po bar song 'dug pa red/ gal te su zhig gis lung der dogs dpyod tsam byas tshe kun gyis der sdigs mdzub ston zhing / sngar lam du shar mar 'gro ba las bden min la brtag pa tsam yang byed mi srid/dper na/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud du bkod pa ni bal yul gyi skor las bod yul gyi skor min pa dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis yang dag par sgrub yod pa dang / lus 'phags sogs gling bzhi ga yang phyogs kyang ma 'dzol bar rgya gar gyi yul bzhi ru ngos bzung ba sogs bod kyi shes rig thad kyi 'khrul shes dang log shes ci rigs shig sel 'dug rung / dus da lta'ang don dngos de dag khas len mkhan srid mtha' tsam red/ de ltar lung sogs la rmongs zhen che drags pas/ tha na‘‘rgya gar pa'i srol zhes yar 'jog byed pa dang / bod dang bon gyi lugs zhes bsnyad thabs su byed pa'i’’(dge chos kyi tshig)gzhan mchog 'dzin dang rang dman 'dzin gyi sems khams 'du shes shig kyang ngang gis chags yod pa red/ spyir na shes yon can gyi sde ni bden pa 'tshol mkhan spyi tshogs kyi gzur gnas/ bran gshis med pa mi mang gi snying phur lta bu zhig yin dgos mod/ 'on kyang 'u cag gi shes yon can gyi sde yi‘‘ma 'ongs lung ston’ridang‘‘'di phyi mngon mkhyen’’sogs kyi phyi shun mdzes po dag bshus tshe/lung kho na'i g.yam la rgyug mkhan ma yin pa dang rang rtsis ma shor zhing rang tshugs yod pa ga tshod yod dam/ de ltar bsams na/ kho pa tsho yang rnga bya smra khams can mgo mkhregs de dang ci khyad/ 'o na 'di lta bu zhig tu ci ltar chags pa red ce na/ kha cig gis rang gi lto phor bsams nas mkhregs 'dzin byed pa red la/ phal mo che ni dad pa'i dmu gab kyis blo mig bsgribs pas red/ 'di ni 'u tsho'i shes yon can gyi sde'i rang gzugs dngos red do/ /— 185 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/'o na mi mang gi gnas tshul ci 'dra red ce na/bod pa phal che bas slob chung slob gso tsam yang myangs med pa'i don dngos ltar na/ yig rmongs ni kho pa tsho'i nad gzhi gtso shos red/ kho pa tsho'i blo mig phye med pa de'i rkyen gyis dmus long ltar dmigs bur mi brten thabs med byung ba red/ju dmigs bu gcig ni‘‘srid pa rgan po'am’’tshe ring don grub kyis 'bri bzhengs byas pa'i‘‘mes po’’red/ kha je gsal du btang nas bshad na/ de ni 'das zin pa'i lo ngo stong phrag ring chags pa'i srol rnying rnams dang / dmigs bu gcig ni gsung tshad chos su 'dzin dgos pa'i‘‘bla ma’’ste chos pa rnams red/ de dag gis bskyed pa ni u tshugs mthar skyel dang chu sna gar khrid zung 'dus kyi rang gshis ya ma brla red/ rang gshis gyong po de ni bcos su dka' /la bsgyur du khag pa dper na/ o li h+pher gyis rnga bya gzhan dag gi blo kha sgyur mi thub pa lta bu red/da ni dbye zhib cung zad byas na/ gnas tshul dang po las/ 'u cag gi shes yon can gyi sde ni bden pa rdog brdzis gtong mkhan/ lung gi khol po dang khron pa'i sbal ba nga'o snyam mkhan rkyang yin pa'i gnas lugs de rtogs thub pa red/ gnas tshul gnyis pa las/ 'u cag gi mi mang ni thog mtha' bar gsum du srol rnying dang gzugs brnyan lta bu'i yon tan pa'i gzhan dbang rang du 'gro ba/ bdag nyid kyi 'du shes yongs su bral ba'i mi'i sha gzugs kho na yin pa'i gnas lugs de rtogs thub pa red/ de'i phyir na/'u cag gi mi mang phal ba yin na'ang 'dra/ shes yon can gyi sde yin na'ang 'dra/ kun kyang so so rang gi blo rig kho nas blang dor 'jug ldog mi nus pa mngon sum mthong chos red/ 'u cag nam yang yar thon med pa dang rtag tu gyong gud reg pa ni rmongs tshod 'di la thug 'dug de yang tshig gzhan gyis ge 186 —

'u tshor blo 'byed byed dgos don ci red/bshad na/ 'di ni bsnyon du med pa'i byis pa'i mi rigs kyi rtags yang dag red do/ / rgyu mtshan 'di'i rkyen gyis/ 'u tshor blo 'byed mi byed thabs med red/des na 'u bu cag byis blo'i tshul bab las ci ltar sgrol dgos she na/ nye rabs kyi nub gling blo 'byed skabs su bsam blo mkhan mang pos thabs lam gcig tu bzhed pa red/ kho pa tshos gang de shes yon la brtsi 'jog dang tshan rig la brtsi 'jog mi bu kun gyi blo mig phye ste so so rang rang gis bsam gzhig byed shes su 'jug rgyu'i steng la 'jog gi yod pa red/ da lta nub gling pa dpyod shes bsam blo can dang rgyal khab khag dar ma'i spyi tshogs su 'phags bzhin pa des thams cad yang dag par ra sprad 'dug pas na/ nga tshos kyang de ni thabs dam pa yin par 'dod/ der ma zad/ rjes yong sngon dran gyi tshul du/'u bu cag gis rnga bya de dag gi‘‘rnam thar’’mi skyong phyir/ kha tsha dgos gtugs kyi skabs 'dir/ nga tshos‘‘o li h+pher’’rgyang 'bod dngad wa dpyod shes rgyang 'bod byed pa yin no/ /

thun min gyi myong rtog thun min gyi blos bslangs/da waganyan gyi snyan deb〈ro langs〉bklags pa'i myong tshor/kun dga' ye shes/da snga'i rang re'i rtsom stegs las nga tshos rgyun du stong ba dang rjes lus/rmongs 'thom la gdung yus brjod pa'i‘‘mya ngan rang bzhin’’gyi snyan ngag mang po mthong la/ gtor bshig dang re 'bod/ mdun skyod kyi ched du gad rgyangs sgrog pa'i‘‘smyon pa'i rang tshugs can’’gyi snyan ngag mang po mthong du snang / de ni nga tsho ci nas kyang gnyid las dkrogs 'dod kyi zhogs pa'i dung brda zhig yin pas zhi bde bag lhod la 'dug bzod mkhan gyi dbang 'khyam smyon pa zhig min na dngangs 'tshab cig ci nas skye nges/ rgyu mtshan ni bar 'di'i snyan ngag gis kun la mdun skyod kyi dung brda btang yod de/ 'dzam gling gzhi khyim gcig tu bskrun pa la thag mi ring ba'i dus su da dung gnyid bsdad na 'phro de nas sad rgyu med par nam yang gnyid 'gro ba'i the tshom ci yang med/ mtshams 'di nas nga tshos slar yang dung brda gsar pa zhig thos thub pa ni gnyan gyi snyan deb〈ro langs〉red/ snyan deb 'di'i nang rtsom pa pos rang nyid slob grwa nas bod spyi tshogs su zhugs pa'i thun min gyi myong rtog brgyud de/ rab rib dang mag mog gi 'tsho ba la rting skul yang yang byas shing / rang gi rnam shes dmigs bsal 'gul stangs spel te thun min gyi blos bslangs sna tshogs spel — 188 —

thun min gyi myong rtog thun min gyi blos bslangs/yod/ de ni rtsom pa por mtshon na rang gi gsar rtsom gyi lam du rnyed pa'i grub 'bras shig yin pa las mtha' zin pa'i gshis stangs shig chags tshar ba red zer na gtan nas mi 'os/ kho'i snyan deb snga gzhug gnyis las rang gshis rgyun du spel ba'i rtsom gshis dmigs bsal ba'i tshor nyams shig 'byung mi thub pas yin la/ lhag par du kho da dung lo na chung zhing gsar rtsom gyi lam du zhugs tshad ltos 'jog gis thung ba dang / phyi thag ha cang ring bas re 'jog dang yid ches kyi ngos nas smras pa yin/‘‘snyan ngag ni rtsom rig gi bye brag cig ste/ rtsom rig tu gyur tshad sems kyi rtsol ba la brten nas byung ba’’ni rtsom pa po'i rmang gzhi'i shes bya zhig red/des na sems de ni yul dus gang la brten yang myong rtog zab mo'i dbugs rgyun zhig gis bslangs pa yin pas de ni gcig tshab gcig gis byed mi thub pa dang / phan tshun g.yar mi thub pa'i sems khams shig yin/ de bas na myong rtog zab mos bskyed pa'i sems khams des dngos po'i chos nyid ji bzhin pa rtogs la/ de las dga' sdug chags zhen gyi 'gyur pa 'byung ba dang / de las 'bad 'bad dungs dungs kyi las shig skye nges/ gal srid myong rtog dma' bas na rnam pa gsar pa la nang don rnying ba'am gsar min rnying min can gyi chos sam yin min grub gzhi med pa'i snyan ngag rgod po'i rnam pa der shor bar the tshom med/ 'tsho ba'i yun gnas kyi dga' sdug las myong rtog zab motshothebs pas da lta bod kha ba can pa'i dus yun nges can zhig la mthong ma thub pa'i 'tsho ba'i rang mdangs te rim gyis gsal byung la/ nga tshos thog dang por mig mthong byung ba ni gangs ri dang rtswa thang / rbab chu/ cong rnying / sbra gur/ smug long dang nags tshal sogs lta bu la gzho sprucol te phyi snod kyi bkod pa'i phun tshogs la ngos zin thebs shing / de nas de dang rang gzhan — 189 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/yongs kyi 'tsho ba'i kha phyogs gshib bsdur gyis thog ma'i 'bod skad de gzhi gcig gi phyogs su babs te da lta'i snyan ngag gi dung brda 'di byung ba red/'on kyang 'ga' zhig sngar zhen gsar ldog gi rnga ma lhag tu ring zhing / 'ga' zhig gsar zhen rnying sun gyi mgo cog gnam du bstad pas phan tshun gyi bar thag ni ci 'dra'i ring ang / gang ltar yang 'tshub bar de nas slar yang 'dzum chog pa zhig la gnyan gyi〈ro langs〉sogs lta bu'i yid dpyod dang myong rtog gis nga tshos rang nyid kyi 'tsho 'dun gyi dmigs gzhi slar yang btsugs chog pa gsal byung la/ dus rabs dang 'dzam gling gi khrod du nga tsho'i go gnas dang gnas bab/ sngon byung gi gzi mdangs mthong nas ma 'ongs pa'i dmigs 'ben cung gsal bor nges song ba yin/ 'di ni myong rtog gis bskrun pa'i rtog 'char zhig ste myong rtog zab mos dgos mkho dang 'dod 'dun bskyar ston byas pa yin/gnyan gyi snyan ngag gi yid khams(༵ṣ+ṭha)de 'tsho ba ngan ngon/ 'dir yi mug skye ba'am skyo gdung gi rjes su ma song bar kho rang nyid kyi myong tshor gyi rjes su song ba ni kho'i brjod bya'i rgya je che ru 'gro ba'i rgyu nyag gcig red zer chogamathong ba las dngos su nyams snang du shar ba phun sum tshogs shing gson nyams yod pas gong du brjod pa'i snyan ngag gi myong rtog ltar na snyan ngag ni myong snang phyi ru bud pa'i bsgrags gtam ci la min/da lta'i shes ldan pa kun gyi yid khams su thun mong gi yid gdung zhig yod pa ni rang gi gzhi khyim dang spun zla'i 'tsho ba ngan ngon/ klad pa rnying dul/byed stangs rdzob po bsgyur bcos kyi dka' khag de yin/ snyan ngag pa la mtshon na de las kyang thun min gyi myong rtog cig yod de/ de ni rang gi sems pa dmar po mtshon byed kyi snyug gu des rang gi sems khongs na 'bar ba'i me phreng — 190 —

thun min gyi myong rtog thun min gyi blos bslangs/las 'o dod dang ki 'bod/ mtshang 'byin dang bstod dbyangs kyi me stag tsha tsha bzhin 'phro bar byas te yid kyi mun pa sel thabs byed/ 'di las nga tshor rgyal pham gnyis kyi nam mkha' zhig bstan yod de/ dga' ba ni mgrin pa brnangs pa las grol ba ltar brjod 'dod snyan ngag la bcol chog la/ skyo 'os pa ni mgrin glu de 'gag sla ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin/ 'di ltar bltas na‘‘ngu shum’’dang‘‘ki 'bod’’kyi snyan ngag 'di dag sems khongs su nyal ba'i rmongs gnyid dkrogs byed kyi gsar brje zhig yin/gnyan gyi snyan deb〈ro langs〉la mtshon na yang de las ma 'das mod/'di'i nang lus kyi cha nas rang mos dang bcad ma/ lhug brjod kyi cha yod la/nang don gyi thad nas dungs pa'i 'bod brda dbyangs su gyer pa'am dungs brjod can yod pa dang / ngan mtshang rjen ston gyi cha'ang yod/ de las sngar gnas tshul 'chos kyi cha de gcer bur btang rjes dngos brjod kyi 'bri stangs dang / slar mtshon gyi 'bri stangs(r+sā7tshos+dza)mtshon don ston pa'i 'bri stangs kyis rang nyid kyi yid khong nas 'phyur ba'i skad cha dag phyir 'phos yod/nga tshos kho'i snyan rtsom〈sham bha lar 'gro ba〉dang〈ro langs〉〈rgyu 'bras lung ba〉〈mdog 'gyur ba'i bod pa tshang〉sogs kyi steng nas rtsom pa po'i yid dpyod las byung ba'i nang gi de nyid de phar cher gsal rtogs byung thub/ lhag par du〈bsam blo smyon pa〉dang〈mdog 'gyur ba'i nyin tho〉〈stong bsam gces bsdus〉〈'gul bzhin pa'i gangs ri〉〈mdog 'gyur ba'i bod pa tshang〉sogs kyi kha byang mthong ba tsam gyis klog pa po rnams la thog mar dmigs bsal gyi go ba zhig 'tshol rgyu yod de/ chos dang chos can gyi 'gal 'brel las med mug dang mu cor la sngog 'don gyi sen 'brad yang yang btang yod/ 'di las mthong thub pa ni rtsom pa pos snyan ngag la blos bslangs byed pa'i mtshon don da 191 da
