mu tig gling gi dga' ston/yang gzhi 'di'i steng nas tshugs yod zer chog la/ 'di las 'tsho gzhes kyi dus tshod yod tshad lhing 'jags dang 'khral 'khrul/ sos dal dang sgyid lug ma yin par ngar shed kyis khengs dgos pa mtshon thub/ deng skabs bod yul la lung kun na rdul 'tshub rlung sprugs lta bu'i snyan ngag gis khyab dus〈ro langs〉lta bus dngos gnas nga tsho la mun ljongs las bud pa'am la rtser bud pa lta bu'i dbugs dbyung bstsal yod/ nga tshos snyan deb 'di klog dus sha rtsa sgrim sgrim la 'dug dgos pa zhig ma yin par sgyu rtsal gyi myong ba 'di dag khrod nas cung lhod chog de ni kho'i snyan rtsom gyis nang don gsar pa dang rnam pa gsar pa'i rtsom rig gi khongs su lag pa bsrings ci thub byas te lad zlos dang rjes 'ded kyi shul tsam yang mthong rgyu med pas yin la/ 'di ni lhag par sems lhod chog pa zhig kyang red/〈sham bha lar 'gro ba〉dang 〈ro langs〉〈skal bzang lha mo〉sogs bklags dus‘‘smyon pa'i’’las dbang yang yang mthong byung ste‘‘gu dog dang rnying zhen mang drags pa ni smyon pa nyung ba'i rkyen gyis bslus’’zhes sam‘‘spyir na/mdzes sdug yod tshad( gtor bshig gis bslangs pa'i yid 'ong yin’’pas‘‘dus tshod thung thung nang( gtor zhing pham par bzo thub pa'i bsam blo pa ci tsam yod’’ces pa'i skad cha dag las ri sgul chu dkrugs lta bu'i byed dbang can gyi‘‘smyon pa’’mkho ba go thub/ 'di la rgyu mtshan nges can zhig go rgyu yod de blo 'byed(khrid+mo)kyi thog ma pa ni smyon pa'i gzugs su lta ba 'jig rten spyi ngos kyi 'char tshul lta bu zhig tu chags yod/ rtsom pa pos phi la tho yi bsam blo'i dar cha dang tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i snang srid bde sdug gi 'thab 'dzing mig ltos su bzhag nas yul snyan ngag gi drag brjid kyi mtshon don de bstan yod/'on kyang mtshon don de yongs su bsam blo'i blo shed che ba'i stag shar mang — 192 —

thun min gyi myong rtog thun min gyi blos bslangs/po'am glag rgod kyis sgrub pa zhig ma yin par ngang ring gshis 'jam gyi khrung khrung ngam phug ron la bcol te‘‘nga tsho lam la chas dus/ khrung khrung gis mdzub ston 'og('od snang khri phrag gi rab kha snyegs nas 'gro dgos’’zhes bkod yod/spyir‘‘khrung khrung’’dang‘‘sge'u khung’’ ‘‘kha par’’sogs mtshon don can gyi khyad gzhi gang yin rung snyan ngag rang steng la bzang mod kyi rma kha ci yang gtod rgyu min par rtsom pa po'i gting nas 'phyur ba'i tshor shes la rag las pa zhig yin mod/bem gzugs sam 'jags rnam gyi rnam par snang ba'i ro dang / gangs ri/nyin tho/ bod pa tshang sogs la langs pa dang / 'gul ba/ mdog 'gyur pa sogs 'gul med can de 'gul bcas can gyi gzugs su 'gyur pa'i snang tshul khyad par ba re skyes dus de nyid kyi byed lugs ni ya mtshar ba dang /dngangs skrag skye ba zhig ci nas yin nges snyam/ rgyu mtshan ni bya dngos yod tshad snyan ngag gis nga tshor ngo sprod byed dus de ni de'o snyam pa tsam gyis gtan nas mi tshad par de'i snang tshul las mi rnams ha las pa dang / ya mtshar ba/khong khro skye ba/ mchi mas brlan pa/ mya ngan skye ba sogs yid kyi gting du myong ba sna tshogs shig zhugs nges te/ de ni 'gul med de 'gul bcas su bsgyur pa'am/ bem gzugs de la srog dbang zhugs te nga tsho'i yid khong du 'gyur pa sna tshogs skyed pa de red/ snyan rtsom gyi nang du ngo mtshar skyed pa'i khyad chos gtso bo zhig ni 'di las 'byung ba yin te/ de ni 'dod yon lngas nga tshor slong ba'i ngo mtshar ram mdzes sdug cig min par yul gyi steng nas yul can pa la 'phrod pa'i mdzes sdug cig yin/ de gnyis sdeb kha legs por 'phrod rgyu ni snyan ngag yid du 'ong ba zhig 'grub pa'i rgyu rkyen gtso bo zhig yin la/ de bzhin yul de'i steng du kha gtad kyi gang zag gang yin gyi sems khams 'thim rgyu yang gnad yin/ 'on kyang snang tshul mang po zhig mi rnams kyi shes pa'i da 193 da

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/bag tu nyal ba'am shes tshor gyis zin med pa'i khongs su 'du bas mi rnams kyis de ma thag tu dang len byed dka'/ de ni phi la tho dang le tshu/ tshangs dbyangs pa/ dge chos sogs kyi gshis spyod ltar‘‘smyon pa'i byed stangs shig’’gam‘‘ya mtshar ba'i snang tshul zhig’’tu ngos 'dzin nges pas mtshams 'di la ci nas kyang gtor bshig drag 'ded kyis smyos shing brjod de skad cha skor zhig gnyom po'am ngang rgyud ring bor byung ba ni mi 'dang ba'i cha 'am ma tshang ba'i rgyu zhig red snyam/ khos de dag la bag lhod po dang sos dal ba'i skad cha gang mang bshad de ngang rgyud ring bo'i sgo nas mtshon par byas yod pas 'di las nga tshos mthong thub pa ni nang du tshe srog gi re sgug gnon dka' ba zhig gis sngon du 'ded bzhin yod na yang phyi na ngang ring dod lug gi skad cha re 'ga'i khyad chos shig mngon shas che 'dug de ni drag shed kyi yid brnyan de dag la dungs zhen gyi ljid kha che ba las mtshon stobs kyi dpung ba thung zer na mi spobs rgyu mi 'dug pa 'dra/gzhon rabs pa'i bsam gzhig gi snying stobs dang yid tshor 'gal 'brel gyi 'thab 'dzing mdun skyod kyi 'bod pa gtong ba'i chod sems bla lhag gis mtshon bzhin pa nas sems kyi rang 'od phyi na mngon par 'phros byung zhe na 'grig ste/ 'di las nga tshos kho'i‘‘brjod 'dod kyi 'od lam lam gyi skad chari’de dag ni brtan g.yo 'gyur med dang bab tshugs brjid bag can zhig yin pa lhag par tshor thub/ gang ltar yang 'tshol snyeg dang brjod 'dod kyi re 'bod thad nas langs te gsar pa nas spobs sems la rgyang glu blangs pa des nga tsho la gnyid tshod min pa'i tha tshig bsgrags pa yin/mdor na gnyan gyi snyan ngag gang la bltas kyang rang gis myangs pa'i 'tsho ba dang rang gi ma mar gyur pa la dungs pa'i sems pa dmar po de la — 194 —

thun min gyi myong rtog thun min gyi blos bslangs/brten nas phyi yul gyi lta tshul sna tshogs dang mdzes sdug ldan pa'i ma 'ongs par kha phyogs pa'i tshul mtshon yod pa ni nga rang〈ro langs〉klog mos che ba'i rgyu tshogs yin la/ spro ba'i brtas te rang gi bsam tshul gleng byed kyi grub cha yang yin/ 'on kyang‘‘snyan ngag ni bro ba sna mang can gyi sgyu rtsal zhig yin’’pa'i cha nas smras na bye brag pa'i 'bri stangs dang rnam pa/ nang don gang zhig kho'i khyad chos red ces tshig thag gcod mi spobs/ rgyu mtshan ni gnyan la mtshon na rang nyid kyi dmigs bsal sgyu rtsal bskrun yul zhig dang 'dun ma 'tshol snyeg gi 'gan 'khur 'du shes shig ci nas kyang yod nges/ 'on kyang kho'i klog pa po dkyus ma zhig byed rgyu'i dbang cha ni nga la yod pas sems lhod lhod kyis 'char snang gang dran 'don spel byed kyang los chog snyam/ de ni rtsom pa po dang nga'i bar la rtsom pa po dang klog pa po'i 'brel ba las kha lta grogs mched kyi bslu chos sra rnyi gang yang chags med pas nga rang ci nas klog pa po drang rkyang zhig dang / bsam tshul drang 'don gyi mi ser ngo ma zhig gi go sa na yod pa yin/snang tshul des ded de nga la rang dbang gi skad cha zhig bshad spobs skyes te/khye'u gzugs kyi bod kyi snyan ngag gam zhogs ljongs las ma bud pa'i bod kyi rtsom rig gsar pa'i las dbang la dmigs nas〈gzi mig dgu ba〉dang〈lang tsho'i mchod pa〉lta bu/ 〈sham bha lar 'gro ba〉dang〈ro langs〉lta bu'i snyan deb yang yang mkho la/ ci yang nyag phra ba'i bod kyi rtsom stegs 'di'i mdun lam gyi ched du smyon pa'i smyo langs dang / 'khums pa dang bag nyal las 'gal ba'i mdzad spyod ci nas kyang mkho zhes gnyan dang rtsom pa po grogs po yongs la zhu bar spobs/

‘‘ra lo'i’’snang brnyan dang 'brel ba'i gtam/gdugs dkar tshe ring /lo rabs brgyad cu par gangs ri'i ljongs su sgyu rtsal gsar pa'i myu gu 'bus pa nas bzung / sgrung gtam dang lhug rtsom/ snyan ngag zlos gar sogs rtsom stangs mang po/ dngos srid ring lugs dang 'char yan ring lugs/ deng rabs phyi ma'i ring lugs sogs mtshon thabs sna tshogs kyi brtsams chos gang mang byung dang 'byung bzhin 'dug de las kyang sgrung gtam la thun mong du dga' bsu thob la 'bras bu'ang g.yur du za ba blangs/de ni klog pa po zhig dang yang na bsam blo gsar pa'i dran skul mkho ba'i mi rigs shig la mtshon na ji 'dra'i dga' 'os pa zhig red/‘‘brtse dungs drag po ni mi yis rang nyid kyi re 'dun snyeg pa'i stobs shugs yin’’zhes pa ji bzhin/ tshe ring don grub kyi〈sgrung gtam thung 'bring phyogs bsgrigs〉dang kho'i sgrung ring〈mes po〉la bltas rjes/ kho'i skyes gzugs lang tsho ji ltar rdzogs pa ma mthong yang / nam yang mtho sgang du glu dang gar la rol ba'i yul mi der sha zhen zab la brtse sems drag cing /rtogs sad kyi mngal du skyo gdung sbrum zhing dran skul gyi mgrin pa gzengs su dod pa'i glu ba zhig gi glu sgra thos la/ kho'i rgyang ring du mched pa'i glu sgra de'i rkyen bdag sems su nam yang‘‘ra lo’’zhes pa'i don spyi zhig yang dang bskyar du — 196 —

‘‘ra lo'i’’snang brnyan dang 'brel ba'i gtam/'khor/ ‘‘rgyab dro/ pho rgyag sems skyid’’sa de nas kho bsam gzhig gi lam la chas shing rtogs sad kyi sgron me sbar ched mun pa ches mthug sar 'dzul/(spyi tshogs kyi sems khams la dpyad pa) ‘‘ra lor’’gzugs che ba ma gtogs shugs mi che ba'i rkyen gyis/ khos mi'i stobs shugs ngo ma ni ci zhig yin pa yongs su tshor/ de'i rkyen gyis‘‘'thab ra'i ches dngangs shing skrag pa'i dus ni bo'u skad med pa'i mtshan mo yin pa’’ji bzhin/ kho'ang yul 'di'i lhing 'jags kyi 'tsho bar dngangs skrag gis khengs/byung rim mdor bsdus/ra los rang gi a pha su yin mi shes la rjes su a pha zhig yong ba des kho la ka ra gcig kyang mi nyo bar ma zad/ ra los g.yag sna ma thub par a pha des 'gram lcag gcig dang bcas ma bu gnyis ka bskyur/ de'i rjes su a ma shi bas sde ba'i mi bsam shes 'gas kho slob grwar bskyal/ slob grwa nas ka mad sum cu yang ma shes par nyi ma 'khyol thabs kyis lo mang por bsdad par/mthar lo che drags nas slob grwa nas phud/ de nas gang sar 'khyams te khyim tshang zhig nas g.yog byas shing / rim gyis mag par gyur mod/ kho'i sgyid lug de'i rkyen gyis gzhan la mi srid pa'i brnyas bcos te kho'i chung mar mag pa gzhan zhig bzhag nas kho bda'/de nas 'khyams par dgon pa zhig tu slebs nas rab tu byung / grwa sa nas las rgyu med par sun nas mtshan mo grong la myul zhing / grong nas mo rkyang zhig dang 'phrad pas de dang khyim bcas/ yang kho'i sgyid lug de'i rkyen gyis chung ma skyes pa gzhan zhig gi rjes su bros/ yang kher rkyang du 'khyam bzhin pa'i sa srod cig la mo rkyang zhig dang 'phrad/ mi rnams kyis de ni ra lo'i a — 197 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/ma'i rnam shes red zer/ gang ltar ra lo bu mo dang 'grogs pa nas kho'i sgyid lug gi gshis ngan yong su dor la chang yang bcad de/ kho gnyis kyis dgod sgras khengs pa'i 'tsho ba gsar pa zhig gi mgo brtsams/ 'on kyang bu mo des gnyen rtseg sgrig gi nyes pa bsags pas khrims khang du zla drug la 'jug dgos byung / bu mo de 'gro zhor‘‘ra lo sems ma pham/ zla drug 'gor rgyu sla mo red/ nga nam yang khyed kyi yin’’ ra los kyang‘‘khyod kyi sems bde mo byos/ ngas khyed la bsgugs nas 'dug’’zer/ 1 gnas bab kyi thad/'dzam gling gi yul rtsod kyi 'thab 'khrug 'jags rjes dpal 'byor gyi 'thab 'khrug langs shing / dpal 'byor gyi 'thab 'khrug ma 'jags gong la 'du shes kyi 'thab 'khrug kyang langs bzhin pa'i dus skabs 'dir/ khos(rtsom pa po)'thab 'khrug ni khyod shi nga gson gyi las shig dang‘‘nyam chung ni 'jig rten na 'dug sa ye nas med pa’’gsal bor mthong bas/ kho mu mtha' bral ba'i rtswa thang gi dkyil dang sos dal bag phebs kyi 'tsho ba de'i khrod du langs nas/ rta gong na 'gying ba'i stag shar dang bzho dbyangs khrod 'dzum pa'i gzhon nu ma/ gyod kha na rgod pa'i rgan po dang rtse ra na spro ba'i byis pa/da rung grong gseb dang grong rdal/ dgon sde dang slob grwa gang sa gang du gzhigs kyang / dwa phrug snabs kha zhig dang de'i 'jig rten chung chung las ci yang ma mthong / de na rtsom rig ni dus rabs shig gi me long yin nam/ ko ku le'i〈rnam shes shi bo〉ni dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i hra hong u go'i bzo pa gral rim dang lu'u zhun gyi〈a0yi byung ba〉ni dus rabs nyi shu pa'i dus 'go'i krung go'i zhing bran mi dmangs yin na/ 〈ra lo〉ni dus rabs nyi shu pa'i dus — 198 —

‘‘ra lo'i’’snang brnyan dang 'brel ba'i gtam/mjug gi gangs ri'i ljongs kyi ci zhig yin srid dam/spyir rtsom rig ni spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba tshur snang byed pa zhig yin/ de ni rtsom pa po 'tsho ba'i zur gang zhig nas langs te 'tsho ba'i snang tshul so so rang nyid kyi rtogs pa'i zhib las brgyud de sngar bas gson nyams dod pa'i sgos tshur ston pa zhig yin/ de na kho zur gang nas langs te 'tsho ba'i snang tshul ji 'dra zhig ston gyi yod/ pha med pa'i steng la ma yang shi bas/ 'tsho ba rang mgo mi thub pa ma zad sna mdo'i snabs kyang bdag mi thub pa'i ra lo/ skyabs bcol sa dang yid brten sa med pa'i 'jig rten du kher rkyang du lus shing /'dzul sa'i khung dang 'dug sa'i gnas med pa'i lo zla de'i mgo brtsams pa nas zas kham gang dang gos mtho gang gi ched du 'dur bzhin pa'i mi hreng zhig nga tsho'i(klog pa po)grogs su sprad/ skabs 'gar snying rje skyes skabs 'gar khong khro yang langs su 'jug pa'i ra lo/ nga tshos kho 'tsho ba'i snang tshul gang gi tshab dang zur gang zhig nas langs su 'jug lu'u zhun gyis‘‘sgrung gtam gyi mi sna'i gshis kar mthong chen bya dgos pa ma zad/ mi sna de 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi mngon tshul dang 'tsho ba'i 'gyur ldog gis mi sna der thebs pa'i shugs rkyen la de bas mthong chen bya dgos’’zer ba bzhin/ sgrung gtam 'di'i khrod‘‘ra lo’’la bzhengs pa'i 'jig rten chung chung dang kho'i thob shor/ skyid sdug bsam sbyor bcas su de lta'i khyad chos gsal bo zhig mngon pa tshor thub/rtsom pa po dus rabs gnyis kyi mtshams su langs te phyi bltas dang rgyang lta zung du sbrel bzhin bsam gzhig bgyis mthar/ khos nga tshor ci zhig med pa dang ci zhig mkho ba yongs su mthong nas/ nam yang 'das pa'i gzi brjid sems su drangs nas 'tsho ba ngan ngon la tshim zhing ma 'ongs par mgo bo rmongs la re bas stong ba'i dus rabs gcig gi yul mi de dag me long gi mdun sar da 199 da

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/bskyal nas rang nyid kyi ngo gdong 'tshol bar bcug2 snang brnyan gyi skor/sgrung gtam 'dis gtam rgyud kyi byung rim zur du bzhag ste mi sna gcig gtsigs su bzung la/ de mtshon stobs yod pa'i don rkyen 'ga' dang sbyar nas mi sna'i gshis ka dang bsam blo/ shes rgya bcas rgyun ldan gyi 'gro 'dug nyal 'chag gi spyod lam las mngon par byas/ spyir mi ni gzugs dang shes pa dbyer med du 'dres pa'i phung sum pa zhig dang / de ni rnam shes lus la brten cing lus ni rnam shes kyis skyong bas yin/ rtsom pa pos kyang mi zhig ji ltar 'tsho ba'i rtsa ba ni‘‘rnam shesari’yin pa gzhi byas te/ ‘‘ra lor’’'tsho ba'i khrod nas thun min gyi rnam shes yod pa mngon du bcug pa/ kher rkyang / nyam nga ba/ mun 'thom mo/ /(1)kher rkyang gi rnam shes/ gal srid mi zhig kher rkyang du(rnam shes)'gyur dus mi de'i rin thang dang go gnas gang nas kyang / yang na rang gis gzhan bskyur ba yin/ de min na gzhan gyis rang bskyur ba yin/ rtsom pa pos mi sna'i‘‘rnam shes’’kher rkyang du 'jug ched/ thog ma nas spyi tshogs dang 'brel ba gcod pa'i las brtsams/spyir‘‘ra lo’’la pha zhig yod srid la yod kyang dgos mod/ ‘‘khyod kyi a pha su yin’’ ‘‘a ma/ nga'i a pha su red’’ces‘‘pha’’zhes ngag thengs dang por brdol bar a mas 'gram lcag tsha thag chod cig gzhus pa dang / rjes su‘‘pha'i tha snyad sbyor yul zhig yod pa des kyang’’khyod la pha zhig gang na yod ces yang 'gram lcag tsha thag chod cig gzhus pas/ ‘‘pha’’de gsang ba lkog gyur gyi bar snang du da 200 da

‘‘ra lo'i’’snang brnyan dang 'brel ba'i gtam/'thims/ ‘‘ra lorari’pha zhig yod pa'i skyid phar zhog tha na‘‘pha’’zhig yod na snyam pa'i 'dun ma de'ang med par/ ‘‘ra lo'i’’sems kyi 'jig rten a mas yongs su bzung / ‘‘ra lo’’la a ma ma gtogs gnyen nye gcig kyang med mod 'chi bdag gis de la snying rje gang nas sgom/ de ltar‘‘ra lo'i’’sems kyi gshin sar a pha'i myu gu 'bus su ma bcug pa ma zad/ kho'i dgra nyen 'jigs skyob dang mkho longs spyod sbyin mkhan gyi ma lo'ang phyi mar brdzangs te/ ‘‘ra lo'i’’byis dus kyi bde skyid dang 'char sgo yongs su bcom nas tshe gang bo'i mdun lam la skya thig btab cing‘‘rnam shes kher rkyang’’du lus par rmang rdo btings/‘‘ra los’’kho'i rus pa dkar po'i bdag po mi shes pa ma zad ka ra gcig kyang mi nyo ba'i pha g.yar des kyang bskyur rjes/ ‘‘phari’de kho'i mi tshe'i thog ma nas gsang bar gyur la/ de bzhin‘‘pho’’la yang nges cha bral bas/ kho'i gshis rgyud kyi khrod du‘‘stag shar gyi snying stobs’’sam rnam shes kyi srog shing de chags ma thub/ tha na‘‘a'’’lta bu'i sems kyi rgyal kha de'ang med par pham kha yod tshad rang nyid kyis bsus/ yang tshig snyan po dang lag 'jam pos skyong ba'i skyabs gcig pu‘‘ma lo’’yang kho dang gtan du gyes pas/ khos 'tsho ba'i snying bo de bde skyid 'tshol ba'i dmigs yul la nges pa med cing / rang la 'tshams pa'i 'tsho stangs dang gnas yul ngo ma zhig rnyed ma thub/ kho rang‘‘pha ma’’gnyis kyis bskyur ba 'jig rten 'di'i mi yongs kyis bskyur ba dang 'dra bar/ slob grwakhyim tshang / dgon pa sogs 'tsho ba gsar pa'i go skabs re re'i khrod nas mgo bo smad bzhin phyir thon la khyer rkyang du lus pas/ 'jig rten 'dir khos lcogs pa'i las shig dang kho mkho ba'i mi zhig med par 'tsho bas kho la sgo mo yongs su brgyab/

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/(2)nyam nga'i rnam shes/‘‘'jig rten gyi ches che ba'i stobs shugs ni snying stobs yin/’’ rtsom pa pos rno lcags lta bu'i sra mkhregs kyi snying stobs shig mkho ba rtogs la/ nyams rgud kyi 'byung rtsa ni snying stobs nyams pa yang shes/ de'i rkyen gnas lugs de gsal rjen du ston ched/ rtsom pa pos‘‘ra lo’’la gzugs che ba ma gtogs shugs mi che ba shes su bcug ‘‘nyam nga ba'i rnam shes’’de'i rkyen gyis pham kha kho na las rgyal kha zhig phar zhog tha na ngo rgol gyi mig log gcig kyang med par mchi ma dang pham kha'i khrod nyam chung nus med kyi ngang tshul bstan/ kho las lo bdun gyi chung ba'i slob ma zhig gis kho rang kha sbubs su mnan nas zhon skabs su khos dge rgan la gtugs pa dang kho'i g.yag rin gyi ral ba bal rjes rna gcod par skrag nas myur du bros pa/ chung ma gzhan gyis phrogs rjes snabs 'drud bzhin khrims khang la song ba sogs las/ kho rang 'tsho ba'i khrod na thabs zad 'u thug gis 'tsho bzhin pa shes la nyam nga ba'i rnam shes de'ang mthong thub/‘‘ra los’’tshig gcig mi bshad la gom gang ma spos kyang kho ni 'khos chung nus med cig yin pa rtogs thub/ de ni‘‘lha sku'i phyag mtshan’’gyis lha de ni zhi rgyas dbang drag gi lha ci zhig yin pa mtshon bzhin/ rtsom pa pos kho'i sha gseng rus gseng na 'thims pa'i rnam shes de phyir gsal bor mngon ched/‘‘snabs ring zhing sbom pa’’zhig kho'i sna mgor 'byar ba‘‘'jam dbyangs phyag gi ral gri’’dang mtshungs/ spyir btang mi zhig gog nur nas lang tsho rgyas shing de nas rgas 'chi'i bar gyi brgyud rim la rtags mtshan mi 'dag gsal bo re yod/'on kyang‘‘ra lo’’nar ji ltar son na snabs kyang de ltar sbom pas‘‘o ya mi zhig yod na khyi yi gong ma’’dang‘‘ra lo/ khyod kyis a ma pang la bzung nas 'gro — 202 —

6‘ra lo'i’’snang brnyan dang 'brel ba'i gtam/ba yin nam’’zhes pa kho'i snabs de dang dam por 'brel/mi sna'i snang brnyan ni gtso bo mi'i phyi'i skyes gzugs dang nang sems kyi 'phro 'du zhib bris brgyud de 'bri bzhengs byas pa zhig yin/ rtsom pa pos ra lo'i snang brnyan la gson nyams rgyas su 'jug ched/ pham kha re re'i khrod du kho'i snabs kyang mngon gsal du dod nas phyi nang tshad mthon pos zung du sbrel ba/ ‘‘ra ngan snabs lugs 'dis g.yag sna zhig kyang 'dzin mi thub’’zer bzhin ra lor 'gram lcag tsha bo gnyis gzhus nas snabs de ma ne'i mgo nas brang kha'i bar 'drud du bcug ‘‘ad dge rgan zer bzhin ngus nas mig chu snabs dang 'dres shing snabs steng la sa rdul 'byar te ’’zhes cho btsog nus med kyi snang brnyan gsal bor bzhengs/(3)mun 'thom gyi rnam shes/ches gsal ba'i 'od zer ni sems kyi 'od zer dang ches gnag pa'i mun pa'ang sems kyi mun pa yin/ ‘‘ra lor’’ngo tsha dang skyo gdung / 'khang ra ci yang med par pham kha khur don kho'i sems su mtshan mo las stug pa'i mun pa zhig 'khyil bas yin/ mun pa de stug drags pas gzhan dang rang nyid su yang ma mthong bas/ 'dug sa'i gnas shig dang 'gro sa'i lam zhig ma rnyed par/ rgyab grang dus dang pho ltogs dus da gzod yid la dran rgyu dang sems la 'char rgyu zhig byung nas 'tshol snyeg gi gom pa spo ba de ni‘‘khyi ldom’’zhig dang yongs su mtshungs/ ‘‘ra los sde ba mang po zhig brgyud pa dang khyim tshang mang po zhig nas bsdad/ khyim tshang la las kho la‘‘song’’zer nas ded pa dang la la nas kho rang 'gul gyis bud 'gro’’khos de ltar dmigs pa dang re ba ci yang med par 'tsho ba bskyal bas/ kho'i 'tsho ba'i 'dod pa yod tshad sems can — 203 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/phal ba'i 'dod pa las ma 'das/‘‘ra lo'i’’mun 'thom gyi rnam shes kyi ngos gcig ni kho'i sgyid lug gi rang gshis de yin/ rtsom pa pos‘‘ra lo'i’’sgyid lug gi rang gshis gsal bor mngon ched/ 'tsho ba'i go skabs gsar pa re re'i khrod du kho'i nus pas lcogs la re ba yang che ba'i las gang legs shig bstsal rjes/ slar yang kho'i sgyid lug gi myu gu 'bus su bcug nas bya ba yod tshad kyi lam sna mar la drangs/‘‘ra lo’rislob sbyong la shin tu bzang ste/ slob grogs sus kyang ka mad sum cu blor ma zin gong la ra los thog mar blor zin pas dge rgan gyis tshang mas‘‘ra lor’’slob sbyong byos zer/ 'on kyang rjes su tshang mas‘‘ra lor’’slob sbyong byed mi rung gsungs/ de bzhin dgon pa dang rang khyim/ mag yul bcas gang nas kyang thog mar hur brtson byas la rim bzhin sgyid lug gi nad rnying slar yang 'phar bas yod tshad re re bzhin shor/ sgyid lug de'i rkyen‘‘ra lo’’ni chu khar g.yeng ba'i rtswa skya bzhin 'tsho ba'i 'jings zab sar zhugs ma thub/‘‘ra los’’yi ge ma shes la chos kyang ma shes/ tha na rang nyid la khyim med pa dang ldom po zhig yin pa'ang don dngos su ma shes/ de ni‘‘ra lo’’rgyab grang dus pho ltogs dus khyim tshang su la so nga yang / dang thog rang 'gul gyis las ce ka las pa dang zog 'tsho ru 'gro ba yin/ cung ma 'gor bar khos rang nyid kyi rtsa ba yongs su brjed nas skad cha bshad skabs su'ang‘‘ad wa'o’’ ‘‘de 'dra yin nam’’ ‘‘ya mtshan’’ ‘‘go ma myong ya’’ ‘‘gna' mi bod kyi gtam dpe la’’zhes mi gsar pa zhig gi tshul gyis langs pa dang / khor sngar med kyi snying stobs chen po zhig dang rig pa gsar pa ci yang rgyas pa min par/ rang gzhan su yang ma rtogs pa'i mun pa'i khrod nas rang nyid bor ba yin/ ‘‘gzhan na mi dpe ba'i brnyas bcos’’de'i rjes su thad kar thog ma'i nyam chung nus med kyi — 204 —

‘‘ra lo'i’’snang brnyan dang 'brel ba'i gtam/rang gshis de phyir 'bud/ ‘‘ra lo’’'tsho ba gsar pa gang mang zhig dang 'phrad kyang go skabs re rer brtsi mthong dang brtson pa mi byed par shor tu bcug pa ma zad/ khos nam yang / ‘‘rang nyid kha sang gang nas yong ba dang sang nyin gang la 'gro bar’’bsam gzhig byas ma myong bas/ slob chung nas slob mthar phyin ma thub la mag par bsdad nas a pha yang byed ma thub/ dgon pa'i tshogs skal shor la khyim gyi chung ma'ang 'phrogs/ tha na kho gla ba ngo ma zhig kyang byed ma thub/ ci yang bsgrubs la ci yang ma 'grub pa ni kho'i kher rkyang / nyam nga / mun 'thom gyi rnam shes de las gzhan ci/3 myong tshon/rtsom po pos mi rigs hūṃdi'i snying rtsa la myong dus/ ‘‘nag dreg chags pa'i’spo rgyus kyi ngo gdong zhig las‘‘drag tu mchong ba'i dus rabs kyi snying gson po’’zhig ma tshor/ mi rigs 'di dpal 'byor gyi steng nas lto skya gos hrul nas rgyab dro pho rgyags dang / rig gnas kyi steng nas nyams rgud rtsa med nas yar dar gyi bskal ba zhig thob pa ste/ lo rgyus kyi char rlung gis yun ring gtses par dus rabs kyi nyi brer zhig 'phros pas/ ngal dub kyi rnam shes kyis mdun skyod kyi gom kha je dal du btang la‘‘bo'u skad’’med pa'i 'thab 'khrug gi(dpal 'byor dang rig gnas/ 'du shes)na zug ma tshor bar lhags pas/ rtsom pa pos 'bod skul min pa'i 'bod skul zhig btang ba yin/‘‘ra lo’’slob grwa nas kha rgyab kho na'i ched du brnyas bcos kyi khrod mgo bo bsgur nas slob grwas bda' rag bar bsdad pa dang rjes su khyim tshang nas mag par gyur la pho ba rgyags rjes su snang ba je mthor song nas bda' ba/ yang rjes su dgon pa nas kha rgyab la 'dang rgyag med mod/ grwa pa gzhan gyi tshul — 205 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/min gyi spyod lam mthong bas rab tu byung bar rgyu mtshan mi 'dug bsam nas grwa log byas pa sogs sgrung gtam hril bo'i bya ba re re'i khrod du pham kha khur mod/‘‘ra lor’’tshad mi 'dra ba'i shes rtogs kyi myu gu thar thor re rgyas bzhin 'dug la/ ches mjug mthar stes dbang zhig gis kho'i gshis ngan dor cing 'tsho bar re bas khengs su bcug pas/ ‘‘ra lo'i’’kher rkyang dang / nyam nga / mun 'thom gyi rnam shes de skyob thabs bral ba zhig min pa bstan/‘‘slob ma'i dus’’dang‘‘mag par 'dug dus’’ ‘‘grwa pa byas dus’’ ‘‘mjug mtha'i khyim gzhi rnyed dus’’bcas so so'i khrod du ra lor yang tha dad pa'i 'tsho stangs re yod pas‘‘kho mi gcig min par bye brag pa'i mi so so ba’’yin kyang srid la/ yang khos kher rkyang dang nyam chung / rmongs rtul gyi cha de nam yang 'dor ma thub par pham kha khur bas‘‘spyi gzugs’’shig kyang yin chogamador na/ ‘‘ra lo’’ni lo rgyus kyi dkyogs mtshams dang dus rabs kyi 'gag phreng du bag la zha ba'i mi rigs 'di'i thun mong gi‘‘sems gzugs’’su nges zur lta'i dpyad gzhi'i yig cha/1 〈sdod+kulo0〉9༄102 〈spratshiṣ+ṭhakā skye〉tsho⑫zortsarma lkoze'i)/yo skyarkistsatsheglone+elku 1kro8lho3 (jir+halkolko〉ṣ+ṭhakhaṣālholkormyo lo 'irkitshi.oṃṭharnyekre 1glu3lho4 〈bod kyi rtsom rig gsar pa'i brtsams chos bdams bkod dang de dag gi bshad pa〉bdud lha rgyal gyis sgrig rtsom byas/ kan su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang /1kro8lo'i par/

‘‘sems chunge sde ba'i’’bsam gzhig than thun/da wasman bla skyabs kyi kha shags la nyan pa'i myong tshor/tshe ring rdo rje/dang po/ brjod bya spyi/bod kyi kha shags ni byung rim khrod skad cha'i sgyu rtsal gyi rnam pa zhig dang rgya che ba'i bod rigs mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba dngos las byung ba sha stag yin pas/ der nang don phun sum tshogs shing / rtsom stangs sna mang la/ dus da ltar ngag thog dang yig thog gnyis ka nas dar che/yig thog ste 'khrab gzhung gi cha nas mdo dbus khams gsum gyi kha shags phan tshun brda sprod mi thub pa med na'ang / ngag thog brgyud skabs yul skad so so'i dbang gis dbus skad dang / khams skad/ am skad so sor grub yod pa las/ 'di ched dmigs kyis am skad thad kyi kha shags sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos la cung zad dpyad na/ de ni ngag thog dang yig thog gnyis sbrags kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom zhig gi tshul du thon yod la/ nga tshos ma gros gcig mthun gyis sman bla skyabs kyi kha shags dpe mtshon can du 'jog nges yin/ de la rgyu rkyen med pa ma yin te/ sman bla skyabs kyi kha shags kyi bod rigs mi dmangs kyi mi lo stong phrag du ma'i ring la 'tsho gnas kyi cha rkyen ha cang zhan pa'i mtho sgang gi kha ba bu yug gi khrod du dka' ngarjo du2 ḍi7 khyan+d+ra du

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/bsad nas/ sdug cing sems 'phreng ba'i gnas 'di nas mi rabs tsha rgyud spel ba dang / rang cag gi mes po tshos rang byung khams dang yun ring 'thab rtsod byas pa'i brgyud rim dang nyams myong gi shes bya phyogs bsdus byas par ma zad/ de las gtsigs che ba zhig ni nga tsho la nam yang bde thang dang spro snang gis khengs pa'i sems khams shig gnang ba de yin/spyir sman bla skyabs kyis sgrung gtam dang snyan ngag sogs rtsom rig gsar rtsom thad kyi rtsom rtsal de dag gzhi byas thog 'tsho ba dngos su zab 'jug gis/ bod mi'i thabs chag gi 'tsho ba'i nang / dpa' ngar zhum med dang dka' spyad sdug nus kyis rang byung dang 'thab rtsod byas pa/ 'tsho rten longs spyod dang thon skyed yo byad sogs gsar skrun byas pa'i shes bya gsog 'jog dang nyams myong sdud len/ de'i brgyud rim khrod kyi tan tan gi dga' skyo chags sdang gi bsam blo'i 'gyur pa sogs mig gis mthong tshad dang rna bas thos tshad kha bde lce bde'i bar nas/ dgod bro zhing ngo mtshar ba'i ngag gi dpal phun sum tshogs pa'i dpe ru bla lhag tu mngon yod pas/ dmangs khrod du brtsi mthong dang dga' po cher byas shing / nga tsho la ha cang‘‘rgyus mnga' che ba'i’’dpe mtshon gyi mi sna dang bya dngos de dag gsong bor mi rnams kyis‘‘mthong thos’’kyi yul du gyur pa na yid sems dbang med du 'phrog pas/ nyan mkhan la nyan spro ba dang / 'bru dag cing don go bde ba sogs su lhug por grol ba red/gnyis pa/ byung rim dang 'phel phyogs/dus da lta'i bar sman bla skyabs kyis kha shags sum cu la nye ba bshad yod pa de dag las skor zhig kha shags ched bsgrigs kyi tshul du sgra thag bzhi ru — 208 —

‘‘sems chung sde ba'i’’bsam gzhig than thun/bkod yod la/ rim pa so so'i bstan don yang rnam pa mi 'dra ba'i spyi tshogs 'tsho ba so so nas thon pas/ de la dus rim bzhi ru dbye chog ste/ dus rim dang po ni dus rabs nyi shu pa'i lo rabs brgyad cu'i snga gzhug tu byung ba'i sgra thag〈kha shags snying bsdus〉dang de'i sngon gyi kha shags dag gis mtshon yod la/dus rim de ni bod rang nyid la mtshon na spyi tshogs gsar pa'i go rtogs kyi smyu gu 'bus 'go brtsams pa yin la/ phyogs so so'i spyi tshogs las sgo mi 'dra bar zhugs 'go brtsams ma thag yin pas/ phyogs gang thad nas kyang 'thus sgo tshang ba'i rig pa gsar pa zhig byung med la/ yod tshad tshod bgam pa'i dus rim zhig tu chags yod pas/ sman bla skyabs kyi kha shags(sgra thag la phab med)kyang las sgo gsar pa'i rnam pa zhig gi tshul du thon yang khong gi rjes kyi kha shags dang bsdur na sgyu rtsal dang dgongs don gang gi thad nas bltas na'ang gleng rin de tsam med/ 'on kyang〈kha shags snying bsdus〉zhes pa'i sgra thag de dang de'i sngon gyi kun khyab rlung 'phrin nas btang ba'i kha shags tshang mar rong 'brog pa mang tshogs kyis dga' bsu chen po thob pa ni sman bla skyabs kyis mu mthud du kha shags gsar rtsom thad 'bad 'bungs byed nges pa'i sgul shugs gtso bo red/ bdag dang 'brel ba'i khyim tshang gi bya ba tsag tsig (〈bza' zla〉dang〈mna' ma〉gnyis kyis mtshon)nas khor yug phan tshun bar gyi 'brel ba/ mi sger bdag dbang do dam nas mi nyam chung skor zhig gi las dbang la sems khur bya ba'i bsam blo'i 'pho 'gyur/ 'di ni sman bla skyabs kyi kha shags spyi'i 'phel rim khrod mngon gsal du thon yod/ spyi tshogs gsar rnying dang bsam blo gsar rnying bar sogs kyi 'gal 'du de dag ni spyi tshogs grub byed kyi rgyu ru gyur yod de/ ‘‘'jig rten gyi 'tsho ba ma tshar na 'jig rten gyi rtsod pa ra tshar ni ma red’’ces pa bzhin/ spyi tshogs kyi 'brel ba che chung gang zhig yin yang — 209 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/'gal 'du'i phung bo zhig tu grub yod pas/ 'phrul chas bzo skrun phyogs nas sa cha dang sa cha/ yul phan tshun bar/ yul skad phan tshun bar/ sgang gshong gi khyad par/ rang 'brog pa'i bar sogs 'gal 'du'i stong gsob bkra ba dang / lhag par sman pa dang nad pa'i bar gyi 'gal 'du(〈'di rmi lam yin nam〉zhes pas ma tshon)lta bur mtshon na/ spyir nad pa'i phyogs kyi langs phyogs gcig tu song na 'grig mod/ 'on kyang‘‘phyogs khag’’de'i khrod du'ang rong 'brog gi 'tsho ba'i rgyab ljongs mi 'dra ba'i rkyen gyis rig gnas mi 'dra ba gnyis thon yod/ der 'gal 'du 'byung ba'i rtsa ba'ang phan tshun gyi 'tsho ba'i goms gshis la cha rgyus de tsam med pa dang / 'brog pa las rong ba rig pa gsal ba'i dgod bro ba'i lta ba des‘‘'brog pa li men la'e(tshokhrolko)’’zhes dang / ‘‘'brog pa da 'brog pa red ya’’zhes pa lta bu'i bye brag tu 'brog pa la zur za dang 'phya dmod byed pa'i rong ba'i bsam blo dgod bro ba tshig zur gyis mngon par thon yod/ 'di ni mi'i rang gshis las grub pa'i bdag gi lta tshul mchog 'dzin dang / ‘‘gzhan bas bdag gces’’kyi bsam blo nyid yin/〈lha sar 'gro〉dang〈'tshol〉zhes pa'i sgra thag gnyis snga rjes su thon la/skabs thog de la sman bla skyabs kyi kha shags sna gcig pu ma zad/ rim gyis zlos gar kha shags kyi lam du zhugs 'go brtsams pa dang / 〈lha sar 'gro〉dang〈lham nyo ba〉〈'di rmi lam yin nam〉bcas kyis rong 'brog sa khul nas thon pa'i‘‘rong 'brog rgan pa tshos’’grong khyer gyi 'gro lugs mi shes na yang / bya dngos re re la rang rang gi tshad shin tu dma' ba'i go ba len stangs re chags yod tshul dang / dgod bro ba'i bsam gzhig las thon pa'i dgod bro ba'i sbyor ba sna tshogs/ grong khyer du 'tsho sdod byed bzhin pa'i bod kyi na gzhon‘‘yon tan pa’’de dag dang gzhung drang zhing ngang rgyud ring ba'i‘‘rong 'brog rgan po'i’’— 210 —

‘‘sems chung sde ba'imi bsam gzhig than thun/bar sogs kyi 'gal zla de nyid gsal rjen du bstan yod/ lhag par du〈'di rmi lam yin nam〉zhes pa'i zlos gar kha shags de brjod bya dang rjod byed gang gi thad nas kyang sgyu rtsal gyi rin thang shin tu mtho ba'i tshad du slebs yod de/'brog pa zhig dang rong ba zhig gi mi sna bzhengs skrun byas pa brgyud nas/sman pa dang de dag gi bar du byung ba'i 'thab rtsod ni‘‘sngon thon’’dang‘‘rjes lus’’bar gyi 'thab rtsod yin la/ 'thab rtsod 'di nyid 'gal ba ltag sprod kyi tshul du thon yang / tshig dang yig 'bru'i bar nas‘‘sngon thon’’dang‘‘rjes lus’’kyi tshad thig gi dbye ba de‘‘sngon thon pa’’dag la'ang mi mnga' bar bstan yod la/gnas lugs so mar snyeg mkhan zhig yin phyir/ sus kyang bsnyon med du bsngags 'os par bstan yod/gsum pa/ sgrig gzhi dam pa/kha shags ni lo rgyus kyi me long dang dus rabs kyi zin bris yin zhes pa ltar/ dus skabs de'i spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i goms srol dang / mi'i kun spyod kyi 'du shes/ sems khams gnas stangs/ mi chos 'brel ba/ bsam blo'i gtad so sogs mtshon gyi yod/ de dag brjod snying du byas pa'i kha shags ni rnam pa'i steng nas gad mo slong byed cig tu ngos 'dzin pas/ kha shags sgyu rtsal la skad cha'i sgyu rtsal dang bzhad gad kyi sgyu rtsal zhes kyang 'bod/ de nyid spro gar gyi gras su gtogs kyang brjod bya'i thad nas dngos yod ring lugs pa'i shan zhugs pa phyogs che bas/ de yang mtha' gcig tu ja kha chang kha'i dgod kha'i tshul du mi 'gro bar/ ku re'i rgyab kyi bsam blo de ni tshad mtho ba'i skad cha'i sgyu rtsal gyi las snon brgyud nas mi sems sgul ba'i rba rlabs ltar yang yang du 'phyur 'ongs/ sman bla skyabs kyi‘‘rtog bzo rdzun ma’’de dang kha thag mi — 211 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/ring ba'i‘‘dngos yod bden pa’’de las kha shags kyi ro myong mkhan nga tsho la smra mi shes pa'i zug gzer dang bcas yid sems skyo bo zhig tu chags par 'gyur ba ni sman bla skyabs kyis brjod par 'dod pa'i bsam blo rnal ma de nyid yin/rab btags dang rtog bzo/ bzhad gad kyi byed thabs la brten nas brjodacibya de nyid kyang phyogs bsdus can dang bden par snang ba ni‘‘rdzun las bden mthong’’dang / ‘‘bden rdzun’’gnyis ka gcig la gcig rten gyi tshul du gnas pa'i sgyu rtsal rtsod sgrub rig pa bla lhag tu mngon par thon yod/ 'di la rigs gnyis su dgar chog ste/(gcig) ‘‘bden pa’’la brten nas‘‘rtog bzo’’byung ba ste‘‘rtog bzo'i thad nas’’rab btags dang bzhag gad chen pos smras kyang / mi sna'i gshis ka dang khor yug ni don dngos las byung ba kho thag yin pa dper na/ 〈 lham nyo ba〉las 'brog pa rgad po zhig gis lham nyo skabs mi ngo ma dang rdzun ma(las ma)gnyis 'khrul ba lta bu ni nga tsho rong 'brog khul nas grong khyer la thog dang por yong mkhan dag gi 'tsho bar dngos su 'byung thub pa lta bu'o/ / de bzhin‘‘rtog bzo’’des‘‘bden pa'i’’tshab byed thub pa ste/ 'tsho bar dngos su zab 'jug dang dpe mtshon can du phyogs bsdus byas pa brgyud nas/ bye brag gis spyi 'dren pa dang / phyi ngos nas gting slog pa las/ ‘‘rtog bzo’’de ru ma 'dus pa med cing / de las ston mi thub pa'i gnas lugs med pa bzhin/de ru 'tsho ba'i snang tshul yod tshad 'dus yod la/ 'tsho ba'i ngo bo gsal bar ston thub pas/ sgyu rtsal snang brnyan gyi steng nas 'phya dmod dang rgol gtam gnyis kyi khyad par gsal bar phye yod/(gnyis) mi sna'i bya spyod la‘‘rtog bzori’byed chog kyang / mi sna'i bya spyod de la brten pa'i dpe mtshon du drangs yod pa'i gshis ka ni nges par du— 212 —

‘‘sems chung sde ba'i’’bsam gzhig than thun/‘‘bden pa’’yin dgos/ mi'i dpe mtshon du ma grub pa'i gshis ka de dag brjod byar gyur pa'i‘‘mi sna'i’’steng du sbyar na‘‘ra mgo lug sbyar’’gyi dpe ru 'gyur bas/ de la phyogs bsdus kyi rang bzhin med pas/ ‘‘rtog bzo’’de las rtog bzo 'ba' zhig ma gtogs‘‘bden pa’’mthong mi thub/ de bzhin byung rim yang‘‘rtog bzo’’byed chog mod/ brjod rnying ni nges par du‘‘bden pa’’yin dgos/ brjod snying de ni kha shas kyi byed thabs te‘‘rtog bzo'i bzhad gad’’kyi steng du mi gnas par/ ‘‘bden pa'i brtse dung’’gi steng du gnas pa yin la/ byung rim gyi‘‘rtog bzo'i’’steng du gnas pa min par/ mi sna'i gshis ka‘‘bden pa'i’’steng nas grub yod/ dper na〈sems chung sde ba'i bag ma〉las/ mgo mjug bar gsum gyi byung rim las brjod snying gtso bo thon thub med kyang / mi sna gtso bo(gsal le rgyal)yi a mas mjug mthar bshad pa'i skad cha des sman bla skyabs kyi brjod 'dod dngos kyi‘‘brtse dung bden pa’’cig car du mtshon yod pa lta bu'o/ /'tsho ba dngos dang sman bla skyabs kyi‘‘rtog bzo’’las bden rdzun gyi khyad par gsal bar thon thub pa ltar/ bden rdzun gyi gnas lugs 'di gcig la gcig brten gyi tshul du gnas yod pas/ de nyid 'tsho ba'i thog mtha' bar gsum dang 'bral thabs med pa nang bzhin/ sman bla skyabs kyi sgyu rtsal gsar rtsom gyi snga gzhug kun gyi sgrig gzhi la lcags kyi a long lta bu'i nus pa thon yod/de yang ma gzhir sman bla skyabs kyi kha shags ni‘‘rong 'brog rgan pori’de dag gi 'tsho ba dngos kyi snang brnyan tag tag yin pa'i rkyen gyis red/bzhi pa/ skad cha'i sgyu rtsal gyis phyug pa/'khrab gzhung rtsom skabs/ rang gis brjod 'dod pa'i brjod snying gtso — 213 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/bo nges dgos par ma zad/ 'khrab gzhung de las gnas lugs gang 'dra zhig gsal bshad bya 'dod yod pa thag gcod dgos/ 'di ni nga tshos rgyun par gleng bzhin pa'i brtsams chos kyi bsam blo'i rang bzhin yin/ de la rtsom stangs gang zhig spyad kyang / dpe mtshon can bzhengs skrun byed par thabs sna mang spyod dgos par ma zad/ dpe mtshon can de dag gi snang brnyan 'bur du thon phyir phyogs so so'i mi dang bya dngos kyang mi sna'i bar gyi kha brda brgyud nas 'os shing 'tsham par‘‘'bri bzhengs’’byed dgos/ rang rgyal gyi kha shags sgyu rtsal pa chen mo lu'o rung hro'u lags kyis tshad mtho ba'i kha shags sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos brjod skabs/ ‘‘mi gnyis kyis gar stegs khebs pa'i 'khrab ston byed thub’’ces brjod yod pa de sman bla skyabs kyi〈ru sde khra mo〉zhes pa'i sgra thag 'di las cig car du mngon yod/ don ngo mar〈ru sde khra mo〉zhes pa'i sgra thag 'dis bod kyi kha shags sgyu rtsal gyi tshad gzhi de'ang dus rim gsar pa zhig tu bskyal la/ ‘‘mi mkhas pa'i skad cha chu dang / rta mgyogs pa'i gom kha rlung’’zhes pa ltar/ che phyogs nas phyi snod kyi 'jig rten bkod pa dang / nang bcud sems can gyi byung rim/ chung phyogs nas bod kyi sa rtsod chu rtsod sogs 'tsho ba'i gnas bab dang 'brel ba'i gtam de dag phul du byung ba'i skad cha'i sgyu rtsal gyis phyug yod pa ni/ brjod pa bab chags shing kha gsal ba/ rgyud 'jam zhing lhod pa/ lus kyang spel lhug ci rigs su nges pas bod rang gi skad cha'i ming gi sbyor lugs tshig gi sdeb stangs kyi khyad chos ji bzhin thon yod/lhag par du ha cang go sla ba yin pas/ rgan dar gzhon gsum gang gis kyang bstod pa'i mthe bong mi bsgrengs mkhan gcig kyang med/ 'di ni sman bla skyabs kyi kha shags 'khrab gzhung gi sgyu rtsal rin thang bla lhag tu mngon pa zhig ste/ dper na/ ‘‘thang rko li'i’’kha nas mchod rten zhig bzhengs pa la ‘‘la — 214 —

‘‘sems chung sde ba'i’’bsam gzhig than thun/las byin rlabs yod gi zer ni red/ la las rlom rgyu med gi zer ni red/'di lha rdzas cig yin na mchod rgyu zer ni red/ da gdon rdzas shig yin na bshig rgyu zer ni red’rices‘‘yod gi’’dang‘‘med gi’’‘‘lha rdzas’’dang‘‘gdon rdzasari’‘‘mchod rgyu’’dang‘‘bshig rgyu’’zhes pa lta bu'i 'gal ba 'di dag dka' khag ci yang med par tshad dang ran par bkod sgrig byas yod par ma zad/‘‘la las’’dang‘‘zer ni red’’lta bu tshig rkang bzhi bo snga gzhug tu yang yang thon pas snyan ngag gi gzhung chen po'i rtsom lus rang shugs su mngon pa lta bu ni zhar zhor du thon pa'i thabs rtsal zhig yin pas/ dge 'dun chos 'phel mchog gis‘‘mkhas par bgrang ba rnams ni/ smra brjod gtsang zhing gtam ring bo dpe sna tshogs dang sbrel te lab nus pa dag yin/ brda thabs yin tshul mang po zhig smra ba dga' bar byed’’ces pa'o/ / de bzhin nga tshos sman bla skyabs kyi kha shags la ro myong byed zhor du 'thad pa'i brda la mgo bo yang yang du mi ldem ka med byung / yang dper na/ ‘‘rkun ma yin na de pha ma gnyis ka'i sha/der rnga ma zhig ma skye no min nas/ der skye sa bo nas ma skyes par/ der ske tshigs nang nas gcig skye’’zhes dang / yang‘‘nga lu gu de'i a ma'i kha ma red/rkun ma der yang a ma zhig los yod/ a ma a ma/ gro ma zhig 'dra 'dra bo de cig gis khyer thub rung gsod thub nas’’zhes pa'i skad cha thung ngu 'di gnyis kyi khrod du‘‘ma’’yig gcig pu thengs bcu gsum la thon yang / skad gdangs kyi gcod mtshams dang nga ro'i 'gyur khug gi snyan cha rang shugs su grub pas/bskyar zlos su mi 'gro ba ma zad/ skad cha la sngar las lhag par gson nyams rgyas su bcug brjod don yang skad cha'i 'phel rim dang bstun nas gnas skabs nas spyi dang / sger nas thun mong / 'das pa nas ma 'ongs pa/ chung ba nas che ba zhes gong bu gcig tu sgril ba ni rim pa so so'i them skas bgrod pa — 215 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/nang bzhin gtso phal gyi dbye ba gsal ba dper na/ ‘‘a lags yod sa 'did byung khyi rkund khyi spyang ngan sbreld phyi rkun nang rkund stobs shugs gcig sgrild sngon chadad ma rtsa ring lugasad 'byor med gral rimad sangs rgyas chos lugasad nga brgyad lod rig gnas gsar brjed 'thab rtsodad srid jus yag pad deng phyin chad’’ces pa 'di ni mi sna gcig gis skad cha'i sgyu rtsal gyi thad nas thon pa sha stag yin la/ 'di lta bu'i skad cha'i dum bu gcig las snga mar phyir dran dang phyi ma'i 'char gzhi 'dus thub pa ha cang dka' ba ma zad/da dung tshad mtho ba'i skad cha'i sgyu rtsal gyis phyug tu 'a jug pa ni sla mo zhig min yang / sman bla skyabs kyi kha shags su brjod kyis mi langs pa yin/ de bzhin mi sna'i snang brnyan 'bri bzhengs thad la'ang ji ma ji bzhin gyi rnam pa mig lam du gsal lhang nger 'char 'ong thub pa ste/ dper na‘‘rgad po mgo rdo snum logamyig ra gi long bu rtsid skud can zhig’’ces dang / ‘‘ske na phyag mdud gang gang nga can gyi rgad po zhig tog se langs nas’’zhes dang / ‘‘a ye lu gu skyid’’‘‘rgad po a lda’’‘‘a khu thung thung’’‘‘a pha che che’’sogs skabs de'i yul khams dang mi sna re re'i skad cha'i khyad chos la gzhigs na mi sna de dag gi gshis ka dang tshugs ka mdzub mos ri ston lta bur 'bur du thon yod la/ mi sna de dag brgyud nas dngos yod 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi kha tsha dgos gtug gi gnad don re re bzhin gsal bsgrags byas yod de/ gnad don de dag nga tsho'i 'tsho ba dngos dang 'brel yod pa sha stag yin pas/ rtsom pa po'i tshor 'du drag zhan dang /bsam bkod che chung / brtsams chos rang steng gi dbyangs 'gyur gsal min/nang don mtshon stangs/ klog pa po'i myong tshor sogs snga phyi gong bu gcig tu gyur par sman bla skyabs kyi kha shags kyis rang rkya 'pher ba'i khyad nus mngon gsal du thon yod do/ /— 216 da

‘‘sems chung sde ba'i’’bsam gzhig than thun/lnga pa/ gleng ba'i dgos pa/bod mi rigs kyi blo gros kyi nying bcud dang skad cha'i sgyu rtsal gyi dpal du gyur pa'i sman bla skyabs kyi kha shags la mtshon na/ rong 'brog pa mang tshogs kyi thon skyed ngal rtsol gyi brgyud rim khrod du byung ba'i gtam rgyud than thun tshang ma kun nas 'tshol sdud dang / ji bzhin zin 'debs/ dag sgrig nan mo/zhib 'jug dam 'dzin bcas kyi rim pa brgyud nas thon pa sha stag yin pas/kha mtshar dang ku re la dga' ba'i bod rigs mi dmangs khrod ngal rtsol la ram 'degs dang ngal ba khyad gsod kyi thabs shig tu song yod pa kho thag yin pas/rong 'brog mang tshogs kyis‘‘sman bla skyabs kyis nga tsho'i don dag ngo ma bshad kyin 'dug’’ces brjod par yang ya mtshar rgyu mi 'dug lhag par du ru sde chung chung dang grong khyer/ rnying zhen dang gsar zhen/ rjes lus dang sngon thon sogs kyi thad nas thon pa'i gnad don tshabs chen de dag blo yul las 'das pa'i byung rim gyi sgrig gzhi la brten nas nyan pa po'i yid 'gug gi nus pa chen po dang ldan zhing / go sla la brjod bde zhing / tshig gi lhu rkang mi 'byor ba bzhin du btsan gyis sbyar ba ma yin par tshig sbyor khrod bod kyi kha skad kyi skad brda'i chos nyid dang mthun par tshig rkang snga phyi phan tshun gcig la gcig sbrel du 'brel chags pa dang / sdeb legs lhu rkang 'grig pas rol dbyangs kyi 'gyur khugs ngang gis rdzogs pa zhig go/

kha gli kha dang kho'i sgrung gtam gyi khrad chos rags tsam gleng ba/mgon po skyabs/mngon mtshon ring lugs kyi sgrung gtam pa gtso bo h+pha ran tsi kha h+phi kha(studzo'iphro5'iṣ+ṭha'i ’oṃrke.oṃ’ 1883— 1924)ni o si khru ri ya'i ya hu dā pa'i tshong pa zhig gi khyim du skyes/ skabs der o hang btsan rgyal ni bkas bkod dbang sgyur ches gtum drag che ba zhig yin pa'i khar/ mi rigs dang chos lugs kyi phyogs nas kyang 'gal 'du shin tu che la/ kho'i pha tshong pa phyug po de yang sger gcod can zhig yin/ kha lha kha de lta ba'i chab srid dang mi rigs/rnga4 rangachos lugs/ khyim tshang sogs phyogs mang po nas btsan gnon thebs pa'i khor yug cig tu nar son pa yin pas/ kho la sems rgya chung zhing kher skyo dang dogs tshom gyis khengs pa'i rang gshis shig grub la/ mdza' brtse'i thad nas kyang kho'i gnyen don thengs gsum po 'bras med du gyur nas tshe gang bor gnyen bsgrigs ma thub pa de yang kho'i mi tshe'i 'dun ma'i skyo snang gi snon pa lta bur gyur/ khos pal za khi'i 'khar ba'i steng bkod pa'i‘‘kho bos gegs rkyen yod tshad rdul du rlog thub’’ces pa'i legs bshad de rang gi 'khar ba'i steng‘‘gegs rkyen yod tshad kyis kho bo rdul du rlog thub’’ces par bsgyur pa dang /khos‘‘phugs 'dun ni yod mod/ 'on kyang lam ni med de/ nga tshos lam zer ba 'di som nyi las ma 'dasari’zer ba dang / rang gis rang la mthong chung dang — 218 —

kha h+phi kha dang kho'i sgrung gtam gyi khyad chos rags tsam gleng ba/le 'ded byed cing rang nyid ni‘‘mi las ngan zhig’’tu smra ba dang / rang nyid lo40las 'tsho mi nus par kha tshon bcad pa sogs las nga tshos kho'i sems khams kyi phyogs tsam rtogs nus/ tha na kho'i ming(5skuṣ+ṭha'ini phug pa'i bye'u yi don)las kyang 'tshang btsir dang 'dug bzod mi bde ba dang / dbugs 'gag pa lta bu'i nyams snang zhig tshor thub/ khos chung dus 'jar man skad yig gi slob grwa chung 'bring 'grims shing / 1901lor po'u la ki'i slob grwa chen mor zhugs thog 'jar man rtsom rig 'dem sbyong byas na'ang / ring bo ma 'gor bar pha'i bkod pa ltar khrims lugs sbyangs te/ 1906lor khrims lugs rig pa'i rab 'byams pa'i shes yon thob thang lon/ de nas khos khag 'khur las khungs shig tu las don bsgrubs nas1922lor glo gcong je sdug tu song ste ngal gso reg bar du bsdad la/ 1924lor nad de'i rkyen gyis tshe las 'das/mdor na/ 'jar man gyi rig rtsal dpyad mol pa kong thur an tir zhes pas kha h+phi kha ni‘‘ya hu dā pa zhig yin pas ye shu chos pas kho rang mir mi brtsi la/ chos tshogs su mi zhugs pa'i ya hu dā pa zhig yin pas ya hu dā pa rnams kyi khrod du'ang rang mir mi brtsi ba dang / 'jar man gyi skad smra mi zhig yin pas o si khru ri ya'i mir mi gtogs pa dang / khag 'khur las khungs kyi las bzo pa zhig yin pas 'byor ldan pa'i gral du'ang mi tshud cing / 'byor ldan zhig gi bu yin pas ngal rtsol pa'i gras su'ang mi the/ khos rang nyid rtsom pa po zhig tu 'dod pa dang / rtsom pa po zhig gi cha nas bshad na/ nus pa mang shos khyim tshang gi phyogs su 'don mi zhig yin mod/ 'on kyang khyim nas kyang rang khyim du nga rang mi cha med las kyang cha med yin zhes pa ltar red/’’ de ltar kha h+phi kha yi spyi tshogs go gnas dang 'tsho ba'i khor yug kho'i kher skyo the — 219 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/tshom gyi rang gshis grub rkyen sogs 'thus tshang ba tsam gyi sgo nas phyogs bsdoms byas yod/kha h+phi kha slob 'bring gi skabs nas rtsom rig la dga' zhing / slob grwa chen mo'i skabs kho'i slob grogs mā khi si pu lo ti yi shugs rkyen dang rogs ram la brten nas rtsom rig gsar rtsom la zhugs/ kho rang gsar rtsom thad brtson pa shin tu che mod/ 'on kyang / kho'i dmigs yul ni brtsams chos deb tu spel ba dang ming grags rgyas ched ma yin par/ bsam blo'i dungs pa dang sems kyi skyo gdung bcol rten zhig gam gtad sa zhig tu byas pa yin pas/kho 'tsho gzhes skabs su 'grem spel byas pa'i brtsams chos nyung tsam las med cing / rang gis brtsams pa rnams la yid tshim po yang med skad/ 'das khar khos grogs po pu lo ti la brtsams chos rnams mer bsregs dgos pa'i kha chems bzhag na'ang / pu lo tis de ltar ma byas par bam po dgu can gyi〈kha h+phi kha'i gsung 'bum〉(1950d+ngha1958)phyogs bsgrigs byas te 'grem spel byas/kha h+phi kha'i grub 'bras gtso bo ni sgrung gtam phyogs na yod de/ 〈lta rtog〉(1913)dang〈khrims chad〉(1913)〈gzugs 'gyur zin tho〉(1915)〈rgyang phud du btang sar〉(1919)〈zhing sde'i sman pa〉(1919)〈bkres skom gyis mnar ba'i sgyu rtsal pa〉(1924)〈zo ba zhon mkhan〉(1921)sogs kho rang 'tsho bzhes skabs su 'grem spel byas pa'i sgrung gtam thung 'bring 'ga' dang /'tsho gzhes skabs su 'grem spel ma byas pa'i〈zhing sde'i dge rgan〉dang〈sa khung〉sogs sgrung gtam thung ngu so bzhi tsam/ bris mjug ma rdzogs pa'i sgrung gtam ring bo〈a me ri kha〉(1912—1914)zhes pa dang〈khrims gcod〉(1914d+ngha1918)〈mkhar rdzong〉(1922)zhes pa gsum ni kho'i deng rabs ring lugs spyi dang nang sgos su mngon mtshon ring lugs kyi brtsams chos thad kyi gzhan — 220 —

kha h+phi kha dang kho'i sgrung gtam gyi khyad chos rags tsam gleng ba/las lhag pa'i grub 'bras mngon sa yin/ de dag las kyang / 〈mkhar rdzong〉zhes pa ni ‘‘kha h+phi kha yi rnam pa'i’’ sgrung gtam gyi 'thus tshab yin zhing /〈gzugs 'gyur zin tho〉ni kho'i sgrung gtam thung 'bring gi 'thus tshab yin/kha h+phi kha ni yo rob gling gi rtsom rig gar stegs kyi yon tan pa khyad mtshar can zhig yin la/ kho'i brtsams chos khrod bzhengs 'god byas pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi 'jig rten der mi rnams kyis‘‘kha h+phi kha yi rnam pa can’’zhes brjod la/ der bsam blo'i go don dang sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos phyogs gnyis nas go ba len dgos/bsam blo'i go don gyi cha nas bshad na/ kha h+phi kha yis gzhi grub ring lugs kyi rig lam dang du blangs nas dus rabs kyi mjug mtha'i gdung sems te/ mi'i kher skyo dang 'jigs dngangs mngon par mtshon la/ tshul 'chal dgod bro'i 'jig rten dang gzhan 'gyur gyi don snying mtshon yod/ de yang bye brag tu/1 dbang chod la rgol du med pa ste/ kha h+phi kha yi nyams snang du ga sa ga na rgyu la mthu chen 'gog tu med pa'i stobs shugs shig ste dbang chod cig gis khengs shing bsdams yod tshul de kho'i brtsams chos mang po zhig tu mtshon yod/dper na/ 〈khrims gcod〉du dngul khang gi las 'dzin paṣā la nyes pa ci byas dang sus gtug pa/ khrims gang la 'gal ba bshad rgyu med par glo bur du 'dzin bzung gi brda sbyor bas/ khos rang la nyes pa med pa'i yid ches brtan pos zhu gtug dkar 'don gyi 'bad pa ji ltar byas na'ang mtha' 'bras ci yang ma byung zhing / mjug mthar5yis yul de'i bstan pa'i bdag skyong gi bslab bya ste/ khrims kyi sgo drung du sgug nas 'chi ba ma gtogs nang du gtan nas thar mi srid pa'i bslab bya ltar/ las skal gyi bkod sgrig dang khrims khyi dra rgya las thar bar 'dod pa ni stong bsam nyag gcig yin tshul thad — 221 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/ nges shes skyes shing / srog khrims dang du ma blangs dbang med byung tshul bris te‘‘khrims’’kyi tshul 'chal dang dbang chod dang gzhan 'gyur mtshon yod pa lta bu red/2 gegs rkyen la g.yol du med pa ste/ kha h+phi kha yi nyams snang gi dngos don 'jig rten de gegs rkyen brtsegs mas grub pa'i rmi 'phrul gyi bdud 'dre'i 'jig rten zhig yin pas kho'i brtsams chos khrod gegs rkyen mtshon pa shin tu mang / dper na/ mngon mtshon ring lugs kyi tshab byed brtsams sgrung ring bo〈mkhar rdzong〉zhes par5zhes pa mkhar rdzong nye 'dabs kyi grong sde zhig tu bslebs shing srid gzhung nas grong sde der gzhis sdod rung ba'i chog mchan 'thob ched/ mkhar rdzong gi dbang bsgyur par mjal du phyin pa na/ mkhar rdzong mig gi mdun na 'dug kyang gtan du bslebs pa med pas/ 5yis sa khyon gzhal mkhan gyi ming gis grong sde'i mgron khang du bsdad de grong sde'i dpon po'i mdza' mo bslu brid byed pa sogs thabs brgya jus stong byas na'ang /gegs rkyen je cher 'gro ba las mkhar rdzong nang gtan nas 'dzul ma thub la/lag g.yog dag ma gtogs sku dngos sus kyang mthong myong ba'i mkhar rdzong gi dbang sgyur pa sku zhabs bubu de bas kyang mjal ma thub tshul bris pa brgyud/dbang 'dzin las khungs dang mi ser phal ba'i bar 'da' ru med pa'i 'obs zab mo zhig gis bkag cing / gtos che ba'i srid gzhung las khungs dang dpon rigs sna tshogs kyi gnon shugs 'og mi ser phal ba'i ma mtha'i re ltos te 'tsho gnas kyi re ltos tsam yang 'grub tu med la/ kho tsho'i 'tsho gnas la'ang don dam gyi khag theg ci yang med par ya nga zhing / ga sa gar gegs rkyen gyis khengs pa'i las skal gyis mtshon yod pa lta bu red/3 kher skyo la bzod bsran mi tshugs pa ste/ kha h+phi kha yi tshul 'chal — 222 —

kha h+phi kha dang kho'i sgrung gtam gyi khyad chos rags tsam gleng ba/gzhan 'gyur gyi 'jig rten du 'tsho ba'i mi sna'i khyad chos gtso bo zhig ni kher skyo ste/ de dag gis phan tshun ngo mi shes pa ji bzhin kher rkyang du 'tsho na yang /gcig pur rgyu ba'i dpa' bo ma yin par snying rje bral ba'i chos nyid cig gis phyir 'phud btang ba'i mi skor zhig yin pas/ pha bu dang spun mched kyi mdza' brtses kyang chos nyid de'i ngo ya mi nus/ dper na/ sgrung gtam ring bo〈a me ri kha〉yi khrod kyi rang lo16las son med pa'i gzhon nu khār gyis bslu brid byed mkhan g.yog mor phru gu chags su bcug pa ni gzhon nu'i rang tshod ma zin pa'i bgyi ba zhig yin na'ang / pha ma zung gis snying rje med par gzhon nu phyi la phud pa dang / sgrung gtam thung ngu〈grong sde'i sman pa〉yi khrod kyi sman pa de dgun 'khyag gi mtshan mor sman bcos byed du song na'ang kho la bka' drin mi zhu ba ma zad/ gcar rdung myong zhing gon pa'ang bshus te gcer bur grang 'dar rgyag skabs/ lam 'gram gyi ngo shes dag gis kyang kha ya mi byed pa lta bu yin/de bas kha h+phi kha yi brtsams chos su mi la dbang tshor gyi dga' spro'i tshim pa dang bag yangs shig ster ba ma yin par/ deng rabs kyi mi rnams kyi kher rkyang dang dka' sdug gi 'du shes slong ba dang rang nyid kyi gnas bab nyam nga ba ngos 'dzin du 'jug pa red/4 bden don la bsnyeg tu med pa ste/ kha h+phi kha yis 'phred gzhung kun tu brkyangs pa'i dra rgya'i 'jig rten 'di ngo bo‘‘gzhan du gyur’’zin pas zol bag gis gnas thabs bgyi ba las drang yus ci yang med par 'dod la/ kho'i brtsams chos mang che shos ni 'jig rten la 'grel bshad bgyi ba'i 'dun ma yod kyang mi nus pa'am/ yang na bden don bsnyeg kyang mi thob pa'i skyo dogs kyi nang nyams mngon pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi zin bris lta bu yin/ dper na/ 〈khrims gcod〉brod khrims kyi sgo drung du 'chi reg sgug kyang nang du phyin ma thub tshul — 223 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/brjod pa de yang don la bden don ni re ltos 'cha' rung ba zhig las bsnyeg tu yod pa zhig ma yin pa bstan yod/mdor na/ kha h+phi kha yi brtsams chos kyis spyi tshogs kyi 'gal 'du gting zab mor mtshon la/ de yang tshul 'chal dgod bro'i brjod bya dang sbrel te/mi rnams kyi dngangs 'dzem dang kher skyo'i tshor 'du bstan 'dug ‘‘kha h+phi kha yi rnam pa'i’’bsam blo'i khyad chos 'di dag kho'i thun mong ma yin pa'i sgyu rtsal khyad chos dang dam du 'brel yod/ kho'i sgyu rtsal khyad chos de dag mdor bsdus na gsham ltar te/1 dgod bro ba'i nang rol na don bye brag pa la bden lugs mngon pa ste/ mtshon don ring lugs kyi sgrig gzhi'i khrod dngos don ring lugs kyi nang don bye brag pa ldan pa ni kha h+phi kha'i rtsom gshis gtso bo yin la/ khos deng rabs ring lugs la phul ba'i legs skyes kyang yin/ sgrung gtam gyi snying bo'am gtso bor gyur pa'i don de dgod bro la/ don de dang 'brel ba'i bye brag gi don phran bu rnams bden shas che ba/ de ni kho'i brtsams chos dang dgod bro dngos ma'i brtsams chos kyi khyad par 'byed byed yin/ dper na/〈gzugs 'gyur zin tho〉yi khrod mi grog spur du gyur pa'i dgod bro'i don 'di ma gtogs/ mi sna gtso phal rnams kyi nyams dang sems khams thams cad mi'i rigs kyi dngos srid 'tsho ba'i khyad chos dang mthun pa lta bu dang /khrims gcod du5'dzin bzung byas pa'i brgyud rim dang bzung rjes da dung ga sa gar 'gro ba'i rang dbang yod pa sogs dgod bro bar snang na yang /khrims khang gis 'dri rtsad byed pa dang 'dri rtsad byed mkhan dang / nyes can sogs kyi ngang tshul rnams rgyun srol dang mthun pa lta bu yin/ kha h+phi kha yis rang mtshan can dang bden chos can gyi don phran tshegs mang po bris par — 224 —

kha h+phi kha dang kho'i sgrung gtam gyi khyad chos rags tsam gleng ba/brgyud/ spyi mtshan gyi nges pa dang dgod bro'i nges pa can gyi gtan tshigs shig dang mjug 'bras shig thon du bcug cing / dgod bro can des kyang rang gi mtshon don mi stor bas/ khos mtshon bya'i snying por gyur pa'i brjod don de'am tshor 'du de shugs dang ldan pa'i sgo nas mtshon yod/2 dgod mtshar te/ kha h+phi kha yis shugs drag cing khyad mtshar byings dang mi mthun pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi nus pa zhig don du gnyer bas/ dgod mtshar gyi thabs spyad de brjod gzhi dang byung rim sogs kyi thad thun mong ma yin pa'i dgod mtshar gyi blo rtsal dang gzhigs tshul zhig thon yod/ spyir mi zhig la 'phrad srid pa'i don rkyen ches yid du mi 'ong ba ni glo bur tshe las 'das pa dang / rmas skyon phog pa dang 'dzin bzung thebs pa sogs yin pa las/lus gzugs gzhan du 'gyur mi srid mod/ 'on kyang kho'i〈gzugs 'gyur zin tho〉ru mi sna gtso bo ki le kor tag tag grog spur du gyur pa lta bu yin/ kha h+phi kha yis srid pa'i 'jig rten gyi rnam pa ji ma ji bzhin du bzlos 'bri byed pa'i brtsams chos de bden pa zhig tu mi 'dzin par/ dgod mtshar la brten nas dngos don gyi gzugs bsgyur na/ da gzod mi rnams la bden don gyi ngo bo dngos mthong du 'jug thub par 'dod/3 mtshon don te/ kha h+phi kha'i brtsams chos khrod dgod mtshar gyi snang tshul rnams bstar du sbrel ba na de dag dgod bro la ya ma gzugs kyi ris dbyibs su 'gyur cing / de lta bu'i ris dbyibs dag ni kha h+phi kha yi rang nyid kyi dbyibs mtshon yi ge yin par ma zad/ de dag la rab bsdus dpe ston gyi mtshon don phun sum tshogs po yod/ 'di ni kho'i rtsom la 'grel lugs mi 'dra ba mang du 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo yang yin/ dper na/ 〈mkhar rdzong〉zhes pa'i dgod bro'i gtam rgyud 'dir skabs rer mngon la skabs rer gab — — 225 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/ste yod yod 'dra la med med kyang 'dra ba'i dngos po gtos che ba ste/ mkhar rdzong de ni mi ser dang bar du 'da' ru med pa'i 'obs kyis chod pa'i dpon nyams las khungs kyi mtshon don ma yin nam snyam la/ sa khung khrod kyi dngangs 'dzem gyi sems khams de ni dus rabs kyi mjug mtha'i 'byor ldan chung 'bring dag gi sems khams mtshon byed cis ma yin snyam pa lta bu red/ kho'i brtsams chos su tshor snang 'dra min bskyed pa'i ris dbyibs de lta bu shin tu mang zhing / de dag la yang ma 'ongs lung bstan gyi nges pa ldan la/ phun sum tshogs pa'i go don zhig mtshon don dang shugs bstan gyis go bar byed pas/mi la bsam gzhig zab mo ster bar nus/4 rang rnam gyi khyad chos shugs che ba ldan pa ste/ kha h+phi kha yi 'jig rten du nam yang kher skyo'i grib gzugs shig g.yo zhing rgyu la/ rtag tu mnar gcod myong ba'i rnam shes shig 'phyo zhing lding bar ma zad/ da dung brtsams chos mang po'i khrod kyi mi sna gtso bo ste/ dper na5 dang yo si h+phu55'i‘1sogs kyang rtsom pa po rang gi ming5sku1skuyi‘‘5’’las byung ba yin pas/ de dag las kho'i brtsams chos la rang rnam gyi khyad chos dang ldan pa rtogs thub pa dang / kha h+phi kha yi sdug myong ba'i tshor snang dang kher rkyang gi skyo gdung zab mo dag brtsams chos khrod kyi mi sna mang po zhig gi steng du 'phos yod pas/ mi sna de dag las klog pa po rnams kyis kha h+phi kha mthong thub cing / mi sna de dag gis ha lam nga tsho tshang ma kha h+phi kha yin zer ba'i snang ba ster/ 〈gzugs 'gyur zin tho〉ni kho'i 'thus tshab brtsams chos yin zhing /de'i khrod kyi mi sna gtso bo ki le kor sam hra zhes pa ni tshong khang zhig gi bzhud skyod tshong gnyer pa yin la/ khos lo zla 'khor mo yug tu phyogs kun nyul te khyim mi'i 'tsho thabs la brtson/ nyin zhig kho gnyid las sad tshe glo bur du — 226 —

kha h+phi kha dang kho'i sgrung gtam gyi khyad chos rags tsam gleng ba/rang nyid rkang pa phra mo mang po dang ldan pa'i grog sbur chen po zhig tu gyur yod pa tshor/ de nas bzung khos las ka shor zhing khyim mis kyang zhen pa log pa zhig tu gyur/ kho la mi gshis dang mi yi bsam gzhig nus pa dang mi yi sems khams khyad chos sogs yod pas/ dngangs skrag dang gnod 'tshe'i tshor 'dus zin par gyur cing / de nas rim bzhin 'bu yi rang gshis yod par gyur te gog nas bgrod la nul sungs su gyur pa'i kha zas bza'/ ki le kor gyis sngar mus bzhin khyim gyi 'tsho thabs skyong mi thub pas/ khyim tshang de'i dpal 'byor gnas tshul nyin bzhin je sdug tu gyur nas pha'i bu lon mu mthud 'jal thabs bral zhing / nu mo rol mo'i slob chen du 'grims pa'i mthun rkyen kyang yong khungs med par gyur pa na/ pha rgan gyis dngul khang du gla ba byas pa dang /rnyo a mas mi gzhan gyi gom pa btsem pa/ nu mos tshong mi gnyer ka med byung / skabs 'dir khyim gyi skyid snang dang bza' mi'i mdza' dung la 'gyur ldog byung ste/ tshang mas ki le kor khur po chen po zhig dang than ltas shig tu lta/mthar ki le kor kher rkyang dang skyo gdung dang yi mug khrod dben 'jags ger shi ba na/ khyim mi rnams khur bo ljid mo zhig phab pa ltar gyi dga' spros brtas shing phyi nyin grong phyir gnas skor du phebs la/ re ltos gsar pa dang mdun lam legs po'ang gleng zhing brjod/ sgrung gtam khrod ki le kor grog sbur du gyur pa'i gtam rgyud ya nga ba 'di brjod pa brgyud nas/ mi ni dngos po'i bran du tshud de mi yi ngal rtsol nus pa nyams pa na/ spyi tshogs dang khyim mis mi gral du mi 'jog par/ mi ma yin pa'am dngos po tsam dang khyad med par gyur nas mthar rang gshis nyams shing / mi'i 'brel ba'i khrod tha na nye du'i 'brel ba'ang en ke sis ma rtsa ring lugs kyi spyi tshogs su khyim tshang gcig tu sbrel byed ni mdza' dung ma yin par thun mong la dbang ba'i rgyu nor gyi phag tu — 227 —

— mu tig gling gi dga' ston/gab pa'i sger gyi khe phan yin par brjod pa ltar/ dngul lor dang rgyu nor gyi byed pas gnyen mi rnams lam 'phrad kyi mi bzhin gyur te/ mi dang mi'i 'brel ba gzhan du gyur pa dang / ki le kor gyis tshong don sgrub skabs las kar brtson 'grus shin tu che na yang / nam rgyun las gnas nas phyir 'phud gtong bar skrag pas/ sems kyi zhing khams kun nas mnan te spro ba med la blos thub grogs po zhig de bas kyang rnyed ma thub/ grog sbur du gyur rjes khos khyim mis kho la 'dzin pa'i rnam 'gyur la lhag par snang dogs byas te skyo zhum dang nongs pa lhag tu skyes la/ nyen thebs kyi 'jigs snang gis kun nas bsdams par gyur/ khos ji ltar sems chung dang gzab gzab byas kyang g.yol du med pa'i mi 'dod 'gal rkyen gcig la gcig mthud ngang kho'i steng la babs pa las mis rang gi las skal la dbang bsgyur mi nus tshul mtshon zhing / mi rnams dngangs skrag dang kher skyo'i khrod 'tsho ba'i ngang tshul bstan yod/dgod mtshar yan na med pa'i sgrung gtam 'dir mi sna'i sems khams kyi khyad chos bstan pa rnams bden pa'i yid ches 'dren pa zhig ste/ ki le kor grog sbur du gyur rjes khyim mi rnams kyis dang thog rim bzhin je legs su 'gro ba'i 'dun pa nas mthar yi thang gtan nas chad pa dang / sngar gzab nan gyis snyor skyong byed pa nas mthar gdug rtsub kyis 'chi ru bcug pa'i brgyud rim khrod/ ki le kor gyi sems khams dang tshor snang gi 'bri 'god byas pa rnams ni dngos don 'tsho ba'i rang mdangs mig mdun du bkram pa bzhin/ klog pa po'i mig tu bden shas che ba'i nyams su bstar yod/ mdor na/ sgrung gtam 'dir khyad mtshar gyi sgyu rtsal blos bslangs dang phun sum tshogs pa'i mtshon don ldan pa dang / rjod byed bab chags shing don gyi byung rim gsal la/nang don gzab nan dang bstan don dza drag che ba'i sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos mngon — 228 —
zhing / ki le kor grog sbur du gyur phyi'i don phran tshegs te/ dper na bza' btung dang gnyid la rol ba/ mal gso ba/ gog bgrod byed pa sogs las gzhan 'gyur tshabs che ba'i nges don bstan yod/

pad ma che brtan gyi sgrung thung〈gza' nyi ma〉bklags pa/sha bo skyid/pad ma tshe brtan ni lo rabs dgu bcu pa'i nang 'tshar longs byung ba'i rtsom pa po zhig yin te/ khos snga rjes su〈sbrang char〉dnge〈bod kyi rtsom rig sgyu rtsal〉la sogs bod khams kyi dus deb dang tshags par sna tshogs kyi steng brtsams chos mi nyung ba zhig spel myong bar ma zad/ da dung〈mi rigs rtsom rig〉dang〈bod kyi rtsom rig〉sogs rgya yig gi dus deb tu yang brtsams chos mi nyung ba spel te rgya bod yig rigs gnyi ga'i lam nas gsar rtsom byed bzhin yod/ khong gis〈sbrang char〉du spel ba'i〈gangs〉zhes par mtsho sngon zhing chen skabs bzhi ba'i rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi phul byung bya dga' yang thob myong bas/rgya che'i klog pa po mang po la mtshon na cha rgyus yod pa'i rtsom pa po zhig yin/skabs 'dir kho bos sgrung gtam de dag las stong lo gsar pa'i sbrang char deb dang po'i steng bkod pa'i sgrung thung〈gza' nyi ma〉bklags pa'i myong tshor tsam brjod par bya/spyir na rtsom rig gi brtsams chos dang de'i bye brag tu gyur pa'i sgrung gtam myong ba tsam brjod skabs thog mar rtsom po po'i lo rgyus dang gsar rtsom gyi dus rabs gang de'i rgyab ljongs/ yang na klog 'don brgyud nas sgrung gtam ram̐ ༵ sna n+d+rang byung rim dang rjod byed bcas kyi myong tshor dngos dang rtsom

pad ma tshe brtan gyi sgrung thung〈gza' nyi ma〉bklags pa/gyi srog don dang bye brag gi bsam blo'i mtha' dpyod bya yul bcas nges dgos/rtsom pa po 'di nyid 'tshar longs byung ba'i dus skabs ni dpal yon dar zhing 'gran rtsod dang 'phel rgyas kyi dus rabs shig yin par ma zad/skyes stobs kyi tshe srog kun nas rdzogs pa'i dpyid kyi rang mdangs lta bu zhig yin/ 'di 'dra'i mtshar sdug 'od stong 'bar ba'i dus skabs ni kho'i sgrung gtam gyi bcud du sim yod ces brjod kyang bsnyon du med/ 〈gza' nyi ma〉zhes pa'i sgrung gtam 'dis dngos mtshon gyi thabs la brten nas las zhor rtsom pa po zhig gi ches spyir btang gi gza' nyi ma'i 'tsho ba 'phyor 'bri byas shing / las rigs mi 'dra ba'i steng gi bod mi'i sems khams dang 'du shes rnal ma bris te/ dus rabs nyer gcig par kha phyogs pa'i mi rigs 'di'i mi dang rig gnas kyi gnas bab gsong bor brjod yod/sgrung gtam 'dis slob chen mthar phyin ma thag pa'i las zhor rtsom pa po zhig gi gza' nyi ma'i 'tsho ba de rang gi slob grogs dang las grogs/ de da gi grogs po sogs kyi 'tsho ba rol stangs dang bsam gzhig gtong stangs sogs bris te gza' nyi ma'i gtam rgyud thung ngu zhig mtshon 'dug yin na yang /gtam rgyud de'i shugs su nang snying zhig sbas yod pas/ rtsom gyi phyi'i dngos yod kyi cha de don gyis brda rtags shig tu gyur yod la/ rtsom gyi mgor/ ‘‘da lo'i dpyid kar/ grong rdal chung chung 'dir char chu thigs pa tsam yang ma babs pas nye 'dabs kyi ri klung thams cad skya ther ther du snang zhing / mi rnams kyis yun ring du char ba zhig e 'bab la re sgug byas yod’’ ces gzugs bsdus can gyi phyi'i rang byung khor yug bris pa der skye stobs kyi dpal yon kun nas rdzogs pa'i dpyid ka'i rnam pa de mya ngan gyi klung du bskrun yod pa 'dis nga tsho la 'dzam gling gi mi rigs dang rig gnas kun la mtshar sdug — 231 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/dang skye stobs rdzogs pa'i dpyid ka'i rnam pa lta bu zhig shar yod na'ang / nga tsho'i mi rigs 'dir bag 'khum dang blo pham/ skyo sdug gi nyams kyis khengs yod pa'i snang ba skyo la ngu 'chor ba'i tshor ba zhig ster bar ma zad/ rtsom pa po'i brjod 'dod kyi don gang yin shugs kyis rtogs thub/ dus rabs nyi shu lo rabs lnga bcu'i dus 'go nas bzung yun ring bkag rgya thebs pa'i bod kyi zhing 'dir spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi lam lugs lag bstar byas shing / sa khul so sor slob grwa che 'bring chung gsum mang po btsugs pas/ rig gnas sbyong 'dod pa'i na gzhon mang po 'tshar longs 'byung ba'i skal ba thob na yang /lo bcu'i g.yon lhung gi nor 'khrul gyis kho tsho'i me ltar tsha ba'i 'dun pa rmang nas nyil mod/ 'on kyang / tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa'i rjes su mi rigs rig gnas rgyun 'dzin dar spel dang phyi phyogs su sgo 'byed pa'i srid jus bzang po lag bstar byas pa des/ rlung khrod kyi mar me ltar gyur pa'i gangs can gyi rig gnas rgyun 'dzin dang dar spel gtong mkhan gyi shes ldan mi sna rabs dang rim par skyed sring byas te/ las rigs mi 'dra ba'i steng du grub 'bras mi dman pa zhig blangs yod mod/ tshong khrom dpal 'byor gyi 'gran rtsod dang bzo las shes rig gi 'du 'god drag tu 'khrigs pa'i dus 'dir rang re'i bod kyi rang byung dpal 'byor gyi ma lag dang / srol rgyun tshong ra'i 'du shes sran phung dbyug pas gtor ba bzhin dmigs yul dang gtad so bral ba dang / rig gnas gsar pa'i ma lag da dung cha tshang ba zhig grub med pa dang dngos po'i longs spyod kyi chu tshad da dung shin tu dman pas/ bod mi dang bod kyi las rigs so so'i steng gnas pa'i mi rnams kyi sems su g.yo 'gul dang 'jigs snang thebs yod tshul bstan yod cing / lhag par du rang don dang snyan grags — 232 —

pad ma tshe brtan gyi sgrung thung〈gza' nyi ma〉bklags pa/gcig pu las mi rigs dang rig gnas/ bu rabs tsha rgyud kyi las dbang dang ma 'ongs par bsam gzhig mi gtong ba'i mi sna 'ga'i yid kyi 'khyer so bris te rtsom pa po'i sems kyi sdug yus nga tsho'i mig mdun du bkram yod/ ‘‘phyi rol du nam zla ha cang 'khyags pas nga la dbang med du grang 'dar zhig byung’’zhes pa'i tshig la brten te bod kyi las don dang 'byung 'gyur la sems khur byed bzhin pa'i yid kyi sdug snang mtshon yod/ dus kyi 'phel rgyas kyis 'gro ba mi'i rigs dus rabs nyer gcig tu slebs pa dang / dus rabs nyer gcig pa ni dpal yon dang shes rig 'gran rtsod kyi dus rabs shig yin la/ ma 'ongs sngon dpag pa 'ga' res bod kyi rig gnas kyi rlabs rgyas pa'i dus shig yin zhes kyang brjod myong mod/ 'on kyang / rtsom pa pos 'phyor 'bri byas pa'i sgrung gtam nang gi mi sna gtso bo dang lhug brjod mkhan rgyal mtshan gyi khor yug tu 'tsho ba'i las rigs mi 'dra ba'i steng gi mi'i sems khams kyi dran snang brjod pa gtsor bzung nas/ rang mi rigs dang rig gnas kyi rin thang la dma' 'bebs dang khyad gsod byed mkhan gyi rigs mthun 'ga'i bsam spyod bris pa brgyud/ rgya 'gyur rig gnas las 'phros pa'i sems khams dang bod pa rang gi rig gnas rlung khrod kyi mar me ltar gtong mkhan gzhan ma yin par rang rigs yin pa'i gnas lugs de phyi'i spyi tshogs kyi khor yug la brten nas mtshon yod de/ rtsom pa pos‘‘dpyid ka'i mtshan mo der/ nga la bar med du grang 'dar byung / sems su char ba zhig babs na ci ma rung snyam’’zhes brtag pa mtha' bzung gi tshig 'dis rtsom pa pos mtshon par byed pa'i bod kyi na gzhon sngon skyod pa 'ga'i sems kyi rma kha phyir bton yod/sgrung gtam 'di'i lhug brjod mkhan rgyal mtshan gyi tshe srog gi dwangs ma'ang rig gnas kyi tshad mtho ba'i gcig bsdus kyi mtshon bya lags te/ dus — 233 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/rabs gsar pa'i nang 'tshar longs byung ba'i bsam blo pa'i tshab byed du gyur pas/ khos rgyun du lha med 'dre med ces ma ṇi 'dren 'dren mi byed la lha'i thugs rje la re ba bcol ba'i lha kun khyab smra ba zhig kyang gtan nas mi 'dod par/ rgyun du the tshom dang dogs dpyod la dga' ba'i mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel lta bu'i dus rabs kyi sngon skyod pa dag gis bsam blo tshad mar 'dzin mkhan zhig tu 'dod pas/ ltos bcos kyi ngos nas brjod tshe/ kho ni nyin rgyun chang dang rkyal stong gi las su rol ba'i slob grogs chang rkyal dang /rang gi khe phan dang snyan grags dang khyim bza' tshang tsam gyi bde skyid kho nar dmigs pa'i slob grogs/ yang na dbang dang thob thang tsam thob tshe phyir rang rigs la khyad gsod byed mkhan gyi slob gtso kun bzang lta bu gtan nas min/yang na go sar snyeg ched rang gi rig gnas rtsed chas byed pa'i slob grogs bu mo lta bu zhig kyang gtan nas min pas/ kho slob grogs gzhan pa ste phogs bzan pa de dag dang rtsa ba nas mi 'dra ba red/ kho'i gshis ka de rgyun par gzhung las khang gi sgrub mi 'dod pa'i las ka rtsag rtsig 'khyol dka' ba'i gza' nyi ma'i dus tshod bed spyad nas dpe klog dang snyan tshig thung thung re bris te nam yang mi rigs kyi las dbang la sems khur dang / phugs bsam brtan cing 'gan khur shes pa'i na gzhon zhig tu 'bri bzhengs byas yod/ 'on kyang /rtsom pa pos 'bri bzhengs thon pa'i ldog phyogs kyi mi sna de dag ni bod kyi rig gnas dang sgyu rtsal la mtho 'tshams byed phod mkhan dang / las grogs a ce sgron dkar gyis ngo sprad pa'i bu mo me tog skyid kyis kyang dus rabs kyi glu ba ru bsngags pa'i snyan ngag pa la‘‘khyod kyis rtsom rig dang rtsom grogs de dag dang 'brel thag gcod dgos’’zhes pas rang tshugs mi thub pa'i dmod tshig brjod thub pa dang / lhag par du chung dus nas rang rigs kyi rig gnas khrod du — 234 —

pad ma tshe brtan gyi sgrung thung〈gza' nyi ma〉bklags pa/'tshar longs byung zhing mtho rim slob grwa'i slob gso thob pa'i slob grogs kyis kyang‘‘nga ngo ma de dus bod yig bslab par shin tu 'gyod pa skyes/ de dus rgya yig cig bslabs yod pa yin na ci ma rung’’zhes rang sha bcad de za phod pa dang da dung de las kyang thu ba zhig la rdzong slob chung dang po'i slob gtso kun bzangagi skad cha ste‘‘drang mor bshad na/ bod yig cig shes pas ci byed/sngags pa dang grwa pa tshos chos 'don spyad tsam las go ci chod/ khyod tsho bod yig sbyangs nas slob grwa chen mo nas mthar phyin pa 'di dag spyi tshogs steng du song na lta rgya mthong rgya yang shin tu chung / ngo ma ’’zhes pha skad smra bzhin rang rigs la khyad gsod byed mkhan dag gi nyam thag pa'i sems khams zhib 'bri byas pa brgyud nas dus rabs nyer gcig par kha phyogs pa'i bod dang bod kyi rig gnas kyi mdun du gnas pa'i kha tsha dgos gtug gi gnad don zhig thad kar bton yod/ de bas rtsom gyi mgo mjug bar gsum gyi don rkyen re re'i mjug 'bras thag gcod pa'i skabs su'ang‘‘gnam ngo sngar bzhin rub yod la/ lam 'gram du mi 'gas gnam la bltas nas myur du char ba chen po zhig babs na ci ma rung’’zhes lhug brjod mkhan gyi sems khams dang mthun pa'i phyi'i rang byung gi khor yug 'phyor 'bri byas pa brgyud nga tsho la bsam gzhig gi dri rtags te mi rigs dang rig gnas/ skad yig gzhan 'gyur dang gzhan mchog rang dman gyi lta ba rgyun 'byams su 'gro bzhin pa'i nyen brda yang nas yang du btang yod pa ma zad/ dus rabs nyer gcig pa gdong gis bsu ba'i na gzhon sngon skyod pa'i sems kyi grang 'dar zhig nga tsho'i mig ngor bstar yod/yin na yang / rtsom pa pos thengs du mar‘‘sems su char ba chen mo zhig babs na ci ma rung snyam’’pa des 'char yan gyi lam nas bton yod/nga tshos pad ma tshe brtan gyi〈gza' nyi ma〉las mthong thub pa ni sngar byung — 235 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/srol rgyun gyi sgrung gtam lta bu'i mi sna'i gshis ka dang don rkyen gyi byung rim la gtsigs cher 'dzin pa las yol te rtsom rig gam sgyu rtsal de gzugs can gyi phyogs su skyod 'go tshugs pa 'di bod kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom de rnam pa gsar pa dang rtsom stangs gsar pa zhig tu phyogs pa 'di ni dga' 'os pa'i grub 'bras shig tu 'khums/ spyir na gzugs bsdus can gyi rtsom stangs 'di'i rigs la klog pa pos go ba len rgyu cung dka' mod/ rtsom pa pos de las ldog ste/ rtsom gyi grub cha'i cha nas sngar yod srol rgyun gyi 'bri stangs rgyun 'dzin dang zhib mtshon gyi cha nas mi sna'i phyi gzugs dang gshis ka gya gyu 'khrul 'dzin can gyi byung rim sogs la gtsigs chen ma byas par gtso bo mi sna'i sems kyi 'jig rten dang sems kyi 'tsho ba mtshon rgyu gtsor bzung nas mi sna'i sems khams kyi 'gal ba zhib tu brjod yod pas/ khong gi 'bri stangs 'di la dge mtshan mngon 'dug dge mtshan 'di las nga tsho'i bod kyi rtsom rig gsar pa de 'dzam gling rtsom rig dang 'dra bar gsar rtsom rnam mang can dang rtsom pa po sna mang can du phyogs pa mthong thub/nye ba'i lo 'ga'i ring gi〈sbrang char〉dang bcas pa'i bod khams kyi rtsom rig dus deb steng nas nga tshos gsal bor mthong thub pa ni bod kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom de'ang rnam pa dang nang don gnyis char dus rabs kyi bsam blos phyug cing / na gzhon rtsom pa po la rtsom rig gzhung lugs kyi lta rgya dang go ba dang lag len gang thad nas sngar las mgyogs myur gyis dus rabs kyi rjes gcod bzhin pa 'di las nga tsho bod kyi rtsom rig gi 'phel rgyas rgya che zhing 'khobs yangs pa'i gnas su skyod bzhin pa mthong thub pa red/

don grub rgyal bsam blo pa yin min skor gleng ba/a bu/nga tshos don grub rgyal khong bsam blo pa yin min thad kyi gtam gleng re gnyis bya ba la/ da snga'i bar yig thog nas don grub rgyal bsam blo pa yin min thad la sgrol ma rgya mtshos〈mang tshogs sgyu rtsal〉du bris pa'i rtsom yig de dang /rjo'abrong bu tshe ring rdo rje dang mgar rtse rta mgrin rgyal gnyis kyis〈bod ljongs zhib 'jug〉steng bgro gleng mdzad yod pa de gnyis las gzhan mthong rgyu ma byung /dumang tshogs kyi khrod na'ang khong nyid bsam blo pa yin min gyi thad la lta ba mi mthun pa yod de/ kha shas ni bsam blo pa yin par 'thad cing de ldog byings ni min par smra ba red/'dir bgro gleng de'i skor dgos dbang gis rags tsam zhus na/ thog mar mgar rtse rta mgrin rgyal gyis don grub rgyal lo rabs brgyad cu pa'i(sgrog bzhin pa ma yin pa'i)bsam blo pa'i gras su ma bzhag par phangs sems shor ba bstan cing / don grub rgyal ni lo rabs brgyad cu'i nang du bod gangs can gyi ljongs su byung ba'i bod rig pa smra ba zhig dang / rtsom rig sgyu rtsal pa grags du 1990lo'i deb gnyis par gsal/du 1997lo'i deb gsum par gsal/

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/can zhig yin par ma zad/ bod kyi deng rabs bsam blo smra ba zhig red ces sdom tshig bkod yod de/ 〈lang tsho'i rbab chu〉dang〈'di na'ang drag tu mchong lding byed bzhin pa'i snying gson po zhig 'dug〉 〈rkang lam phra mo〉sogs ni khong gi bsam blo mtshon pa'i brtsams chos gtso bo yin pa dang / rnying zhen dang bag 'khums ni mdun du skyod pa'i bgrod lam steng gi bar chad ya nga ba zhig tu ngos bzung la/ snying zhum dang rang sdom de'ang rjes su lus pa'i ngan rkyen 'jigs su rung ba zhig red’’ces pa ni khong gi bsam blo'i brjod snying gtso bo red ces bstan 'dug par ma zad/ dung dkar tshang gis bsam blo par bkod pa'i lta tshul zhig lung gi rgyab rtsar drangs yod de/ ‘‘spyir bsam blo pa zer ba de nga rang gi lta tshul ltar na/ bsam blo gtong mkhas pa dang bsam tshul gsar pa yod pa de 'dra zhig red/ de yang dus rabs kyi khyad chos yod pa dang kho rang la dmigs bsal gyi bsam blo'i rin thang yod pa/ dus rabs kyi mi'i bsam blo yar rgyas 'gro bar phan thogs yod pa zhig la ngos 'dzin gyi med dam bsam gyi 'dug gang yin zer na/ bsam blo de rigs spyi tshogs nang shugs rkyen chen po yod pa dang / yun ring por gnas thub pa zhig yin pa'i rkyen gyis red’’ces pa ni mgar rtse rta mgrin rgyal gyi lta tshul gtso bo red/de la 'brong bu tshe ring rdo rjes bgro gleng gi phyir lan phul yod pa mdor bsdus na/ don grub rgyal khong sher rtogs rig pa'i cha nas bsam blo pa min pa dang /rtsom rig gi thad nas bsam blo dang bzhed srol gang du rtogs min da dung dbye zhib sus kyang byas med ces pa ste/ shugs su bsam blo zhes pa rig tshan gyi dbang gis 'jog pa zhig yin pa ni rtsom rig la rtsom rig gi bsam blo dang /dpal 'byor la dpal 'byor gyi bsam blo/ mdor na mi'i rigs kyis bsam blo dang bsam blo pa zhes gdags gzhi rul yul tshos so so'i rig gzhung gi rnam — 238 —

don grub rgyal bsam blo pa yin min skor gleng ba/pa nyid spyad de bsam blo zhig nges par mtshon par byed pa dang / bsam blo der dmigs bsal gyi ma lag cig yod pa dang nye bar mkho ba ni bsam blo zhes bya ba'i sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen zhig red ces pa ni thengs de'i bgro gleng gi brjod bya gtso bo red/spyir btang bsam blo pa zhig yin tshe thun min gyi lta ba re gnyis gsar rtsom gyi lag len la brten nas dngos shugs gang dung gis bstan 'dug ces pa tsam gyis 'thus pa zhig ma red/ gal srid bsam blo kho na ston pa'i brtsams chos kyi phyi mo med rung / brtsams chos gzhan gang rung las khol du phyungs tshe ma mtha' yang thar thor gyi lta ba de dag snga phyi gung 'grig pa'am 'brel chab srid gros mol pa zhig dang / ma lag can zhig tu grub pa/ phun sum tshogs pa zhig gting zab pa zhig bcas sna sgo bzhi tshang dgos pa zhig tu 'dod cing / dung dkar tshang gi lta tshul der gzhigs na/ bsam blo gtong mkhas pa/ bsam tshul gsar pa yod pa/ dus rabs kyi khyad chos yod pa/rang nyid la dmigs bsal gyi bsam blo'i rin thang yod pa/ dus rabs kyi mi'i bsam blo yar rgyas 'gro bar phan thogs yod pa bcas lnga ni bsam blo pa zhig la nges par tshang dgos par bstan yod/ der brten 'di nyid tshad gzhi zhig tu brtsis te klog pa po rang rang gis khong nyid bsam blo pa yin min gyi brdar sha gcod chog mod/ nga tshos‘‘tshad gzhi’’'di re zhig phar g.yugs kyang rung ste/ khong gi snying stobs rnal ma bo yin na tshad gzhi de dag la'ang dogs pa 'chang ba zhig yin srid kyi red snyam/gal srid don grub rgyal bsam blo pa zhig yin par bzhag pa dang / khong gi bsam blo ni ma lag cig tu grub pa zhig brtan 'jags tsam gyi nges pa mchis pa zhig yin tshe/ nga tshos de nyid dpe ngos blo skyor nang bzhin da lta'i — 239 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/dus su spyod chog chog cig las gzhan khol du phyung ba'i dgos pa ye nas ma mchis/ bsam blo pa zhes pa'i‘‘pa sgra’’des‘‘don grub rgyal’’la dbang cha khyad par ba zhig sprad de/ de nyid gzhan mgo gcog byed kyi tho ba zhig tu gyur na/khong la rjes su yi rang byed pa min par khong gi snying stobs dang rgyab 'gal du song yod pa red/ lhag par du smyug thogs pas khong gi brtsams chos dang mi tshe la slob sbyong dang nyams myong phyogs sdom byed pa'i khrod du/ khong gi lta tshul de dag thar thor du snang zhing snga phyi gung bsgrigs pa'i thad du rang nyid kyis(klog pa po)u tshugs btsang dgos pa zhig yin pa'i nyams snang yang skyes te/don dril bar bshad na gzhung lugs kyi rang rtogs yod pa zhig ma red/bsam blo pa yin min yang kho bo ltar na gnad de'i steng nas bzhag chog kyang snyam/ gzhan yang khong gi snying stobs khyad par ba gsar gtod ces par khong rang nyid kyi brtsams chos kho na'i steng nas bshad na phal che ba‘‘kha g.yang’’tsam zhig tu 'dug pa'ang tshor/ rtsom yig 'dir khong gi thar thor gyi lta tshul de dgadang gzhan yang khong gi‘‘mi tshe’’la 'brel 'dris byas pa las byung ba'i nyams myong gzhi byas thog sngog 'don dang dbye zhib dang rgyud 'dzin bcas byas te bsam blo'i gzhi rkang chags pa tsam zhig dang dus rabs 'di'i snying stobs kyi bang mdzod cig tu gyur tshe/ de ni bsam blo pa zhig red ces pa'i sgrub byed du cis kyang 'jog mi nyan te/ 'di ni sa bcad 'dir nan du gsal bshad byed dgos pa gtso bo zhig yin/ kho bo rang gi lta tshul ltar na/gal srid bsam blo pa zhes pa ni sher rtogs rig pa'i cha nas 'jog dgos tshe/snying stobs 'di da dung yang bsregs bcad brdar gsum byed dgos pa zhig las bsam blo'i thon khungs gtos che ba zhig tu grub med/ gang ltar don grub rgyal gyis nga tshor sngar med pa'i‘‘tshan rig’’dang‘‘'dra mnyam’’‘‘rang dbang’’— 240 —
