don grub rgyal bsam blo pa yin min skor gleng ba/sogs kyi brda chad dam de'i shugs kyi bsam blo'i gnyug ma'i rgyu cha gang mang bstsal yod pa ni shin tu nas gal che la/ nga tshos mu mthud du sngog 'don dang zhib 'jug bya chog phyir/ khong gi snying stobs de da dung yang dpung 'jug bya yul gyi‘‘mya ngam thang’’chen po zhig tu 'dod/lo rgyus kyis‘‘don grub rgyal’’bzos pa red dam/ yang na don grub rgyal gyis‘‘lo rgyus’’bskrun pa red/ ham le kri lta bu'i 'dri tshig 'di rnyog dra zhig tu snang yang srid mod/ zhib tu brtags na kho bo ni snga ma der 'thad shas yod de/lo rgyus dang spyi tshogs dang dus rabs kyi khor yug bcas kyi dbang gis lo rabs brgyad cu par bod ma zad krung go'i nang khul gyi bsam blo'i mkha' dbugs khrod du rtogs sad kyi dri ma ngad kha thul le ba zhig gis khyab yod cing /ches thog mar mkha' dbugs de brngubs pa'i go skabs reg pa'i don grub rgyal la mtshon na/ rigs stobs skyen pa'i rkyen dang bstun nas rim bzhin dus rabs de'i mgrin tshab pa zhig tu 'gyur pa thag gis chod cing / lo rgyus kyi nyams myong gang mang gis ra sprod thub pa ni/ mgrin tshab pa'i thog ma'i dbyangs rta gtso bo de nam yang rtsom yig gsar rtsom gyi lam bu nas 'go brtsams pa zhig kyang red/ gsar pa'i ngang tshul du shugs kyis 'byung bzhin pa'i bsam blo'i mkha' dbugs de la dus rabs kyi blo 'dun yang zer te/mgrin tshab pa zhig lo rgyus kyi gar stegs su bud rkyen ni khong rang nyid kyi rig gnas bya byed(dper na khong nyid rtsom rig gsar rtsom la mos pa lta bu)dang dus rabs kyi blo 'dun gnyis lam bzhi mdo lta bu zhig nas ngo 'phrad cing mdza' bshes su gyur pa dang rag las pa zhig red/ dus rabs kyi blo 'dun de ni gzhung yig lta bu zhig min la/ dmangs byings kyi 'dun thub pa'am yang na rgyal khab kyis thag gis bcad pa'i sgrig khrims lta bu zhig kyang min/ tha na spyi — 241 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/tshogs yongs su tsha tsha 'ur 'ur du bsgrags shing grags pa'i bsam blo'i rlabs rgyun gtso bo ste/ dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun gyi phyogs su gzhol bar bya'o zhes pa'i kha g.yang lta bu min par/ lo rabs brgyad cu par thun min du yod pa'i blo 'dun khyad par ba zhig ste/ don grub rgyal dang don grub rgyal lta bus tag tag la blo 'dun de'i nus pa rtogs shing de nyid rgya skyed du 'don par brtson pa red/ thun mong gi spyi tshogs su thun min gyi lta ba sgrog pa ni mgrin tshab pa zhig gi khyad chos nyag gcig kyang yin la/ khos 'thus tshab bya yul ni spyi tshogs kyi sgrig srol gang rung ma yin par rang nyid kyi go rtogs dang / phal ba'i ngang tshul dang dbang grags kyi mtha' 'khob tu 'phag 'tshag byed pa'i‘‘mang tshogs’’kyi 'dod blo'am khe dbang kho na yin/ der brten gsar dar gyi blo 'dun de ga dus da lta ba'i spyi tshogs la mtshon na 'grul ba rgyus med cig tu snang zhing / des sngar zho ltar chags pa'i spyi tshogs dang sgrig srol dbang dang go sa bcas par 'gran btsugs te rang nyid la'ang‘‘khyim gyi go kha’’'os tsam dbang bar brtson len ci thub byed pa red/mkha' dbugs gsar pa brngubs pa/ rang nyid kyi rtogs pas sbyangs pa/ de yang ches nyung shas su gyur pa'i‘‘mang tshogs’’kyi 'dod blo dang mthun pa bcas kyis don grub rgyal gyis skabs thog der rtsom rig gi dar cha mtho ru bsgrengs pa ste/ khong gis rtsom 'bri ba ni lag cha dang mtshon cha zhig yin la/nga tshos lag cha bkol shes shing mtshon cha de 'dzin shes dgos zhes pa ltar/dusnying stobs rigs shig go char sbran te rmongs mun spyi tshogs kyi ngan mtshang 'bru ba'i lta ba sna tshogs rtsom rig dang lhag par du sgrung gtam gyi lam nas brjod du 〈thor rtsom phyogs bsgrigs〉kyi shog ngos94par gsal/— 242 —

don grub rgyal bsam blo pa yin min skor gleng ba/ci thub byas yod/yin na'ang / don grub rgyal gyi sgrung gtam sogs la skabs der spyi tshogs steng grags 'gul chen po byung ba las yun ring lo rgyus dang sgyu rtsal gyi rin thang mi 'dug ces smra ba bzhin/ snying stobs de ni kho la mtshon na'ang gsar pa gsar rkyang gi tshul du 'dug pas/ bsregs bcad brdar gsum gyi khom long med par phal cher thad brjod lta bu byas shing / spyi tshogs kyi snang tshul re gnyis dmigs 'ben du bzung nas lta tshul gsar bas gshag bcos byas pas na/ ‘‘gnyug gshis’’kyi khyad chos tsam ldan pa zhig tu snang / gzhan yang khong gi snying stobs de la thun mong gi khyad chos 'dzoms pa zhig las‘‘gsar rtsom’’gyi bro bas phyug cing stug pa zhig tu mi gda'/a ri pa tu'u lan thi lags kyis 'dzam gling gi bsam blo pa che bcu bgrang ba'i tshad gzhi ga 'dra yin pa gleng dus/rjo gsar gtod dang gting zab min/da dung mi'i rigs la shugs rkyen ci 'dra thebs pa'i khyab rgya dang dus yun ring min sogs gtso bor bzhag yod/ de'i ngos nas bshad na nga tshos don grub rgyal bsam blo par brtsis na dungs zhen tsam las ma 'das/ khong gi lta tshul de'i rigs ni lo rabs brgyad cu par byung ba'i thun min gyi snying stobs shig la go na 'grig par sems/lhag par du don grub rgyal khong la mtshon na snying stobs de dag gi rgyab rten nam bsam blo'i thon khungs gtos che ba zhig dang 'brel 'dris kyi go skabs med pas ltag chad kyi rdzing bur snang ba red/du 〈ṭha4stuzarkitshimod+kuṣ+yo〉(r+sā)༈tshodze+estsozo ā+oṃ༈p+taltaglornyeṭ+wāṃ 2 9— 243 —

ltung bshags dang gsal bshad/ da dung sems khral re gnyis/a bu/〈shar dung ri〉'don thengs bco brgyad pa'i steng du/ dmigs bu lags kyis bris pa'i〈bar thag dang nor 'khruld pad ma tshe brtan gyi skrung gtam〈snyan ngag pa dur khrod rjes su dran pa〉bklags rjes〉zhes pa de ni/gcig na〈snyan ngag pa dur khrod rjes su dran pa〉 (2004lo'i〈sbrang char〉deb dang por 'khod)zhes pa'i sgrung gtam la dmigs pa zhig dang / gnyis na kho bos sgrung gtam der bris pa'i rtsom bshad thung ngu ste/ 〈nor 'khrul dang bar thag〉(2004lo'i zla4pa'i tshes30nyin gyi〈mtsho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyur〉steng 'khod)ces par gzas pa zhig kyang red/ dmigs bu lags kyis〈bar thag dang nor 'khrul〉zhes kho bo'i kha byang de ldog nas bris yod pa la/ ji ltar kha byangaspras nang don mthong ba'i dpe bzhin‘‘bar thag’’ya nga ba zhig sdun la brjod 'dug phyir/ 'dir kho bos‘‘bar thag’’de 'dra byung bar ltung bshags bgyi rtsis yod pa dang / ‘‘nor 'khrul’’de'i don du gsal bshad re gnyis dang zhar la‘‘sems khral’’rigs shig kyang mchis pas/ de ltar rtsom las kha byang rnyed pa'i lugs〈ltung bshags dang gsal bshad/ da dung sems khral re gnyis〉srong bor brjod 'dod pa lags/ —kārdo~X wadamigs bu lags kyi rtsom de nga rang nyid la mtshon na dga'

ltung bshags dang gsal bshad/ da dung sems khral re gnyis/'os pa'i gnas shig red/ yin na'ang / de la dga' ba tsam gyis‘‘snyan ngag pa dur khrod’’la sdang ba'i nang don ye nas med/ des na/ dga' ba'i rgyu dang spro ba'i rkyen ni nga rang gi‘‘sems nad’’cig la thug yod cing / dmigs bu lags kyis‘‘nad thog gtsag khel’’byas pa dang yang 'brel ba zab mo mchis/de ring kho bos slar yang rang nyid kyi rtsom yig〈nor 'khrul dang bar thag〉ces pa 'then sgam las phyir blangs te thengs gcig min du bklags shing /bklags pa'i rjes la dran 'char re gnyis smyug rtser thogs byung /‘‘sgrung gtam 'di'i mgo mjug bar gsum gang yang dur khrod lta bu'i 'jigs snang gis khyab pa zhig yin la/ mjug ni skyo gar tshul gyis bsdus pa'ang 'os shing 'tsham ste/ rtsom pa pos/ ‘ngag gi brjod pa’shi ru bcug pa'i‘gdug rtsub kyi lag thabs’spyad pa ni skyo gar gyi mdzes pa lhur len ched yin mod/ nga tshos rtsom pa po kho'ang snying rje med pa zhig tu 'dug ces lab mi chog ste/ de ltar na sgrung gtam 'di mdzes pa mdzes pa'i ched du song ste mi la do khur(rkispra〉 /rko)gyi snying stobs med pa zhig tu 'gro srid/ 'on kyang sgrung gtam du yod pa nang bzhin‘nga dang nga 'dra'i grogs po’skor zhig gis nam yang dkyel yangs kyi rnam 'gyur bstan te snyan ngag pa dang snyan ngag pa lta bu'i mi tshogs der rjes dran dang rjes dran zhu rgyu'i sta gon gnang yod pa ma yin nam/’’‘‘mjug mthar/ klog pa po kho bo'ang dbang med du‘nga dang nga 'dra'i’grogs po dag gi gras su 'tshang 'dod snying nas skyes so/ / ’’ gong du drangs pa ni kho bos bris pa'i rtsom de'i mjug sdud kha ma'i tshan pa gnyis te/ gtam gleng gi 'go ni 'di nas brtsam chog chog red/ dmigs bu lags kyi rtsom yig de mthong rjes/ rang nyid kyis da dung spang blang gi rnam dbye gsal bor nges med pas phyi phyir‘‘kun spyod kyi khrims chad’’phog srid pa'i glen gtam de brjod — 245 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/'dug ang snyam pa'i ngo tsha dang nongs 'gyod cig car skyes byung / gcig ni‘‘nga tshos rtsom pa po khong snying rje med pa zhig tu 'dug ces lab mi chog’’ lta bu ngas pad ma tshe brtan la‘‘thar lam’’btsal ba dang 'dra zhing / gnyis na/‘‘klog pa po kho bo'ang dbang med du‘nga dang nga 'dra'i’grogs po dag gi gras su 'tshang 'dod snying nas skyes’’zhes pa lta bu ni pad ma tshe brtan la‘‘gzhogs 'degs’’byas 'dug pa'i snang ba las/ gzhan yang nga rang nyid mi gsod gshed ma'i grogs su gyur song ba'i zhed snang tsha bo skyes/ rgyu rkyen de gnyis kyisakho bor da dung yang‘‘rgyu 'bras rgya mas’’lci yang tshad kyang mnar gcod gtong gin 'dug tshe srog cig 'jig rten du 'tsho ba 'di ma gzhi nas mdzes sdug tu rtsi ba'i nga tsho'i dus rabs 'dir de dus/ kho bo'i rtsom de rgya yig tu 'gyur skabs/ sgyur mkhan dang nged gnyis kas sgrung gtam de'i mi sna gtso bo dur khrod la‘‘gdung sems’’'chang min dang‘‘gu yangs’’gtong min thad gleng mol re gnyis byas shing / gzhug nas grogs po kha shas kyis mjug gi tshan pa de ni‘‘sbrul la rkang lag bris pa'i’’dper song 'dug par ma zad/dpyad gtam pa'i ngos nas sam‘‘kun spyod rnam gzhag’’gi cha nas bshad na nga rang nyid‘‘mi gsod gshed mar’’brtsi dgos pa'i gnas lugs kyang brjod byung / da lta bsams na/ ‘‘gang la 'khor nas bsdad na de bzhin mthong ba'i yul ljongs tsam’’zhes pa ltar/ kho bo snyan ngag pa dur khrod kyi phyogs su 'greng ci thub kyis rgyab logs na gzhi gnas kyi tshe srog(misna phal pa)dag la‘‘rdog brdzis’’dang‘‘snang med’’du btang ba ni ci 'dra'i skyo gar nang gi skyo gar zhig red ang / bden te/ nga tshos rgya nag pa ku'u khrin(khokhroḥyi)la 'dang re brgyab ste dpe re bzhag na/ lis tse hig gis ku'u khrin gyis mi bsad pa snyan ngag pa yin pas dang / snyan ngag pa'i bya spyod ya ma brla yin pa sogs rgyu mtshan du da 246 —

ltung bshags dang gsal bshad/ da dung sems khral re gnyis/drangs nas gu yangs gtong mi chog mi yin na rang srog bcad chog kyang rung //gzhan gyi srog gcod pa'i dbang cha ye nas med/ tha na snyan ngag gi‘‘klong brdol mkhan’’dag kyang de ltar lags/ zhes pa ji bzhin/ da ni sgyu rtsal brtsams chos su grub pa de'i nang gi mi sna‘‘snyan ngag pa dur khrod’’la cha bzhag nas bshad na'ang / kho la rang nyid kyi srog gcod pa'i dbang cha yod rung gzhan gyi srog gcod pa'i dbang cha ye nas med/ rgya la‘‘snyan ngag par’’rgyu mtshan dang sdug med stong bgrang rgyu yod kyang mi chog tha na khyod rang nyid kyi srog gcod pa'i dbang cha'ang ye nas med(rig gnas sems khams kyi cha nas bshad na de ltar zad)ces brjod chog chog yin phyir/ kho bos ni de dang ldog pa'i rnam 'gyur 'dra bstan pa 'di dngos gnas mi mdza' snyam/ de'i don du nga rang ngos nas ltung bshags bgyi rtsis yod/ ngas tshe srog nyam chung ba dag la brtsi 'jog byed mkhan rnams la ltung bshags bgyis pa yin/ ngas rang nyid lta bu u ru su'i‘‘to si tho ye h+phu si khe’’dag dang bar thag gis chod par ltung bshags bgyis pa yin/ ngas mdzes sdug gi tshe srog dang tshe srog gi mdzes sdug de'i ched du ltung bshags bgyis pa yin/gnyis/ yin na'ang / da lta kho bo'i rtsom thung〈nor 'khrul dang bar thag〉ces pa der/ bzo bcos bya dgos pa byung tshe'ang / klog pa po zhig gi cha nas bris pa'i tshig nyog de dag gcig kyang mi 'phri la snon pa de bas kyang ga la srid/ de ni ngas ci zhig gi ched du u tshugs btsangs pa ma yin par/ kho bos‘‘kun spyod kyi rnam gzhag’’sogs bltas na gtos che zhing bcal na ljid tig ger 'dug pa dag logs su bskyur te/ sgrung gtam rang ngos nas sam yang na rang nyid kyi dran 'char ngo ma zhig brjod yod pa dang 'brel ba dam po yod/— 247 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/thog mar/ dmigs bu lags kyi skad cha zhig las 'phros chog ste/ kho'i rtsom yig de ru dri ba bstud mar bdun yod pa'i lnga par/ rtsom pa pos sgrung gtam 'di brgyud nas mtha' gcig tu mi gsod lag dmar du gyur pa'i mi sna snyan ngag par‘‘sems khong nas dran gso byed’’pa de dang dpyad gtam par‘‘dbang med du nga dang nga 'dra'i grogs po dag gi(dran gso byed mkhan tsho'i)gras su 'tshang 'dod snying nas skyes’’pa de ni/ mthar gtugs na tshe srog la snang med( 74oṃ)dang tshesrog la rdog rdzi(lhulko4oṃ)byed pa'i ya ma brla'i sems gshis shig la rag las pa e yin zhes pa ste/ rgyu dang rkyen la phrad tshe rang nyid ngo ma bo lhang la 'bud nges pa'i gnas lugs der bsams na/ ya ma brla'i mi sna snyan ngag pa dang ya ma brla'i rtsom pa po pad ma tshe brtan/ ya ma brla'i dpyad gtam pa a bu gsum‘‘skabs thog gcig’’tu phrad de/ sha gseng rus dang rus gseng rkang gi nang nas phan tshun a 'grig cha 'grig tu snang bas‘‘ngo 'phrod cing mdza' bshes’’su gyur pa e yin nam snyam pa'i 'dang rgyag kho bor yang shin tu che bar ma zad/ khyod kyi shugs bstan/ rtsom pa po dang dpyad gtam pa gnyis kyi ya ma brla'i sems gshis rigs shig dang rag las pas/ tshe srog la rdog rdzi gtong mkhan snyan ngag par dran gso byas pa gu yangs btang ba'i gnas tshul 'di byung ba red ces par yang bden kha mi ster ka med red/'on kyang / khyod kyi shugs bstan de las 'phros te/ nga rang nyid kyis brjod bde ba zhig tu bsgyur na/ ngas sgrung gtam 'bri mkhan dang sgrung gtam gyi mi sna gtso bo gnyis kar mos mthun gyi lta ba zhig brjod pa'am yang na gong smras bzhin ‘‘ngo 'phrod cing mdza' bshes’risu gyur rkyen ni/ don du brtsams chos rol myong gi go rim khrod nas‘‘rang nyid’’gsar du rnyed pa'amad 248 da

ltung bshags dang gsal bshad/ da dung sems khral re gnyis/‘‘rang nyid kyi mdzes tshor nyams myong’’gang zhig gsar du rnyed pa dang 'brel ba dam po yod pas/ da ni kho bos rang la‘‘kha g.yor sa’’yag po zhig kyang rnyed song bsams/ de'i phyir/ gnas skabs su tshe srog dang 'brel ba'i brjod bya rgya che ba de dag dang / kun spyod dang 'brel ba'i rnam gzhag gtos che ba de dag logs su bskyar/ ltung bshags sngon du song / gsal bshad lhan thabs kyi tshul du 'bri na/gsum/ spyir btang sgyu rtsal rtsom rig gi gras su gtogs pa'i sgrung gtam zhig la cha mtshon nas bshad na/ klog pa por lhan langs(mojibak+shi)slong rkyen ni/ brtsams chos las rang nyid rnyed pa de yin zhes pa ltar/ pad ma tshe brtin gyi sgrung gtam de las ngas‘‘rang nyid’’rnyed tshul lam rnyed pa'i go rim ni/kho bo rtsom der dga' rkyen dang yang na bklags rjes kyi gtam de bris pa'i rgyu mtshan yin/ ji ltar‘‘rang nyid’’rnyed pa yin zer na/ gnas lugs chen po'i klong gi‘‘rang nyid’’der go ba ma yin par/ skabs 'dir nga rang sger gyi 'tsho ba'i ngos zin dang nyams myong / gzhan yang mdzes dpyod kyi lta tshul zhig la thug yod de/ ngas bltas na rtsom pa pos sgrung gtam der brjod 'dod pa ni mi dang mi'i bar du'am lhag par du mi rang steng na nam yang song mi tshar ba'i‘‘bar thag’’ya nga ba zhig yod pa de yin par 'dod cing / sgyu rtsal bden thub kyi khyad chos ngos nas bshad na/ ‘‘bar thag’’de nga tsho'i nye ring kun tu snang ba gzugs tsam min pa'i tshul du mchis pa zhig kyang red/ ‘‘bar thag’’de rnyed pa ni ngas gong nas bshad pa'i‘‘rang nyid rnyed pa’’dang don gcig yin zer yang chog ste/ kho bo'i rtsom der/ snyan ngag pa dur khrod kyi snang brnyan las rang cag gi don grub rgyal dran 'ongs zhes pa zhig bris don/ de snga kho bos don grub rgyal gyi‘‘mi tshe’’la 'brel 'dris tog tsam byas rjes/ khong gi 'das rkyen — 249 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/la'ang bsam blo thongs shing / nga rang sger la ngos zin tsam thob pa ni/ mang tshogs kyi kha nas smra ba nang bzhin dang / yang na kha kher gyis rang srog bcad pa de shes yon can zhig yin pa'i cha nas gu yangs gtang sa mi 'gro ba red ces smra ba lta bu zhig ma yin par/ don grub rgyal khong rang steng na‘‘don grub rgyal’’gnyis gsum lhag 'gal bar gnas shing‘‘bar thag’’cig gis chod 'dug pas dus shig na rkyen la phrad tshe rang srog bcad pa red 'dugaskabs skabs su/ mi'i nang gi 'dod zhen dang brtse dung dang chags sdang sogs ni dpe ngos kyi gnas lugs dag las kyang bden pa bden thub kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i snang ba 'dug par ma zad/ mi yin pa'i cha nas nyam chung dang sdar ma'ang rang nyid kyi 'dor mi rung ba'i dbang cha red bsams/ de'i ngos thad nas don grub rgyal la gu yangs btang ba yin la/ snyan ngag pa dur khrod la'ang gu yangs btang ba yin/ 'di ni kho bo sgrung gtam de bklags rjes/‘‘kun spyod kyi gser khri mthon por’’ma 'dzeg par‘‘rtsom dngos gzhir’’rkang rten bcas nas‘‘sgyu rtsal gyi drang gtam’’zhig brjod pa dang / mi ngo ma zhig gi dungs zhen ngo ma bo de bris pa'ang yin 'dod/ gang ltar/ sgrung gtam de khyod ltar bklags rung chog chog ste/ ‘‘dris lan yang dag’’cig nam yang med na 'grig snyam/ 'di ni gsal bshad dang po yin/bzhi/ nga rang nyid la gong lta'i nyams mong ngam‘‘klog 'don gyi re ltos’’( / glaṣ+ṭhaspya༈lha‘ chonok+ṣu)shig sngon du yod pa'i rkyen gyis/ sgrung gtam klog skabs kyi tshor ba da lta ba dang bye brag pa de gnyis 'phrod sbyor du phyin pas/ da gzod‘‘bar thag’’ces pa'i bsnol mtshams shig nas bdag gi‘‘lhan langs’’bslangs par 'dod/ 'dir 'or bshad re brgyab na/ de ni mtho dma' dang dbul phyug dang 'jon min sogs la ltos pa med par/ mi dang mi'i bar du nam — 250 —

ltung bshags dang gsal bshad/ da dung sems khral re gnyis/yang song mi tshar ba'i phan tshun rgyus lon gyi bar thag cig dang / lhag par du nang gi bar thag cig ste/ dper na las bya'i steng gi don grub rgyal dang / spyi tshogs steng gi don grub rgyal/ gsar rtsom skabs kyi don grub rgyal/ khyim tshang nang gi don grub rgyal bcas mang po zhig gdos bcas kyi phung bo gcig tu gnas rung / phan tshun kha khar snang zhing yun ring gdong thug brgyab mthar/de las gtso bo gyur pa'i‘‘rang nyid’rigang zhig gis yan lag tu gyur pa'i‘‘rang nyid’rimang por mgo bdag rgyag ma thub par rang srog bcad pa nang bzhin snyan ngag pa dur khrod kyi gshis ka'i steng nas kyang de lta'i khyad chos shig mthong thub/gong nas bshad pa ltar/ tha na rang nyid kyi srog gcod pa'i dbang cha'ang med ces par bsam blo re 'khor na/ ngas gu yangs mi gtong zer mkhan dag gi sems khams la rgyus lon mi yong rgyu cang med mod/ skabs rer/'tsho ba'i gdug rtsub dang khor yug gi nyam nyes dag dran tshe nga tshor yang nyam chung dang sdar ma/ tha na‘‘spyod log’’gi dbang cha yang yod chog chog red snyam byung / ngas‘‘mi gsod lag dmar’’gyi zhwa mo de re zhig phar g.yugs/ ‘‘kun spyod rnam gzhag’’gi ral gri de'ang re zhig phar g.yugs/ de ma zad/ ‘‘tshe srog’’gi mdzes sdug gi phyi gos de'ang phar g.yugs tshe/ de dag gi gsog rdzu dang 'khya' 'khyor gyi ngos zur dag kyang mthong yong ba red/'jig rten na dpa' bo yod pa bden la/ sdar ma yod pa'ang bden/go la hril bo'i lo rgyus 'di‘‘dpa' mdzangs’’rkyang rkyang gis bris pa zhig ye nas ma red/ ‘‘shes yon can’’(gal srid snyan ngag pa dur khrod kyang de'i tshad du bzhag tshe)zhig la mtshon na/ tshe srog gi rin thang zer ba dang / rang dbang zer ba dang / 'dra mnyam zer ba so gas phugs bsam zhig tu brtsis te/ de dag — 251 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/mngon 'gyur gyi ched du yod tshad phul ba'i rjes la/ rin thang la brin rgyu med pa dang / rang dbang sger du gcod pa/ 'dra mnyam mtho dman gyis 'byed pa'i zur ngos gzhan zhig mthong ste/ sngon chad kyi‘‘phugs bsam’’de dag ni mi'i rin thang gi tshad gzhi nges can zhig las mthar thug gi dmigs yul min pa'i nges shes rnyed tsa na/ sngar med kyi a thang chad par 'gyur la/ a thang chad drags tshe‘‘sdug gcod’’kyi lam bu de 'dra zhig 'dems kyang srid pa red/der brten/ kho bos sgrung gtam dngos gzhir babs te brjod pa'i cha nas/ 〈snyan ngag pa dur khrod rjes su dran par〉'tsho ba'i bden thub dang sgyu rtsal gyi bden thub gzhi gcig tu bsnol 'dug pa'i nyams snang ster la/ des kyang nga rang nyid kyi mdzes dpyod nyams myong gang zhig la ram 'degs byas pas na/ nga klog pa pos kyang‘‘lhu lag’’lta bu'i brtul zhugs ma bzung bar mi sger gyi chags sdang phyogs zhen ma gsang drang mo brjod pa 'dir/ ‘‘kun spyod’’ kyi mchil zhags phog par yang gcig gsal bshad byas pa'i zhor la/ sems khral re gnyis kyang rtag par 'byung /lnga/ dmigs bu lags kyi rtsom des tshe srog la brtsi 'jog dang snang med btang min gyi cha nas brtsams te/ shugs su‘‘kun spyod’’kyi sta re chen pos rtsom hril bor gzhogs gtubs byas 'dug snyam/ tha na/ de lta'i gnad ka dang mthong sne zhig bzung ste/ ‘‘gal srid’’sngon la 'jug chog chog gi sbyor dngos kyis‘‘snyan ngag pas khrims sar gtug bsher byas nas bde skyid la chad gcod byed ma bcug par dmar gsod btang ba de ni tshe srog la rdog rdzi bgyis pa'i sdig spyod ngo ma zhig ma yin nam’’zhes sdom tshig dgod bro ba zhig bzhag 'dug pa ni/ gzu ba btsan po zhig gis khyod don sdum pa 'dra ba'i tshor snang bdag la skyes 'ongs/ der brten/ dmigs bu lags kyis sgrung gtam der lta dus— 252 —

ltung bshags dang gsal bshad/ da dung sems khral re gnyis/‘‘kun spyod rnam gzhag’’sngon du song ste/ rtsom de'i dngos gzhi'i sgyu rtsal gyi cha de dag snang med du bzhag 'dug snyam mur/ deng dus kyi klog pa po dang rtsom dpyad pa gang rung gis‘‘rig gnas mtha' dpyad’’(sprangalta'ilo'irākyā)la a gsar gyi rnam 'gyur 'dzin pa'i grib gzugs mig la 'char zhing / ‘‘grib gzugs’’de ni skabs don gyi sems khral che shos kyang yin/'dir zob la shad dus med pa bzhin 'or bshad re brgyab na/ ngas kyang‘‘gal srid’’ces pa'i dbang cha 'di g.yar te/ gal srid/ sgrung gtam gyi mi sna snyan ngag pas kyang mi bsad pa'i nag nyes ngos len gyi ched du khrims ngor gtugs kyang chad pa nyos par ma zad/ tshe gang bor nongs 'gyod kyis khengs pa zhig tu 'bri dgos tshe/ ma mtha' yang yig grangs kyi cha nas sgrung 'bring gi tshad cig tu 'bri rgyu yod 'dug gal srid/ khrims ngor zhu gtug tu song tshe/ sgyu rtsal gyi bden pa dang skyo gar gyi mdzes pa de lta bu zhig yong khag po red/ gal srid/ snyan ngag pas nag nyes ngos len byas te khrims khang du phyin tshe/ sgrung gtam bye brag pa 'di'i gnas skabs la 'dang brgyab na/ de ni mi sna'i gshis ka'i 'phel 'gyur dang bstun pa min par/ rtsom pa pos‘‘mi mngon pa'i smyu gu gzhan zhig gis’’bsam gzas nas bcos par snang yang srid/‘‘gal srid’’'di dag‘‘kun spyod rnam gzhag’’gi khri la 'gying mkhan tshos‘‘snang med’’dang‘‘rdog rdzir’’gtong bar ngan khag cher dkri rgyu mi 'dug mod/ gang ltar/ nga tshos shes dgos pa nyag gcig ni/ an na kha le nyi na lcags lam du lcebs pa ni sgyu rtsal la dang dod byas pa yin la/ h+phu er ma'o si 'das log brgyab pa ni klog pa por brtsi 'jog byas pas red/drug da lta'i klog 'don rol myong gi thabs dang / rtsom rig dpyad mol(sprastsakātsho kāskye)lam rtsom rig mtha' dpyad(sprastsa7rā༈)bcas gang thad — 253 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/nas bshad na'ang / yun gyis‘‘rig gnas mtha' dpyad’’kyi phyogs su srab med du brgyugs kyang thur med du gzhol ba'i snang ba 'gog min du ster/ de snga rtsom rig mtha' dpyad kyi las ka 'di chab srid dang chos lugs sogs kyi mnga' 'og tu tshud de/ ‘‘gral rim dbye zhib’’dang‘‘dgos sogs chos bzhi’’bcas pa'i dpyad stangs shig sra brtan du chags sgang la/ nga tshos rtsom rig nyid rtsom rig tu rtogs pa'i rnam 'gyur phra mo zhig drang gzhag sgos ston khul gyis/ sgrig gzhi dang rnam pa/ sgyu rtsal dang mdzes dpyod sogs brda chad skor zhig la rkang btsugs te mtha' dpyad kyi lam bur zhugs 'go brtsams mod/‘‘ bsam blo'i rlabs rgyun’’drag tu 'khol ba'i da bar zhig la/ rtsom rig 'di nyid rim gyis‘‘mtshan nyid rig pa'i’’mnga' 'og tu tshud kyang / bsam gzas nas‘‘rig gnas mtha' dpyad’’kyi gral gshar du btsud bzhin pa'i snang tshul mchis/ ma gzhir/ 'di ni rtsom rig gi bzlog tu med pa'i las dbang btsan po dang bsnyon du med pa'i chos nyid cig tu 'khums srid mod/ bltas na 'jigs 'jigs dang bab brling / sgam mdog chags pa'i‘‘rig gnas mtha' dpyad’’kyi me tog 'di nub phyogs su btabs kyang skyes te/ re zhig zhi bde rgya mtsho'i rlung bu dang bsdongs nas 'u cag kha ba'i ljongs la khyab dus/‘‘nam zla drod grang’’sogs rkyen gzhan gyis khyer te dri ma kha bo gzhan zhig 'thul 'dug snga dus nub phyogs yul du/ tshul tsam pa'i ring lugs(༅dz+rartsaspra)dang byung ba brjod pa'i rig pa (྾rgostsa)sogs dar rgyas che ru phyin te brtsams chos kyi phyi shun nas nang snying thug pa'i bar sngog bsher byas mthar/rtsom rig gi lam khegs song ba'i sdom tshig re gnyis rnyed de da gzod‘‘rig gnas mtha' dpyad’’kyi lam du zhugs skad mod/ yin na'ang / 'u tsho'i yul — 254 —

ltung bshags dang gsal bshad/ da dung sems khral re gnyis/dus bye brag pa'i gnas bab la bltas na/ ‘‘rta la ba glang brjod pa'i’’mtha' dpyad ci rigs byung ba dang 'byung bzhin 'dug pas/ kha ba rtags can gyi‘‘rig gnas mtha' dpyad’’'di'ang‘‘byis pa ya ma brla can’’zhig red 'dod/mis lan khon ti la lags kyis‘‘kha h+phi kha zhib 'jug’’la dgag gtam gtong dus/ de tshos kha h+phi kha nyid gom pa re re bzhin mdzes dpyod kyi khyab khongs nas sgor 'phud rtsis 'dug ces pa ste/ 'di ni da lta'i bdag cag gi gnas bab rigs shig dang 'dra 'dra red/ rtsom yig de'i rigs sa khyab rdo khyab tu 'gyur pa'i deng gi dus 'dir/ kho tshor mtshon na/ rang dgar brtsams chos gang rung lag tu thogs te/ brtsams chos de ni dmangs gtso dang rang dbang /'dra mnyam/ yang na kun spyod rnam gzhag gi brda dang tha snyad ci rigs gsed 'grol byed spyad du ci mi snyam par 'jog la rangs mod/ ma bsams sa nas brtsams chos dngos de yig tshags rig shig gam yang na sngon du 'gro ba gzhir byas kyi rang gi lta ba gang rung sgrub byed kho nar gyur 'dug dper na/ me lce lags kyi〈〈rang khyim〉las mthong ba'i rang dbang〉zhes pa'i rtsom dpyad du/(〈bdag dpe tshogs〉las〈mi gzhi'i snying stobs〉zhes par gsal) rtsom gyi dngos gzhi las tshig dum tsam bsal te/ ‘‘red ya/ rang dbang’’ni zhes pa'i bshad stangs kyis 'khyer cing / rang dbang zhes pa'i brda chad kho nas 'bru 'grel lta bu brgyab yod pas mtshon thub/ de dus bdag cag gi rtsom pa po kha cig na re/ci'i phyir nga'i brtsams chos de dag sgyu rtsal gyi cha nas khas ma blangs par/gzhung lugs sgrub pa'i lag cha lta bur gyur song zhes blong blong bor par yang khag med pa red/bdun/ spyir na/ ‘‘rtsom rig’’la zhib 'jug dang brtsams chos la dpyad pa gtong mkham/ tshos kyang ci zhig ‘‘sgyu rtsal’’dang gang zhig ‘‘mdzes — 255 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/dpyod’’zer bzhin/ brtsams chos kyi dngos shugs gang rung las mngon pa'i mi chos dang kun spyod/ chos lugs sogs spyi tshogs tshan rig gi lta ba ci rigs thos kyang mi nyan pa/ mthong yang mi 'dzin pa'i brtul zhugs kho na blangs tshe/ de ni mi 'os pa'i gnas kho nar mthong mod/ rtsa ba'i rtsa ba ni rtsom rig sgyu rtsal zhes pa'i sgyu rtsal las phyi'i sgyu rtsal gyi cha tsam ste/ rtsed mo rtse na rtsed srol yod pa'i dpe bzhin/ ‘‘rtsed srol’’de tsam la'ang dmigs pa med na yan lag dor ba dang gcig red/ sgrung gtam zhig la cha mtshon na/ brjod 'dod kyi don gang zhig rjod stangs kyi lam gang zhig bdams nas mtshon rgyu yin pa lta bu ste/ de las phyi'i sgyu rtsal rnyed/ de las nang gi mdzes dpyod mthong / de las‘‘rig gnas’’sngog kyang chog da gzod de las klog pa po'i dga' skyo chags sdang dang‘‘nying mtshams’’spyor sa rnyed na 'grig pa red/ snyan ngag pa dur khrod kyi sems khams dang shi rkyen sogs kyang de 'dra'i thabs dang rnam pa/dper na/ mthong sne brje spor sogs kyi ngal ba bzung ste‘‘tshig tshogs’’spros nas ma brjod na‘‘phyod 'bras’’(ste/skorngo)de 'dra yong mi thub/ ma gtogs/snyan ngag pa dur khrod kyis 'tsho ba'i dka' khag dang sems ngal gyi khur ma theg par dbugs snum rgya ma lnga bcu nyos rjes‘‘khyi rgan khyi mo’’gnyis gson sreg byas pa red ces sdom tshig thung ngu zhig gis 'thus su rung la/ 'thus pa de tsam la'ang nga tsho‘‘dpyad pa po’’rnams kyis‘‘kun spyod rnam gzhag’’dang‘‘tshe srog gi dbang cha'i’’ngos nas ci 'dod du 'bri chog chog yin/ gal srid de ltar byas pa yin na/ des nga tsho'i brtsams chos la brdar sha gcod pa'i mdzes dpyod kyi nus pa je zhan du mi gtong ba'i nges pa med de/ sgrung gtam sdug thug cig yin rung / ‘‘rgyu cha’’zhig gi ngos nas de la gsed 'grol rgya cher bya chog pa'i stong cha yod nges yin/ dper na/ che ge mo'i nyin thor/ bkra shis kyis slob — 256 —

ltung bshags dang gsal bshad/ da dung sems khral re gnyis/grogs 'brug mor gcar rdung gtong bzhin 'dug na'ang / nga bkra shis la skrag pas bar bshol ma thub lta bur mtshon na/ nga tshos bkra shis kyis bud med kyi thob thang la brtsi 'jog mi byed pa dang / ‘‘nga’’la'ang bden don gyi ched du rang srog blos gtong ba lta bu'i spobs pa mi 'dug ces bris te/ mu mthud du bud med kyi thob thang zer ba dang bden don zer ba ga 'dra yin tshul sogs rgyas bshad bya los chog de 'dra'i‘‘rig gnas mtha' dpyad’’kyi khor yug rim gyis je stug tu phyin na/ klog pa po gang mang la dngos gnas‘‘nor 'khrul’’gyi lta ba ci rigs bsgo srid de/ cis kyang sgyu rtsal brtsams chos su brtsi mi rung ba'i‘‘yig cha’’gang rung yang rtsom rig brtsams chos yin pa'i snang ba skyes srid pa red/

rtog btags kyi yid brnyan/rgya mtsho 'bum/klog pa po'i bsam phyogs/snyan ngag 'di mi yul la 'tshar longs bskyed pa po ni sku zhabs ljang bu yin la/ khong ni rtsom rig las don la grub 'bras yod pa/ 'jon thang ldan pa/ yid dpyod che ba/ rtog btags kyi blo stobs mtho ba'i rtsom pa po dang /'grul bzhud pa sogs kyi mtshan nyid gnyer ba'i skyes bu zhig red/ la las khong gi skye rgyud shes kyang snyan ngag gi lta ba mi rtogs/ la las khong gi snyan ngag gi lta ba(rang rang gi tshod)gsal yang khong gi skye rgyud mi shes/ shes blun gnyis kyi sa mtshams nas khong dang khong gi snyan ngag la gdeng 'jog dang pha mtha' e rnyed blta ba'i skye bo gang mang re mchis ang / khong gis‘‘klog pa po zhig gi ngos nas bshad na/ khong(rtsom pa po)dang gleng mol brgyud de kho'i nang sems la 'dzul ba'i dmigs yul 'grub thabs byed pa'i thabs gtso bo ni/ khong dang mnyam du a rag pi tsi do gsum rer rol zhor sha rgya ma zlagang do zhig bza' ba de min la/ gleng mol tshogs 'du zhig las khong la gsung bshad dum bu gnang ba'i re zhu byed pa'ang ma yin te/ gal te khyod rang khong dang bar thag ring sar bsdad nas khong gi brtsams chos klog thub na de ni thabs lam 'ba' — 258 —

rtog btags kyi yid brnyan/zhig go’’ces pa nang bzhin/ ngas kyang khong gi〈'jig rten dang mi〉zhes pa'i snyan ngag de bklags par myong tshor gyi na bun ban bun 'di 'dra zhig 'thibs dgos byung /nga tsho gnas sa'i 'jig rten 'di ni res 'gar kha dog dmar po dang sngo skya/ ljang khu dang dkar po sogs kyi khor yug gi 'gyur ldog dang phyi'i snod bcud thams cad ni res 'gar 'jam zhing mnyen pa 'dra ba dang re 'gar tsub cing gyong ba 'dra ba ma zad/ mi'i rigs gtso bor gyur pa'i nang bcud kyi sems can rnams kyang res 'gar yi gar 'ong zhing res 'gar zhe la gnod pa 'dra ba sogs kyis 'gal 'du chen po zhig yin/ de'i khrod na bden rdzun dang yag btsog phan gnod/ bzang ngan/ thob go sa/ rgyu 'byor ba/mtshan snyan grags/ pham gyong kha/ khe dge ba sogs kyi 'gal 'du mang po mchis par khong gis de dag gi dkar po gang dang nag po gang yin gyi don rtsa de rdog tu bzung nas〈'jig rten dang mi/ shog dkar dang nag thig〉ces pa'i kha byang dang brjod snying / lhug rkang 'phrod pa/ tshig gdangs legs pa'i snyan ngag 'di ljang bu'i sems rtsa na rgyu ba'i khrag dron zhig yin pa dang / nga tsho'i rtsa lam gyi sbubs nas 'phyur ba'i chu mig dwangs mo zhig yin par snyam/rtsom pa po'i sems sgra/phyi khor yug dang nang 'gro ba gnyis kyi 'brel 'dris zab mo de las 'phros pa ni dkar nag gi spyi 'gros yin la/ dkar nag gi spyi 'gros gnyer mkhan yang srid pa'i 'jig rten 'dir 'tsho ba'i mi'i rigs yin/ khong gi bsam blo'i 'char sgo rnam par bskyed de 'char yan ring lugs kyi rtsom stangs kyis‘‘shog dkar dang nag thig’’gi sgyu rtsal de 'jig rten khams kyi mi su yin — 259 —

mu tig glija gi dga' ston/yang semasal gsal bris byas yod/ he kel gyis‘‘sgyu rtsal gyi mdzes pa ni rang byung gi mdzes pa las mtho ba red’’ces gsungs pa ni/ rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi lag len dngos yin la rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi thabs lam yang dag pa'ang yin/sku zhabs ljang bus kyang‘‘mi’’zhes pa'i sha khrag rus gsum gyi phung bo tshang ba/blo rig rnam dpyod kyi shes pa ldan pa de la mi tshe'i rin thang ji lta bu yod na kun gyis yod mos pa dang gang lta bu ma tshang na kun pos ngan smra ba'i ngag sgo‘‘shog dkar dang nag thig’’gnyis la kha g.yar te/ dgod pa'i kha la bltas nas dgod bro ba dang ngu ba'i kha la bltas nas ngu bro ba'i lam kha de na rang la tshad ldan gyi dmigs 'bras re nam yang ma yod pas/ mdzes mdzes mtshar mtshar dang sgrub sgrub dka' dka' yi las shig la thug tshe/ kha gdangs pa dang mig cer nas ha las 'gro ba'i rnam pa de ngom don gtan nas ma yod pas/ rang gi brtse dung la rang gis 'od snang sbyin dgos pa'i sems sgra bsgrags yod/shog dkar gyi tha snyad mched don/yong gin yong gin 'gro bzhin 'gro bzhin du/ don du yong mi tshang ma 'gro mi red/ ces pa ltar du yong na yong don/ 'gro na 'gro don gang 'jog rgyu de mi su dang su yin gyi re smon legs po dang phugs 'dun zab mo yin pa khong gis‘‘shog dkar’’zhig la sems gtam bcol nas mi'i rigs la dran skul gyi cong sgra bsgrags/ yang na/ yangs pa'i 'jig rten chen po 'di shog dkar thar gcig gi dbang du btang na/ nga tsho shog dkar 'di'i steng nas lte khrag 'phos la shog dkar 'di'i steng nas 'tsho ba rol dus don sgo ci yang ma 'khyongs par mig mchi ma lhung zhor kha mid thag skam pa'i ngang mi tshe ring mo'i me tog de sad kyis bcom dus/ ches ngo gnongs pa dang ches 'u thug pa de — 260 —

rtog btags kyi yid brnyan/khong gis ma bzod gas snyan tshig gcig na'ang‘‘nga tshor dogs pa dang the tshom dgos don med/ bde skyid kyi dpal yod dgos’’ces mdzad pa rlabs chen de ma brjed par‘‘nag thig’’cig la blo sgo g.yar nas mi'i rigs kyi 'tsho ba 'di la kha mig yar blta byas te mi re rer mi tshe'i lta ba yod dgos pa ma zad/ ‘‘nga 'di ru skyes/ nga 'di na yod’’ces kha bsgo mthon po'am lag rdang dam po re dgos pas legs byas kyi snum thig zab mo re re mi tshe ring mo'i shog dkar de'i steng du nag gor rer lhung yod tshe/ de ni ma bcos sems kyi dpa' gdeng rlabs chen zhig yin par brjod/nag thig gi 'bras bu/‘‘mi zhig skyes pa'i don sgo lag rjes yin na’’gzhan la gnod dang ngan/gyong dang khe/ rku 'phrog chom gsum sogs kyi las ka mang mang re byas nas kha bza' btung dang rgyab gon pa tsam gyi phyogs nayomi tshe ring mo zhig tshar na/de las phangs pa dang 'gyod pa dang yi mug pa zhig gzhan na med pa dge chos kyis‘‘bza' btung longs spyod phyi ru skyid chas tsam 'grigs kyang / blo bde gu yangs nang gi skyid nyams de mi 'dug’’ces sems gtam dron po re bzhag par yang khag mi 'dug de bzhin ljang bus kyang dkar po'i rin thang med par nag po'i zhe rtsa rgod pa de ches blun rtags chen po re yin la/ mi skyes kyi mtshan ma thob dus 'dir 'jig rten mi chos kyi bya ba gang dang gang yin kyang skye 'gro pho mo sus kyang ro thod sa la thim rag bar las dgos pa bsnyon du med pa de mtshon pa'i thabs su dkar po dang nag thig gi mjug 'bras gshib bsdur byas yod/rdza dpal sprul gyis kyang‘‘kha phar 'khor nas gzhan gyi bzang ngan yin — 261 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/ min de bshad ki ma 'dug par tshur rang gis rang lam la zhog rang rgyud 'di rang gis bcos’’zhes gsungs don yang / dkar po dang nag po gnyis kyi rin thang la dmigs pa los yin/ ljang bus kyang legs nyes kyi dkar khung de rgan dar gzhon gsum la ston ched kha dog dkar nag gnyis kyi steng nas sgyu rtsal gyi snang brnyan 'tsho bzhin pa de klog po po dag gi yid la par dang brnyan ris tshul du bzhengs yod/mjug bsdu ba'i gtam/spyir mi don re la kha blta bgyi skabs dus rabs shig gi 'khor phyogs gang dang gang yag thog yag gang dang gang ngan thog ngan gyi bya ba de dkar po dang nag po gnyis las ma 'das la/ rang rang gi nus tshod de rang rang la gsal bas/ dkar nag gi dbye ba 'byed rgyu'ang de las gzhan du kha brda dron po 'ig su la'ang gleng rgyu med/dge chos kyis 'di skad/ ‘‘dbang 'byor khrag la rngams pa'i me 'bar ba'i/ / dmar ser phrag dog mig la cher 'jigs kyang / / gnag chung thos pa bsags pa'i bag chags la/ / goms 'di rang sems rigs pa'i gtam la chags’’zhes bzang por bzang ma smras na bzang po kho chad/ ngan par ngan ma smras na ngan pa ngo ldang gi snang tshul der gzigs nas/ phrag dog bar nas mi sems thal bar gtong ba de tsho yid la mi mdzes rung / mi lus thengs gcig thob pa'i bskal ba la shes rig gi gtam yag po re gleng rgyu de ches yid du 'ong ba'i bag chags zab mo zhig la brtsis te/ der phyir 'dang re brgyab na ljang bus kyang dkar po zhig gi bden kha ma dor bar nag po re la sdang mig bgrad yod ces gleng chog chog red/— 262 —

mjug byang /dus rabs nyi shu pa'i lo rabs brgyad cu pa nas bzung / 'dzam gling rig gnas kyi chu klong chen po'i khrod nas mi chos rig gnas kyi grub cha gtso bo zhig ste‘‘rtsom rig’’ces pa 'di kha ba can gyi bsam pa'i longs spyod cig tu gyur pa sngon las mngon gsal lags/ lo ngo nyi shu lhag gi ring 'dir rtsom rig la 'jug mi mang ba dang gsar rtsom gyi 'phel kha myur ba dang spus kyang je yag yin na'ang / la shas kyis 'u cag la dmangs kyi blo dpal 'tsho ba'i rtsom rig da rung mi 'dug ces kyang smra/ gang ltar kyang 'u cag gi gom stabs je mgyogs yin la mgrin dbyangs je mtho yin pa kho thag red/ rtsom rig gi gsar rtsom dang mtha' dpyad gnyis ni bya zhig la mtshon na gshog zung ltar te/gshog pa gnyis las gang zhig gnyom na'ang rtsom rig gi glag rgod de a sngon dbyings nas rang dbang dang ldan pa'i lding skor rgyag mi thub pa ji bzhin 'u cag gi da lta'i rtsom rig zhing khams la bltas na/ gsar rtsom gyi gshog pa rgyas shing mtha' dpyad kyi gshog pa da rung gnyom pa'i nyams snang zhig 'gog med du skyes 'ong / 'u cag gi dpyad mol ru dpung de da dung ha cang gnyom zhing / gsar rtsom gyi nyams myong ngam bslab bya spyi sdom dang spang blang blo skyed thad nas gom stabs dal la yon tan dma' ba tsam du snang / gnas tshul 'di 'dra zhig la dmigs nas nged tshags par khang gis spyi lo19tsheto/bhe 263 —

mu tig gling gi dga' ston/ma 5lo'i bar gyi〈rig rtsal gzhogs bkod〉par ngos steng gi〈mu tig gling〉(snga thog〈rtsom dpyad mu tig gsal 'don〉zer)zhes pa'i le tshan du bkod zin pa'i dpyad mol gyi rtsom legs shos rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/〈mu tig gling gi dga' ston〉zhes bya ba'i deb 'dir bdams pa'i dpyad mol dag gi nang don gyi cha nas sgrung gtam dang snyan ngag lhug rtsom bcas la dpyad pa dang/ ngag rgyun rtsom rig dang rtsom rig grub mtha' dang rtsom pa po dang bsam blo'i 'khyer so sogs la rigs pa chu thub kyis dpyad pa btang ba yang yod/ dpyad mol rtsom stangs kyi cha nas bshad na/ lta tshul gsar pa yin pa dang gzhal bya gsar pa yin pa dang 'dzin phyogs gsar pa yin pa sogs kyi khyad chos ldan/ de yang deb 'di'i dkar chag sgrig rim ni rtsom yig de tshags par steng spel ba'i lo zla'i snga phyi ltar bsgrigs pa yin la/dpyad mol pa rnams kyi rtsom 'dem tshad ni gsum las brgal med pas 'dir ched du babrod gsol zhu ba dang / gzhan yang deb 'di las 'byung ba'i phyi gling gi mi ming skor zhig〈bdag dpe tshogs〉ltar bsgyur yod pa bcas gsal bshad sgron pa yin/deb 'dis kyang bod kyi rtsom rig gi 'phel rgyas la phyar ba gru 'degs kyi dge mtshan 'byung bar gyur cigaces deb 'di'i sgrig pa po gcod pa klu rgyal gyis spyi lugs216lo'i zla3pa'i ches7nyin zi ling du bris/— 264 —

rtsom sgrig 'gan 'khur pa/ 'brug mo skyid/ gcod pa klu rgyal/r+sā4rwatshir+sā ṣā cha oṃ kro༅stome0mdun shog jus 'god pa/ me long /dh+ra1khroshārnye༈ zlo2mu tig gling gi dga' ston/sgrig pa po/ mtsho sngon bod yig gsar 'gyur khang /dpe skrun mkhan/ mi rigs dpe skrun khang /'grems spel mkhan/ mi rigs dpe skrun khang /gnas yul/ pe cin ho phing li byang lam ang 14pa/sbrag srid ang grangs/ 100013kha par ang grangs/ 010—64275311par 'debs mkhan/ pe cin ti zhin par 'debs tshad yod kung si/brgyud 'chong mkhan/ rgyal yongs sa gnas so so'i zhin hwa dpe tshong khang /deb tshad/ 850pa༄ ྾116807ba 1 khri2par gzhi'i sgrig thengs/ 2006lo'i zla 6par par gzhi dang po bsgrigs/par thengs/ 2006lo'i zla 6par pe cin du par thengs dang po brgyab/ljaragrangs/ glu01—1500—na gong / sgor 14 50
